### [1] [Unified Backbone Refinement for Diffusion Models via Internal-Latent Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09753)
*Haksoo Lim,Myeongjin Lee,Wonjoon Chang,Jaesik Choi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DUNE，一种无需训练的扩散模型精炼框架，通过检测并抑制深层低噪潜在表示中的突变来减少伪影和幻觉，提升生成保真度。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 扩散模型的性能与参数化评分函数的去噪骨干网络密切相关，但现有方法缺乏对扩散组件在时间阶段上的系统性分析，导致生成结果中仍存在伪影和幻觉。

Method: DUNE框架包含两个核心步骤：(1) 检测阶段：基于共享的EMA（指数移动平均）准则，检测深层低噪内部潜在表示中的突变偏差；(2) 抑制阶段：对检测器选中的条目应用骨干网络专用的抑制操作。该检测-抑制原理从U-Net自然扩展至Transformer架构，作用于深度自注意力块的潜在表示。

Result: 在多种骨干网络上的大量实验表明，DUNE在提升生成保真度的同时减少了幻觉现象。

Conclusion: 本文提供了关于扩散骨干网络应在何时、何地被控制的新见解，并验证了无需额外训练的轻量级干预即可有效改善生成质量的可行性。

Original Abstract: Diffusion models have achieved remarkable success across diverse domains, with performance closely related to the denoising backbones that parameterize the score function. In this paper, we present a systematic, phase-aware analysis of diffusion components and show that abrupt, early-stage fluctuations in deep latents are strongly associated with artifacts. Guided by these findings, we introduce DUNE (Diffusion Unified Network refiNEr), a training-free refinement framework that detects abrupt deviations in deep low-noise internal latents using a shared EMA-based criterion, and applies backbone-specific suppression to the detector-selected entries. Although derived from U-Net, the same detect-suppress principle extends naturally to Transformer-based diffusion models by acting on the latents of deep self-attention blocks. Extensive experiments across multiple backbones indicate that DUNE improves fidelity while reducing hallucinations, offering new insight into where and when diffusion backbones should be controlled.

中文摘要翻译: 扩散模型在多个领域取得了显著成功，其性能与参数化评分函数的去噪骨干网络密切相关。本文对扩散组件进行了系统的、阶段感知的分析，发现深层潜在表示中的早期阶段突变与伪影高度相关。基于这些发现，我们提出了DUNE（扩散统一网络精炼器），一种无需训练的精炼框架，它使用共享的基于EMA的准则检测深层低噪内部潜在表示中的突变偏差，并对检测器选中的条目应用骨干网络专用的抑制操作。尽管该方法源于U-Net，但相同的检测-抑制原理通过作用于深度自注意力块的潜在表示，能够自然地扩展到基于Transformer的扩散模型。在多种骨干网络上进行的大量实验表明，DUNE在提升保真度的同时减少了幻觉，为理解应在何时、何地对扩散骨干网络进行控制提供了新的见解。

</details>


### [2] [Cross-Subject Modeling for Widefield Calcium Imaging via Atlas-Aligned Spatiotemporal Tokenization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09754)
*Mohammad Hosseini,Eray Erturk,Saba Hashemi,Maryam M. Shanechi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: WiCAT是一个基于自监督预训练的多主体宽场钙成像基础模型，通过图谱锚定的分词方案学习全局共享的时空表征，在多个数据集上超越单会话模型，并首次实现对未见主体的零样本行为解码和脑区重建。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 宽场钙成像数据维度高、时空结构复杂且包含大量与任务无关的神经活动，现有模型大多局限于单会话分析，缺乏可扩展性和泛化能力；多主体预训练模型在宽场钙成像领域尚未被探索，且跨神经模态的零样本行为解码仍是一大难题。

Method: 提出WiCAT模型，采用图谱锚定的分词方案（atlas-grounded tokenization），无需会话特定组件；通过自监督预训练学习全局共享的时空表征，支持轻量级下游解码，并实现跨主体、跨任务、跨数据集的迁移。

Result: 在多个宽场钙成像数据集上，WiCAT预训练模型优于单会话基线模型；支持轻量级下游解码；实现了对未见主体的鲁棒零样本连续行为解码和留出脑区重建。

Conclusion: WiCAT是迈向宽场数据基础建模的第一步，证明了自监督预训练在多主体宽场钙成像中的有效性，为零样本行为解码和跨主体泛化提供了新范式。

Original Abstract: Large-scale, multi-subject widefield calcium imaging provides unprecedented access to brain-wide cortical dynamics. However, the high dimensionality, complex spatiotemporal structure, and substantial task-irrelevant activity in widefield recordings have largely restricted modeling efforts to single-session analyses, limiting scalability and generalization. While multi-subject pretrained models have been explored for some neural modalities, multi-subject models for widefield calcium imaging have not yet been demonstrated; further, subject-invariant zero-shot behavior decoding remains elusive for multi-subject models across neural modalities more broadly. As a first step toward foundation modeling of widefield data, we introduce WiCAT, a multi-subject model that leverages self-supervised pretraining to both outperform single-session models and enable zero-shot behavior decoding on unseen subjects. WiCAT introduces an atlas-grounded tokenization scheme without session-specific components and learns globally shared spatiotemporal representations. Across multiple widefield datasets, the pretrained model supports lightweight downstream decoding, transfers across subjects, tasks, and datasets, and outperforms baseline models. Notably, the model also achieves robust zero-shot continuous behavior decoding and left-out brain region reconstruction on unseen subjects.

中文摘要翻译: 大规模、多主体的宽场钙成像技术为大脑皮层动态活动提供了前所未有的观测能力。然而，宽场记录数据的高维度、复杂时空结构以及大量与任务无关的神经活动，使得建模工作大多局限于单会话分析，严重限制了模型的可扩展性与泛化能力。尽管多主体预训练模型已在某些神经模态中有所探索，但面向宽场钙成像的多主体模型尚未被验证；此外，更广泛地看，跨神经模态的多主体模型中仍缺乏可实现主体无关的零样本行为解码能力。作为宽场数据基础建模的第一步，我们提出了WiCAT——一种多主体模型，它利用自监督预训练不仅超越了单会话模型，还能对未见主体实现零样本行为解码。WiCAT引入了一种基于图谱锚定的分词方案（无需会话特定组件），学习全局共享的时空表征。在多个宽场钙成像数据集上，该预训练模型支持轻量级下游解码，能够跨主体、跨任务和跨数据集迁移，并优于基线模型。值得注意的是，该模型在未见主体上还实现了鲁棒的零样本连续行为解码和留出脑区重建。

</details>


### [3] [RSLoRA: Training-free Rank Allocation for LoRA via Representational Sensitivity Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09757)
*Jiaqi Liu,Haidong Kang,Qihui Zhao,Guo Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: RSLoRA是一种无需训练和梯度的秩分配方法，通过激活空间几何分析层敏感性，为低秩适配（LoRA）动态分配秩，在多个基准上优于AdaLoRA、GoRA等现有方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统LoRA使用统一秩分配，忽略了神经层的功能异质性；现有秩分配方法在计算开销与启发式简单性之间存在权衡——基于训练的方法开销过高，而预分配方法无法捕捉动态的任务特定表示流形。

Method: 提出RSLoRA框架，通过虚拟表示探测机制：模拟低秩噪声结构化适配，利用有效秩（Effective Rank）和弗雷歇距离（Fréchet Distance）测量表示流形位移，从而识别需要更高秩的高敏感性模块。

Result: 在主流基准测试中，RSLoRA一致性地优于最先进的秩分配方法（如AdaLoRA、GoRA）。

Conclusion: RSLoRA消除了迭代训练调整和反向梯度的需求，提供了一种高效、鲁棒且具有表示感知能力的大规模模型适配方案。

Original Abstract: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has become a cornerstone of parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT); however, the conventional practice of uniform rank assignment ignores the functional heterogeneity of neural layers. Existing rank allocation methods typically struggle with a trade-off between computational intensity and heuristic simplicity: training-based methods suffer from prohibitive overhead, while pre-allocation methods fail to capture the dynamic task-specific representation manifold. In this paper, we propose RSLoRA (Representational Sensitivity LoRA), a training-free and gradient-free rank allocator driven by activation-space geometry. We identify a "sensitivity regime shift" across layers, observing that static weight analysis and local gradients are insufficient to reflect how updates reshape a model's internal representations. To address this, RSLoRA introduces a virtual representational probing mechanism. By simulating adaptation through structured low-rank noise and measuring the resulting manifold displacement by using Effective Rank and Frechet Distance, we identify high-sensitivity modules that require higher rank capacity. Our framework effectively bridges the gap between expert-crafted heuristics and actual representational impact. Extensive evaluations demonstrate that RSLoRA consistently outperforms state-of-the-art allocators (e.g., AdaLoRA, GoRA) across mainstream benchmarks. By eliminating the need for iterative training-time adjustments and backward gradients, RSLoRA provides a highly efficient, robust, and representation-aware solution for large-scale model adaptation.

中文摘要翻译: 低秩适配（LoRA）已成为参数高效微调（PEFT）的基石；然而，传统统一秩分配的做法忽视了神经层的功能异质性。现有的秩分配方法通常在计算强度与启发式简单性之间权衡：基于训练的方法开销过高，而预分配方法则无法捕捉动态的任务特定表示流形。在本文中，我们提出RSLoRA（表征敏感性LoRA），一种由激活空间几何驱动的无需训练和无需梯度的秩分配器。我们识别出跨层的"敏感性区间转移"，观察到静态权重分析和局部梯度不足以反映更新如何重塑模型的内部表征。为解决这一问题，RSLoRA引入了一种虚拟表示探测机制。通过模拟结构化低秩噪声的适配，并利用有效秩（Effective Rank）和弗雷歇距离（Fréchet Distance）测量所得流形位移，我们识别出需要更高秩容量的高敏感性模块。我们的框架有效弥合了专家设计的启发式方法与实际表征影响之间的差距。大量评估表明，RSLoRA在主流基准测试中一致性地优于最先进的分配器（如AdaLoRA、GoRA）。通过消除迭代训练时调整和反向梯度的需求，RSLoRA为大尺度模型适配提供了一种高效、鲁棒且具有表征感知能力的解决方案。

</details>


### [4] [ReflectWorld-MM: An Entity-Oriented Multi-Media Memory System for Open-Ended Video Streams](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09759)
*Xiaokang Ma,Yifan Sun,Zhihong Jin,Jie Gu,Yudong Luo,Shenyi Shao,Chu Tang,Jingmin Chen,Li Pu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ReflectWorld-MM 提出了一种面向实体的多媒体记忆系统，用于开放式视频流，通过分层长期记忆（情景记忆、语义记忆、程序记忆）实现对持续视频流中实体和事件的长期跟踪与推理，在六个长视频和终身记忆基准上均取得最佳准确率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有系统要么将记忆保持在模型上下文中，要么存储在扁平特征存储中，且围绕帧而非流中持续存在的实体组织记忆，这限制了它们在有限视频上的应用，削弱了随时间追踪重复出现的人和物的能力。

Method: ReflectWorld-MM 包含三部分：1) 感知前端，将流式视频转换为实体解析的观测（有界短期记忆）；2) 基于人类记忆理论的分层长期记忆，包括多尺度情景记忆、演化的实体中心语义记忆和程序记忆；3) 面向真实世界操作的完整实现，可接收任意流并接入现成助手。

Result: 在六个长视频和终身记忆基准上均取得最佳准确率，优于强记忆智能体和前沿模型。

Conclusion: 面向实体的多尺度分层记忆系统在开放式视频流任务上显著优于现有基于帧或扁平记忆的方法。

Original Abstract: Building assistants that can continually watch the world, remember what they see, and reason over their accumulated experience is a long-standing goal, and recently multimodal agents equipped with long-term memory over video streams have attracted increasing interest. Unfortunately, existing systems either keep their memory inside the model context or in a flat feature store, and organize it around frames rather than around the persistent entities a stream is really about, which confines them to bounded videos and weakens their ability to track who and what reappears over time. In this paper, we propose ReflectWorld-MM, an entity-oriented multi-media memory system for open-ended video streams. It consists of three parts. The first is a perception front-end that turns a streaming video into entity-resolved observations under a bounded short-term memory. The second is a hierarchical long-term memory, grounded in human memory theory, that couples a multi-scale episodic memory, an evolving entity-centric semantic memory, and a procedural memory. The third is a complete realization, built for real-world operation, that ingests arbitrary streams and plugs into off-the-shelf assistants. Across six long-video and lifelong-memory benchmarks, ReflectWorld-MM achieves the best accuracy on all six, outperforming strong memory agents and a frontier model.

中文摘要翻译: 构建能够持续观察世界、记忆所见内容并基于累积经验进行推理的助手是一个长期目标，近年来，配备视频流长期记忆的多模态智能体引起了越来越多的兴趣。不幸的是，现有系统要么将记忆保持在模型上下文中，要么存储在扁平特征存储中，并且围绕帧而非流真正涉及的持久实体来组织记忆，这限制了它们在有限视频上的应用，削弱了随时间追踪重复出现的人和物的能力。在本文中，我们提出 ReflectWorld-MM，一种面向实体的开放视频流多媒体记忆系统。它由三部分组成。第一部分是一个感知前端，将流式视频在有界短期记忆下转换为实体解析的观测。第二部分是一种基于人类记忆理论的分层长期记忆，它耦合了多尺度情景记忆、演化的实体中心语义记忆和程序记忆。第三部分是一个完整的实现，为真实世界操作而构建，可接收任意流并接入现成助手。在六个长视频和终身记忆基准上，ReflectWorld-MM 在所有六个基准上均取得了最佳准确率，优于强记忆智能体和前沿模型。

</details>


### [5] [Knowledge-Constrained Shape Optimization with a Mixture-of-Experts Neural Operator for High-Confidence Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09763)
*Wenhao Fan,Yuanwei Bin,Jianghan Gu,Wenfa Luo,Jiao Xiang,Yuntian Chen,Shiyi Chen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种知识约束的形状优化框架，结合混合专家神经算子（MoE-NO）和不确定性估计策略，实现了工程感知的可控约束优化，在气动数据集上取得了优于基线的预测精度，并实现了约4%-10%的阻力系数降低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 工程形状优化面临两个主要挑战：一是优化设置（如可编辑区域、变形范围、设计保持约束）通常依赖专家手动指定；二是基于代理模型的优化在异构几何数据库和分布外设计上可能不可靠。

Method: 提出知识约束形状优化框架，将知识约束和用户意图转化为DFFD变形算子的可量化参数；开发混合专家神经算子（MoE-NO）提升异构气动数据集上的阻力预测和趋势一致性；基于MoE-NO编码器和马氏距离引入不确定性估计策略，检测分布外几何并选择性触发物理求解器反馈进行局部样本丰富化。

Result: 在MPV、SUV、Sedan数据集上，MoE-NO测试集MAPE达1.16%，趋势预测准确率达94.34%，优于基线最优的1.52%和90.34%；车辆形状优化实验经CFD验证实现约4%-10%的阻力系数降低。

Conclusion: 所提框架通过知识约束和MoE-NO有效解决了形状优化中的专家依赖和代理模型不可靠问题，实现了工程感知的可控优化，并在实际气动设计中取得了显著性能提升。

Original Abstract: Engineering shape optimization faces challenges in both expert-dependent problem setup and surrogate-model reliability. In practical aerodynamic design, optimization settings such as editable regions, deformation ranges, and design-preservation constraints are typically specified manually by experienced engineers, while surrogate-based optimization may become unreliable for heterogeneous geometry databases and out-of-distribution designs. To address these challenges, we propose a knowledge-constrained shape-optimization framework that translates knowledge-based constraints and user intent into quantifiable parameters of DFFD-based deformation operators, enabling engineering-aware and controllable constrained optimization. We further develop a Mixture-of-Experts Neural Operator (MoE-NO) to improve drag prediction and trend consistency over heterogeneous aerodynamic datasets. Based on the MoE-NO encoder and Mahalanobis distance, an uncertainty-estimation strategy is introduced to detect out-of-distribution geometries and selectively trigger physics-solver feedback for local sample enrichment. Experiments on in-house MPV, SUV, and Sedan datasets show that MoE-NO achieves a test-set MAPE of $1.16\%$ and a trend-prediction accuracy of $94.34\%$, outperforming the best baseline results of $1.52\%$ and $90.34\%$, respectively. Vehicle shape-optimization experiments further yield CFD-validated drag coefficient reductions of approximately $4\%$ to $10\%$.

中文摘要翻译: 工程形状优化面临着专家依赖的问题设置和代理模型可靠性两方面的挑战。在实际气动设计中，可编辑区域、变形范围和设计保持约束等优化设置通常由经验丰富的工程师手动指定，而基于代理模型的优化在异构几何数据库和分布外设计场景下可能变得不可靠。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了一种知识约束的形状优化框架，将基于知识的约束和用户意图转化为DFFD变形算子的可量化参数，从而实现工程感知且可控的约束优化。我们进一步开发了混合专家神经算子（MoE-NO），以提升在异构气动数据集上的阻力预测和趋势一致性。基于MoE-NO编码器和马氏距离，引入了一种不确定性估计策略，用于检测分布外几何形状，并选择性触发物理求解器反馈进行局部样本丰富化。在内部MPV、SUV和轿车数据集上的实验表明，MoE-NO的测试集平均绝对百分比误差（MAPE）达到1.16%，趋势预测准确率达94.34%，优于最优基线结果（分别为1.52%和90.34%）。车辆形状优化实验进一步获得了经CFD验证的约4%至10%的阻力系数降低。

</details>


### [6] [Low-Power License Plate Detection and Recognition on a RISC-V Multi-Core MCU-Based Vision System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09768)
*Lorenzo Lamberti,Manuele Rusci,Marco Fariselli,Francesco Paci,Luca Benini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次展示了基于低功耗MCU的边缘设备用于自动车牌识别（ALPR），采用9核RISC-V处理器GAP8和QVGA超低功耗灰度图像传感器，通过SSDlite-MobilenetV2与LPRNet的多模型推理管线，在117mW功耗下实现1.09 FPS的吞吐量，能量效率比Raspberry Pi3系统高出73倍。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有ALPR系统多依赖高性能计算平台（如Raspberry Pi3），功耗较高，难以部署于资源受限的边缘设备。本文旨在探索在MCU级别的超低功耗设备上实现高效ALPR的可行性，以兼顾性能与能效。

Method: 基于9核RISC-V处理器GAP8和QVGA超低功耗灰度图像传感器，采用SSDlite-MobilenetV2进行车牌检测、LPRNet进行光学字符识别的多模型推理管线，并应用压缩与优化策略实现低功耗高效推理。

Result: 车牌检测mAP达38.9%，字符识别率>99.13%；在真实数据上可识别小至30x5像素的车牌；多模型推理（687 MMAC）在GAP8上达1.09 FPS，功耗仅117 mW；能量效率比Raspberry Pi3系统高73倍。

Conclusion: 本文首次在MCU级设备上实现了具备如此网络复杂度的ALPR系统，且未依赖任何硬连线加速引擎，保留了算法改进的完全灵活性，为超低功耗边缘AI推理提供了可行方案。

Original Abstract: In this paper, we present the first (to the best of our knowledge) demonstration of a low-power MCU-based edge device for Automatic License Plate Recognition (ALPR). The proposed visual processing pipeline uses a multi-model inference approach based on SSDlite-MobilenetV2 for license plate detection and LPRNet for optical character recognition, reaching a 38.9% mAP score for the first task and a recognition rate of >99.13% for the latter on public datasets. Independently, ethology-inspired queries are processed by a Large-Language Model (LLM) based coding agent to parse the structured text per video and retrieve videos accordingly. Original Abstract: Multi-Modal Knowledge Graphs (MMKGs) enrich entities with multiple modalities such as text and images, yet entities with highly similar multi-modal features remain difficult to distinguish. Temporal information of an entity can serve as an additional modality to disambiguate such entities, but existing approaches rarely treat time as a separate modality alongside text and images due to two major challenges: (1) sparse temporal semantics, which hinder alignment with richer modalities, and (2) multiple timestamps, which introduce noise or reduce robustness in representation learning. To address these challenges, we propose Time Imprint, a framework that treats time as an entity-level modality and jointly aligns temporal, textual, and visual representations via a three-view contrastive objective. Additionally, to mitigate multi-timestamp ambiguity, Time Imprint studies a compact timestamp subset selection design space and aggregates the selected timestamps into a discriminative temporal embedding with attention pooling, balancing temporal specificity and robustness. Experiments on three MMKG benchmarks demonstrate that Time Imprint achieves state-of-the-art link prediction performance, improving Hits@1 by up to 6.07\% overall and yielding up to 58\% gains on the subset of the top-1\% ambiguity samples. We further examine different fusion strategies and the sensitivity to timestamp availability and quality, clarifying when and why time-as-modality is most beneficial, while adding only modest training overhead. Original Abstract: The deep nonnegative matrix factorization (DNMF) technique is proposed to address the low interpretability of deep learning-based methods in extracting multilayer features from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) target samples. However, existing DNMF methods employ a layer-by-layer decomposition strategy, which is prone to causing error accumulation and local optimum, thereby hindering a consistent improvement in recognition accuracy as the number of layer increases. The new update formula indicates that both the DNMF method based on the encoding matrix and the mixing matrix are special cases of the proposed method, theoretically demonstrating the universality of proposed method. In general, the proposed method discards the layer-by-layer decomposition strategy, thereby effectively mitigating the risk of local optima and eliminating error accumulation, leading to a significant improvement in DNMF's multi-layer feature extraction capability. The experimental results, by presenting the feature images extracted from each layer by G-DNMF and the reconstructed original images, verified the proposed method's pure additive understanding of multi-layer features and demonstrated its interpretability. The experimental results based on MSTAR and OpenSARship datasets show that G-DNMF outperforms existing DNMF algorithms and their derivatives in terms of stability and recognition performance.

First, we present a large-scale multi-modal dataset synchronizing these consumer-grade sensors with ground-truth 3D motion, spanning 50 diverse activities including everyday tasks, sports, and social interactions. <details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 真实图像扩散反演面临严格的质量-成本权衡，现有方法在计算、存储或逐图像优化上开销高昂。本文旨在揭示存储噪声反演有效性的底层机制，从而设计更高效的反演方法。

Method: 提出噪声锚定反向校正（NARC），一种无需训练的反演原语。核心思路是：(1) 存储单个int8量化的完整潜变量锚点；(2) 采用固定的、依赖噪声水平的锚点权重调度——在反向轨迹受噪声主导时强锚定，在图像细节浮现后放松锚定。

Result: 在Stable Diffusion 1.5的PIE-Bench++上，NARC优于五种现代非精确基线方法，相比PnP DirectInv提升PSNR达+3.24 dB，同时反演存储减少约400倍。压缩不对称性、锚点特异性和编辑插件功能均可迁移至SDXL 1024²。

Conclusion: 扩散反演中应存储全维度的int8噪声锚点而非低维子空间摘要；反演依赖于匹配的前向锚点和训练好的分数网络，而非纯代数恒等关系。NARC在极低存储开销下实现了更优的反演质量。

We study this trade-off through the forward Gaussian noise anchor that defines a diffusion trajectory and isolate two mechanisms behind effective stored-noise inversion. First, diffusion noise exhibits an element-wise compression asymmetry: int8 full-dimensional anchors preserve reconstruction, whereas low-dimensional subspace summaries are much less reliable, often collapsing even at comparable or smaller payloads; the element-wise over subspace ordering persists across five stored-noise inversion methods. Second, inversion is trajectory-bound and score-prior coupled: the matched forward anchor and a trained score network are both necessary, arguing against a purely algebraic-identity explanation. Together, these findings specify what to store and how to use it. They lead to Noise-Anchored Reverse Correction (NARC), a training-free inversion primitive that stores a single int8 latent anchor and reuses it with a fixed, noise-level-dependent anchor-weight schedule: strong anchoring when the reverse trajectory is noise-dominated, then relaxed anchoring as image detail emerges. On PIE-Bench++ with Stable Diffusion 1.5, NARC outperforms five modern non-exact baselines and improves PSNR by +3.24 dB over PnP DirectInv while using about 400x less inversion storage than PnP DirectInv. The compression asymmetry, anchor specificity, and editing plug-in also transfer to SDXL 1024^2.

中文摘要翻译: 真实图像扩散反演受到严格的质量-成本权衡的约束，其成本体现在计算、存储或逐图像优化中。本文通过定义扩散轨迹的前向高斯噪声锚点来研究这一权衡，并分离出有效存储噪声反演背后的两种机制。第一，扩散噪声表现出逐元素的压缩不对称性：int8全维度锚点能保持重建质量，而低维子空间摘要则远不可靠，即使在可比或更小的负载下也常常崩溃；这种逐元素优于子空间的排序在五种存储噪声反演方法中持续存在。第二，反演受轨迹约束且与分数先验耦合：匹配的前向锚点和训练好的分数网络两者缺一不可，这反驳了纯代数恒等式的解释。综合这些发现，本文明确了存储什么以及如何使用它们。由此提出噪声锚定反向校正（NARC），一种无需训练的反演原语，它存储单个int8潜变量锚点，并使用固定的、依赖噪声水平的锚点权重调度重复利用该锚点：在反向轨迹受噪声主导时强锚定，在图像细节浮现后放松锚定。在基于Stable Diffusion 1.5的PIE-Bench++上，NARC优于五种现代非精确基线方法，相比PnP DirectInv提升PSNR达+3.24 dB，同时反演存储减少约400倍。压缩不对称性、锚点特异性以及编辑插件功能同样迁移到了SDXL 1024²。

</details>

TL;DR: 本文系统综述了视觉领域的持续自监督学习（CSSL），分析了评估协议的不一致性，解释了自监督目标对灾难性遗忘的鲁棒性原因，提出了基于遗忘缓解策略的统一分类法，并指出了当前面临的开放挑战与未来方向。

Method: 通过系统综述方法，首先分析现有评估协议并指出不一致之处；然后从理论层面解释自监督目标为何对灾难性遗忘更具鲁棒性（任务无关表示和平滑损失景观）；接着基于遗忘缓解策略（蒸馏、回放、正则化、架构方法、模型合并、目标级适应）构建统一分类法；最后识别开放挑战。

Result: 揭示了现有评估协议存在不一致性；解释了自监督学习相比监督学习在持续学习中具有更强抗遗忘能力的原因；建立了涵盖六类遗忘缓解策略的统一分类体系；指出了可扩展性和快速适应性等开放挑战。

Original Abstract: Traditionally, continual learning has assumed access to labeled data, yet many real-world applications -- such as lifelong robotics -- require models to adapt continuously from unlabeled streams. This has led to the development of continual self-supervised learning (CSSL), a rapidly growing area that lacks a dedicated, systematic review. In this work, we present a comprehensive survey of CSSL for vision, with connections to emerging vision-language settings. First, we analyze existing evaluation protocols and highlight inconsistencies that hinder fair comparison. We then examine why self-supervised objectives exhibit improved robustness to catastrophic forgetting, relating this to task-agnostic representations and smoother loss landscapes. Next, we organize existing methods into a unified taxonomy based on their forgetting-mitigation strategies, including distillation, replay, regularization, architectural approaches, model merging, and objective-level adaptation. Finally, we identify open challenges such as scalability and the need for fast adaptability. We argue that advancing CSSL requires moving beyond small-scale benchmarks towards continual pre-training paradigms for large-scale systems.

中文摘要翻译: 传统上，持续学习假设可以访问带标签的数据，然而许多现实应用——例如终身机器人——要求模型从无标签数据流中持续适应。这促使了持续自监督学习（CSSL）的发展，这是一个快速增长的领域但缺乏专门的系统性综述。在这项工作中，我们对视觉领域的CSSL进行了全面综述，并与新兴的视觉-语言设置建立了联系。首先，我们分析了现有的评估协议，并指出了阻碍公平比较的不一致性。然后，我们检验了自监督目标为何对灾难性遗忘表现出更强的鲁棒性，并将其归因于任务无关表示和平滑的损失景观。接着，我们基于遗忘缓解策略（包括蒸馏、回放、正则化、架构方法、模型合并和目标级适应）将现有方法组织成一个统一的分类体系。最后，我们识别了开放挑战，如可扩展性和对快速适应性的需求。我们认为，推进CSSL需要从小规模基准测试转向大规模系统的持续预训练范式。

</details>

TL;DR: 首次提出基于扩散模型的、针对2D距离图像语义分割的无限制对抗攻击方法，利用分割损失作为对抗引导，在保持数据流形真实性的同时生成可调节的对抗样本，并在SemanticKITTI数据集上验证了其有效性和可迁移性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有对抗攻击主要针对图像分类和3D点云分割，但在2D距离图像（3D点云的投影）上，无限制对抗样本的研究几乎空白，而LiDAR语义分割的误判会影响自动驾驶的规划和安全决策。

Method: 首次将扩散模型用于2D距离图像语义分割的无限制对抗攻击：在扩散模型的采样过程中，直接施加来自分割损失的对抗引导，生成既贴近LiDAR数据流形又能诱发结构化分割错误的对抗样本。

Result: 在SemanticKITTI数据集上，针对RangeNet++和CENet的测试表明：攻击的退化程度可通过引导强度调节，且能跨分割架构迁移；与范数约束的FGSM、SegPGD相比，该方法在有效性与真实性之间实现了可调节的权衡，在保持分布真实性和视觉真实性的同时实现了可控的白盒和迁移退化。

Conclusion: 基于扩散模型的无限制对抗攻击在LiDAR距离图像分割上具有可行性和优势，提供了一种更真实、可调节且可迁移的对抗攻击范式。

Original Abstract: LiDAR semantic segmentation is a key perception task in autonomous driving, where false predictions can affect downstream planning and safety-critical decision-making. Although adversarial attacks, and specifically adversarial examples, have been widely studied for image classification and 3D point cloud segmentation, unrestricted adversarial examples remain largely unexplored in the space of 2D range images, which are projections of 3D point clouds. The proposed method is, to the best of our knowledge, the first diffusion-based unrestricted adversarial attack against 2D range-image segmentation, using adversarial guidance from a segmentation loss. By applying guidance directly during sampling, the method produces unrestricted adversarial examples that remain close to the learned LiDAR data manifold while inducing structured segmentation errors. Experiments on the SemanticKITTI dataset using RangeNet++ and CENet segmentation networks demonstrate that the attack provides adjustable degradation across guidance strengths and transfers across segmentation architectures. Compared with norm-bounded FGSM and SegPGD baselines, the proposed attack offers a distinct effectiveness-realism trade-off, achieving controllable white-box and transfer degradation while maintaining competitive distributional and visual realism.

中文摘要翻译: LiDAR语义分割是自动驾驶中的关键感知任务，其错误预测会影响下游规划和安全关键决策。尽管对抗攻击（特别是对抗样本）已在图像分类和3D点云分割中被广泛研究，但在2D距离图像（3D点云的投影）空间中，无限制对抗样本仍基本未被探索。据我们所知，所提出的方法是首个针对2D距离图像分割的基于扩散模型的无限制对抗攻击，利用来自分割损失的对抗引导。通过在采样过程中直接施加引导，该方法生成的无限制对抗样本既贴近所学到的LiDAR数据流形，又能诱发结构化的分割错误。在SemanticKITTI数据集上使用RangeNet++和CENet分割网络的实验表明，该攻击在不同引导强度下提供可调节的退化程度，并能跨分割架构迁移。与范数约束的FGSM和SegPGD基线相比，所提出的攻击提供了独特的效果-真实性权衡，在保持具有竞争力的分布真实性和视觉真实性的同时，实现了可控的白盒和迁移退化。

</details>

*Zhonghua Yi,Hao Shi,Qi Jiang,Yufan Zhang,Kailun Yang,Kaiwei Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了一种无需标签和传感器标定的两阶段训练范式，通过无标签蒸馏预训练和极线引导自蒸馏实现事件-图像数据的跨模态像素级匹配，在MVSEC和TUM-VIE位姿估计任务上达到SOTA。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有跨模态匹配方法严重依赖匹配标签或严格对齐的硬件，无法适用于无标签、无约束的真实场景。为解决这一问题，提出一种无需先验传感器关系和标注数据的两阶段训练范式。

Method: 两阶段训练范式：(1) 标签无关的蒸馏预训练阶段，利用大规模数据进行分布损失和对比损失的优化，学习高泛化性表示；(2) 极线引导的自蒸馏框架，通过一致性验证筛选稳健匹配，并利用外部极线先验的几何置信度，在目标域上实现无监督自演化。

Result: 在MVSEC和TUM-VIE位姿估计任务上达到最先进性能；基于TUM-VIE构建了严格评估基准，包含物理分离、不同内参和分辨率的相机。

Conclusion: 提出的方法有效解决了无标签、无约束场景下事件-图像跨模态匹配问题，无需任何标注或传感器先验即可实现高性能匹配，为多传感器系统提供了一种实用的自监督学习范式。

Original Abstract: Building pixel-level correspondence between event and image data is a fundamental task for multi-sensor systems. However, existing cross-modal matching methods are largely restricted by their reliance on either matching labels or strictly aligned hardware, which limits them to unlabeled and unconstrained real-world scenarios where neither matching ground truth nor prior sensor relationships are available. To address this, we propose a novel two-stage training paradigm. First, we leverage large-scale data to perform label-agnostic distillation pretraining, upgrading optimization objectives with distribution-based and contrastive losses to learn highly generalizable representations. Second, to tackle unlabeled and unconstrained downstream data, we introduce an epipolar-guided self-distillation framework. By utilizing consistency verification to isolate robust matches and incorporating geometric confidence derived from an external epipolar prior, our model can effectively self-evolve directly on target domains without any supervision. Furthermore, we introduce a rigorous cross-modal evaluation benchmark based on TUM-VIE, featuring physically separated cameras with distinct intrinsic parameters and resolutions. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our proposed method achieves state-of-the-art performance on both MVSEC and TUM-VIE pose estimation tasks. The source code and benchmark will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ZhonghuaYi/nexus2-official.

中文摘要翻译: 建立事件数据与图像数据之间的像素级对应是多传感器系统中的一项基础任务。然而，现有的跨模态匹配方法严重依赖于匹配标签或严格对齐的硬件，这限制了它们在无标签、无约束的真实场景中的应用——此类场景中既无匹配真值，也无先验传感器关系可用。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种新颖的两阶段训练范式。首先，我们利用大规模数据进行与标签无关的蒸馏预训练，通过基于分布的损失和对比损失来优化学习目标，从而学习高度泛化的表示。其次，为应对无标签、无约束的下游数据，我们引入了一种极线引导的自蒸馏框架。通过利用一致性验证来分离稳健匹配，并结合从外部极线先验中导出的几何置信度，我们的模型能够在无需任何监督的情况下，直接在目标域上实现有效的自演化。此外，我们基于TUM-VIE构建了一个严格的跨模态评估基准，该基准采用物理分离的相机，具有不同的内参和分辨率。大量实验表明，我们提出的方法在MVSEC和TUM-VIE的位姿估计任务上均达到了最先进的性能。源代码和基准将在https://github.com/ZhonghuaYi/nexus2-official公开发布。

</details>

Original Abstract: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a common neurodegenerative disorder, and early diagnosis is of great significance for delaying disease progression and enabling timely intervention. Structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI) provides detailed characterization of anatomical structures and plays an important role in AD-related brain analysis. However, existing sMRI-based brain network methods typically rely on a single graph construction strategy, limiting their ability to jointly capture spatial relationships and morphological similarities between brain regions. To address these issues, this paper proposes an sMRI-based multi-view masked graph neural network model (MVMGNN) for AD diagnosis. A joint node-edge masking mechanism is proposed to simultaneously select radiomics feature dimensions and structural connections, reducing redundancy during graph learning. Furthermore, a patient-level cross-view gated fusion mechanism is proposed to integrate multi-view representations. Experimental results on the ADNI dataset demonstrate that MVMGNN outperforms several competing approaches in AD classification. 中文摘要翻译: 阿尔茨海默病（AD）是一种常见的神经退行性疾病，早期诊断对于延缓疾病进展和及时干预具有重要意义。轻度认知障碍（MCI）是介于正常衰老认知与AD之间的中间临床阶段。结构磁共振成像（sMRI）能够提供详细的解剖结构特征，并在AD相关脑分析中发挥重要作用。然而，现有基于sMRI的脑网络方法通常依赖单一图构建策略，限制了其联合捕获脑区之间空间关系和形态相似性的能力。针对这些问题，本文提出了一种基于sMRI的多视图掩码图神经网络模型（MVMGNN）用于AD诊断。我们提出了一种联合节点-边掩码机制，能够同时选择影像组学特征维度和结构连接，减少图学习过程中的冗余信息。此外，还提出了一种患者级跨视图门控融合机制，用于整合多视图表示。在ADNI数据集上的实验结果表明，MVMGNN在AD分类任务中优于多种对比方法。可解释性分析进一步证明，MVMGNN能够识别与AD相关的关键脑区，为基于sMRI脑网络中的判别性模式提供了有用见解。我们的实现代码已公开在https://github.com/chenzhao2023/MVMGNN_AD。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统人脸识别系统依赖传统相机，存在体积大、成本高、隐私保护有限等问题。无透镜相机虽可解决这些问题，但其重建图像常带伪影且泛化能力差，而现有数据集未包含无透镜图像的伪影特征，因此需要专门数据集来推动该领域研究。

Method: 构建了LFD数据集，包含21,080张人脸图像，涵盖三种不同无透镜相机在多种光照、角度和距离下的原始测量值、重建图像和标准图像，其中4,976张为户外自然场景图像。

Conclusion: LFD数据集为推进无透镜人脸识别研究提供了有价值的基准，能够帮助模型更好地应对无透镜图像中的伪影和现实环境挑战。

Original Abstract: Face recognition is a ubiquitously used computer vision task that has a wide range of applications ranging from everyday smartphone biometrics to high-stakes security systems. Most face recognition systems rely on traditional cameras, which often suffer from limitations such as bulky form factors, high costs, and limited privacy protection. To address these limitations, lensless cameras have emerged as an alternative. Lensless cameras use thin optical encoders, enabling smaller size, lower cost, and greater design flexibility. These cameras are typically paired with reconstruction algorithms that convert raw captures into recognizable images. However, reconstructed images often contain artifacts, and the reconstruction methods struggle to generalize well to real-world conditions. Furthermore, existing face datasets do not account for the artifacts present in lensless images. To address this issue, we introduce the Lensless Face Dataset (LFD). LFD comprises 21,080 lensless raw measurements, reconstructions, and standard images of faces captured under diverse lighting, angle, and distance. Our key contributions are: (1) Real-world lensless face data: LFD focuses on capturing a diverse face dataset with varying levels of artifacts introduced under different environments; (2) In-the-wild captures: 4,976 images are captured in outdoor settings with varying intensities of natural light and different background patterns; (3) Multiple lensless devices: LFD includes face images collected from three different types of lensless cameras, each with a unique optical encoder. We use this hardware diversity to demonstrate generalization across different lensless cameras. Through comprehensive evaluations and analysis, we show that LFD effectively captures shared features and artifacts across different lensless imaging devices, making it a valuable dataset for advancing lensless face recognition.

中文摘要翻译: 人脸识别是一项被广泛使用的计算机视觉任务，其应用范围涵盖从日常智能手机生物识别到高安全性安全系统。大多数人脸识别系统依赖传统相机，而这些相机通常存在体积庞大、成本高昂以及隐私保护有限等局限性。为了解决这些问题，无透镜相机作为一种替代方案应运而生。无透镜相机采用薄型光学编码器，具有更小的尺寸、更低的成本和更大的设计灵活性。这类相机通常与重建算法配合使用，将原始捕获数据转换为可识别的图像。然而，重建后的图像常包含伪影，且重建方法难以很好地泛化到真实世界场景。此外，现有人脸数据集未考虑无透镜图像中存在的伪影。为解决这一问题，我们引入了无透镜人脸数据集（LFD）。LFD包含21,080张在不同光照、角度和距离条件下捕获的无透镜原始测量值、重建图像以及标准人脸图像。我们的主要贡献包括：(1) 真实世界的无透镜人脸数据：LFD专注于捕获在不同环境下具有不同程度伪影的多样化人脸数据集；(2) 野外场景捕获：其中4,976张图像在户外场景中拍摄，包含不同强度的自然光和不同的背景图案；(3) 多种无透镜设备：LFD包含从三种不同类型的无透镜相机收集的人脸图像，每种相机具有独特的光学编码器。我们利用这种硬件多样性来展示跨不同无透镜相机的泛化能力。通过全面的评估和分析，我们表明LFD有效捕捉了不同无透镜成像设备之间的共享特征和伪影，使其成为推进无透镜人脸识别的有价值数据集。

</details>

Original Abstract: We present a framework for understanding and generating feature rich hair strands. Drawing upon both scientific and cultural expertise, we define strand texture as the various distinctive patterns (curling, switchbacks, twist, etc.) that are formed by forces internal to a hair strand. We begin by proposing a novel five-dimensional parameter space, intended to be a bijection with naturally occurring hair strand textures. This encoding is both qualitatively accessible, allowing users to readily locate their own hair in the parameter space, and quantitatively precise, allowing the generation of individual strands from texture inputs. In order to disentangle strand texture from the overall strand direction, we identify centerline geometry and use it to map strands into a canonical space (a strand texture space). The ability to create new strands conforming to any desired texture enables groom editing using either texture transfer or user-provided inputs. We demonstrate results on a variety of hair types.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一个用于理解和生成富有纹理特征的发丝的框架。结合科学知识与文化经验，我们将发丝纹理定义为由发丝内部力形成的各种独特图案（卷曲、折返、扭转等）。我们首先提出一个新颖的五维参数空间，旨在与自然发生的发丝纹理形成双射关系。该编码既具备定性可理解性——允许用户在参数空间中轻松定位自己的发质，又具备定量精确性——支持从纹理输入生成单根发丝。重要的是，发丝纹理应独立于整体发丝方向。为了将发丝纹理与整体发向解耦，我们识别中心线几何结构，并以此将发丝映射到一个规范空间（发丝纹理空间）。我们采用一种新颖的方法构建中心线，该方法能清晰提取复杂发型中的纹理特征，将发丝纹理与整体风格（由风格引导参数化）分离开来。我们通过生成式人工智能方法创建符合纹理参数描述的新发丝，该方法由一个独立的神经网络进行监督，该网络被训练用于根据我们的五参数描述对候选发丝进行标注。这种创建任意纹理发丝的能力支持通过纹理迁移或用户输入进行发型编辑。我们在多种发质类型上展示了实验效果。

TL;DR: 本文提出ViT中间层具有可恢复性（recoverability），即中间层表示能够纠正最后一层的分类错误。作者引入VFusion——一种可学习的垂直聚合策略，将ViT内部层次结构的特征融合到低维潜在空间中，显著提升分类性能，缩小与理论最优性能之间的差距。

  <summary>Details</summary>

Conclusion: ViT中间层表示具有可恢复性，能够有效纠正最后一层的分类错误。VFusion作为一种鲁棒且高效的垂直聚合策略，是水平集成方法的有效替代方案。

Original Abstract: Despite exposing rich intermediate representations, Vision Transformers (ViTs) are almost exclusively utilized as black-box feature extractors, where only the last layer is considered for downstream tasks. We challenge this convention by introducing the notion of recoverability: the capacity of intermediate representations to correct last-layer failures. By evaluating independent classification probes at every model depth across 16 datasets, we observe that intermediate probes correctly classify 18% to 76% of samples that the last-layer probe misclassifies. We show that these gains are not primarily driven by predictive diversity, but by a redundancy-correctness correspondence, where the internal hierarchy acts as a series of stable, redundant probes of a shared discriminative signal. While established horizontal ensemble strategies (i.e., across multiple models) can improve performance, they incur high computational cost and ignore this vertical signal within a single model. To bridge this gap, we propose VFusion, a principled vertical aggregation strategy employing a learnable mapping into a low-dimensional latent space that synthesizes features across the internal ViT hierarchy. VFusion substantially outperforms established aggregation baselines in both in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, notably closing 45% of the accuracy gap between the best individual layer and a theoretical oracle performance. Our gains consistently generalize across model sizes and pre-training regimes, confirming that VFusion offers a robust and efficient alternative to horizontal ensemble methods. The code is available at https://github.com/francescodisalvo05/vit-vertical-fusion.

中文摘要翻译: 尽管视觉变换器（ViT）暴露了丰富的中间层表示，但它们几乎完全被用作黑箱特征提取器，仅将最后一层用于下游任务。我们通过引入可恢复性（recoverability）的概念来挑战这一惯例，即中间层表示纠正最后一层分类失败的能力。通过在16个数据集上评估每个模型深度处的独立分类探针，我们观察到中间层探针能够正确分类最后一层探针误分类样本中的18%到76%。我们证明这些增益并非主要由预测多样性驱动，而是源于冗余-正确性对应关系（redundancy-correctness correspondence），即内部层次结构充当了一系列稳定的、冗余的共享判别信号探针。虽然已有的水平集成策略（即跨多个模型）可以提升性能，但它们的计算成本高昂，并且忽视了单个模型内部的这种垂直信号。为弥合这一差距，我们提出VFusion，一种基于原则的垂直聚合策略，采用可学习映射将特征合成到低维潜在空间中，从而实现ViT内部层次结构特征的融合。VFusion在分布内和分布外场景中均显著优于已有的聚合基线方法，特别地，它缩小了最佳单层与理论最优性能之间45%的准确率差距。我们的增益在不同模型规模和预训练机制下均一致泛化，证实了VFusion提供了一种鲁棒且高效的水平集成方法替代方案。代码可在https://github.com/francescodisalvo05/vit-vertical-fusion获取。

</details>

  <summary>Details</summary>

Method: 设计了一个三层个人视觉记忆结构：用户画像（profile）、短期焦点（short-term focus）和观察记录（observations）。每轮交互加载该记忆来条件化LLM工具调用循环，并包含冲突感知写回机制用于更新用户模型。实验采用800张图像配以合成记忆块进行受控消融研究。

Result: 移除完整三层记忆模块后，工具查询相关性从4.21降至3.74（5分制，绝对下降0.47，相对下降11.2%）；端到端效用从0.842降至0.760（绝对下降0.082，相对下降9.7%）。

Conclusion: 个人视觉记忆能显著提升智能体在图像输入场景下的工具选择与参数设置的准确性和用户对齐度。该结果是在固定合成记忆块和单轮图像输入条件下测得的，未涉及多会话的真实用户历史写回。

Original Abstract: Recognition tells an agent what is in an image; personal memory affects what is worth looking up next. In a camera-first setting the user can send only an image, so the agent must form the lookups. We study whether personal visual memory improves agent-side tool choice and tool arguments, and thereby more user-aligned multi-tool lookups. The design uses a three-layer personal visual memory (profile, short-term focus, observations) that is loaded on each turn to condition an LLM tool-calling loop under camera-first intake, and includes conflict-aware write-back intended to refresh the user model for later captures. On 800 images paired with synthetic memory blocks constructed for controlled ablation, removing the full three-layer memory block reduces tool-query relevance by 0.47 points absolute (4.21 -> 3.74 on a 5-point scale; 11.2% relative) and end-to-end utility by 0.082 absolute (0.842 -> 0.760; 9.7% relative). These results measure memory conditioning of tool policy under image-only intake with fixed synthetic blocks, not multi-session write-back from live user histories.

中文摘要翻译: 识别告诉智能体图像中有什么；个人记忆影响接下来值得查询什么。在相机优先的设置中，用户只能发送图像，因此智能体必须自主形成查询。我们研究个人视觉记忆是否能够改善智能体端的工具选择和工具参数，从而实现更符合用户需求的多工具查询。该设计采用三层个人视觉记忆（用户画像、短期焦点、观察记录），在每个轮次加载该记忆来条件化LLM在相机优先输入下的工具调用循环，并包含冲突感知写回机制，旨在为后续捕获更新用户模型。在800张图像配以用于受控消融的合成记忆块的实验中，移除完整三层记忆块使工具查询相关性绝对下降0.47分（5分制从4.21降至3.74；相对下降11.2%），端到端效用绝对下降0.082（从0.842降至0.760；相对下降9.7%）。这些结果衡量了在固定合成记忆块和仅图像输入条件下记忆对工具策略的条件化作用，而非来自真实用户历史的多会话写回效果。

### [20] [On the Real-World Generalisability of Optical Flow Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10470)
*Petter Reijalt,Sander Gielisse,Rickard Karlsson,Jan van Gemert*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文通过构建包含FlowFactor在内的真实世界光流基准，系统评估了现代光流模型在真实视频上的泛化能力，发现合成基准（如Sintel、KITTI）的精度无法有效预测真实世界精度，且单纯扩大训练数据无法弥合这一差距。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有光流研究主要依赖合成数据和特定领域基准，但真实世界部署是终极目标。作者质疑合成基准上的精度能否真实反映模型在真实视频上的表现，并希望量化这一不匹配的严重程度。

Method: 构建了一个包含8,204帧对的真实世界评估基准，其中包括自建的FlowFactor数据集（1,000帧对，按大位移、重复纹理、遮挡、光照变化四个混淆因素组织）。使用标准预训练检查点评估多种现代光流模型，并进行混淆因素特异性分析和相关性分析。

Result: 发现：（1）光照变化和大位移场景的精度与真实世界准确性相关性最强；（2）大运动场景的改进可能以牺牲小运动/静态场景的鲁棒性为代价；（3）Sintel、KITTI、Spring上的进展对真实世界精度的预测能力很弱；（4）扩大训练数据量无法弥合合成与真实之间的差距。

Conclusion: 需要建设广泛的真实世界光流基准来推动研究发展，单纯增加数据和计算量无法解决根本问题，亟需创新性研究。

Original Abstract: Real-world deployment of vision models to broadly benefit society is arguably a main research objective. In optical flow, however, the difficulty to obtain the ground truth has focused research mainly on synthetic data and domain-specific benchmarks. Here, we investigate the severity of this mismatch. We study how well modern optical flow estimation models generalise to real-world video and question if accuracy on synthetic benchmark proxies actually predicts accuracy on real-world optical flow. To address this, we build a real-world evaluation benchmark and evaluate the real-world generalisability of a broad set of recent optical flow models using standard checkpoints. Our benchmark contains 8,204 frame pairs across TAP-Flow, Slow Flow, and our own dataset FlowFactor. FlowFactor is a manually annotated real-world benchmark of 1,000 HD frame pairs organised into four confounding factors: large displacements, repetitive textures, occlusions, and lighting variation. Each setting mainly varies only one factor, enabling diagnostic, confounder-specific analysis. Using FlowFactor, we reveal that performance on varying lighting and large displacements correlates most strongly with real-world accuracy, and that improvements on large-motion regimes can trade off against robustness in small-motion, stationary scenes. Our experiments show that progress on Sintel, KITTI and Spring only weakly predicts accuracy on real-world data, highlighting the need for a broad real-world optical flow benchmark. Interestingly, scaling up the amount of training data does not necessarily resolve the gap, calling for new innovative research instead of simply scaling data and compute.

中文摘要翻译: 将视觉模型部署到现实世界以广泛造福社会，可说是主要的研究目标。然而在光流领域，获取真实标注的困难导致研究主要集中在合成数据和特定领域基准上。本文研究了这一不匹配问题的严重程度。我们考察了现代光流估计模型在真实视频上的泛化能力，并质疑合成基准上的精度是否真能预测真实世界光流的准确性。为此，我们构建了一个真实世界评估基准，并使用标准预训练检查点评估了一组广泛的最新光流模型在真实世界的泛化能力。我们的基准包含来自TAP-Flow、Slow Flow以及我们自建数据集FlowFactor的8,204帧对。FlowFactor是一个人工标注的真实世界基准，包含1,000帧高清帧对，按四个混淆因素组织：大位移、重复纹理、遮挡和光照变化。每个设置主要仅变化一个因素，从而实现诊断性的混淆因素特异性分析。利用FlowFactor，我们发现光照变化和大位移场景的表现与真实世界准确性的相关性最强，并且大运动场景的改进可能与小运动、静态场景的鲁棒性之间存在权衡。我们的实验表明，Sintel、KITTI和Spring上的进展对真实世界数据的预测能力很弱，这凸显了对广泛真实世界光流基准的需求。有趣的是，扩大训练数据量并不一定能弥合这一差距，这表明需要新的创新性研究，而非简单地扩大数据和计算规模。

</details>


### [21] [Towards Objective Dysgraphia Detection: A Multi-Branch Deep Learning Approach for Online Handwriting Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09826)
*Lydia Ouhib,Yassine Ouzar,Zoé Pinseel,Stéphane Bouilland,Mehdi Ammi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于深度学习的书写困难症客观检测框架，利用数字化平板采集的在线手写数据，融合手工特征与深度学习特征（基于信号和图像两种表示），在DiaGraMo数据集上验证了多模态融合方法的有效性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有书写困难症诊断依赖临床观察，主观性强、耗时长且结果不一致，亟需一种客观、自动化的检测方法。

Method: 提出双分支深度学习框架：第一分支从原始时间序列信号中提取手工特征和基于MOMENT的嵌入特征；第二分支利用连续小波变换（CWT）和Gramian角场（GAF）将时间信号转为图像表示。四类特征（手工特征、MOMENT嵌入、CWT图像、GAF图像）分别评估后融合，利用互补性提升检测性能。

Result: 在DiaGraMo数据集上，GAF、MOMENT与手工运动学特征的融合方案优于各单独表示及其他融合方案，证明了信号与图像表示互补性的有效性。

Conclusion: 信号与图像表示的特征融合能够为书写困难症提供更客观、准确的检测，具有临床应用潜力。

Original Abstract: Dysgraphia is a specific learning disability that is prevalent among school-age children. It affects handwriting coherence, quality, fluency, and legibility, often hindering academic achievement and early learning development. This motor coordination disorder is typically diagnosed through subjective assessments based on clinician observation, which can be timeconsuming and prone to variability. In this paper, we introduce a deep learning-based framework for objective dysgraphia detection using online handwriting data captured via digitizing tablets. The proposed framework relies on two complementary branches: the first pipeline extracts both handcrafted and embedding-based kinematic features directly from raw temporal signals, while the second leverages image-based representations of the temporal signals generated using continuous wavelet transforms (CWT) and Gramian Angular Fields (GAF). The resulting features are then fused to leverage the complementary strengths of both representations. The four representations were evaluated separately and jointly using the publicly available DiaGraMo dataset, showing that the fusion of GAF, MOMENT, and hand-crafted kinematic features outperforms each individual representation, as well as other fusion schemes. These findings highlight the potential of the complementarity of image and signal based representations for more objective dysgraphia detection.

After binary encoding, both terms form a unified QUBO model. Experiments used four 40 times 40 CT images under a 10-view fan-beam geometry with Poisson noise. Method: 提出X-GuideAR增强现实框架，通过生成合成X光预览图像，在不使用真实X光的情况下加速投照角度搜寻过程。在确定最佳解剖视图后，获取一次真实X光，并将钻孔轨迹预览叠加到真实X光图像上，引导精确螺钉置入。

Conclusion: X-GuideAR在减少辐射暴露和简化S2AI螺钉置入流程方面展现出巨大潜力，为更安全、更高效的骨科手术提供了有前景的方向。

This work introduces X-GuideAR, an augmented reality (AR) framework for identifying optimal X-ray views, aimed at reducing radiation exposure while ensuring accurate screw placement. To exemplify the benefits of X-GuideAR, we focus on S2 alar-iliac (S2AI) screw placement. Our system provides radiation-free guidance for view acquisition and drilling by generating synthetic X-ray previews that accelerate fluoro-hunting. Once the required anatomical views are identified using these previews, a real X-ray is acquired, and the preview of the drilling trajectory is augmented onto it, facilitating precise screw placement with minimal additional radiation. A preliminary study involving eight S2AI trajectories performed by an expert spine surgeon demonstrated a 62.3% reduction in the number of X-rays. Post-procedure evaluations showed that trajectories done with X-GuideAR supported an average safe screw diameter of 12.95 mm compared to 5.9 mm under the conventional workflow, suggesting improved bony containment and potential biomechanical benefit. X-GuideAR shows great potential to reduce radiation exposure and streamline S2AI screw placement, offering a promising direction toward safer and more efficient surgeries.

Original Abstract: The recently introduced YOLO26 architecture incorporates NMS-free end-to-end inference and is optimized for deployment on resource-constrained CPU-based devices, making it well-suited for edge-based aquaculture applications. However, its performance, operational efficiency, and deployment suitability have not been systematically validated in aquaculture-specific scenarios. This study presents a comprehensive benchmark of YOLO26 against three Ultralytics predecessors (YOLOv5u, YOLOv8, and YOLO11) across nano, small, and medium model scales for fish mortality detection, a critical indicator of fish population health and welfare. Twelve model variants were evaluated for detection accuracy, training efficiency across seven dataset sizes, and inference performance on high-performance NVIDIA A100 GPUs and a CPU-only Raspberry Pi 5 edge platform. All models achieved comparable performance on the full dataset, with mAP50 differing by only 1.04 percentage points, indicating that architectural generation has little influence on final detection accuracy when sufficient training data are available. However, clear trade-offs emerged in data efficiency and deployment performance. YOLOv8 achieved 90% mAP50 with only 400 training images, whereas the YOLO26 nano and small variants required 1,000 images to reach comparable accuracy. Conversely, YOLO26n achieved the highest inference speed on the Raspberry Pi 5 (7.51 FPS), while YOLOv5mu outperformed all contemporary medium-scale architectures on CPU-based hardware. These results show that architectural novelty alone is insufficient for model selection and that training data availability, target hardware, and inference requirements should be considered jointly when selecting object detection models for practical edge AI deployment in aquaculture.

中文摘要翻译: 近期提出的YOLO26架构采用了无需NMS的端到端推理，并针对资源受限的CPU设备进行了部署优化，使其非常适合基于边缘计算的水产养殖应用。然而，其性能、运行效率及部署适用性尚未在水产养殖特定场景中得到系统验证。本研究将YOLO26与三个Ultralytics前序版本（YOLOv5u、YOLOv8和YOLO11）在nano、small和medium三种模型尺度上进行全面基准测试，应用于鱼类死亡检测——这一鱼类种群健康与福利的关键指标。我们评估了12个模型变体在检测精度、七个数据集规模下的训练效率，以及在高性能NVIDIA A100 GPU和仅配备CPU的树莓派5边缘平台上的推理性能。所有模型在完整数据集上均取得了可比的性能，mAP50仅相差1.04个百分点，这表明当训练数据充足时，架构代际差异对最终检测精度影响甚微。然而，在数据效率和部署性能方面出现了明显的权衡。YOLOv8仅需400张训练图像即可达到90%的mAP50，而YOLO26的nano和small变体则需要1000张图像才能达到相当精度。相反，YOLO26n在树莓派5上实现了最高的推理速度（7.51 FPS），而YOLOv5mu在CPU硬件上的表现优于所有当代中等规模架构。这些结果表明，仅凭架构新颖性不足以指导模型选择，在为水产养殖中的实际边缘AI部署选择目标检测模型时，应联合考虑训练数据可用性、目标硬件和推理需求。

### [26] [Reliability-Aware Ensemble Classification Under Class Imbalance: A Calibration Study on Liquid-Based Cervical Cytology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09837)
*Nisreen Albzour,Sarah S. Lam*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文在Mendeley LBC数据集上，针对宫颈细胞学分类中的类别不平衡和校准问题，研究了轻量级模型及其集成方法。结果表明，温度缩放校准显著提升模型可靠性（降低ECE、Brier分数和NLL），而集成方法并未带来额外增益；所有分类错误均局限于HSIL与SCC之间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有宫颈细胞学分类模型通常在经过筛选的类别平衡基准上评估，但现实中的液基细胞学（LBC）数据集往往规模小且类别高度不平衡。本文旨在探究在此类真实场景下，如何通过类别不平衡感知和校准感知的策略提升分类可靠性。

Method: 使用三种轻量级架构（Swin-Tiny、TinyViT-5M、DenseNet121），在Mendeley LBC数据集上采用加权随机采样缓解类别不平衡，并构建两种软投票集成（Hybrid-2和Hybrid-3）。在交叉验证中，从训练集划分出独立的校准子集进行事后温度缩放，确保校准数据与训练和评估数据分离，避免乐观校准估计。

Result: 校准显著降低了所有模型和集成配置的期望校准误差（ECE）、Brier分数和负对数似然（NLL），而判别性指标（准确率、宏F1、宏AUROC）基本不变。集成规模在校准后未带来额外可靠性提升。所有分类错误仅局限于HSIL与SCC之间，不涉及NILM或LSIL类别。

Conclusion: 在该数据集上，校准是提升模型可靠性的主导因素，而非集成规模。该结论受限于数据集规模较小，需谨慎推广。

Original Abstract: Cervical cytology classification models are typically evaluated on curated, class-balanced benchmarks, but real-world liquid-based cytology (LBC) collections are often small and class-imbalanced. This paper presents a class-imbalance-aware and calibration-aware ensemble classification study on the Mendeley LBC dataset, using its native four-class Bethesda taxonomy (NILM, LSIL, HSIL, SCC) rather than a collapsed binary formulation. Three lightweight architectures (Swin-Tiny, TinyViT-5M, DenseNet121) are trained directly on Mendeley LBC using weighted random sampling to counteract class imbalance, and compared against two soft-voting ensembles (Hybrid-2, Hybrid-3). Post-hoc temperature scaling is fit on a held-out calibration subset carved out of the training portion of each cross-validation fold, distinct from both the training data used to fit model weights and the evaluation fold used for final metrics, avoiding the optimistic calibration estimates that result when the same data is used for both purposes. Calibration substantially reduces expected calibration error, Brier score, and negative log-likelihood for every model and ensemble configuration tested, while discrimination metrics (accuracy, macro-F1, macro-AUROC) remain essentially unchanged. Ensemble size shows no consistent additional reliability benefit over the best individual model once all configurations are properly calibrated. Confusion matrices show that all classification errors, across every configuration, are confined to the boundary between high-grade lesions (HSIL) and carcinoma (SCC); no errors involve the negative (NILM) or low-grade (LSIL) categories. These results suggest that, for this dataset, calibration is the dominant lever for reliability, not ensemble size, though this conclusion should be read in light of the dataset's modest size.

中文摘要翻译: 宫颈细胞学分类模型通常在经过筛选、类别平衡的基准上进行评估，但现实中的液基细胞学（LBC）数据集往往规模小且类别高度不平衡。本文在Mendeley LBC数据集上开展了一项类别不平衡感知且校准感知的集成分类研究，采用其原生的四类Bethesda分类体系（NILM、LSIL、HSIL、SCC），而非简化的二分类形式。三种轻量级架构（Swin-Tiny、TinyViT-5M、DenseNet121）直接在Mendeley LBC上训练，使用加权随机采样来对抗类别不平衡，并与两种软投票集成方法（Hybrid-2、Hybrid-3）进行比较。事后温度缩放在一个从每个交叉验证折的训练部分中划分出的保留校准子集上进行拟合，该子集既不同于用于拟合模型权重的训练数据，也不同于用于最终指标评估的评估折，从而避免了因同一数据兼具两种用途而导致的乐观校准估计。校准显著降低了所有测试模型和集成配置的期望校准误差、Brier分数和负对数似然，而判别性指标（准确率、宏F1、宏AUROC）基本保持不变。一旦所有配置得到恰当校准，集成规模相比最佳单个模型并未带来一致的额外可靠性提升。混淆矩阵显示，所有配置中的所有分类错误均局限于高级别病变（HSIL）与癌变（SCC）之间的边界；没有错误涉及阴性（NILM）或低级别（LSIL）类别。这些结果表明，对于该数据集，校准是可靠性的主导杠杆，而非集成规模，不过该结论应结合数据集规模较小的背景加以审慎解读。

<details>

Result: 基于文献导出的延迟分布进行蒙特卡洛仿真，证明该方法在理论上能够区分真实生物响应与模拟攻击条件；多轮挑战设计可在存在非零渲染延迟间隙时提高对生成式深度伪造的检测能力。

Original Abstract: Ocular biometric systems face sophisticated presentation attacks, including high-resolution video replays and real-time generative deepfakes, which easily bypass static liveness checks. Current Presentation Attack Detection (PAD) frameworks typically rely on isolated physiological metrics, such as gaze tracking or the Pupillary Light Reflex (PLR), which can be spoofed independently. This paper proposes a Spatio-Luminance Sensor Fusion protocol, which introduces a dual-stream challenge-response framework for ocular liveness verification by uniting these metrics into a simultaneous authentication challenge. By generating a randomized, time-varying visual stimulus that fluctuates in both spatial trajectory and luminance intensity, we construct a mathematically coupled state-space likelihood model, termed the Synchronization Matrix, to evaluate the continuous cross-correlation between the expected biological latencies of smooth pursuit tracking and pupillary constriction. Using Monte Carlo simulation grounded in literature-derived latency distributions, we demonstrate theoretical separability between genuine and simulated attack conditions, and show that a multi-round challenge design improves the detection of generative deepfakes when a non-zero rendering-latency gap exists. ### [28] [ShapKO: Shapley-Adaptive Modality Knockout for Robust Multimodal Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09884)
*Nusrat Binta Nizam,Fengbei Liu,Sunwoo Kwak,Minh Nguyen,Ruining Deng,Mert R. Sabuncu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ShapKO提出了一种基于Shapley值的自适应模态淘汰策略，在训练过程中动态调整各模态的掩码概率，从而缓解多模态医学模型在输入缺失时的性能下降和模态主导问题，无需修改模型架构。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 多模态医学模型在输入缺失时性能严重下降；即使所有模态都存在，训练中也会出现模态主导现象（模型过度依赖预测能力强的模态而忽视互补模态），导致部分模态可用时鲁棒性差；现有的训练时模态淘汰方法使用静态掩码率，无法根据训练过程中模态效用的变化进行自适应调整。

Method: ShapKO是一种动态训练策略：周期性地评估模态子集上的验证性能，通过Shapley值估计各模态的重要性，据此更新各模态的掩码概率，使主导模态被更频繁地淘汰，促进模型学习互补表征。该方法无需修改模型架构。

Result: 在多任务临床分类、生存预测和癌症检测三个数据集上，ShapKO在模态缺失场景下持续提升了模型性能，并产生了可解释的掩码学习行为轨迹。

Conclusion: ShapKO通过自适应模态淘汰有效提升了多模态医学模型在模态缺失情况下的鲁棒性，且不依赖架构改动，具有良好的通用性和可解释性。

Original Abstract: Multimodal medical models often degrade when inputs are missing, a common scenario in real-world clinical workflows. Separately, even when all modalities are present, modality dominance is observed during training, where optimization over-relies on a highly predictive modality and undertrains complementary sources, resulting in poor robustness under partial availability. While training-time modality knockout improves missing-modality robustness, existing approaches use static masking rates that cannot adapt to evolving modality utility during training. We introduce ShapKO (Shapley-Adaptive Modality Knockout), a dynamic training strategy that learns modality-specific knockout probabilities based on validation utility. ShapKO periodically evaluates performance across modality subsets, estimates modality importance via Shapley values, and updates masking probabilities to suppress dominant modalities more frequently. This adaptive process promotes complementary representations, while requiring no architectural modifications. We evaluate ShapKO on three datasets covering multitask clinical classification, survival prediction, and cancer detection. ShapKO consistently improves performance under modality absence and yields interpretable trajectories of learned masking behavior. Code is available at: https://github.com/sumona00/ShapKO

中文摘要翻译: 多模态医学模型在输入缺失时性能常常下降，这是真实临床工作流中的常见情况。此外，即使所有模态都存在，训练过程中也会观察到模态主导现象——优化过程过度依赖预测能力强的模态，而弱化了互补来源的训练，导致在部分模态可用时鲁棒性差。虽然训练时的模态淘汰可以提高缺失模态鲁棒性，但现有方法使用静态掩码率，无法根据训练过程中模态效用的变化进行自适应调整。我们提出ShapKO（Shapley自适应模态淘汰），一种基于验证效用学习模态特定淘汰概率的动态训练策略。ShapKO周期性地评估模态子集上的性能，通过Shapley值估计模态重要性，并更新掩码概率以更频繁地抑制主导模态。这种自适应过程促进了互补表征的学习，同时无需修改模型架构。我们在三个数据集上评估了ShapKO，涵盖多任务临床分类、生存预测和癌症检测。ShapKO在模态缺失场景下持续提升了性能，并产生了可解释的掩码学习行为轨迹。代码地址：https://github.com/sumona00/ShapKO

  <summary>Details</summary>

Original Abstract: Automated product recognition is a cornerstone of modern retail intelligence; however, accurately matching real-world, in-store images against extensive corporate catalogs remains a major scalability bottleneck for large-scale applications. In this work, we address this challenge by reformulating the task as an embedding-based cross-domain retrieval problem rather than a standard closed-set classification task. Specifically, we define the objective as retrieving the most corresponding catalog reference image for a given real-world product query crop from an expansive inventory. To bridge the severe domain gap between pristine studio packshots and noisy in-store queries, we introduce a novel catalog-to-real multi-stage contrastive learning paradigm (Cat2Real). This framework fine-tunes a vision backbone by systematically exploiting both item-level and image-level similarities to drive targeted hard negative mining. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that our paradigm scales seamlessly to unseen products and categories, yielding outstanding zero-shot generalization performance even in the complete absence of real-world training images for novel inventory.

Main category: cs.CV

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探究CorrNet在连续手语识别中的两种看似合理的架构扩展（Transformer替换BiLSTM、注入运动线索）是否真的能带来性能提升，验证直觉驱动的扩展是否有效。

Method: 在复现的CorrNet系统基础上进行两种扩展：1) 将BiLSTM时序头替换为Transformer编码器并调整训练策略；2) 设计轻量级模块MotionGate在时序池化后注入运动线索。

Conclusion: CorrNet的基于相关性的编码已充分捕捉运动信息，显式运动注入是冗余的；在CSLR中不能想当然地认为自然架构扩展会有效，应谨慎测试验证。

Original Abstract: CorrNet is a strong baseline for continuous sign language recognition (CSLR) because it models inter-frame correlations inside the visual encoding stage. In this paper, we study two natural extensions of a reproduced CorrNet system: replacing the BiLSTM temporal head with a Transformer encoder, and injecting motion cues after temporal pooling. We find that the Transformer head does not outperform the BiLSTM baseline, even with a training strategy adjusted for the Transformer, and the two heads have almost the same computational and runtime cost. For the second extension, we design a lightweight module called MotionGate. In our experiments, MotionGate consistently collapses to an identity-like mapping: the gate loses motion selectivity, and the injected residual becomes a weak, non-selective perturbation of the pooled features. These results suggest that explicit motion injection after CorrNet's correlation-based encoding is largely redundant, and that natural-looking architectural extensions in CSLR should be tested carefully instead of being assumed to help.

中文摘要翻译: CorrNet是连续手语识别（CSLR）的一个强基线，因为它在视觉编码阶段建模了帧间相关性。本文研究了复现的CorrNet系统的两种自然扩展：将BiLSTM时序头替换为Transformer编码器，以及在时序池化后注入运动线索。我们发现，即使为Transformer调整了训练策略，Transformer头也未能超越BiLSTM基线，且两种头部的计算和运行时成本几乎相同。对于第二种扩展，我们设计了一个轻量级模块MotionGate。在我们的实验中，MotionGate始终塌缩为类似恒等映射的状态：门控失去了运动选择性，注入的残差变成了对池化特征的微弱、非选择性扰动。这些结果表明，在CorrNet基于相关性的编码之后进行显式运动注入在很大程度上是冗余的，并且CSLR中看似自然的架构扩展应被谨慎测试，而非想当然地认为会有帮助。

Original Abstract: Gimbal-stabilized visual tracking is critical for modern autonomous systems such as Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). While prior work shows acoustic signals can disturb gimbal internals, the impact of such attacks on real-world applications like UAV tracking and following remains underexplored. Existing demonstrations largely overlook practical challenges for real-world attacks, such as object-motion uncertainty and runtime latency. To bridge this gap, we present Banshee, the first physically realizable attack that induces target switching in UAV visual tracking systems by exploiting acoustic vulnerabilities in gimbal-camera systems. Banshee generates carefully crafted acoustic waveforms that induce optimized adversarial gimbal oscillations, causing directionally biased camera-view drifts that break inter-frame target associations. Consequently, the onboard tracker is driven to switch from the original target to an attacker-selected object with high probability, with occasional target loss. Banshee achieves a 93.6% success rate in simulation across two commercial gimbal systems and five trackers. Real-world benchtop and in-flight black-box attacks against a commercial drone across varied scenarios show an overall 95.5% attack success rate. Our results reveal a practical cross-domain vulnerability between acoustics and vision, highlighting the need for robust designs of gimbal systems and applications. Original Abstract: Unified multimodal models (UMMs) with interleaved reasoning, which generate both textual and visual steps as part of intermediate reasoning traces, have demonstrated great potential for visual mathematical reasoning tasks. However, we identify a key insight in this paradigm: generating intermediate visual reasoning steps is not always beneficial and can even be harmful, as self-generated visual steps may introduce erroneous visual evidence that misleads subsequent reasoning. Moreover, frequently triggering visual steps during reasoning incurs substantial computational and memory overhead, degrading inference efficiency. To address these accuracy and efficiency challenges, we observe that the model's internal signals can indicate whether a visual step will benefit reasoning before the entire visual generation is completed. Specifically, this work identifies two internal signals: 1) Generation Intent, which reflects whether the model has a concrete textual plan for what to draw, and 2) Visual Fidelity, which measures whether the visual generation remains grounded in the original input image. Leveraging these internal signals, we propose AdaViG, a training-free adaptive visual gating method for unified multimodal reasoning. AdaViG dynamically evaluates each triggered visual step at an early visual generation stage and aborts it when both signals are weak, thereby preventing misleading visual evidence from entering the reasoning trace while avoiding unnecessary computation. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that AdaViG improves accuracy by up to 5.7% while reducing visual generation FLOPs by 25.0%-91.0% and wall-clock latency by 15.4%-45.6%.

We revisit Tensorized Sampling-VT from an operator-execution perspective and show that it follows a gather-reduction pattern: each BEV query independently accumulates contributions across cameras and height bins, enabling thread-local accumulation with on-the-fly recomputation that eliminates the need to materialize height- and camera-dependent intermediates. Based on this insight, we propose FlashBEV, a fully fused and IO-aware execution strategy mathematically equivalent to Tensorized Sampling-VT (same operator output) while substantially reducing global memory traffic and kernel-launch overhead. Experiments show that FlashBEV achieves more than an order of magnitude lower peak GPU memory and significant inference-latency speedups, with memory effectively independent of the number of height bins, reducing the operator's peak memory to O(BCXY) (output only). This unlocks higher BEV range/resolution and vertical discretization within fixed deployment budgets on memory-constrained devices. Our contribution is an execution redesign -- same math, different execution -- that removes a key scalability barrier for deployment-ready Sampling-VT. Original Abstract: We introduce Grassmannian splatting, a dynamic scene representation whose primitives are Gaussians supported on 3-planes in spacetime $\R^4$: generically, spatial 2-planes in uniform translation along their normals. Each primitive carries a unit normal $n \in \mathbb S^3/\{\pm 1\} \cong \mathrm{Gr}(3,4)$ and an unconstrained factor $L \in \mathbb R^{4 \times 3}$, with covariance \[
  Σ_{4\mathrm{D}} = (P_n L)(P_n L)^T, \qquad P_n = I - n n^T. \] For generic $L$ and $n \neq \pm e_0$, conditioning on time returns a rank-2 surfel at every frame. The normal of the disk and its velocity along that normal are read off from $n$; the disk shape and the tangential drift of its center are set by $L$. Existing native 4D Gaussian splatting methods [\it{Yang et. al. 2023,Duan et. al. 2024}] slice full-rank spacetime covariances, so their per-frame primitive is a volumetric ellipsoid; since conditioning lowers rank by exactly one, a rank-2 surfel in the slice requires a rank-3 spacetime covariance, and the parameterization above realizes exactly these. The motion model is closed form, i.e. no deformation field is learned, and no custom CUDA is required: the conditioned disk feeds a standard 3DGS rasterizer through its precomputed-covariance interface. A soft clamp in the Schur denominator regularizes the static orientation and continuously bridges rank-3 static and rank-2 dynamic behavior, so static and moving primitives form a single continuous family. On the 17 HyperNeRF scenes of MonoDyGauBench, training is fastest among all compared methods (4.9 to 5.6 times faster than the strongest quality baselines), while ranking second in PSNR, MS-SSIM, and LPIPS. The scaled NanoVSR-1.7M variant reaches 29.15 dB with a throughput of 19.58 FPS, providing superior, edge-optimized upscaling. Code is available at https://github.com/filippawlicki/nanovsr.

*Shengyuan Liu,Jia-Xuan Jiang,Boyun Zheng,Cheng Wang,Zipei Wang,Wentao Pan,Hongtao Wu,Houwen Peng,Yu Gu,Lichao Sun,Yixuan Yuan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出AMID，一个面向医学影像模型开发的自主多智能体框架。AMID通过数据条件化方法规划与验证引导的两阶段优化，在20项医学影像挑战任务上表现优于通用MLE系统，部分任务接近或达到人类专家设计的解决方案水平。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有大语言模型智能体已开始自动化机器学习工程流程，但将该能力迁移到医学影像领域仍十分困难，因为每项任务都涉及模态特定的实验设计、严格的验证协议要求和预测工件规范。亟需一个能够处理医学影像多样性和严格要求的自动化框架。

Method: AMID包含两大核心组件：(1) 数据条件化方法规划——通过任务特定数据分析将粗粒度的任务级搜索空间细化为一组可执行、可并行的方法通道；(2) 验证引导的两阶段优化——先对多样化方法通道进行广泛早期探索，再转向对候选方案的选择性利用，并在全过程中强制执行验证协议、度量计算和预测工件的严格验证。

Result: 在涵盖多种模态和预测类型的20项医学影像挑战任务上，AMID在多个基准上超越了评估的通用MLE系统，并且在若干任务上接近或匹敌由人类专家设计的强基线解决方案。

Conclusion: AMID能够将任务特定的医学影像模型开发从定制化手工工程转变为一种智能化工作流，从而在异构任务上生成高性能且可审计的模型工件。

Original Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are beginning to automate machine learning engineering (MLE) by coupling planning, code execution, debugging, and empirical feedback. Translating this capability to medical imaging remains difficult because each task imposes modality-specific experimentation and strict requirements for validation protocols and prediction artifacts. Here we introduce AMID, an autonomous multi-agent framework for medical imaging model development. AMID first proposes Data-Conditioned Method Planning, which refines coarse task-level search spaces into executable, parallelizable method lanes grounded in task-specific data analysis and runnable medical-imaging resources. It then develops Verification-Guided Two-Stage Optimization, moving from broad early exploration of diverse method lanes to selective exploitation of promising candidates while enforcing strict verification of validation protocols, metric computation, and prediction artifacts throughout the optimization. Across 20 medical imaging challenge tasks spanning diverse modalities and prediction types, AMID outperformed evaluated general-purpose MLE systems and, on several tasks, approached or matched strong human-designed challenge solutions. These results suggest that AMID can turn task-specific medical imaging model development from bespoke manual engineering into an agentic workflow for producing high-performing and auditable model artifacts across heterogeneous tasks.

中文摘要翻译: 大语言模型智能体通过耦合规划、代码执行、调试和实证反馈，开始实现机器学习工程的自动化。然而，将这一能力迁移到医学影像领域仍然困难，因为每项任务都涉及模态特定的实验设计、严格的验证协议要求和预测工件规范。本文提出AMID，一个面向医学影像模型开发的自主多智能体框架。AMID首先提出数据条件化方法规划，该策略通过任务特定的数据分析及可运行的医学影像资源，将粗粒度的任务级搜索空间细化为可执行、可并行的方法通道。随后，AMID开发了验证引导的两阶段优化，从对多样化方法通道的广泛早期探索过渡到对有前景候选方案的选择性利用，并在整个优化过程中强制执行验证协议、度量计算和预测工件的严格验证。在涵盖多种模态和预测类型的20项医学影像挑战任务上，AMID超越了所评估的通用MLE系统，并且在若干任务上接近或匹敌由人类专家设计的强基线解决方案。这些结果表明，AMID能够将任务特定的医学影像模型开发从定制化手工工程转变为一种智能化工作流，从而在异构任务上生成高性能且可审计的模型工件。

### [71] [Improving Sample Diversity in Autoregressive Text-to-Image Generation via Cluster Truncation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10535)
*Trang Nguyen,Shuang Wu,Runyan Tan,Phillip Howard*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次系统研究了自回归图像生成模型的样本多样性问题，发现现有token级解码策略效果有限，并提出了一种新的聚类级解码策略p-less cluster，在保持图像质量和提示对齐的前提下，显著提升了多样性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 扩散模型在文本到图像生成中虽能达到最先进的图像质量，但存在样本多样性坍塌问题。自回归模型作为替代方案，其序列生成特性兼容文本生成中用于提升多样性的解码策略，有望实现更好的多样性-质量权衡，但目前缺乏对AR图像生成模型多样性的系统研究。

Method: 提出p-less cluster解码策略，在聚类级别（而非token级别）执行基于熵的截断采样，以应对AR图像生成中token级熵持续偏高和视觉token空间存在大量冗余这两个关键特性。

Result: 在四个自回归T2I模型和两个数据集上，使用涵盖图像质量、提示对齐和多样性的综合指标进行评估，结果表明p-less cluster在绝大多数设置下实现了最大的多样性提升，同时保持了图像质量和提示对齐。

Conclusion: 自回归图像生成模型的样本多样性受到token级高熵和视觉token冗余的限制，而聚类级的截断采样策略能更有效地解锁多样性。

Original Abstract: While diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art image quality for text-to-image (T2I) generation, recent work has demonstrated that they suffer from sample diversity collapse. In this work, we investigate whether autoregressive (AR) image generation models can push the Pareto frontier between image quality and sample diversity. With recent advances in quality and efficiency, AR models have emerged as a viable alternative to diffusion-based image generation. Beyond enabling new use cases such as interleaved image-text generation, their sequential generation process makes them compatible with a wide range of token-based decoding strategies originally developed to improve diversity in text generation. Motivated by the potential of a better diversity-quality tradeoff in the AR paradigm, we present the first systematic study of sample diversity in AR image generation models. We show that two key properties of AR image generation, persistently high token-level entropy and substantial redundancy in visual token spaces, limit the effectiveness of existing token-level decoding methods for diversity enhancement. We therefore propose $p$-less cluster, a new decoding strategy that performs entropy-based truncation sampling at cluster level rather than at token level. We evaluate our approach and baseline decoding methods across four autoregressive T2I models and two datasets using a comprehensive suite of metrics spanning image quality, prompt alignment, and diversity. Our results show that $p$-less cluster unlocks the greatest diversity across most evaluated autoregressive T2I models and datasets while maintaining image quality and prompt alignment.

中文摘要翻译: 尽管扩散模型在文本到图像（T2I）生成中实现了最先进的图像质量，但近期研究表明它们存在样本多样性坍塌问题。本文研究了自回归（AR）图像生成模型是否能够推动图像质量与样本多样性之间的帕累托前沿。随着质量和效率方面的最新进展，AR模型已成为基于扩散的图像生成的可行替代方案。除了支持交错图文生成等新用例之外，其序列生成过程使其兼容多种最初为提升文本生成多样性而开发的基于token的解码策略。受AR范式中实现更好多样性-质量权衡潜力的启发，我们首次对AR图像生成模型中的样本多样性进行了系统研究。我们发现，AR图像生成的两个关键特性——持续较高的token级熵和视觉token空间中的大量冗余——限制了现有token级解码方法在多样性增强方面的有效性。因此，我们提出了p-less cluster，一种新的解码策略，它在聚类级别而非token级别执行基于熵的截断采样。我们在四个自回归T2I模型和两个数据集上，使用涵盖图像质量、提示对齐和多样性的综合指标评估了我们的方法和基线解码策略。结果表明，在大多数评估的自回归T2I模型和数据集中，p-less cluster在保持图像质量和提示对齐的同时，实现了最大的多样性提升。

</details>


### [72] [Physics-inspired Pseudo Anomaly Generation and Prototype Feature Guidance for 3D Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10544)
*Jian Ning,Qin Zou,Linchun Wu,Yuanhao Yue,Kunmo Li,Shoubin Chen,Zhongyuan Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对3D点云异常检测中真实异常样本稀少且获取成本高的问题，提出PA3AD框架，通过物理启发的伪异常生成策略和原型特征引导机制，有效学习正常与异常的分布偏移，在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD数据集上达到SOTA性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 3D点云异常检测在工业制造中至关重要，但真实异常样本稀缺且获取成本高昂，同时训练数据天然无异常，使得检测方法难以有效学习正常与异常样本间的判别性特征。

Method: 提出PA3AD框架，包含两个核心创新：(1)物理启发模块，通过多物理场建模从正常数据生成多样化的伪异常点云；(2)动量更新原型和差异感知融合模块，捕获稳定的正常表示及其与伪异常之间的差异，从而有效学习分布偏移。

Result: 在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD两个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法一致性地优于现有最先进方法。

Conclusion: PA3AD通过物理启发的伪异常生成和原型特征引导机制，有效解决了真实异常样本稀缺问题，实现了卓越的3D点云异常检测性能。

Original Abstract: 3D point cloud anomaly detection plays a vital role in industrial manufacturing, yet it faces significant challenges due to the scarcity and high acquisition cost of real anomalous samples. The inherently anomaly-free training data further hinders detection methods from effectively learning discriminative features between normal and abnormal instances. To address these issues, we propose PA3AD, a novel framework that introduces a physics-inspired pseudo-anomaly generation strategy to create physically plausible anomalous samples from normal data. Additionally, we incorporate prototype features via a weight-sharing mechanism to guide the model in capturing the distribution shifts between normal and anomalous samples. Specifically, PA3AD introduces two key innovations to tackle the scarcity of real anomalies. First, a physics-inspired module generates diverse pseudo-anomalous point clouds from normal data via multi-physics modeling. Second, momentum-updated prototypes and a difference-aware fusion block capture stable normal representations and their discrepancies with pseudo-anomalies. This design effectively learns distribution shifts, achieving superior detection performance. Extensive experiments on the Anomaly-ShapeNet and Real3D-AD datasets demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art approaches. Our code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/NingxiaoJian/PA3AD.

中文摘要翻译: 3D点云异常检测在工业制造中发挥着至关重要的作用，但由于真实异常样本的稀缺性和高获取成本，该任务面临着巨大挑战。训练数据本身天然无异常，进一步阻碍了检测方法有效学习正常与异常样本之间的判别性特征。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了PA3AD，一种新颖的框架，它引入了物理启发的伪异常生成策略，从正常数据中创建物理上合理的异常样本。此外，我们通过权重共享机制引入原型特征，以引导模型捕捉正常样本与异常样本之间的分布偏移。具体来说，PA3AD引入了两项关键创新来解决真实异常的稀缺问题。首先，一个物理启发模块通过多物理场建模从正常数据生成多样化的伪异常点云。其次，动量更新的原型和差异感知融合模块捕获稳定的正常表示及其与伪异常之间的差异。该设计有效地学习了分布偏移，实现了卓越的检测性能。在Anomaly-ShapeNet和Real3D-AD数据集上的大量实验表明，我们的方法一致性地优于现有最先进方法。我们的代码将在https://github.com/NingxiaoJian/PA3AD上公开。

</details>


### [73] [Why Domain Matters: Domain-Aware Benchmarking of Underwater Object Detection and Annotation Quality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10575)
*Melanie Wille,Dimity Miller,Tobias Fischer,Scarlett Raine*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于外观、场景构成和采集几何的水下图像域标签框架，首次系统研究了域因素对水下目标检测中人工标注质量和深度学习检测器性能的影响，揭示了显著的域依赖差异，并展示了该框架在指导数据采集、设计更信息化的基准测试以及评估检测器鲁棒性方面的应用价值。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有水下目标检测评估使用聚合指标会掩盖特定环境下的性能失败，且域泛化基准多依赖不反映真实条件的合成变化，缺乏系统研究域因素对检测性能影响的工作。

Method: 提出一个通过外观、场景构成和采集几何三个维度描述水下图像以分配域标签的框架，并基于此框架系统分析域因素对人工标注质量和深度学习检测器性能的影响。

Result: 发现水下目标检测中域因素会导致显著的域依赖差异，即在不同水下环境中检测性能和标注质量存在不一致性。

Conclusion: 通过引入物理上有意义的域标签，域偏移变得可表征、可测量、可基准化、可应对，可用于指导数据采集与标注、设计更信息化的基准测试、评估检测器在不同水下环境中的鲁棒性。

Original Abstract: Underwater object detection is strongly affected by domain shift, where performance can vary significantly across different locations, habitats, and deployment conditions. However, detector performance is typically evaluated using aggregate metrics that hide failures in specific environments, while existing domain generalization benchmarks often rely on synthetic variations that do not reflect real-world conditions. We introduce a framework that characterizes underwater images by appearance, scene composition, and acquisition geometry to assign domain labels. Using this framework, we perform the first systematic study of how domain factors influence both human annotation quality in underwater object detection datasets and deep learning-based detector performance, revealing substantial domain-dependent discrepancies. By incorporating physically meaningful domain labels, domain shift becomes something we can characterize, measure, benchmark, and act on. We highlight how this can be used to guide data collection and annotation, design more informative benchmarks, and assess detector robustness across diverse underwater environments.

中文摘要翻译: 水下目标检测受到域偏移的强烈影响，其性能在不同位置、栖息地和部署条件下可能存在显著差异。然而，检测器性能通常使用聚合指标进行评估，这掩盖了特定环境下的失败情况；同时，现有的域泛化基准往往依赖无法反映真实世界条件的合成变化。我们引入了一个框架，通过外观、场景构成和采集几何三个维度描述水下图像，从而分配域标签。利用该框架，我们首次系统研究了域因素如何影响水下目标检测数据集中的人工标注质量以及基于深度学习的检测器性能，揭示了显著的域依赖差异。通过引入物理上有意义的域标签，域偏移变得可表征、可测量、可基准化、可应对。我们重点展示了这如何用于指导数据采集与标注、设计更具信息性的基准测试，以及评估检测器在多种水下环境中的鲁棒性。

</details>


### [74] [DiffUE: Enhancing Utility-Unlearnability Trade-off of Unlearnable Examples via Diffusion Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10580)
*Syed Irfan Ali Meerza,Oktay Ozturk,Amir Sadovnik,Jian Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DiffUE，通过将噪声注入图像的语义空间而非像素空间，利用扩散自编码器框架生成自然且鲁棒的不可学习样本，在保持视觉质量的同时有效抵抗各种重学习攻击。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有不可学习样本方法主要依赖像素空间噪声，容易被对抗训练、图像变换和压缩等重学习策略绕过；虽有一些鲁棒性增强技术，但往往以牺牲图像质量和实用性为代价。

Method: DiffUE利用基于扩散的自编码器框架，将噪声注入到图像的高层语义特征空间而非像素空间，生成具有自然外观的修改，能够有效抵抗高级重学习策略。

Result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CelebA-HQ和ImageNet四个数据集上的实验以及主观用户研究表明，DiffUE显著提升了图像质量与不可学习性之间的权衡，提供了更鲁棒有效的个人数据保护方案。

Conclusion: DiffUE通过语义空间噪声注入，在保护个人隐私数据方面实现了比现有像素空间方法更优的鲁棒性和视觉质量平衡。

Original Abstract: AI models are increasingly trained on personal images scraped from social media and public platforms, often without consent, leading to serious privacy violations, such as unauthorized facial recognition and targeted advertising. To counter this, researchers have developed unlearnable examples (UEs), images modified with imperceptible noise to prevent AI models from extracting meaningful information. However, existing UE methods primarily rely on pixel-space noise, which can be bypassed by relearning strategies such as adversarial training, image transformation, and compression. While some techniques improve robustness, they often come at the expense of significant degradation in image utility and perceptual quality. In this paper, we introduce DiffUE to overcome these limitations by injecting noise into the semantic space of images instead of the pixel space. Instead of corrupting pixel values, DiffUE modifies high-level semantic features of images, ensuring robust unlearnability while preserving visual quality and utility. By leveraging a diffusion-based autoencoder framework to manipulate semantic features, DiffUE generates purposeful, natural-looking modifications that effectively resist advanced relearning strategies. Extensive experiments on four datasets, CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, CelebA-HQ, and ImageNet, as well as a subjective user study, demonstrate that DiffUE significantly enhances the trade-off between image quality and unlearnability, offering a more robust and effective solution for safeguarding personal data in an increasingly exploitative AI landscape.

中文摘要翻译: 人工智能模型越来越多地使用从社交媒体和公共平台抓取的个人图像进行训练，且往往未经用户同意，导致严重的隐私侵犯，例如未经授权的人脸识别和定向广告。为应对这一问题，研究人员开发了不可学习样本（UEs），即通过添加不可感知的噪声来修改图像，从而阻止AI模型提取有意义的信息。然而，现有的UE方法主要依赖像素空间噪声，这可以被对抗训练、图像变换和压缩等重学习策略绕过。虽然某些技术提升了鲁棒性，但它们通常以牺牲图像实用性和感知质量为代价。在本文中，我们提出了DiffUE来克服这些限制，该方法将噪声注入到图像的语义空间而非像素空间。DiffUE不是破坏像素值，而是修改图像的高层语义特征，从而在保持视觉质量和实用性的同时确保鲁棒的不可学习性。通过利用基于扩散的自编码器框架来操控语义特征，DiffUE生成具有目的性、自然外观的修改，有效抵抗高级重学习策略。在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、CelebA-HQ和ImageNet四个数据集上的大量实验以及一项主观用户研究表明，DiffUE显著增强了图像质量与不可学习性之间的权衡，为在日益被利用的AI环境中保护个人数据提供了一种更鲁棒且更有效的解决方案。

</details>


### [75] [Benchmarking UAV-based Vehicle Re-Identification under Simulated Weather Conditions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10583)
*Vu Minh Tran,Khang Nguyen*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统评估了三种代表性车辆重识别方法（CLIP-ReID、MSINet、AdaSP）在无人机航拍场景下面对合成雾天和雨天干扰的鲁棒性，发现恶劣天气显著降低检索性能，其中雨天影响更大，AdaSP表现最佳，揭示了现有方法在天气鲁棒性上的不足，呼吁未来研究应关注天气感知模型设计。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 尽管无人机车辆重识别在交通监控等领域有重要应用，但现有方法在恶劣天气下的鲁棒性缺乏系统研究。天气退化（雾、雨）会严重影响航拍图像中用于车辆匹配的细粒度外观线索，尤其是在小目标、视角变化和复杂背景条件下。因此，有必要对现有方法进行受控的对比鲁棒性评估。

Method: 选取三种代表性车辆ReID方法（CLIP-ReID、MSINet、AdaSP），在VRU和UAV-VeID两个无人机基准数据集上，使用解析天气效应管线生成合成雾天和雨天变体，保持原始身份标签和数据划分一致，在匹配的干净、雾天、雨天条件下进行训练和评估。

Result: 恶劣天气持续降低所有方法的检索性能，雨天导致的性能下降普遍大于雾天。AdaSP在雾天和雨天条件下表现最优：VRU-Large上mAP分别达93.0%和88.5%，UAV-VeID-Test上分别达88.7%和76.2%。

Conclusion: 模拟恶劣天气显著增加了无人机车辆ReID的难度，揭示了现有方法在鲁棒性上的明显差异，强调了未来航拍ReID研究需要设计天气感知模型和评估协议。

Original Abstract: UAV-based vehicle re-identification (ReID) has emerged as a promising technique for traffic surveillance, urban monitoring, and public-safety applications thanks to the flexible viewpoints and wide-area coverage provided by unmanned aerial vehicles. However, despite recent progress on UAV-based vehicle ReID benchmarks, the robustness of existing methods under adverse weather remains insufficiently studied. This is important because weather degradation can significantly affect the fine-grained appearance cues required for reliable vehicle matching in aerial imagery, especially under small object scale, viewpoint variation, and complex backgrounds. In this paper, we present a controlled comparative study of three representative recent vehicle ReID methods, namely CLIP-ReID, MSINet, and AdaSP, on two UAV-based benchmarks, VRU and UAV-VeID. To ensure consistent robustness evaluation, we generate synthetic foggy and rainy variants of both datasets using an analytical weather-effect pipeline while preserving the original identities and data splits. All methods are then trained and evaluated under matched clean, foggy, and rainy conditions. Experimental results show that adverse weather consistently degrades retrieval performance across both datasets, with rain causing larger drops than fog in nearly all settings. Among the evaluated methods, AdaSP demonstrates the strongest robustness, achieving 93.0% and 88.5% mAP on VRU-Large, and 88.7% and 76.2% mAP on UAV-VeID-Test under foggy and rainy conditions, respectively. Overall, our findings show that simulated adverse weather substantially increases the difficulty of UAV-based vehicle ReID, reveals clear robustness differences among recent methods, and highlights the need for weather-aware model design and evaluation protocols in future aerial ReID research. The code is released at https://github.com/tranminhvu945/Benchmarking-ReID.

中文摘要翻译: 基于无人机的车辆重识别（ReID）凭借无人机提供的灵活视角和广域覆盖能力，已成为交通监控、城市监测和公共安全应用中一项极具前景的技术。然而，尽管近年来无人机车辆ReID基准测试取得了进展，现有方法在恶劣天气下的鲁棒性仍缺乏充分研究。这一问题至关重要，因为天气退化会显著影响航拍图像中用于可靠车辆匹配所需的细粒度外观线索，尤其是在小目标尺度、视角变化和复杂背景条件下。本文在VRU和UAV-VeID两个无人机基准数据集上，对三种具有代表性的最新车辆ReID方法（CLIP-ReID、MSINet和AdaSP）进行了受控对比研究。为确保鲁棒性评估的一致性，我们使用解析天气效应管线生成了两个数据集的合成雾天和雨天变体，同时保留原始身份标签和数据划分。所有方法均在匹配的干净、雾天和雨天条件下进行训练和评估。实验结果表明，恶劣天气持续降低两个数据集上的检索性能，且在几乎所有设置中，雨天导致的性能下降均大于雾天。在所评估的方法中，AdaSP表现出最强的鲁棒性，在VRU-Large上雾天和雨天的mAP分别达到93.0%和88.5%，在UAV-VeID-Test上分别达到88.7%和76.2%。总体而言，我们的研究结果表明，模拟恶劣天气显著增加了无人机车辆ReID的难度，揭示了近期方法间明显的鲁棒性差异，并强调了未来航拍ReID研究中需要采用天气感知模型设计与评估协议。代码已开源：https://github.com/tranminhvu945/Benchmarking-ReID。
