Method: 基于DriveLM风格的多视图视觉问答，每个场景使用六路同步摄像头图像和结构化问答对。参与者生成对抗性图像和后缀文本扰动，使模型输出偏离参考答案，同时约束图像保真度和文本成本。比赛分两阶段，第二阶段引入隐藏黑盒模型评估迁移性。

Result: 五项优秀提交分析显示：图像侧攻击因后缀惩罚而更受青睐；场景级多视图优化优于单视图独立处理；问答类型和图结构为攻击预算分配提供先验；特征空间目标可提升黑盒迁移性；摄像头图像中的排版内容暴露了自动驾驶VLA的持续脆弱性。

Conclusion: 这些发现为未来多模态自动驾驶系统的鲁棒性评估和防御设计提供了实用参考。

Original Abstract: Vision-language agents (VLAs) are increasingly used to interpret complex driving scenes and support safety-critical reasoning. This report presents the CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop Challenge on adversarial multimodal attacks against autonomous-driving VLAs. Built on DriveLM-style multi-view visual question answering, the challenge represents each scene with six synchronized camera images and a structured collection of driving-related question-answer pairs. Participants generate adversarial images and suffix-only textual perturbations that induce model responses to deviate from reference answers while preserving image fidelity and limiting textual cost. The competition comprises two phases, with Phase II adding a hidden black-box model to assess transferability. We describe the task design, submission rules, evaluation protocol, and leaderboard results, and then examine five leading submissions for which technical reports were available. Across these reports, several recurring patterns emerge: image-side attacks are favored by the suffix penalty; scene-level, multi-view optimization is more effective than treating views in isolation; QA types and graph structure provide useful priors for allocating attack budget; feature-space objectives can improve black-box transfer; and typographic content embedded in camera images exposes a persistent vulnerability in driving VLAs. These findings provide a practical reference for future robustness evaluation and defense design in multimodal autonomous-driving systems.

中文摘要翻译: 视觉-语言智能体（VLA）越来越多地被用于解释复杂的驾驶场景并支持安全关键推理。本报告介绍了CVPR 2026@AdvML Workshop关于针对自动驾驶VLA的对抗性多模态攻击挑战赛。该挑战基于DriveLM风格的多视图视觉问答，每个场景由六路同步摄像头图像和一组结构化的驾驶相关问答对表示。参与者生成对抗性图像和仅后缀文本扰动，使模型输出偏离参考答案，同时保持图像保真度并限制文本成本。比赛包含两个阶段，第二阶段引入隐藏黑盒模型以评估迁移性。我们描述了任务设计、提交规则、评估协议和排行榜结果，然后考察了五项有技术报告可查的优秀提交。在这些报告中，出现了若干重复模式：图像侧攻击因后缀惩罚而更受青睐；场景级多视图优化比孤立处理各视图更有效；问答类型和图结构为攻击预算分配提供了有用先验；特征空间目标可以改善黑盒迁移；摄像头图像中嵌入的排版内容暴露了自动驾驶VLA的持续脆弱性。这些发现为未来多模态自动驾驶系统的鲁棒性评估和防御设计提供了实用参考。

</details>


### [165] [MonkeyOCRv2: A Visual-Text Foundation Model for Document AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11562)
*Yuliang Liu,Zhang Li,Ziyang Zhang,Shuo Zhang,Qiang Liu,Jiajun Song,Zidun Guo,Xinhan Wang,Handong Zheng,Yang Liu,Dongliang Luo,Zhiyin Ma,Jiarui Zhang,Xiang Bai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MonkeyOCRv2是一种专为文档AI设计的视觉-文本预训练模型，通过构建1.13亿张图像、覆盖17种语言的最大文档预训练语料库MonkeyDoc v2，并采用图像到文本生成与像素级文档重建的联合预训练策略，在五个文档分析任务上取得一致提升，作为冻结视觉编码器在0.7B文档解析模型上达到开源SOTA，并在八个文档理解基准上优于CLIP/DINO/SAM等通用视觉编码器。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 主流的视觉编码器在自然图像上预训练，缺乏对文档图像中密集文本和精细字符笔画的字符级视觉感知能力，因此需要面向文档领域的视觉预训练。

Method: 构建了目前最大的文档图像预训练语料库MonkeyDoc v2（1.13亿张图像，17种语言），并提出联合学习图像到文本生成（对齐视觉与文本内容）和像素级文档重建（保留字符笔画和布局细节）的预训练策略。

Result: 在文本识别、公式识别、文本检测、文档篡改检测、重叠文本分割五个任务上均有一致提升；冻结作为视觉编码器搭配轻量语言模型，0.7B文档解析模型在MDPBench上超越3B的dots.mocr达2.8%绝对值，编码器小11倍；在八个文档理解基准上优于基于CLIP/DINO/SAM的模型。

Conclusion: 面向文档的视觉预训练可以独立作为文档智能的基础，MonkeyOCRv2证明了文档导向的预训练相比通用视觉预训练在文档AI任务上具有显著优势。

Original Abstract: Mainstream visual encoders are pretrained on natural images and cannot be effectively applied to document images without document-oriented adaptation, as dense text and fine-grained character strokes demand character-level visual perception. We present MonkeyOCRv2, a visual-text pretrained model for document AI. First, we construct MonkeyDoc v2, to our knowledge the largest document-image pretraining corpus, comprising 113 million images spanning 17 languages. Second, we propose a pretraining strategy that jointly learns image-to-text generation and pixel-level document reconstruction: the former aligns visual representations with textual content, while the latter preserves character strokes and layout details. Extensive experiments are conducted on five representative document analysis tasks, including text recognition, formula recognition, text detection, document tampering detection, and overlapping text segmentation. Replacing the original encoders with MonkeyOCRv2 consistently improves performance across all five tasks. Finally, we validate its effectiveness as the vision encoder of multimodal large language models on the more challenging tasks of document parsing and document understanding. Kept frozen and paired with a lightweight language model, it yields a 0.7B document parsing model that sets a new open-source state-of-the-art on MDPBench, a recent benchmark spanning digital-born and photographed documents across 17 languages, surpassing the previous best 3B dots.mocr by 2.8% absolute with a vision encoder roughly 11$\times$ smaller. The frozen encoder also powers a document understanding model that outperforms counterparts built on CLIP, DINO, and SAM across eight benchmarks under identical training settings. These results suggest that document-oriented visual pretraining can serve as a foundation for document intelligence in its own right.

中文摘要翻译: 主流的视觉编码器在自然图像上预训练，无法有效应用于未经文档导向适配的文档图像，因为密集文本和精细字符笔画需要字符级的视觉感知。我们提出MonkeyOCRv2，一个面向文档AI的视觉-文本预训练模型。首先，我们构建了MonkeyDoc v2，据我们所知是目前最大的文档图像预训练语料库，包含1.13亿张图像，覆盖17种语言。其次，我们提出了一种联合学习图像到文本生成与像素级文档重建的预训练策略：前者将视觉表示与文本内容对齐，后者保留字符笔画和布局细节。在五个代表性文档分析任务（文本识别、公式识别、文本检测、文档篡改检测、重叠文本分割）上进行了大量实验。将原始编码器替换为MonkeyOCRv2后，五个任务的一致性能均有提升。最后，我们在更具挑战性的文档解析和文档理解任务上验证了其作为多模态大语言模型视觉编码器的有效性。保持冻结状态并搭配轻量语言模型，它生成了一个0.7B的文档解析模型，在MDPBench（一个近期发布的涵盖数字原生和拍摄文档、17种语言的基准测试）上取得了新的开源最优结果，以约11倍更小的视觉编码器，超越了此前最佳3B的dots.mocr模型2.8%的绝对值。该冻结编码器还驱动了一个文档理解模型，在相同训练设置下，在八个基准上优于基于CLIP、DINO和SAM的对应模型。这些结果表明，面向文档的视觉预训练可以独立成为文档智能的基础。

</details>


### [166] [Actor as Its Own Critic: Unifying Region Understanding and Localization via CycleGRPO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11581)
*Xin Zhang,Haochen Wang,Yikang Zhou,Jason Li,Robby T. Tan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: CycleGRPO是一种统一的强化学习框架，通过“区域→文本→区域”的自循环机制，让MLLM同时作为演员和评论家，在不依赖文本真值的情况下联合优化区域理解与定位能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法通常将区域理解和定位任务分离处理，且依赖大量文本标注。论文利用这两个任务之间固有的对偶性，提出一种无需文本真值的自评价强化学习范式，以统一优化MLLM的像素级能力。

Method: 提出CycleGRPO框架，核心是“区域→文本→区域”的自循环强化学习范式：同一MLLM先作为actor生成区域描述，再作为critic将生成的文本映射回空间域。采用质量感知的token级循环一致性奖励，通过文本描述的物理定位精度来评估其语义判别能力。基于SAMTok构建。

Result: 无需任何任务特定微调，在区域描述、区域VQA、接地对话和指代分割等多个基准测试上均取得一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: CycleGRPO提供了一种简单且可扩展的方式，能够有效提升MLLM的像素级能力，代码和模型已开源。

Original Abstract: This paper introduces Actor as Its Own Critic, a unified reinforcement learning framework, Cycle Group Relative Policy Optimization (CycleGRPO), that jointly optimizes region understanding and localization for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Unlike existing separate pipelines, we leverage the inherent duality between the two tasks to construct a self-evaluating reinforcement learning paradigm: "region $\to$ text $\to$ region''. Specifically, a single MLLM first acts as the actor to generate region captions, then immediately transitions to a critic to ground its generated text back in the spatial domain. Therefore, CycleGRPO requires only region inputs, e.g., masks or bounding boxes, entirely bypassing the need for textual ground truths. A quality-aware token-level cycle-consistency reward is employed to assess the semantic discriminability of text captions via their physical localization accuracy. Empirically, built upon SAMTok, our CycleGRPO framework successfully bootstraps both capabilities simultaneously. Without any task-specific fine-tuning, the framework yields consistent performance gains across a wide range of benchmarks, including region captioning, region VQA, grounded dialogue, and referring segmentation. Overall, CycleGRPO offers a straightforward and scalable way to advance pixel-level capabilities in MLLMs. Code and models are released at https://github.com/devinxzhang/CycleGRPO.

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出了"演员即评论家"的统一强化学习框架——循环组相对策略优化（CycleGRPO），用于联合优化多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的区域理解和定位能力。与现有的分离式流水线不同，我们利用两个任务之间的固有效对偶性构建了一个自评价强化学习范式："区域→文本→区域"。具体而言，单个MLLM首先充当actor生成区域描述，然后立即转变为critic，将其生成的文本映射回空间域。因此，CycleGRPO仅需区域输入（如掩码或边界框），完全绕过了对文本真值的需求。采用质量感知的token级循环一致性奖励，通过文本描述的物理定位精度来评估其语义判别能力。实验结果表明，基于SAMTok构建的CycleGRPO框架能够同时引导两种能力的提升。无需任何任务特定的微调，该框架在区域描述、区域VQA、接地对话和指代分割等多个基准测试上均取得一致的性能提升。总体而言，CycleGRPO提供了一种简单且可扩展的方式来提升MLLM的像素级能力。代码和模型已在https://github.com/devinxzhang/CycleGRPO开源。

</details>


### [167] [GB-SVFBP: Gaussian-Based Shift-Variant FBP neural network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11584)
*Chengze Ye,Linda-Sophie Schneider,Yipeng Sun,Andreas Maier*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于高斯的移位变体滤波反投影神经网络，用于非圆形轨迹锥束CT的高效重建，将参数减少99%，训练时间缩短至原来的四分之一。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统可微移位变体FBP模型参数过多，训练效率低，需要设计一种参数更少、训练更快且重建质量损失较小的模型，以提升实际应用中的实用性。

Method: 在可微移位变体FBP框架基础上，引入可训练的2D高斯模型来表示滤波过程中与轨迹相关的部分，大幅减少可训练参数数量。

Result: 参数数量减少99%，重建质量仅有轻微损失；每条轨迹的训练时间缩短为原来的四分之一，收敛速度显著加快。

Conclusion: 所提模型在保持较高重建质量的同时，大幅降低了参数数量和训练时间，显著提升了模型的实用性和有效性，适用于实际应用场景。

Original Abstract: This paper proposes a Gaussian-Based Shift-Variant filtered backprojection (FBP) neural network, which is designed for the efficient reconstruction of non-circular trajectory cone beam computed tomography. The traditional differentiable shift-variant FBP model consists of a filtering component and a backprojection process. The filtering component includes operations such as weightings, differentiations, a 2D Radon transform, and a 2D backprojection. The proposed methods build on this framework by introducing a trainable 2D Gaussian model to represent the trajectory-related part in the filtering process, achieving a substantial reduction in the number of trainable parameters. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed model reduces the parameter count by 99%, while only sacrificing a slight amount of reconstruction quality. Furthermore, the training time for each trajectory is reduced to one-fourth of the original, significantly accelerating convergence. These enhancements demonstrate a considerable augmentation in the model's practicality and effectiveness, making it a valuable asset for real-world applications.

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出了一种基于高斯的移位变体滤波反投影神经网络，旨在高效重建非圆形轨迹锥束计算机断层扫描图像。传统的可微移位变体FBP模型由滤波组件和反投影过程组成。滤波组件包括加权、微分、二维Radon变换和二维反投影等操作。所提方法在此基础上，引入一个可训练的二维高斯模型来表示滤波过程中与轨迹相关的部分，大幅减少了可训练参数的数量。实验结果表明，所提模型将参数数量减少了99%，同时仅牺牲了轻微的重建质量。此外，每条轨迹的训练时间减少到原来的四分之一，显著加快了收敛速度。这些改进表明该模型的实用性和有效性得到了显著增强，使其成为实际应用中的重要工具。

</details>


### [168] [FoundationGeo: Learning Spatial Pixel-Wise Fields for Monocular Metric Geometry](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11588)
*Muxin Liu,Xiaoyang Lyu,Tianhe Ren,Peng Dai,Xiaoshan Wu,Zhiyue Zhang,Jiaqi Zhang,Jiehong Lin,Shaoshuai Shi,Xiaojuan Qi*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出FoundationGeo两阶段框架，通过空间校准和焦距分布扩展，在单目几何估计中实现相对预测与度量预测的显式桥接，在7个基准上平均超越其他方法5.2%以上。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有单目几何估计方法在零样本跨域泛化时性能急剧下降，且度量预测（metric prediction）通常依赖全局缩放，无法处理空间变化的尺度偏差；同时相机内参（尤其是焦距）在训练与测试数据之间的分布不匹配是零样本度量泛化的关键瓶颈。

Method: 两阶段框架：阶段1以DINOv3初始化，在1020万样本多领域数据集上训练仿射不变几何模型，配合局部细节监督；阶段2引入轻量级逐像素校准场（尺度场+射线方向校正场）实现度量估计；并通过Blender数据引擎合成多焦距训练数据以修复内参覆盖不足。

Result: 在7个零样本评测基准上，FoundationGeo显著提升跨域鲁棒性，避免其他方法的跨域性能暴跌，平均超越更重的基线方法5.2%以上。

Conclusion: 通过显式桥接相对预测与度量预测、引入像素级校准场以及扩展焦距分布覆盖，可以有效提升单目几何估计的跨域泛化能力和度量一致性。

Original Abstract: We present FoundationGeo, a two-stage framework that explicitly bridges relative and metric prediction via spatial calibration and principled data design. Stage 1 learns a high-fidelity, affine-invariant geometry model by initializing with DINOv3 and training on a curated 10.2M-sample multi-domain corpus with complementary local-detail supervision, yielding sharp boundaries and strong cross-domain generalization. Stage 2 moves beyond global scaling by introducing lightweight pixel-wise calibration fields for metric estimation: a scale field for spatially varying metric alignment and a ray-direction correction field that mitigates directional bias in point-map geometry, together producing metrically consistent 3D point maps. Beyond model design, we identify camera intrinsic coverage, especially focal length distribution mismatch between training and test data, as a key bottleneck for zero-shot metric generalization: performance drops sharply when test intrinsics fall outside the training distribution. To address this, we synthesize additional training data across diverse focal lengths using a Blender-based data engine, repairing under-covered focal regimes and improving robustness under intrinsic shift. Extensive zero-shot evaluations across seven benchmarks show that FoundationGeo significantly strengthens cross-domain robustness, staying near the top across diverse domains while avoiding the sharp cross-domain performance drops observed in other methods. This consistency translates into the best overall performance, surpassing heavier baselines by over 5.2% on average.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出FoundationGeo，一种两阶段框架，通过空间校准与精心的数据设计显式桥接相对预测与度量预测。阶段1通过以DINOv3初始化并在精心筛选的1020万样本多领域语料库上训练，辅以局部细节监督，学习高保真、仿射不变的几何模型，产生清晰的边界和强大的跨域泛化能力。阶段2超越全局缩放，引入轻量级逐像素校准场用于度量估计：一个尺度场用于空间变化的度量对齐，以及一个射线方向校正场用于缓解点图几何中的方向偏差，共同生成度量一致的三维点图。除了模型设计，我们识别出相机内参覆盖范围——尤其是训练与测试数据之间的焦距分布不匹配——是零样本度量泛化的关键瓶颈：当测试内参落在训练分布之外时，性能急剧下降。为解决此问题，我们使用基于Blender的数据引擎合成覆盖不同焦距的额外训练数据，修复覆盖不足的焦距区域，提升内参偏移下的鲁棒性。在七个基准上的广泛零样本评估表明，FoundationGeo显著增强了跨域鲁棒性，在不同领域中始终接近最优水平，同时避免了其他方法中观察到的剧烈跨域性能下降。这种一致性转化为最佳的整体性能，平均超越更重的基线方法5.2%以上。

</details>


### [169] [Similarity-Guided Curriculum Fine-Tuning of LLMs for Neural Architecture Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11591)
*Anujaya Vijayakumar,Radu Timofte,Dmitry Ignatov*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出了一种基于MinHash的相似度调度框架，用于在LLM驱动的神经架构搜索中构建渐进式课程。通过128-排列MinHash签名对7-gram源代码分片进行聚类，按架构异质性递增顺序呈现，并逐步合并LoRA适配器。在CIFAR-10上的实验表明，高相似度阶段达到60%峰值成功率，而消融实验揭示了接口修复与课程调度分别应对不同的失败模式。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在LLM驱动的神经架构搜索中，直接生成多样化架构容易导致生成质量下降和成功率低。现有方法缺乏对架构代码相似性的结构性利用，无法有效引导模型从熟悉到陌生的渐进式学习过程。

Method: 提出基于MinHash的相似度调度框架：使用128-排列MinHash签名对归一化的7-gram源代码分片进行哈希，将参考池划分为不同相似度带；按架构异质性递增的顺序呈现给LLM；每个阶段训练的最佳LoRA适配器被累积合并到骨干模型中，形成渐进式课程。

Result: 在CIFAR-10上，高相似度课程阶段达到60%峰值成功率（无需修复）；在最具多样性课程水平上，无修复时基座模型（47% SR）显著优于课程模型（7% SR），添加部分修复后两者均达到53% SR；在SVHN上直接生成（无课程预热）仅获得27%峰值SR且准确率较低（60.5%）。

Conclusion: 接口修复和课程调度针对不同的失败模式：合并级权重漂移逐渐擦除评估器-接口先验知识。课程调度适合利用高相似度知识，而接口修复对于处理低相似度/高多样性场景至关重要。跨数据集迁移中，无课程预热时生成难度显著增加。

Original Abstract: Introduce a MinHash-based similarity scheduling framework that constructs a progressive curriculum over neural architecture code for LLM-based neural architecture search (NAS). Using 128-permutation MinHash signatures over normalised 7-gram source code shingles, we partition the reference pool into similarity bands and present them in increasing architectural heterogeneity, with the best LoRA adapter from each stage merged cumulatively into the backbone. We evaluate the framework on OlympicCoder-7B within the LEMUR benchmark on CIFAR-10 image classification, generating N =15 candidate architectures per epoch across six progressive fine-tuning steps. The curriculum achieves 60% peak success rate at the high-similarity level without post-processing repair. A 2*2 ablation at the most diverse level curriculum versus base model, with versus without partial interface repair reveals that without repair the base model (47% peak SR) substantially outperforms the curriculum model (7% SR), while adding partial repair brings both to 53% SR. This pattern is consistent with merge-level weight drift progressively erasing evaluator-interface priors, and suggests that interface repair and curriculum scheduling target distinct failure modes. We further report a cross-dataset transfer observation on SVHN, where direct base-model generation without curriculum warmup yields 27% peak SR at substantially lower accuracy (60.5%) than the CIFAR-10 equivalent, consistent with the increased synthesis difficulty of the unq-family anchor architecture.

中文摘要翻译: 我们引入了一种基于MinHash的相似度调度框架，该框架为基于大语言模型的神经架构搜索构建了一个关于神经架构代码的渐进式课程。通过对归一化的7-gram源代码分片使用128-排列MinHash签名，我们将参考池划分为不同的相似度带，并按架构异质性递增的顺序呈现它们，同时将每个阶段的最佳LoRA适配器累积合并到骨干模型中。我们在LEMUR基准测试中的CIFAR-10图像分类任务上，使用OlympicCoder-7B评估了该框架，在六个渐进式微调步骤中每个epoch生成N=15个候选架构。该课程在高相似度水平下达到了60%的峰值成功率，且无需后处理修复。在最具多样性课程水平上的2×2消融实验（课程模型与基座模型对比，有/无部分接口修复）揭示：无修复时，基座模型（47%峰值SR）显著优于课程模型（7% SR），而添加部分修复后两者均达到53% SR。该模式与合并级权重漂移逐渐擦除评估器-接口先验知识的现象一致，表明接口修复和课程调度针对不同的失败模式。我们进一步报告了在SVHN上的跨数据集迁移观察结果：无课程预热直接进行基座模型生成取得了27%的峰值成功率，但准确率（60.5%）远低于CIFAR-10上的对应结果，这与unq族锚点架构的合成难度增加是一致的。

</details>


### [170] [Backbone-Agnostic Perturbation-Induced Uncertainty Learning for End-to-End Real-World Image Dehazing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11623)
*Bingcai Wei*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BPUL，一种即插即用的不确定性学习框架，通过可学习的扰动调制器、先验引导重建模块和对比损失，在几乎不增加推理开销的情况下显著提升多种去雾骨干网络的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有端到端去雾网络将去雾视为确定性映射，未能充分探索退化特征、雾先验和跨域负样本中的不确定性，导致真实世界图像去雾效果不佳。

Method: 1) 可学习扰动诱导不确定性调制器(LPUM)，通过重参数化随机扰动估计通道维和空间维特征敏感性；2) 先验引导不确定性重建模块(PURM)，利用透射率和大气光先验从复原结果重建有雾图像以保持退化一致性；3) 双空间域多样化分布感知对比损失(D^3CL)，在干净复原和雾图重建两个空间中联合正则化真实与合成负样本。

Result: 在五个真实世界配对基准数据集上，BPUL一致地提升了多种代表性骨干网络的去雾性能。推理时仅保留LPUM，PURM和D^3CL作为训练约束，因此仅带来极小的额外推理开销。

Conclusion: BPUL通过显式建模不确定性，有效地提升了真实世界图像去雾的质量，且具有良好的通用性和轻量级推理特性。

Original Abstract: Real-world paired image dehazing remains challenging because haze degradation is spatially non-uniform, illumination-dependent, and physically ambiguous even when haze-free references are available. Existing end-to-end restoration networks usually formulate dehazing as a deterministic mapping from a hazy observation to a clean target, leaving the uncertainty hidden in degraded features, haze priors, and cross-domain negative samples insufficiently explored. In this paper, we propose Backbone-Agnostic Perturbation-Induced Uncertainty Learning (BPUL), a plug-and-play uncertainty learning framework for end-to-end real-world image dehazing. BPUL first introduces a Learnable Perturbation-induced Uncertainty Modulator (LPUM) that estimates channel-wise and spatial-wise feature sensitivity through reparameterized stochastic perturbations. It then develops a Prior-informed Uncertainty-guided Reconstruction Module (PURM), which exploits transmission and atmospheric-light priors to reconstruct the hazy observation from the restored result and enforce degradation consistency. Furthermore, we propose a Dual-space Domain-diversified Distribution-aware Contrastive Loss ($D^3$CL) to regularize both clean restoration and hazy reconstruction spaces with real-world and synthetic negatives. Experiments on five real-world paired benchmarks show that BPUL consistently improves multiple representative backbones. Since only LPUM is retained during inference while PURM and $D^3$CL are used as training-time constraints, BPUL brings substantial restoration gains with only marginal additional inference overhead.

中文摘要翻译: 真实世界的配对图像去雾仍然具有挑战性，因为即使存在无雾参考图像，雾霾退化在空间上非均匀、依赖于光照且在物理上具有模糊性。现有的端到端恢复网络通常将去雾建模为从有雾观测到干净目标的确定性映射，未能充分探索退化特征、雾先验和跨域负样本中隐藏的不确定性。本文提出BPUL（Backbone-Agnostic Perturbation-Induced Uncertainty Learning），一个即插即用的不确定性学习框架，用于端到端真实世界图像去雾。BPUL首先引入可学习扰动诱导不确定性调制器（LPUM），通过重参数化随机扰动估计通道维和空间维的特征敏感性；然后开发了先验引导不确定性重建模块（PURM），利用透射率和大气光先验从复原结果重建有雾观测并强制退化一致性。此外，我们提出双空间域多样化分布感知对比损失（D^3CL），在干净复原和雾图重建两个空间中联合使用真实和合成负样本进行正则化。在五个真实世界配对基准上的实验表明，BPUL一致地改进了多个代表性骨干网络。由于推理时仅保留LPUM，而PURM和D^3CL作为训练时约束，BPUL在仅增加极小额外推理开销的情况下带来了显著的复原增益。

</details>


### [171] [Motion4Motion: Motion Transfer Across Subjects at Inference](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11644)
*Ling-Hao Chen,Zixin Yin,Duomin Wang,Xianfang Zeng,Gang Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出Motion4Motion，一种无需训练的跨物种视频运动迁移框架，通过建模视频中的运动流而非骨骼结构，实现不同物种间的运动风格迁移。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于骨架的视频运动迁移方法受限于预定义人体骨骼结构，难以泛化到不同物种的角色，且标注的多类骨骼数据稀缺，限制了大规模训练。

Method: 跳出基于骨架的运动迁移框架，提出无需训练的Motion4Motion框架，通过直接建模视频中角色的运动流（motion flow）而非骨骼结构来实现运动迁移。

Result: 大量实验和新颖应用表明，该方法在性能上显著优于基线方法。

Conclusion: Motion4Motion通过运动流建模实现了跨物种的无训练运动迁移，克服了骨架方法的泛化局限，为动画创作提供了更灵活高效的解决方案。

Original Abstract: This work explores the motion transfer from one video to another, which is crucial in animation for diverse characters. Previously, video motion transfer has been largely explored between human and human-like characters, enabling a lot of applications in digital creation. However, these approaches encounter a main limitation. Specifically, related technical pipelines heavily rely on a predefined human skeleton structure and accordingly require skeleton-conditional model training. On the one hand, these methods are difficult to generalize to diverse characters, such as animals from different species, while preserving their unique motion styles. On the other hand, labeled data in diverse skeletons is limited, which additionally restricts the large-scale training for the task. In this paper, we jump out of the skeleton-based motion transfer framework and propose a training-free motion transfer framework, named Motion4Motion. Motion4Motionmodels the motion flow of the character in a video instead of skeletons, which makes motion transfer across species easier. Extensive experimental results and novel applications show our methods outperform baselines impressively. Project page is available at https://lhchen.top/Motion4Motion.

中文摘要翻译: 本工作探索了从一个视频到另一个视频的运动迁移，这对于动画中多样化角色的制作至关重要。此前，视频运动迁移主要在人类及类人角色之间进行研究，催生了数字创作中的诸多应用。然而，这些方法面临一个主要限制：相关的技术流程严重依赖于预定义的人体骨骼结构，并因此需要基于骨骼条件的模型训练。一方面，这些方法难以泛化到不同物种的角色（如来自不同物种的动物），同时保留其独特的运动风格。另一方面，多样化骨骼的标注数据稀缺，进一步限制了该任务的大规模训练。在本文中，我们跳出了基于骨架的运动迁移框架，提出了一种无需训练的运动迁移框架，命名为Motion4Motion。Motion4Motion通过建模视频中角色的运动流（而非骨骼）来实现运动迁移，使得跨物种的运动迁移更加容易。大量实验结果和新颖应用表明，我们的方法在性能上显著超越基线方法。项目页面见https://lhchen.top/Motion4Motion。

</details>


### [172] [Event-RGB Adaptive Tracking for Nighttime Highway Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11646)
*Haidong Wang,Hengxing Cai,Wanlei Li,Xiaogang Xiong,Renxin Zhong*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 针对高速公路夜间低光照环境下RGB感知性能严重退化的问题，提出联合事件流与RGB的自适应跟踪框架JEAT，通过自适应扩展卡尔曼滤波动态融合两种模态，并构建了大规模合成数据集SEHN。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 高速公路夜间缺乏人工照明设施，车辆高速运动导致RGB相机出现运动模糊、曝光不足和低信噪比等问题，严重降低了RGB感知系统的可靠性，亟需引入事件相机等互补模态来提升夜间跟踪性能。

Method: 提出JEAT框架：将异步事件流和RGB帧统一为联合数据关联优化问题，采用自适应扩展卡尔曼滤波通过NIS统计量持续估计测量噪声，动态加权融合两种模态——在暗光/高速运动时依赖事件流，在明亮/静态条件下利用RGB帧。

Result: 构建了SEHN大规模合成数据集（基于CARLA），涵盖白天、夜间、夜间无人工照明等多种环境条件及不同交通密度，提供同步的RGB图像和事件流。

Conclusion: JEAT框架通过自适应模态融合有效克服了夜间高速公路场景下RGB感知的局限性，SEHN数据集为多模态融合研究提供了重要基准资源。

Original Abstract: Intelligent Transportation Systems deployed on highways predominantly rely on conventional RGB cameras for traffic perception and vehicle tracking. However, highway environments present unique challenges: the absence of artificial lighting infrastructure, combined with high vehicle velocities, results in severely degraded perception performance under low-light conditions. Specifically, nighttime scenarios suffer from motion blur, insufficient exposure, and poor signal-to-noise ratios, which catastrophically impair the reliability of RGB-based sensing systems. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Joint Event-RGB Adaptive Tracking (JEAT) framework. Unlike existing multi-sensor trackers constrained by rigid, hard-coded prioritization, JEAT merges asynchronous event streams and RGB frames into a unified joint data association optimization. By employing an Adaptive Extended Kalman Filter to continuously estimate measurement noise via NIS statistics, the framework dynamically weights and fuses both modalities, optimally harnessing event streams during dark or high-speed motion while leveraging RGB frames under bright or static conditions. Furthermore, given the absence of publicly available datasets tailored for event-based highway perception with diverse environmental conditions, we present SEHN, a large-scale synthetic dataset generated using the CARLA simulator. Our dataset encompasses diverse environmental conditions (daytime, nighttime, nighttime with out artificial lighting) and varying traffic densities, providing synchronized RGB imagery and event streams to facilitate multi-modal fusion research. Our code and datasets will be available at https://github.com/haidongwang96/SEHN.

中文摘要翻译: 部署在高速公路上的智能交通系统主要依赖传统的RGB相机进行交通感知和车辆跟踪。然而，高速公路环境存在独特挑战：缺乏人工照明基础设施，加之车辆高速行驶，导致低光照条件下感知性能严重退化。具体而言，夜间场景存在运动模糊、曝光不足和信噪比差等问题，严重损害了RGB感知系统的可靠性。为解决上述限制，我们提出了一种新颖的联合事件-RGB自适应跟踪（JEAT）框架。与受限于刚性硬编码优先级的现有多传感器跟踪器不同，JEAT将异步事件流和RGB帧融合为统一的联合数据关联优化问题。通过采用自适应扩展卡尔曼滤波，利用NIS统计量持续估计测量噪声，该框架动态加权并融合两种模态，在暗光或高速运动条件下最优地利用事件流，同时在明亮或静态条件下利用RGB帧。此外，针对目前缺乏适用于事件驱动高速公路感知且涵盖多样化环境条件的公开数据集，我们提出了SEHN——一个基于CARLA模拟器生成的大规模合成数据集。该数据集涵盖多种环境条件（白天、夜间、夜间无人工照明）和不同交通密度，提供同步的RGB图像和事件流，以促进多模态融合研究。我们的代码和数据集将在https://github.com/haidongwang96/SEHN公开。

</details>


### [173] [Feature-Space Guided Diffusion for Realistic Ultrasound Image Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11655)
*Marina Domínguez,Nélida Mirabet-Herranz,Valery Naranjo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出特征空间候选引导（FSCG），一种无需训练的采样策略，通过局部k-NN特征校正和特征空间能量选择，缩小条件扩散模型生成的超声图像与真实图像之间的表征差距，在三个数据集上显著降低FID和最近邻特征距离。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 条件扩散模型能生成解剖上合理的医学超声图像，但仅靠解剖合理性不足以确保逼真的B模式外观；标准生成架构和引导机制仅依赖解剖掩码，忽略了超声图像中依赖采集条件的特性（如散斑纹理、组织对比度和衰减），导致生成图像与真实图像在表征空间存在差距。

Method: 提出Feature-Space Candidate Guidance (FSCG)，一种无需训练的采样策略。在采样时，FSCG对多个随机候选样本应用局部k-NN特征校正，并根据特征空间能量选择最优候选。解剖掩码定义解剖结构，FSCG将采样结果引导向真实超声域。

Result: 在三个不同数据集上，相比于标准条件扩散采样，FSCG平均降低FID64 56%、FID192 57%、最近邻特征距离47%，优于其他推理时引导基线。

Conclusion: 领域感知的特征表示能够揭示并减少医学扩散合成中的真实感差距，且无需重新训练生成器。

Original Abstract: Conditional diffusion models can generate anatomically plausible medical ultrasound (US) images, but anatomical plausibility alone does not ensure realistic B-mode appearance. Most US pipelines adapt standard generative architectures and condition them on anatomical masks, or use guidance mechanisms that reinforce the same anatomical signal. However, B-mode US images are shaped by acquisition-dependent properties such as speckle texture, tissue contrast, and attenuation. Using a frozen US foundation model, we show that standard conditional diffusion baselines remain separated from real images in representation space. In this work, we propose Feature-Space Candidate Guidance (FSCG), a training-free sampling strategy to reduce this gap. At sampling time, FSCG applies local k-NN feature correction and selects the best of multiple stochastic candidates according to their feature-space energy. In this way, the mask defines the anatomy, while FSCG steers samples toward the real US domain. Across three different datasets, FSCG reduces average FID64 by 56\%, FID192 by 57\%, and nearest-neighbour feature distance by 47\% over standard conditional diffusion sampling, outperforming alternative inference-time guidance baselines. The results suggest that domain-aware feature representations can reveal and reduce realism gaps in medical diffusion synthesis without retraining the generator. Our code is available at https://github.com/marinadominguez/FSCG.

中文摘要翻译: 条件扩散模型能够生成解剖上合理的医学超声图像，但仅凭解剖合理性并不能确保逼真的B模式外观。大多数超声生成流程采用标准生成架构并以其为条件输入解剖掩码，或使用强化相同解剖信号的引导机制。然而，B模式超声图像的形状受到诸如散斑纹理、组织对比度和衰减等依赖于采集过程的特性影响。我们利用一个冻结的超声基础模型证明，标准条件扩散基线在表征空间中与真实图像仍存在差距。在这项工作中，我们提出了特征空间候选引导（FSCG），一种无需训练即可缩小这一差距的采样策略。在采样时，FSCG应用局部k-最近邻特征校正，并根据特征空间能量从多个随机候选中选择最优样本。通过这种方式，掩码定义了解剖结构，而FSCG将样本引导至真实的超声域。在三个不同数据集上，相比于标准条件扩散采样，FSCG平均降低了FID64 56%、FID192 57%以及最近邻特征距离47%，优于其他推理时引导基线。结果表明，领域感知的特征表示能够揭示并减少医学扩散合成中的真实感差距，且无需重新训练生成器。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/marinadominguez/FSCG 获取。

</details>


### [174] [ABot-3DWorld 0: A Universal World Model to Explore Any 3D Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11673)
*Mingchao Sun,Luyang Tang,Yu Liu,Xu Yan,Zhan Li,Yunwei Zhang,Fei Yu,Zengye Ge,Yumin Liu,Jiacheng Zhang,Yongchang Zhang,Jiawei Zhang,Zhicheng Liu,Zhongxu Sun,Tianjian Ouyang,Wenzheng Chen,Shixing Yang,Nianfei Fan,Guodong Sun,Huan Li,Zheng Zhou,Yongze Li,Yingliang Peng,Mengmeng Du,Yuan Liu,Haozhe Shi,Chunnuo Gong,Chengzhen Yu,Chunxue Jia,Yang Liu,Shiying Zeng,Junnan Lai,Hang Zhang,Ning Guo,Baoquan Chen,Mu Xu,Hongyu Pan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ABot-3DWorld 0 是一个通用的多模态3D世界模型，通过统一的“空间生成基元”（SGP）将文本、图像和视频输入转化为高保真、可探索的3D世界，支持从丰富输入到单张图像/句子的多种场景重建与创造，并在开放方法中达到SOTA水平。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有3D内容创建方法通常需要大量多视角数据或专业操作，门槛高且缺乏通用性。本文旨在构建一个低门槛、通用的3D世界模型，能够统一处理多模态输入（文本、图像、视频），并实现高保真、可探索的3D场景生成与地理锚定，推动消费级空间探索。

Method: 提出统一的空间生成基元（SGP），由高质量全景图和空间点云组成。流程分为三步：(1) 多模态输入被提升为SGP——丰富输入通过几何精确恢复生成SGP，单张图像或句子通过生成式补全完成；(2) 3D一致的全景视频生成器沿规划轨迹探索SGP；(3) 全景视频重建引擎将生成视频转换为干净、逼真的3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）世界。此外支持将生成世界锚定到地理兴趣点。

Result: 实验表明，ABot-3DWorld 0 在开放方法中达到了最先进水平，在丰富的多模态输入下，场景保真度优于Marble方法。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一个通用、低门槛的3D内容创建引擎，通过统一的空间生成基元和分层流水线，成功实现了从多模态输入到高质量3D世界的转化，为消费级地图原生空间探索提供了可行方案。

Original Abstract: We present ABot-3DWorld 0, a universal multimodal 3D world model that turns text, image, and video inputs into high-fidelity, explorable 3D worlds. At the heart of our framework is a unified Spatial Generative Primitive (SGP), a compact tuple of a high-quality panorama and a spatial point cloud that delivers an efficient description of any 3D space. Multimodal inputs are first lifted into this primitive; a 3D-consistent panoramic video generator then explores the primitive along a planned trajectory; finally, our panoramic video reconstruction engine converts the generated video into a clean, photorealistic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) world. This pipeline covers two regimes: rich inputs (multi-view sets, casual video) are lifted into the SGP through a geometry-rigorous recovery that mirrors the observed scene, while a single image or sentence is completed generatively into a creative world. The result is one low-barrier engine for general 3D content creation that further anchors generated worlds to geographic points of interest, enabling map-native spatial exploration at consumer scale. Experiments show that ABot-3DWorld 0 sets the state of the art among open-source methods and demonstrates stronger scene fidelity than Marble under rich multimodal inputs.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了ABot-3DWorld 0，一个通用的多模态3D世界模型，能够将文本、图像和视频输入转化为高保真、可探索的3D世界。我们框架的核心是一个统一的空间生成基元（Spatial Generative Primitive, SGP），它是一个由高质量全景图和空间点云组成的紧凑元组，能够高效描述任何3D空间。多模态输入首先被提升为该基元；然后，一个3D一致的全景视频生成器沿规划轨迹探索该基元；最后，我们的全景视频重建引擎将生成的视频转换为干净、逼真的3D高斯泼溅（3D Gaussian Splatting, 3DGS）世界。该流程涵盖两种模式：丰富输入（多视角集、随意视频）通过几何精确恢复被提升为SGP，以镜像观察到的场景；而单张图像或句子则通过生成式补全创建出一个创意世界。其结果是一个低门槛的通用3D内容创建引擎，进一步将生成的世界锚定到地理兴趣点，从而支持消费级地图原生的空间探索。实验表明，ABot-3DWorld 0在开源方法中达到了最先进水平，并且在丰富的多模态输入下展现出比Marble更强的场景保真度。

</details>


### [175] [Illuminant-Adaptive 3D Lookup Tables for Camera Color Correction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11681)
*Claudio Rota,Luca Cogo,Simone Bianco,Raimondo Schettini*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于照明自适应三维查找表（C²LUT）的颜色校正框架，结合色度感知照明表示与非线性颜色变换，采用Tucker张量分解压缩LUT以适应相机ISP硬件限制，在大规模照明数据集上实现了优于现有方法的校正效果，CIE ΔE₀₀降低最高20%，角度误差降低最高18%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 相机传感器响应与CIE XYZ颜色空间之间存在非线性关系，且高色度、光谱复杂的LED照明日益普及，导致现有颜色校正方法精度不足，亟需一种能够适应多样化照明条件的高精度颜色校正方案。

Method: 提出C²LUT框架，包含：（1）色度感知的照明表示方法；（2）基于照明自适应三维查找表的非线性颜色变换；（3）采用Tucker张量分解对LUT进行低秩压缩，降低计算和存储开销，使其可在相机ISP中部署。

Result: 在多款相机、多种照明条件、多个反射率数据集及真实拍摄图像上，C²LUT相比现有方法CIE ΔE₀₀降低最高20%，角度误差降低最高18%，且兼容现代相机硬件约束。

Conclusion: 基于照明自适应三维LUT的颜色校正框架能够有效处理传感器响应与颜色空间之间的非线性关系，适应宽范围色度和光谱复杂度的照明条件，在保持低计算开销的同时显著提升校正精度，适用于相机ISP实际部署。

Original Abstract: Color correction is a key component of camera image signal processing (ISP) pipelines, encompassing illuminant discounting and colorimetric mapping of device-dependent sensor responses to device-independent color spaces, such as CIE XYZ. Despite extensive research, accurate color correction remains challenging due to the non-linear relationship between camera sensor responses and CIE XYZ color space, as well as to the increasing presence of highly chromatic and spectrally complex LED illuminants. We propose a color correction framework based on illuminant-adaptive three-dimensional lookup tables (LUTs), which we call Color Correction LUT (C$^2$LUT). Our method combines a chromaticity-aware illuminant representation with a non-linear color transformation, enabling accurate correction under illuminants spanning a wide range of chromaticities and spectral complexities. We employ Tucker tensor decomposition to represent the LUTs, ensuring that computational requirements remain sufficiently low for deployment in camera ISPs. In addition, we introduce a large-scale illuminants dataset comprising 1,473 spectral power distributions, with different chromaticities and spectral profiles. Experiments across multiple cameras, illuminants, reflectance datasets, and real captured images demonstrate consistent improvements over existing methods for color correction, reducing CIE $ΔE_{00}$ by up to 20% and angular error by up to 18% while remaining compatible with modern camera hardware constraints. Code and datasets are available at https://github.com/claudiom4sir/C2LUT.

中文摘要翻译: 颜色校正是相机图像信号处理（ISP）流水线中的关键组成部分，涵盖照明折扣以及将设备相关的传感器响应进行色度映射，转换到设备无关的颜色空间（如CIE XYZ）。尽管已有大量研究，但由于相机传感器响应与CIE XYZ颜色空间之间存在非线性关系，且高色度、光谱复杂的LED照明日益普及，精确的颜色校正仍然具有挑战性。本文提出了一种基于照明自适应三维查找表（LUT）的颜色校正框架，称为颜色校正LUT（C²LUT）。该方法结合了色度感知的照明表示与非线性颜色变换，能够在涵盖宽范围色度和光谱复杂度的照明条件下实现精确校正。我们采用Tucker张量分解来表示LUT，确保计算需求足够低，可部署于相机ISP中。此外，我们引入了一个大规模照明数据集，包含1,473条光谱功率分布，具有不同的色度和光谱分布。跨多款相机、多种照明条件、多个反射率数据集以及真实拍摄图像的实验表明，本文方法在颜色校正上相较于现有方法持续改进，CIE ΔE₀₀降低最高20%，角度误差降低最高18%，同时与现代相机硬件约束保持兼容。代码和数据集见https://github.com/claudiom4sir/C2LUT。

</details>


### [176] [SVI360: Spherical Video Interpolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11710)
*Le-Kim Nguyen,Renato Martins,Pascal Vasseur,Cedric Demonceaux*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SVI360双分支框架，结合原始图像帧与旋转正交视图来解决球面视频插值中的极点畸变问题，通过增强流位移的等变性提升中间帧预测质量，在四个公开基准上超越现有最优方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频插值方法难以处理球面视频靠近极点区域的严重畸变问题，因此需要专门针对全景球面视频的插值方法。

Method: 提出SVI360双分支框架，同时处理原始图像帧及其旋转正交视图，核心是增强原始视图与正交视图之间光流位移的等变性，以改善中间帧预测。

Result: 在四个不同公开基准上，SVI360在插值质量上优于现有最先进方法，且能保持准确的光流估计。

Conclusion: SVI360有效解决了球面视频插值中的极点畸变问题，为虚拟现实和沉浸式视频增强等应用提供了更优的方案。

Original Abstract: This paper addresses the problem of omnidirectional video interpolation, which plays an essential role in applications such as virtual reality and immersive video enhancement. Existing video interpolation methods are not well-suited for spherical videos, as they have difficulty handling severe distortions close to the poles. To address this issue, we propose SVI360, a dual-branch framework that combines the image frame and its rotated orthogonal view to deal with these distortions. The core methodological aspect of the approach is to reinforce equivariance of the flow displacements between the original and orthogonal views to improve intermediate frame prediction. Experiments show that our method outperforms state-of-the-art approaches in interpolation quality while maintaining accurate optical flow in four different public benchmarks. Code and pre-trained models are available at: https://icb-vision-ai.github.io/video360_interpolation/

中文摘要翻译: 本文研究了全向视频插值问题，该问题在虚拟现实和沉浸式视频增强等应用中扮演着关键角色。现有的视频插值方法并不适用于球面视频，因为它们难以处理靠近极点区域的严重畸变。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SVI360，一种双分支框架，它结合了原始图像帧及其旋转正交视图来处理这些畸变。该方法的核心在于增强原始视图与正交视图之间光流位移的等变性，以改善中间帧预测。实验表明，我们的方法在四个不同的公开基准上，在插值质量上优于现有最先进方法，同时保持了准确的光流估计。代码和预训练模型可在以下网址获取：https://icb-vision-ai.github.io/video360_interpolation/

</details>


### [177] [GFR-SAM: Training-Free Referring Camouflaged Object Segmentation via Cross-Image Prompting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11732)
*Yilong Yang,Jianxin Tian,Shengchuan Zhang,Liujuan Cao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GFR-SAM是一种无需训练的参考伪装目标检测框架，通过“生成-过滤-精炼”三阶段流程，利用SAM3的跨图像上下文提示能力，在R2C7K基准上超越现有无训练方法8.7%的加权F-measure，与有监督方法性能相当。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有参考伪装目标检测方法存在两大不足：有监督方法依赖大量标注数据；无训练的稀疏点提示方法对定位误差敏感。为此，本文提出一种鲁棒的无需训练框架，将脆弱的点匹配范式转变为更稳健的“生成-过滤-精炼”流程。

Method: 提出GFR-SAM三阶段无训练框架：(1) 上下文示例引导分割(In-Context Exemplar-guided Segmentation)，利用跨图像推理生成候选掩码；(2) 区域-全局对比过滤模块(Region-Global Contrastive Filtering)，基于DINOv3原型对齐排序候选并抑制背景干扰；(3) 几何-语义精炼模块(Geometric-Semantic Refinement)，协同边界框和文本提示恢复精细边界并提升实例召回。

Result: 在R2C7K基准上，GFR-SAM在加权F-measure (F_β^w)上超越现有无训练方法8.7%，并与有监督的最先进方法性能相当。

Conclusion: 该工作展示了释放SAM3跨图像上下文提示潜在能力的重要性，建立了一种鲁棒的无需训练范式，有效弥合了通用基础模型与专业、标签密集型感知任务之间的差距，无需特定任务微调。

Original Abstract: Referring Camouflaged Object Detection (Ref-COD) requires segmenting hidden targets guided by reference cues. While supervised methods are annotation-heavy and training-free approaches via sparse point-prompting are sensitive to localization errors, we propose GFR-SAM, a robust three-stage training-free framework. GFR-SAM shifts the paradigm from fragile point-matching to a "Generate-Filter-Refine" pipeline. First, we introduce In-Context Exemplar-guided Segmentation, empowering SAM3 with cross-image inference to generate candidate masks via holistic visual exemplars, bypassing its native intra-image constraints. Second, a Region-Global Contrastive Filtering module ranks candidates through DINOv3-based prototypical alignment, effectively suppressing background distractors. Finally, a Geometric-Semantic Refinement module synergizes bounding box and text prompts to recover fine-grained boundaries and enhance instance recall. Evaluated on the R2C7K benchmark, GFR-SAM outperforms existing training-free methods by 8.7\% in weighted F-measure ($F_β^w$) and competes with supervised state-of-the-art counterparts. Ultimately, this work underscores the potential of unlocking SAM3's latent capability for cross-image In-Context prompting, establishing a robust, training-free paradigm that effectively bridges the gap between general-purpose foundation models and specialized, label-intensive perception tasks without the need for task-specific fine-tuning.

中文摘要翻译: 参考伪装目标检测（Ref-COD）需要根据参考线索分割隐藏目标。针对有监督方法标注成本高、基于稀疏点提示的无训练方法对定位误差敏感的问题，我们提出GFR-SAM，一个鲁棒的三阶段无训练框架。GFR-SAM将脆弱的点匹配范式转变为"生成-过滤-精炼"流程。首先，我们提出上下文示例引导分割，赋予SAM3跨图像推理能力，通过整体视觉示例生成候选掩码，突破其原生图像内约束。其次，区域-全局对比过滤模块通过基于DINOv3的原型对齐对候选进行排序，有效抑制背景干扰。最后，几何-语义精炼模块协同边界框和文本提示，恢复精细边界并提升实例召回。在R2C7K基准上的评估表明，GFR-SAM在加权F-measure（F_β^w）上超越现有无训练方法8.7%，并与有监督的最先进方法竞争。最终，这项工作强调了释放SAM3跨图像上下文提示潜在能力的价值，建立了一种鲁棒的、无需训练的范式，有效弥合了通用基础模型与专业、标签密集型感知任务之间的差距，且无需任务特定微调。

</details>


### [178] [Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11754)
*Jordão Bragantini,Ilan Theodoro,Loïc A. Royer*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于边缘架构的细胞追踪Transformer（HOCT），通过高阶几何先验解决候选追踪图中的结构障碍，在Cell Tracking Challenge和细菌分裂基准上达到SOTA，且易于微调。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有细胞谱系重建方法忽视了候选追踪图中的两个结构障碍：（1）细胞分裂在节点嵌入空间中纠缠了不同的谱系路径；（2）共享节点的边具有近随机的标签一致性，导致候选图拓扑对图神经网络聚合无效。

Method: 提出高阶细胞追踪Transformer（HOCT），采用以边为中心的架构，让候选细胞链接在3D几何先验下相互关注，从而同时解决节点嵌入纠缠和图拓扑信息缺失两个问题。

Result: 在Cell Tracking Challenge和细菌分裂基准上达到SOTA，无需深度预训练图像编码器；在人机协同场景下仅需400个标注即可将追踪错误降低59%，比LoRA微调竞争基线提升6.75%。

Conclusion: HOCT通过边注意力机制和几何先验有效克服了候选追踪图的结构缺陷，实现了高效、易微调的细胞追踪，为实时交互式标注提供了实用方案。

Original Abstract: Reconstructing lineages from live-imaging microscopy requires linking cell detections across time, including through cell divisions. A common approach is to construct a candidate graph and associate cell segmentations (nodes) across frames. However, these and other existing methods overlook two structural obstacles in candidate tracking graphs: (i) cell divisions entangle distinct lineage paths in the node embedding space, and (ii) edges sharing a node have near-random label agreement, so the candidate-graph topology carries no useful information for graph neural networks to aggregate. We propose the \textbf{Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer} (HOCT), an edge-centric architecture in which candidate cell links attend to one another under a 3D geometric prior, resolving both issues. Evaluated on the Cell Tracking Challenge and a bacteria division benchmark, HOCT achieves state-of-the-art results without deep pre-trained image encoders. Moreover, the proposed approach is easier to fine-tune, quickly reducing tracking errors by 59% with 400 annotations in a human-in-the-loop setting, outperforming LoRA fine-tuning of competing transformer baselines (6.75% improvement).

中文摘要翻译: 从活体成像显微术中重建谱系需要将细胞检测结果在时间维度上关联起来，包括跨越细胞分裂的过程。一种常见方法是构建候选图，并将跨帧的细胞分割结果（节点）进行关联。然而，这些方法及其他现有方法都忽视了候选追踪图（candidate tracking graph）中的两个结构障碍：（i）细胞分裂会在节点嵌入空间中纠缠不同的谱系路径；（ii）共享同一节点的边具有近随机的标签一致性，因此候选图的拓扑结构对图神经网络（GNN）的聚合不提供有效信息。本文提出**高阶细胞追踪Transformer**（Higher-Order Cell Tracking Transformer, HOCT），一种以边为中心的架构，使候选细胞链接在3D几何先验下相互关注，从而同时解决上述两个问题。在Cell Tracking Challenge和细菌分裂基准上的评估表明，HOCT无需深度预训练图像编码器即可取得最先进的结果。此外，所提方法更易于微调，在人机协同（human-in-the-loop）场景下，仅需400个标注即可快速将追踪错误降低59%，优于使用LoRA微调的竞争Transformer基线（提升6.75%）。

</details>


### [179] [StoryTeller: Training-Free Narrative Grounding for Long-Form Audio Description](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11798)
*Seung Hyun Hahm,Minh T. Dinh,SouYoung Jin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: StoryTeller 是一个无需训练的长篇音频描述生成框架，通过维护经过验证的叙事记忆来保持跨场景的角色、事件和故事上下文一致性，并提出了 StoryAD-QA 评测基准。实验证明该方法在叙事连贯性、事实准确性和故事理解方面显著优于现有基线。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频-语言模型在处理长篇音频描述时，往往独立对待每个时刻，忽略了角色身份、事件因果和跨场景的叙事上下文，导致盲人和低视力观众无法跟随电影情节。现有方法依赖本地视觉线索，缺乏对故事层面信息的维护与传递。

Method: StoryTeller 是一个无需训练（training-free）的框架。核心组件是一个经过验证的叙事记忆（verified narrative memory），用于跨场景传递故事相关信息。它仅输入原始视频和电影名称，可选检索公开电影元数据来解析角色名称和故事上下文，但仅接受经语义过滤和 VLM 验证确认与视频内容相符的事实。无需字幕、脚本、AD 转录、对齐字幕、角色库、预计算人脸身份或任务特定微调。

Result: 在标准 AD 基准和多种长视频上的实验表明，StoryTeller 在自动评估、基于 QA 的评估和人工评估中，在叙事连贯性、事实准确性和故事理解方面均持续优于强基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过维护跨场景的叙事记忆，无需额外训练数据和标注即可显著提升长篇音频描述的叙事连贯性和上下文信息量，为盲人和低视力观众提供更具故事感知的观影辅助。

Original Abstract: Long-form audio description (AD) requires more than describing visible actions: it must preserve characters, events, relationships, and story context across scenes so that blind and low-vision (BLV) audiences can follow a film. Modern video-language models (VLMs) are effective on short clips, but they often treat each moment independently, producing descriptions that miss who characters are, why events matter, and how the current scene connects to earlier narrative context. We propose StoryTeller, a training-free framework for story-aware long-form AD. Instead of relying only on local visual cues, StoryTeller maintains a verified narrative memory that carries forward story-relevant information across scenes, enabling later descriptions to remain coherent, grounded, and contextually informative. Given only raw video and a movie title, StoryTeller can optionally retrieve public movie metadata to resolve names and story context, while accepting only facts that are supported by the video through semantic filtering and VLM verification. The method requires no subtitles, scripts, AD transcripts, aligned captions, character banks, precomputed face identities, or task-specific fine-tuning. To evaluate whether generated AD preserves narrative information, we introduce StoryAD-QA, a question-answering benchmark that tests whether a language model can answer story-context questions using only the generated descriptions. Experiments on standard AD benchmarks and diverse long-form videos show that StoryTeller consistently improves narrative coherence, factual grounding, and story comprehension over strong baselines in automatic, QA-based, and human evaluations.

中文摘要翻译: 长篇音频描述（AD）不仅需要描述可见的动作，还需要保留跨场景的角色、事件、关系及故事上下文，以便盲人和低视力（BLV）观众能够跟上电影情节。现代视频-语言模型（VLM）在短片段上表现有效，但它们往往独立处理每个时刻，生成的描述遗漏了角色身份、事件重要性以及当前场景与先前叙事上下文的关联。我们提出 StoryTeller，一个无需训练的故事感知型长篇音频描述框架。StoryTeller 不依赖局部视觉线索，而是维护一个经过验证的叙事记忆（verified narrative memory），将故事相关信息跨场景传递，使后续描述保持连贯、有据可依且上下文信息丰富。仅给定原始视频和电影名称，StoryTeller 可选择检索公开电影元数据来解析角色名称和故事上下文，但仅接受经语义过滤（semantic filtering）和 VLM 验证确认与视频内容相符的事实。该方法不需要字幕、脚本、AD 转录、对齐字幕、角色库、预计算人脸身份或任务特定微调。为评估生成的 AD 是否保留了叙事信息，我们提出 StoryAD-QA，一个问答基准测试，用于测试语言模型仅使用生成的描述能否回答故事上下文问题。在标准 AD 基准和多种长视频上的实验表明，StoryTeller 在自动评估、基于 QA 的评估和人工评估中，在叙事连贯性、事实准确性和故事理解方面均持续优于强基线方法。

</details>


### [180] [MM-ToolSandBox: A Unified Framework for Evaluating Visual Tool-Calling Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11818)
*Kaixin Ma,Di Feng,Alexander Metz,Jiarui Lu,Eshan Verma,Afshin Dehghan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: MM-ToolSandBox是一个面向视觉接地工具调用agent的基准与评估框架，包含500+工具、16个应用域，支持多图像多轮任务。评估12个模型发现最佳模型成功率低于50%，53%的失败源于图像信息提取不精确，且存在规划→精度能力交叉现象：小模型在决策上失败，大模型在感知上失败。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有工具调用Agent缺乏对视觉输入的充分支持，现有基准无法评估视觉接地工具调用能力，尤其是在多图像、多轮交互和现实对话现象（目标修正、错误纠正、状态变化）下的表现。

Method: 构建了包含500+工具、16个应用域的状态化执行环境；设计自动化场景生成管线，通过信息流引导规划和多阶段质量过滤生成258个人工验证场景及50个UI交互变体；在此框架下评估12个SOTA模型。

Result: 最佳模型成功率低于50%；53%的失败源于图像信息提取错误（而非规划错误）；小模型失败于决策规划（what to do），大模型失败于视觉感知（what they see），即出现"规划→精度"能力交叉现象。

Conclusion: 当前模型仍缺乏稳健的视觉工具调用能力；视觉精度是比规划更主要的瓶颈；不同能力水平的模型需要截然不同的改进方向——小模型需提升规划能力，大模型需提升视觉感知精度。

Original Abstract: We introduce MM-ToolSandBox, a benchmark and evaluation framework for visually grounded tool-calling agents. The framework provides a stateful execution environment spanning 500+ tools across 16 application domains, supporting multi-image, multi-turn tasks where agents must ground progressively arriving visual inputs into executable tool calls while handling realistic conversational phenomena (goal revisions, error corrections, state mutations). An automated scenario generation pipeline produces diverse, visually grounded scenarios through information-flow-guided planning and multi-stage quality filtering, yielding 258 human-verified nominal scenarios and 50 variants targeting interactive UI applications. Evaluating 12 state-of-the-art models, from 4B open-weight to frontier proprietary systems, shows that current models still lack robust visual tool-calling capability: even the best model achieves below 50% success rate. Our failure analysis further reveals that visual precision, not only planning, is a primary bottleneck for capable models: 53% of failures stem from incorrect information extraction from images despite otherwise correct task workflows. A planning-to-precision crossover emerges with scale: smaller models fail at deciding what to do, while larger models fail at perceiving what they see, suggesting fundamentally different research directions for improving models at different capability levels. The framework and the benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/apple/ml-mmtoolsandbox

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了MM-ToolSandBox，一个面向视觉接地工具调用智能体的基准与评估框架。该框架提供了一个状态化执行环境，涵盖16个应用领域的500多个工具，支持多图像、多轮任务，其中智能体必须将逐步到达的视觉输入转化为可执行的工具调用，同时处理现实对话现象（目标修正、错误纠正、状态变化）。通过信息流引导规划和多阶段质量过滤，自动化场景生成管线能够生成多样化、视觉接地的场景，最终得到258个人工验证的标准场景和50个针对交互式UI应用的变体。对12个最先进模型（从4B开源模型到前沿闭源系统）的评估表明，当前模型仍缺乏稳健的视觉工具调用能力：即使是最佳模型，其成功率也低于50%。进一步的失败分析揭示，视觉精度（而不仅仅是规划）是能力较强模型的主要瓶颈：53%的失败源于从图像中提取信息错误，尽管任务工作流本身是正确的。随着模型规模增大，出现了从规划到精度的能力交叉现象：较小的模型在决定做什么上失败，而较大的模型在感知其所见上失败，这表明针对不同能力水平的模型需要截然不同的研究方向。该框架和基准已在 https://github.com/apple/ml-mmtoolsandbox 公开。

</details>


### [181] [MicroCharNet: Less is More for License Plate Character Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11830)
*Huy Che,Dinh-Duy Phan,Duc-Lung Vu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MicroCharNet，一个超轻量级车牌字符检测模型，仅0.08M参数和0.096 GFLOPs，在UFPR-ALPR数据集上达到与大型模型相当的检测精度，并可在边缘设备上实时部署。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有高精度车牌字符检测模型大多依赖大规模架构，计算开销大，难以部署到资源受限的边缘设备上，因此需要设计兼顾精度和效率的超轻量级模型。

Method: 采用由C2f块构成的紧凑骨干网络，集成CoordAtt（坐标注意力）模块增强特征提取并保留空间信息；使用轻量级C3k2-based颈部网络融合多层级特征；最后采用单层无锚点检测头实现端到端预测。

Result: 在UFPR-ALPR数据集上，MicroCharNet仅用0.08M参数和0.096 GFLOPs即达到有竞争力的检测精度，超越了多个近期YOLO基线模型；硬件级评估证实其在边缘设备上可实现实时部署。

Conclusion: 精心设计的超轻量级架构能够在车牌字符检测任务中有效平衡精度与效率，适合在资源受限设备上实时运行。

Original Abstract: License plate character detection is a crucial component of intelligent transportation systems, where high accuracy and computational efficiency are required for real-time deployment. Although recent deep learning-based methods have substantially improved detection performance, many high-accuracy models rely on large-scale architectures that incur substantial computational overhead, limiting their applicability to resource-constrained devices. In this paper, we propose MicroCharNet, an ultra-lightweight model specifically designed for license plate character detection. The proposed architecture employs a compact backbone composed of C2f blocks, integrated with CoordAtt module to enhance feature extraction while preserving spatial information. A lightweight C3k2-based neck fuses multi-level features, followed by a single-level anchor-free detection head that enables end-to-end prediction. Experiments conducted on the UFPR-ALPR dataset demonstrate that MicroCharNet achieves competitive detection accuracy with only 0.08M parameters and 0.096 GFLOPs, while outperforming several recent YOLO-based baselines. Hardware-level evaluations further confirm its efficiency for real-time deployment on edge devices. These results indicate that carefully designed ultra-lightweight architectures can effectively balance accuracy and efficiency in license plate character detection. The source code is available at https://github.com/chequanghuy/MicroCharNet.

中文摘要翻译: 车牌字符检测是智能交通系统中的关键组成部分，需要高精度和高计算效率以实现实时部署。尽管近年来基于深度学习的方法显著提升了检测性能，但许多高精度模型依赖大规模架构，导致计算开销巨大，限制了其在资源受限设备上的应用。在本文中，我们提出MicroCharNet，一个专为车牌字符检测设计的超轻量级模型。该架构采用由C2f块构成的紧凑骨干网络，并集成CoordAtt模块以增强特征提取同时保留空间信息。基于C3k2的轻量级颈部网络融合多层级特征，随后通过单层无锚点检测头实现端到端预测。在UFPR-ALPR数据集上的实验表明，MicroCharNet仅用0.08M参数和0.096 GFLOPs即达到具有竞争力的检测精度，并超越了多个近期YOLO基线模型。硬件级评估进一步证实了其在边缘设备上实时部署的效率。这些结果表明，精心设计的超轻量级架构能够在车牌字符检测中有效平衡精度与效率。源代码可在https://github.com/chequanghuy/MicroCharNet获取。

</details>


### [182] [Cycle-World: Mitigating Error Accumulation in Long-term Video World Models via Reverse-Prediction Cycle Consistency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11836)
*Zihan Su,Teng Hu,Jiangning Zhang,Ruiyan Wang,Ran Yi,Lizhuang Ma,Dacheng Tao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Cycle-World通过强制时序可逆性（双向循环一致性）来抑制自回归扩散模型在长视频生成中的误差累积问题，在VBench基准上实现了60秒视频生成的最优质量与时间一致性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 自回归扩散模型在长时序视频生成中，由于顺序推理特性导致预测偏差随时间累积，引发不可控的生成漂移、结构坍塌和严重视觉退化，亟需一种能够限制误差积累的稳定长视频生成框架。

Method: 核心方法包括：（1）训练阶段：引入反向预测模型，通过循环一致性目标隐式地将因果约束嵌入前向生成器，迫使生成可逆序列；（2）推理阶段：将冻结的反向模型作为运行时校正器，通过基于梯度的循环引导迭代优化潜在表示，主动抑制已累积误差。

Result: 在VBench基准上，Cycle-World的双阶段协同机制显著缓解了误差漂移，在60秒长视频合成中实现了最先进的整体生成质量和长时序一致性。

Conclusion: 理论和实验证明，通过循环一致性目标可以将前向生成漂移严格限制在瓶颈内，训练与推理阶段的双重可逆性约束是解决长视频生成中误差累积问题的有效范式。

Original Abstract: Autoregressive diffusion models have enabled high-quality video generation, yet their sequential nature inherently suffers from error accumulation. In long-horizon video synthesis, minor prediction deviations compound over time, inevitably leading to unconstrained generative drift, structural collapse, and severe visual degradation. To address this, we propose Cycle-World, a novel framework designed for stable and temporally consistent long-video generation. Our approach tackles error drift by enforcing strict temporal reversibility across both the training and inference phases. Theoretically, we demonstrate that forward generative drift can be strictly bottlenecked by a cycle-consistency objective. During training, we integrate an efficient reverse-prediction model to implicitly embed causal constraints into the forward generator, compelling it to produce reversible sequences that tightly adhere to the natural video manifold. At inference time, we repurpose this frozen reverse model as a runtime corrector. Through gradient-based cycle guidance, it iteratively refines the generated latent representations, actively suppressing accumulated errors before they are committed to the historical context. Extensive experiments on the VBench benchmark demonstrate that Cycle-World's dual-phase synergy significantly mitigates error drift, achieving state-of-the-art overall generation quality and long-horizon temporal consistency in 60-second synthesis.

中文摘要翻译: 自回归扩散模型实现了高质量视频生成，但其序列化本质固有地遭受误差累积问题。在长时序视频合成中，微小的预测偏差随时间不断叠加，不可避免地导致不受控的生成漂移、结构坍塌和严重的视觉退化。为解决这一问题，我们提出Cycle-World，一个专为稳定且时间一致的长视频生成而设计的新型框架。我们的方法通过在训练和推理阶段均强制执行严格的时间可逆性来应对误差漂移。理论上，我们证明前向生成漂移可以通过循环一致性目标被严格限制。训练过程中，我们集成一个高效的反向预测模型，将因果约束隐式地嵌入前向生成器，迫使其生成严格贴合自然视频流形的可逆序列。在推理时，我们重新利用这个冻结的反向模型作为运行时校正器。通过基于梯度的循环引导，它迭代地优化生成的潜在表示，在累积误差被固化到历史上下文之前主动将其抑制。在VBench基准上的大量实验表明，Cycle-World的双阶段协同显著缓解了误差漂移，在60秒合成中实现了最先进的整体生成质量和长时序时间一致性。

</details>


### [183] [HASTE: A Platform for Rapid Post-Disaster Building Damage Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11838)
*Caleb Robinson,Anthony Ortiz,Simone Fobi Nsutezo,Cameron Birge,Meygha Machado,Marcelo Duarte,Joaquin Rivero Rodriguez,Anthony Cintron Roman,Kevin White,Inbal Becker-Reshef,Juan M. Lavista Ferres*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: HASTE是一个无需编码的Web平台，允许非机器学习分析师仅使用灾后卫星图像快速生成每栋建筑的损毁评估地图，通过两种方法（场景内小样本语义分割和基于预训练基础模型嵌入的逻辑回归）实现，已在30多次真实灾害响应中得到验证。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 大型灾害发生后，响应人员需要在数小时内获得建筑损毁地图。现有表现良好的模型依赖于匹配的灾前/灾后图像以及来自类似历史事件的训练集，而新发灾害的首日通常无法获得这些条件。因此亟需一种无需编码、不依赖灾前图像和预训练数据集的解决方案。

Method: HASTE实现了两种方法共享同一界面：(1) 用户标注灾后场景中的多边形，训练一个小型语义分割模型，逐像素预测后与现有建筑足迹结合；(2) 使用预训练视觉模型对每个建筑足迹进行嵌入，用户标注少量建筑，在浏览器中拟合逻辑回归模型，数秒内完成全场景评分。

Result: 在xBD数据集上的初步实验表明，仅使用灾后影像、通过基础模型嵌入池化后的建筑足迹即可区分受损与完好建筑，性能与全监督ResNet-50基线相当，但仅需其1/20的标注量。HASTE自2023年以来已支持30多次真实灾害响应，涵盖地震、飓风、龙卷风、洪水、野火等，在影像可用后数小时至数天内向人道主义合作伙伴交付结果。

Conclusion: HASTE是一个开源、无需编码的平台，有效解决了灾后建筑损毁快速评估的实际需求，未来最有希望的方向包括视觉-语言评估、主动学习以及道路等基础设施的损毁模型。

Original Abstract: When a large disaster strikes, responders need a map of which buildings are damaged within hours. The models that do well on public benchmarks assume matched before-and-after imagery and a training set drawn from similar past events, and neither is usually available for a new disaster in its first day. We present HASTE (High-speed Assessment and Satellite Tracking for Emergencies), a no-code web platform that lets analysts who are not machine learning engineers produce per-building damage maps from post-disaster satellite imagery. HASTE implements two methods that share one interface. The first requires the user to label polygons over the post-disaster scene, trains a small semantic segmentation model on that single scene, runs it over the whole image, and joins the per-pixel output to existing building footprints. The second embeds every footprint with a pretrained vision model, requires the user to label a handful of buildings, and fits a logistic regression in the browser that scores the rest of the scene in seconds. We describe the platform, both methods, and the engineering that supports them. We also report preliminary experiments on xBD showing that foundation-model embeddings pooled over footprints separate damaged from intact buildings using post-disaster imagery alone, matching a fully supervised ResNet-50 baseline with a twentieth of its labels. HASTE and its predecessors have supported more than thirty real-world disaster responses since 2023, spanning earthquakes, hurricanes, cyclones, floods, wildfires, and tornadoes, delivering results to humanitarian partners within hours to days of imagery becoming available. We close with the directions we think are most promising, including vision-language assessment, active learning, and damage models for roads and other infrastructure. HASTE is open source at https://github.com/microsoft/haste.

中文摘要翻译: 当大型灾难发生时，响应人员需要在数小时内获得哪些建筑受损的地图。当前在公开基准测试中表现良好的模型假设拥有匹配的灾前-灾后影像，且训练集来自类似的历史事件——而新发灾难的首日通常无法满足这两个条件。我们提出HASTE（应急高速评估与卫星追踪），一个无需编码的Web平台，让非机器学习领域的分析师能够仅凭灾后卫星影像生成每栋建筑的损毁地图。HASTE实现了两种方法并共享同一界面。第一种方法要求用户在灾后场景中标注多边形，在单场景上训练一个小型语义分割模型，将其应用于整张影像，并将逐像素输出与现有建筑足迹关联。第二种方法使用预训练视觉模型对每个足迹进行嵌入，用户仅需标注少量建筑，即可在浏览器中拟合一个逻辑回归模型，在数秒内完成全场景评分。我们描述了该平台、两种方法以及支撑它们的技术工程。我们还报告了在xBD上的初步实验，结果表明：仅使用灾后影像，通过基础模型嵌入对建筑足迹进行池化后，即可区分受损与完好建筑，其性能与全监督ResNet-50基线相当，而标注量仅为后者的二十分之一。自2023年以来，HASTE及其前身已支持超过30次真实灾害响应，涵盖地震、飓风、气旋、洪水、野火和龙卷风，在影像可用后的数小时至数天内向人道主义合作伙伴交付结果。最后，我们指出了最有前景的发展方向，包括视觉-语言评估、主动学习以及道路等基础设施的损毁模型。HASTE已在https://github.com/microsoft/haste开源。

</details>


### [184] [LoRA-Based Cascaded Multimodal Fusion for Action Recognition in Medical Training Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11839)
*Divya Mereddy,Jeevan Beedareddy*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于级联低秩适配（LoRA）的多模态融合框架，用于医疗培训环境中的动作与活动识别。该框架通过参数高效的模态特定适配与顺序融合，逐步整合不同模态，无需重训练已有组件，并在NurViD和护士训练数据集上取得了有竞争力的性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有方法通常假设固定的融合结构，难以灵活适应不同数据集中的模态集合变化，且全参数微调成本高昂。本文旨在设计一种可扩展、参数高效的多模态融合方法，能够按阶段整合模态，避免重新训练已有组件。

Method: 提出级联LoRA融合框架：首先为每种模态训练参数高效的LoRA适配器，然后按相关性依次融合相关模态，再逐步引入异构模态，实现分阶段顺序融合，无需重训已学习组件。

Result: 在NurViD和护士训练数据集上，级联融合策略优于单模态模型，且与先前的数据集特定基线相比具有竞争力。

Conclusion: 级联LoRA融合是一种有前景的参数高效方法，适用于医疗培训动作与活动识别中异构模态的整合。

Original Abstract: This paper presents a cascaded Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA)-based multimodal fusion framework for action and activity recognition in healthcare-oriented training environments. The proposed architecture combines parameter-efficient modality-specific adaptation with sequential fusion, enabling modalities to be integrated in stages without retraining previously learned components. Rather than assuming a fixed fusion structure, the framework first integrates more closely related modalities and then incorporates additional heterogeneous modalities, supporting scalable adaptation across datasets with different modality sets.We evaluate the framework on two healthcare-oriented training environment datasets: NurViD and the Nurse Training dataset. Across these datasets, preliminary results suggest that the proposed cascaded fusion strategy improves over individual modality models and provides competitive performance relative to previously reported dataset-specific baselines. Overall, these findings indicate that cascaded LoRA-based fusion is a promising parameter-efficient approach for integrating heterogeneous modalities in medical training action and activity recognition tasks. github: https://github.com/anonymous0-ai/LoRA-Based-Cascaded-Multimodal-Fusion-.git.

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出了一种基于级联低秩适配（LoRA）的多模态融合框架，用于面向医疗培训环境的动作与活动识别。所提出的架构结合了参数高效的模态特定适配与顺序融合，使得模态能够分阶段集成，而无需重新训练先前学习的组件。该框架不假设固定的融合结构，而是首先整合相关性更强的模态，再逐步加入其他异构模态，从而支持对不同模态集合的数据集进行可扩展的适配。我们在两个面向医疗培训环境的数据集——NurViD和护士训练数据集上评估了该框架。在这些数据集上，初步结果表明，所提出的级联融合策略优于单模态模型，并且与先前报道的数据集特定基线相比具有竞争力。总体而言，这些发现表明，级联LoRA融合是一种有前景的参数高效方法，适用于医疗培训动作与活动识别中异构模态的整合。GitHub: https://github.com/anonymous0-ai/LoRA-Based-Cascaded-Multimodal-Fusion-.git。

</details>


### [185] [Beyond the Single Camera: Agentic Multi-View Reasoning in Sports Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11844)
*Kerui Chen,Jinglu Wang,Xiaoyi Zhang,Yan Lu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SportMV-Bench，首个面向多视角体育视频理解的多模态大语言模型评测基准，包含787个多视角视频包和2592个问答对，涵盖三类任务。同时提出SportMV-Agent框架，通过主动视角选择、感知工具执行和证据推理的迭代循环，相比最强基线提升14.46%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有MLLM评测集中于单视角视频理解，但体育视频存在密集遮挡、快速运动和复杂交互，单视角难以解决。实际比赛中多视角被广泛使用，但缺乏对应的多视角体育视频理解基准。

Method: 构建SportMV-Bench：采用LLM生成、MLLM验证和人工过滤的流水线确保质量。提出SportMV-Agent：主动视角选择、感知工具执行、证据推理三者迭代循环的智能体框架。

Result: 当前MLLM未能有效利用多视角信息，瓶颈在于细粒度视觉感知和视角选择而非逻辑推理或领域知识。SportMV-Agent相较于最强MLLM基线取得14.46%的相对提升。

Conclusion: 多视角信息对体育视频理解至关重要，现有MLLM在此任务上表现不足，所提SportMV-Agent通过主动视角选择与工具增强推理可有效弥补这一差距。

Original Abstract: Recent Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) achieve strong performance on single-view video understanding benchmarks. However, sports videos involve dense occlusion, rapid motion, and complex interactions that are difficult to resolve from a single viewpoint. In practice, sports events are recorded from multiple camera angles, providing complementary evidence used by referees. Yet, no existing benchmark evaluates MLLMs on multi-view sports video understanding. To address this gap, we introduce SportMV-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark built from official match recordings, through a dedicated pipeline combining LLM-based generation, MLLM-based verification, and human filtering to ensure quality and consistency. SportMV-Bench containing 787 multi-view video bundles and 2592 question-answer pairs across three categories: Perception-Aware Recognition (PAR), Rule-aware Event Interpretation (REI), and Adjudicative Decision Reasoning(ADR). Our analysis shows that current MLLMs fail to effectively exploit multi-view information, with the bottlenecks lying in fine-grained visual perception and view selection rather than logical reasoning or domain knowledge. We propose SportMV-Agent, an agentic framework that orchestrates an iterative loop of active view selection, perception tool execution, and evidence-grounded reasoning, achieving a significant 14.46% relative improvement over the strongest MLLM baseline.

中文摘要翻译: 近年来的多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在单视角视频理解基准上取得了强劲的性能。然而，体育视频涉及密集遮挡、快速运动以及复杂的交互，这些难以从单一视角解决。在实际中，体育赛事通过多个摄像机角度进行录制，为裁判提供了互补的证据。然而，目前尚无现有基准评估MLLMs在多视角体育视频理解上的表现。为填补这一空白，我们引入了SportMV-Bench，这是一个基于官方比赛录像构建的综合性基准，通过结合基于LLM的生成、基于MLLM的验证以及人工过滤的专用流水线来确保质量和一致性。SportMV-Bench包含787个多视角视频包和2592个问答对，涵盖三个类别：感知感知识别（PAR）、规则感知事件解释（REI）和裁决决策推理（ADR）。我们的分析表明，当前MLLMs未能有效利用多视角信息，其瓶颈在于细粒度视觉感知和视角选择，而非逻辑推理或领域知识。我们提出了SportMV-Agent，这是一个智能体框架，通过主动视角选择、感知工具执行和基于证据的推理的迭代循环进行编排，相较于最强MLLM基线取得了14.46%的显著相对提升。

</details>


### [186] [Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11862)
*Shijie Wang,Honglu Zhou,Ziyang Wang,Ran Xu,Caiming Xiong,Silvio Savarese,Chen Sun,Juan Carlos Niebles*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出E-VQA任务，要求视频大语言模型同时输出语义答案和精确的时空证据（时间片段+密集跟踪分割掩码）。构建了首个像素级人工验证基准ST-Evidence，并开发自动生成流程构建160k规模的ST-Evidence-Instruct数据集进行微调，在7B模型上取得+27.2 t-mean和+13.8 J&F的显著提升。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视频大语言模型在视频问答中表现优异，但本质上是黑盒系统，仅提供文本答案而缺乏可验证的视觉依据。已有的可解释性工作依赖文本解释或稀疏边界框，难以捕捉遮挡、非刚性变形等复杂视频动态。因此，需要让模型输出兼具语义答案和精确的时空定位证据。

Method: (1) 定义E-VQA新任务，要求模型联合输出语义答案、时间片段和密集跟踪对象分割掩码；(2) 构建ST-Evidence基准，首个经人工验证的像素级定位基准，涵盖判别式和生成式两种任务；(3) 开发自动化生成流程，构建160k规模的ST-Evidence-Instruct数据集；(4) 在该数据集上微调带定位能力的视频大语言模型。

Result: (1) 现有最优模型在QA准确率与真实视觉感知之间存在严重解耦，仅靠规模扩展无法弥合；(2) 在ST-Evidence-Instruct上微调后，7B模型相比同等规模的UniPixel基线提升显著：t-mean提升27.2，J&F提升13.8。

Conclusion: 本文通过定义E-VQA新任务、构建人工验证基准和自动化数据集生成流程，建立了可解释、有证据支撑的视频理解基线，证明了精细时空定位与高层语义推理相结合的有效性。

Original Abstract: Current Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) excel in question answering (QA) but largely operate as black boxes, providing textual answers without verifiable visual grounding. Existing explainability efforts rely on textual rationales or sparse bounding boxes, which struggle to capture complex video dynamics such as occlusions and non-rigid deformations. We propose Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering (E-VQA), a novel task requiring models to jointly output a semantic answer and precise spatio-temporal evidence: temporal segments and dense, tracked object segmentation masklets. To support this, we introduce ST-Evidence, the first human-verified benchmark for both discriminative and generative pixel-level grounding. Evaluations of state-of-the-art models reveal a critical decoupling between QA accuracy and true visual perception that scaling alone fails to bridge. To address this, we develop scalable, automated generation pipelines to create ST-Evidence-Instruct, a 160k-scale dataset bridging high-level reasoning with fine-grained grounding. Fine-tuning grounded Video LLMs on this data yields substantial gains over the corresponding size-matched UniPixel baselines (e.g., +27.2 t-mean and +13.8 J&F on a 7B model), establishing a robust baseline for explainable, evidence-backed video understanding. Code and data are available at https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/EVQA.

中文摘要翻译: 当前视频大语言模型（Video LLMs）在问答任务中表现出色，但本质上作为黑盒系统运行，仅提供文本答案而缺乏可验证的视觉定位能力。现有的可解释性工作依赖文本解释或稀疏边界框，难以捕捉遮挡、非刚性变形等复杂视频动态。我们提出Evidence-Backed Video Question Answering（E-VQA），这是一个新任务，要求模型同时输出语义答案和精确的时空证据：时间片段以及密集的、可跟踪的对象分割掩码序列。为此，我们引入了ST-Evidence，这是首个针对判别式与生成式像素级定位的经人工验证的基准。对现有最优模型的评估揭示了QA准确率与真实视觉感知之间存在严重解耦，且仅靠规模扩展无法弥合这一差距。为解决此问题，我们开发了可扩展的自动化生成流程，构建了ST-Evidence-Instruct，一个16万规模的数据集，用于桥接高层推理与细粒度定位。在该数据上微调带有定位能力的视频大语言模型，相较于同等规模的UniPixel基线取得了显著提升（例如，7B模型上t-mean提升27.2，J&F提升13.8），为可解释的、有证据支撑的视频理解建立了稳健的基线。代码与数据已开源至https://github.com/SalesforceAIResearch/EVQA。

</details>


### [187] [Latent-Identity Tuning in Text-to-Image Personalization Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11885)
*Daniel Garibi,Ronen Kamenetsky,Hadar Averbuch-Elor,Daniel Cohen-Or,Or Patashnik*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种无需额外训练的细粒度身份调优方法，通过在预训练冻结编码器的潜在空间中识别语义方向，实现对文本到图像个性化模型中特定身份特征的局部化、语义一致的编辑，同时保持跨图像的身份一致性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于通用文本到图像模型的个性化与编辑方法缺乏对人脸进行细粒度编辑所需的精度，即使是微小修改也可能显著改变主体的感知身份。因此需要一种能够实现精细面部编辑且保持身份一致性的方法。

Method: 方法利用预训练冻结编码器（用于文本到图像个性化）的现有架构，无需额外训练。通过探索编码器的潜在空间，识别由不同潜在令牌构成的语义方向，这些令牌在捕捉身份不同方面扮演不同角色，并对应特定空间或语义面部区域。在完整潜在空间及选定令牌的子空间内识别有意义的编辑方向，实现局部化、细粒度、语义一致的编辑。

Result: 通过定性和定量实验验证，该方法能够实现多样化的局部面部编辑，同时保持跨图像的身份一致性。

Conclusion: 本文证明了在文本到图像个性化模型的冻结编码器潜在空间中存在有意义的语义方向，通过利用这些方向可以在无需额外训练的条件下实现细粒度、局部化的身份编辑，并且编辑后的身份在生成的不同图像中保持一致。

Original Abstract: Generating and editing a person's face demands high precision, as even minor modifications can significantly alter a subject's perceived identity. Current personalization and editing methods built on general-purpose text-to-image models, however, often lack the precision required for fine-grained facial edits. We present a method for fine-grained identity tuning in text-to-image personalization models. Unlike standard image editing, which operates on a given image, identity tuning modifies the latent representation of a specific identity, enabling the generation of diverse images that consistently depict the same edited identity. To enable fine-grained latent identity tuning, we explore the latent space of a pre-trained, frozen encoder for text-to-image personalization. Our approach requires no additional training. Instead, it leverages the existing architecture of a frozen encoder to uncover latent semantic directions. This space consists of a set of latent tokens that play distinct roles in capturing different aspects of an identity and often correspond to specific spatial or semantic facial regions. We show that meaningful directions can be identified within this space and within subspaces defined by selected tokens, enabling localized, fine-grained, and semantically coherent edits. We validate our approach through qualitative and quantitative experiments that demonstrate diverse localized facial edits while preserving cross-image identity consistency. Project page at: https://garibida.github.io/IdentityTuning/

中文摘要翻译: 生成和编辑人脸需要高精度，因为即使是微小的修改也可能显著改变主体的感知身份。然而，当前基于通用文本到图像模型的个性化和编辑方法往往缺乏进行细粒度面部编辑所需的精度。我们提出了一种用于文本到图像个性化模型的细粒度身份调优方法。与在给定图像上操作的标准图像编辑不同，身份调优修改特定身份的潜在表示，从而能够生成多样化的图像，这些图像一致地描绘相同的编辑后身份。为了实现细粒度的潜在身份调优，我们探索了用于文本到图像个性化的预训练冻结编码器的潜在空间。我们的方法无需额外训练。相反，它利用冻结编码器的现有架构来揭示潜在的语义方向。该空间由一组潜在令牌组成，这些令牌在捕捉身份的不同方面扮演着不同的角色，并且通常对应于特定的空间或语义面部区域。我们证明，在该空间内以及由选定令牌定义的子空间中，可以识别出有意义的编辑方向，从而实现局部化、细粒度且语义一致的编辑。我们通过定性和定量实验验证了我们的方法，展示了多样化的局部面部编辑，同时保持了跨图像的身份一致性。项目页面：https://garibida.github.io/IdentityTuning/

</details>


### [188] [Read It Back: Pretrained MLLMs Are Zero-Shot Reward Models for Text-to-Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11886)
*Runhui Huang,Qihui Zhang,Zhe Liu,Yu Gao,Jie Wu,Hengshuang Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpectraReward，一种免训练的奖励函数，通过计算生成图像重建原提示的对数似然来评估图像质量，无需偏好标签或奖励模型微调；进一步提出Self-SpectraReward实现策略自改进闭环。实验在多种扩散模型、RL算法和奖励MLLM骨干上验证了其有效性和一致性提升。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有MLLM衍生的奖励训练方法通常需要偏好标签或对奖励模型进行微调，成本高昂且泛化能力有限；此外，外部奖励模型与策略模型之间存在对齐问题，影响图像生成强化学习的效果。

Method: SpectraReward利用预训练MLLM的图像-文本对齐能力，对生成的图像进行单次教师强制前向传播，计算图像条件下原提示的平均对数似然作为奖励分数，无需额外训练。Self-SpectraReward进一步利用统一多模态模型中理解分支作为生成分支的奖励模型，形成自改进闭环。

Result: 在两种扩散模型、三种RL算法、九种奖励MLLM骨干（4B~235B参数）及五个分布外文生图基准上，SpectraReward和Self-SpectraReward均显著且一致地提升生成性能，超越先前MLLM衍生的奖励训练方法。分析发现更大规模的奖励MLLM并不总是更好，而Self-SpectraReward可匹敌或超越更大的外部奖励模型，表明奖励-策略对齐是图像生成RL的关键因素。

Conclusion: SpectraReward提供了一种高效、免训练的奖励函数方案，Self-SpectraReward展示了统一多模态模型中自监督闭环的潜力，揭示了奖励-策略对齐的重要性，为图像生成强化学习提供了新范式。

Original Abstract: In this paper, we propose SpectraReward, a training-free reward function that turns pretrained MLLMs into off-the-shelf reward models for image-generation reinforcement learning. Instead of asking the MLLM to judge a generated image or answer decomposed verification questions, SpectraReward measures how well the original prompt can be recovered from the generated image through a single image-conditioned, teacher-forced forward pass. We use the average image-conditioned prompt log-likelihood as the reward, directly reusing the MLLM's pretrained image-text alignment ability without preference labels, reward-model fine-tuning. We further introduce Self-SpectraReward, a special case for unified multimodal models where the policy's own understanding branch serves as the reward model for its generation branch, forming a closed-loop self-improving framework without external reward models or external knowledge. Extensive experiments validate SpectraReward through a broad image-generation RL study covering two diffusion models, three RL algorithms, nine reward MLLM backbones from four MLLM families spanning 4B to 235B parameters, and five out-of-distribution text-to-image benchmarks. Results show that both SpectraReward and Self-SpectraReward significantly and consistently improve generation performance and outperform prior MLLM-derived reward training methods. Further analysis reveals that larger reward MLLMs are not always better, while Self-SpectraReward can match or surpass much larger external reward models, suggesting that reward-policy alignment is a key factor for effective image-generation RL. Project Page: https://huangrh99.github.io/SpectraReward/

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出SpectraReward，一种免训练的奖励函数，可将预训练多模态大语言模型（MLLM）直接转化为图像生成强化学习的现成奖励模型。不同于要求MLLM评判生成图像或回答分解的验证问题，SpectraReward通过单次图像条件教师强制前向传播，衡量原始提示能从生成图像中恢复的程度。我们使用平均图像条件提示对数似然作为奖励，直接复用MLLM的预训练图像-文本对齐能力，无需偏好标签或奖励模型微调。我们进一步引入Self-SpectraReward，这是统一多模态模型的一个特例，其中策略模型自身的理解分支作为其生成分支的奖励模型，形成了一个无需外部奖励模型或外部知识的闭环自改进框架。大量实验通过一个广泛的图像生成强化学习研究验证了SpectraReward，涵盖两种扩散模型、三种RL算法、来自四个MLLM家族（参数规模从4B到235B）的九种奖励MLLM骨干，以及五个分布外文生图基准。结果表明，SpectraReward和Self-SpectraReward均能显著且一致地提升生成性能，并优于先前的MLLM衍生奖励训练方法。进一步分析揭示，更大的奖励MLLM并不总是更好，而Self-SpectraReward可以匹敌或超越规模大得多的外部奖励模型，这表明奖励-策略对齐是有效图像生成强化学习的关键因素。项目页面：https://huangrh99.github.io/SpectraReward/

</details>
