### [189] [ECG-LDC: A Hardware-Efficient Low-Dimensional Computing Framework for ECG Arrhythmia Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09680)
*Anh Tran,Khanh Tran,Cuong Do*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出ECG-LDC，一种面向可穿戴设备实时ECG心律失常分类的软硬件协同设计框架，通过低维计算（LDC）和双编码器架构，在极低内存占用（3.86 kB）下实现97.18%的准确率，相较SOTA TinyML分类器内存减少11~570倍，且不消耗DSP资源。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有深度神经网络模型在ECG心律失常检测中准确率高，但参数量大且依赖乘加密集型运算，难以部署在资源受限的低成本边缘平台（如可穿戴设备）上。

Method: 提出ECG-LDC软硬件协同设计框架，采用双编码器架构：值编码器与特征编码器分别独立编码形态波形特征和RR间期时序特征，捕获心拍内与心拍间的心跳动态；使用二进制表示和XOR/XNOR运算替代传统乘加操作；在Pynq-Z2平台上原型化了硬件加速器。

Result: ECG-LDC达到97.18%准确率，内存占用仅3.86 kB；相比SOTA TinyML分类器准确率仅低约1.8%，但内存减少11~570倍；在基于FPGA的五分类心律失常分类器中准确率最高，LUT减少最多达2.4倍，且零DSP资源消耗。

Conclusion: ECG-LDC证明了低维计算与软硬件协同设计是实现资源受限可穿戴平台上实时心律失常检测的有效途径，兼顾了高准确率与极低资源开销。

Original Abstract: Continuous cardiac monitoring in wearable devices demands classifiers that are simultaneously accurate, energy-efficient, and deployable on resource-constrained hardware. While deep neural network approaches have demonstrated high classification accuracy for electrocardiogram (ECG) arrhythmia detection, their substantial parameter counts and reliance on multiply-accumulate-intensive operations make them impractical for low-cost edge platforms. In this work, we propose ECG-LDC, a hardware-software co-design framework that adapts Low-Dimensional Computing (LDC) for real-time ECG arrhythmia classification. ECG-LDC employs a dual-encoder architecture with dedicated value and feature codebooks to independently encode morphological waveform features and RR-interval temporal features, enabling effective capture of both intra-beat and inter-beat cardiac dynamics. The framework encompasses data preprocessing, model training, and a hardware accelerator architecture prototyped on the Pynq-Z2 platform. Implemented using binary representations and XOR/XNOR-based operations, ECG-LDC achieves $97.18\%$ accuracy with a memory footprint of only $3.86\ \text{kB}$. ECG-LDC sacrifices approximately $1.8\%$ accuracy versus SOTA TinyML classifiers but achieves $11$~$ 570\times$ reduction in memory usage; among FPGA-based five-class arrhythmia classifiers, it delivers the highest accuracy with up to $2.4\times$ fewer LUTs and zero DSP block utilization, affirming its suitability for real-time arrhythmia detection on resource-constrained wearable platforms.

中文摘要翻译: 可穿戴设备的连续心脏监测要求分类器同时具备高准确率、高能效以及可在资源受限硬件上部署的特性。虽然深度神经网络方法在心电图（ECG）心律失常检测中表现出较高的分类准确率，但其庞大的参数数量和对乘加密集型操作的依赖使其难以应用于低成本的边缘平台。本文提出ECG-LDC，一种面向实时ECG心律失常分类的软硬件协同设计框架，将低维计算（Low-Dimensional Computing, LDC）适配于该任务。ECG-LDC采用双编码器架构，配备专用的值编码器和特征编码器，分别独立编码形态学波形特征和RR间期时序特征，从而有效捕获心拍内与心拍间的心脏动态信息。该框架涵盖数据预处理、模型训练以及在Pynq-Z2平台上原型实现的硬件加速器架构。ECG-LDC采用二进制表示和基于XOR/XNOR的运算实现，在仅3.86 kB的内存占用下达到97.18%的准确率。相较于SOTA TinyML分类器，ECG-LDC的准确率降低约1.8%，但内存使用量减少了11~570倍；在基于FPGA的五分类心律失常分类器中，ECG-LDC实现了最高准确率，且LUT使用量最多减少2.4倍，零DSP模块消耗，证实了其适用于资源受限可穿戴平台上的实时心律失常检测。

</details>


### [190] [Tensor-Based Modal Decomposition and Sparse Sensor Placement for the Brugge Field Simulation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09687)
*D. Samatov,B. Merzlikin,G. Shishaev*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于四维张量模态分解（TBMD）和稀疏重构的框架，用于从少量观测数据中重建油藏压力-饱和度耦合场。在Brugge基准测试中，随着监测井数量从1口增加到20口，重构误差显著降低，结构相似性大幅提升，验证了张量结构化稀疏重构的可行性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 油藏压力和饱和度的稀疏监测需要既能保留网格化结构、又能从少量观测中重建完整场的数值方法，现有方法在这方面的能力有限。

Method: 提出四维张量模态分解（TBMD）与稀疏重构框架：使用显式属性模态、模态4的QR分解对网格空间-属性纤维进行排序，以及基于张量压缩感知的网格范围和现有井测量算子。对每个实现独立处理为139×48×2×134的张量，采用80/20时间分割和训练拟合的属性归一化。

Result: 在压力-饱和度联合井测研究中，将监测井从1口增加到10口，相对Frobenius误差从约0.57降至0.20，结构相似性指数从约0.47升至0.88，峰值信噪比从约33.8升至37 dB。当井数达20口时，相对误差降至约0.11。

Conclusion: 张量结构化稀疏重构方法能够有效实现耦合油藏场的重建，为与替代的降阶方法和稀疏感知方法进行控制性比较提供了基础。

Original Abstract: Sparse monitoring of reservoir pressure and saturation requires numerical methods that retain gridded structure while reconstructing full fields from few observations. We present a four-dimensional tensor-based modal decomposition (TBMD) and sparse reconstruction framework for coupled pressure-saturation fields. The approach uses an explicit property mode, mode-4 pivoted orthogonal-triangular (QR) ranking of grid-wide spatial-property fibers, and tensor-based compressive sensing for both grid-wide and existing-well measurement operators. The Brugge benchmark is evaluated using 10 well-control realizations with fixed geology. Each realization is processed independently as a tensor of size 139 x 48 x 2 x 134 under an 80/20 temporal split with training-fitted property-wise min-max normalization. In the joint pressure-saturation well-only study, increasing the number of instrumented wells from 1 to 10 reduces the relative Frobenius error from about 0.57 to 0.20, increases the Structural Similarity Index Measure from about 0.47 to 0.88, and raises the peak signal-to-noise ratio from about 33.8 to 37 dB. By 20 wells, the relative error drops to about 0.11. The results support the feasibility of tensor-structured sparse reconstruction for coupled reservoir fields and provide a basis for controlled comparisons with alternative reduced-order and sparse-sensing methods.

中文摘要翻译: 油藏压力和饱和度的稀疏监测需要既能保留网格化结构、又能从少量观测中重建完整场的数值方法。我们提出了一种用于压力-饱和度耦合场的四维张量模态分解（TBMD）与稀疏重构框架。该方法使用显式属性模态、模态4的主元三角（QR）分解对网格范围的空间-属性纤维进行排序，以及基于张量压缩感知的网格范围和现有井测量算子。采用10个具有固定地质特征的井控实现评估Brugge基准。每个实现独立处理为大小为139×48×2×134的张量，采用80/20时间分割，并应用训练拟合的属性最小-最大归一化。在联合压力-饱和度的纯井测研究中，将监测井数量从1口增加到10口，相对Frobenius误差从约0.57降至0.20，结构相似性指数从约0.47升至0.88，峰值信噪比从约33.8 dB增至37 dB。当井数达到20口时，相对误差降至约0.11。结果支持了张量结构化稀疏重构用于耦合油藏场的可行性，并为与替代的降阶方法和稀疏感知方法进行控制性比较提供了基础。

</details>


### [191] [SpindleFlexNet: Flexible sleep spindles detection for EEG signals based on an adaptive one-dimensional RetinaNet-based framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09690)
*Shao-Jun Xia,Jing Bao,Anlan Sun,Xiaoyang Chen,Hongjia Liu,Xiao-Ting Li,Ying-Shi Sun*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出SpindleFlexNet，首个将深度学习一维目标检测框架（基于RetinaNet）应用于睡眠纺锤波检测的方法，通过锚点生成、匹配、回归和一维损失函数，在公开数据集上取得良好性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 睡眠纺锤波在脑电信号中幅度低、信噪比小，现有检测方法难以精确捕捉其起止点，且缺乏处理多纺锤波场景的灵活性。

Method: SpindleFlexNet基于改进的一维RetinaNet架构，包含一维锚点生成、匹配与回归机制，以及定制的一维损失函数，用于实现端到端的纺锤波目标检测。

Result: 在两个公共数据集（MASS和DREAMS）上，五折交叉验证平均召回率、精确率和F1分数分别为0.61、0.76、0.67和0.58、0.80、0.67，模型检测稳定且泛化良好。

Conclusion: SpindleFlexNet为睡眠研究提供了实用的纺锤波自动检测工具，可应用于临床自动标注及结合fMRI的脑电联合研究。

Original Abstract: Sleep spindle is a physiologically significant biomedical signal in electroencephalographic (EEG) waveforms, which is typically a low-amplitude event in sleep. Due to the small signal ratio in the overall EEG, previous detection methods have limited capability to capture its start and end points and lack flexibility in handling multi-spindle scenarios. To address the gap, we address the problem from a new perspective and introduce SpindleFlexNet, the first framework in this field to apply deep learning-based one-dimensional object detection, leveraging an adapted one-dimensional RetinaNet architecture. The framework employs one-dimensional anchor generation, matching, and regression, along with a customized one-dimensional loss function. Analyses were conducted on two public datasets: the Montreal Archive of Sleep Studies and DREAMS, from which a total of 11,061 and 335 segments were obtained, respectively. When trained on these datasets, SpindleFlexNet achieved an average recall, precision, and F1-score of 0.61, 0.76, 0.67, and 0.58, 0.80, 0.67 in five-fold cross-validation. The model demonstrates stable detection performance and good generalization, making it a practical tool for sleep research. Potential applications include automated spindle labeling in clinical settings and as a reference for studies combining EEG with simultaneous functional magnetic resonance imaging.

中文摘要翻译: 睡眠纺锤波是脑电图波形中具有重要生理意义的生物医学信号，在睡眠中通常表现为低振幅事件。由于其在整体脑电信号中占比很小，以往的检测方法捕捉其起止点的能力有限，且在应对多纺锤波场景时缺乏灵活性。为弥补这一不足，我们从新的视角出发，提出了SpindleFlexNet——该领域首个应用基于深度学习的一维目标检测框架，采用适配后的一维RetinaNet架构。该框架包含一维锚点生成、匹配与回归机制，以及定制的一维损失函数。我们在两个公开数据集上进行了分析：蒙特利尔睡眠研究档案和DREAMS数据集，分别获取了11,061个和335个片段。在这些数据集上训练后，SpindleFlexNet在五折交叉验证中的平均召回率、精确率和F1分数分别达到0.61、0.76、0.67和0.58、0.80、0.67。该模型展现出稳定的检测性能和良好的泛化能力，是睡眠研究的实用工具。其潜在应用包括临床场景中的自动纺锤波标注，以及作为结合脑电图与同步功能磁共振成像研究的参考。

</details>


### [192] [Track-Consistency-Based GNSS RFI Monitoring Using Crowdsourced ADS-B Sensor Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09700)
*Sanghyeon Park,Halim Lee,Pyo-Woong Son*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于众包ADS-B接收机网络的三阶段框架，通过轨迹一致性验证而非传统质量指标来监测GNSS射频干扰，在东亚地区验证了其有效性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: GNSS射频干扰事件日益增多，亟需大规模广域感知能力，而现有的ADS-B质量指标在异常位置报告行为中可能仍然偏高，且异构接收机时间戳会产生虚假速度尖峰，因此需要更可靠的监测方法。

Method: 提出三阶段框架：第一阶段筛选位置跳变候选；第二阶段验证局部轨迹一致性以抑制时间戳伪影；第三阶段将确认的异常聚合成交通自适应的多飞行器事件集群。

Result: 基于2025年12月至2026年2月东北亚地区6.05亿条1090-MHz ADS-B报告，该框架在NOTAM有效窗口内识别出166个事件集群，而在NOTAM发布前未检测到任何事件。超过99%的确认异常仍处于高质量指标区间。

Conclusion: 轨迹一致性验证为GNSS射频干扰监测提供了一种互补的感知准则，能够弥补传统质量指标的不足。

Original Abstract: Growing reports of global navigation satellite system (GNSS) radio-frequency interference (RFI) highlight the need for scalable wide-area sensing for situational awareness. Crowdsourced Automatic Dependent Surveillance-Broadcast (ADS-B) receiver networks form a large-scale opportunistic sensor network for GNSS RFI monitoring, but ADS-B quality indicators may remain high during abnormal reported-position behavior, and heterogeneous receiver timestamping can produce apparent speed spikes. This letter proposes a three-stage framework that screens position-jump candidates, verifies local track consistency to suppress timing artifacts, and groups confirmed anomalies into traffic-adaptive multi-aircraft events. Using 605 million 1090-MHz ADS-B reports over Northeast Asia from December 2025 to February 2026, the framework identified 166 event clusters within the validity window of Notice to Airmen (NOTAM) RKRR Z1401/25 and none in the pre-NOTAM period. More than 99% of confirmed anomalies remained in high quality-indicator regimes, suggesting that track-consistency verification provides a complementary sensing criterion for GNSS RFI monitoring.

中文摘要翻译: 全球导航卫星系统（GNSS）射频干扰（RFI）事件的日益增多凸显了对可扩展广域态势感知能力的需求。众包自动相关监视广播（ADS-B）接收机网络构成了用于GNSS射频干扰监测的大规模机会传感器网络，但在异常报告位置行为期间，ADS-B质量指标可能仍然偏高，且异构接收机时间戳会产生表观速度尖峰。本文提出了一种三阶段框架：筛选位置跳变候选，验证局部轨迹一致性以抑制时间戳伪影，并将确认的异常聚合成交通自适应的多飞行器事件集群。利用2025年12月至2026年2月东北亚地区6.05亿条1090-MHz ADS-B报告，该框架在航行通告（NOTAM）RKRR Z1401/25的有效窗口内识别出166个事件集群，而在NOTAM发布前未检测到任何事件。超过99%的确认异常仍处于高质量指标区间，表明轨迹一致性验证为GNSS射频干扰监测提供了一种互补的感知准则。

</details>


### [193] [The Universal Language of CSI:Unifying Wireless Sensing Across Devices and Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09727)
*Jiayi Chen,Weiting Ou,Guangxu Zhu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于基础模型的WiFi感知框架WiLLM，将CSI视为一种结构化语言，通过学习通用语法来桥接不同硬件、环境和任务之间的异构性鸿沟，实现跨系统通用的无线感知。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前WiFi感知研究碎片化严重，模型针对特定硬件、固定环境和窄任务设计，主要瓶颈是异构性鸿沟——信号维度、采样率和语义标签的差异阻碍了跨系统理解。

Method: 首先构建并标准化大规模异构真实CSI数据集作为统一语料库；其次设计模块化架构，包含轻量级数据集特定适配器（将不同信号输入分词化为共享潜在词汇）和共享的自监督Transformer骨干（学习人体运动与环境动态的时间语法），将感知语义与硬件语法解耦。

Result: 在跨环境泛化、少样本场景下一致优于任务特定基线模型，展现强泛化能力和高效性。

Conclusion: 通过有效吸收异构性，该框架为实现鲁棒、通用的无线感知提供了可行路径，类似大语言模型中的语言泛化能力。

Original Abstract: WiFi sensing based on Channel State Information (CSI) promises ubiquitous, device-free perception, yet current research remains trapped in a Tower of Babel - fragmented into isolated silos where models are tailored to specific hardware dialects, fixed environments, and narrow tasks. The primary bottleneck is the Heterogeneity Gap: the disparity in signal dimensions, sampling rates, and semantic labels that prevents cross-system understanding. To bridge this gap, we propose a foundation-model framework that treats CSI not merely as raw signals but as a structured language with a learnable universal grammar. We first curate and standardize a large collection of heterogeneous real-world CSI datasets, establishing a unified infrastructure that allows incompatible signal formats to be treated as a single corpus. Second, we introduce a modular architecture that acts as a universal translator where lightweight dataset-specific adapters tokenize diverse signal inputs into a shared latent vocabulary, while a shared self-supervised Transformer backbone learns the temporal syntax of human motion and environmental dynamics. This design decouples sensing semantics from hardware syntax. Extensive evaluations show that by mastering this universal language, our approach consistently outperforms task-specific baselines and exhibits strong generalization capability in new environments, achieving superior efficiency in few-shot scenarios. By effectively absorbing heterogeneity, the framework offers a path toward robust, general-purpose wireless sensing, mirroring the linguistic generalization observed in Large Language Models. The code implementation is available at: https://github.com/cjychenjiayi/WiLLM.

中文摘要翻译: 基于信道状态信息（CSI）的WiFi感知有望实现无处不在、无需设备接触的感知能力，然而当前研究仍困于“巴别塔”之中——碎片化为相互隔离的孤岛，模型被裁剪以适应特定的硬件方言、固定环境和狭窄任务。其主要瓶颈在于异构性鸿沟：信号维度、采样率和语义标签的差异阻碍了跨系统的理解。为弥合这一鸿沟，我们提出一个基础模型框架，将CSI不仅视为原始信号，更视为一种具有可学习通用语法的结构化语言。我们首先整理并标准化大规模异构真实世界CSI数据集，建立统一的基础设施，使不兼容的信号格式能被当作单一语料库处理。其次，我们引入一种模块化架构，充当通用翻译器：轻量级数据集特定适配器将多样的信号输入分词化为共享的潜在词汇表，而共享的自监督Transformer骨干则学习人体运动和环境动态的时间语法。该设计将感知语义与硬件语法解耦。大量评估表明，通过掌握这种通用语言，我们的方法一致优于任务特定基线模型，并在新环境中展现出强大的泛化能力，在少样本场景下实现卓越的效率。通过有效吸收异构性，该框架为实现鲁棒、通用的无线感知提供了一条路径，镜像了大语言模型中观察到的语言泛化能力。代码实现见：https://github.com/cjychenjiayi/WiLLM。

</details>


### [194] [Multimodal EEG-IMU Fusion for Motor Assessment: Leveraging Task-Dependent Complementarity for Robustness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09730)
*Zhenan Yin,Lalitha Pranathi Pulavarthy,Saptarshi Purkayastha*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出了一项概念验证研究，通过同步EEG-IMU数据（6名参与者、52组记录）评估十种运动任务中单模态（EEG、IMU）与晚期融合多模态方案的性能。IMU在7/10任务中表现更优（94.41%），EEG在节律性踩踏任务中误差更低（4.03% vs 12.10%），逻辑回归晚期融合达到98.68%准确率，错误率较EEG单独降低81.5%，最差任务准确率从~87%提升至96.76%，跨任务性能方差从~3%降至1.06%。结果表明EEG与IMU具有不对称、任务依赖的互补优势，融合可提升评估可靠性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 帕金森病等运动障碍疾病需要全面的运动评估，但目前缺乏可靠的多模态数字评估流程，该流程需整合多种传感模态并覆盖多样化的运动任务，且其特性尚未被充分刻画。

Method: 在六名参与者（共52个EEG-IMU同步记录对）中采集十种运动活动的数据。EEG（125 Hz，16通道）采用EEGNet+Transformer模型，IMU（25 Hz）基于手工提取的加速度计和陀螺仪特征使用XGBoost分类器。采用五折交叉验证（受试者依赖设置），并通过逻辑回归进行晚期融合。

Result: IMU准确率94.41±0.58%，在10项活动中7项优于EEG；EEG准确率92.82±1.45%，在节律性踩踏任务中误差更低（4.03% vs 12.10%）。晚期融合达98.68±0.32%，错误率较EEG单独降低81.5%，最差任务准确率从约87%提升至96.76%，跨任务性能方差从约3%降至1.06%（配对t检验，p<0.001）。

Conclusion: EEG和IMU具有非对称的、任务依赖的互补优势，晚期融合可利用这种互补性提高运动评估的可靠性。尽管样本量小限制了泛化性，但本研究为在运动障碍人群中开展更大规模临床验证提供了方法和实证动机。

Original Abstract: Movement disorders such as Parkinson's disease require comprehensive motor assessment, but reliable digital assessment pipelines integrating multiple sensing modalities across diverse motor tasks remain insufficiently characterized. We present a proof-of-concept study evaluating task-specific modality performance and multimodal fusion across ten motor activities. Synchronized EEG-IMU data were recorded from six participants (52 recording pairs). We evaluated an EEGNet + Transformer model for 16-channel EEG (125 Hz) and XGBoost on hand-crafted accelerometer and gyroscope features (25 Hz). Under 5-fold cross-validation in a subject-dependent setting, IMU achieved 94.41+/-0.58% accuracy and outperformed EEG on 7 of 10 activities, while EEG achieved 92.82+/-1.45% and showed lower error for rhythmic cycling (4.03% vs. 12.10%). Late fusion via logistic regression reached 98.68+/-0.32%, giving an 81.5% error reduction versus EEG alone and improving worst-task accuracy from approximately 87% for a single modality to 96.76%. Fusion also reduced cross-task performance variance from approximately 3% to 1.06% (paired t-test, p < 0.001, df = 4; p-values approximate given fold dependence), showing more uniform reliability across the assessment battery. Although the small sample limits generalizability, these results suggest that EEG and IMU provide asymmetric, task-dependent strengths and that late fusion can leverage this complementarity to improve assessment reliability. This study provides methodological and empirical motivation for larger-scale clinical validation in movement disorder populations.

中文摘要翻译: 帕金森病等运动障碍疾病需要全面的运动评估，但整合多种传感模态并覆盖多样化运动任务的可靠数字化评估流程仍未被充分刻画。我们提出了一项概念验证研究，评估了十种运动活动中任务特定的模态性能及多模态融合效果。我们从六名参与者（52组记录对）中采集了同步EEG-IMU数据。我们评估了基于EEGNet+Transformer的16通道EEG（125 Hz）模型以及基于手工提取的加速度计和陀螺仪特征（25 Hz）的XGBoost模型。在受试者依赖的五折交叉验证设置下，IMU达到了94.41±0.58%的准确率，在10项活动中有7项优于EEG，而EEG达到了92.82±1.45%的准确率，在节律性踩踏任务中表现出更低的误差（4.03% vs 12.10%）。通过逻辑回归进行的晚期融合达到了98.68±0.32%，较单独EEG实现了81.5%的错误率降低，并将最差任务的准确率从单模态的约87%提升至96.76%。融合还将跨任务性能方差从约3%降低至1.06%（配对t检验，p<0.001，df=4；由于折数依赖，p值为近似值），表明在评估组合中具有更均匀的可靠性。尽管小样本限制了泛化性，但这些结果表明EEG和IMU具有非对称的、任务依赖的互补优势，且晚期融合可以利用这种互补性来提高评估可靠性。本研究为在运动障碍人群中开展更大规模的临床验证提供了方法和实证动机。

</details>


### [195] [MorphologyFM: A Foundation Model for Morphology-Aware Representation Learning from ECG and Pulse Oximetry Waveforms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09749)
*Saiyang Feng,Yuanyun Zhang,Shi Li*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出MorphologyFM，一种多模态基础模型，在ECG和SpO2波形上使用形态学感知的自监督学习进行预训练，通过形态学引导掩码、跨模态表示学习和对比潜在对齐来捕捉临床相关的生理结构，在心律失常分类、低氧血症预测、死亡预测和住院时长估计等任务上优于MAE、对比学习、Barlow Twins和JEPA等代表性方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有生理波形基础模型主要优化重建或预测目标，未能显式保留临床上有意义的波形形态学信息，而ECG和SpO2波形的形态结构蕴含丰富的心血管和血流动力学信息，因此需要一种能够直接捕捉形态学信息的自监督学习方法。

Method: 提出MorphologyFM，采用形态学感知的自监督学习目标，结合三种关键技术：(1) 形态学引导掩码（Morphology Guided Masking），(2) 跨模态表示学习（Cross Modal Representation Learning），(3) 对比潜在对齐（Contrastive Latent Alignment），在MIMIC重症监护数据库的配对ECG和SpO2波形上进行多模态预训练。

Result: 在心律失常分类、低氧血症预测、死亡预测和住院时长估计等下游任务中，MorphologyFM一致优于MAE、对比学习、Barlow Twins和JEPA等代表性子监督学习方法；联合建模ECG和SpO2波形比单一模态预训练产生更具迁移性的表示。

Conclusion: 波形形态学可以作为自监督生理表示学习的有力归纳偏置，MorphologyFM可作为连续生理监测的通用基础模型。

Original Abstract: Foundation models have recently emerged as a powerful paradigm for learning transferable representations from large scale biomedical data, yet existing approaches for physiological waveforms primarily optimize reconstruction or forecasting objectives that do not explicitly preserve clinically meaningful waveform morphology. Electrocardiograms (ECGs) and pulse oximetry (SpO2) waveforms encode rich cardiovascular and hemodynamic information through their morphological structure. In this work, we introduce MorphologyFM, a multimodal foundation model pretrained on paired ECG and SpO2 waveforms from the MIMIC critical care database using a morphology aware self supervised learning objective. MorphologyFM combines morphology guided masking, cross modal representation learning, and contrastive latent alignment to learn representations that capture clinically relevant physiological structure without requiring manual annotations. We evaluate MorphologyFM across multiple downstream prediction tasks, including arrhythmia classification, hypoxemia prediction, mortality prediction, and length of stay estimation, demonstrating consistent improvements over representative self supervised learning methods, including Masked Autoencoders (MAE), contrastive learning, Barlow Twins, and Joint Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPA). Furthermore, we show that jointly modeling ECG and SpO2 waveforms produces more transferable representations than single modality pretraining. Our results establish waveform morphology as a powerful inductive bias for self supervised physiological representation learning and introduce MorphologyFM as a general purpose foundation model for continuous physiological monitoring.

中文摘要翻译: 基础模型最近已成为从大规模生物医学数据中学习可迁移表示的有力范式，但现有的生理波形方法主要优化重建或预测目标，未能显式保留临床上有意义的波形形态学信息。心电图（ECG）和脉搏血氧饱和度（SpO2）波形通过其形态学结构编码了丰富的心血管和血流动力学信息。在这项工作中，我们提出了MorphologyFM，一种多模态基础模型，在MIMIC重症监护数据库的配对ECG和SpO2波形上，使用形态学感知的自监督学习目标进行预训练。MorphologyFM结合了形态学引导掩码、跨模态表示学习和对比潜在对齐，以学习捕捉临床相关生理结构的表示，而无需人工标注。我们在多个下游预测任务上评估MorphologyFM，包括心律失常分类、低氧血症预测、死亡预测和住院时长估计，结果表明其一致优于代表性的自监督学习方法，包括掩码自编码器（MAE）、对比学习、Barlow Twins和联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）。此外，我们证明联合建模ECG和SpO2波形比单一模态预训练产生更具迁移性的表示。我们的结果确立了波形形态学作为自监督生理表示学习的有力归纳偏置，并将MorphologyFM作为连续生理监测的通用基础模型。

</details>


### [196] [Data-Driven Forward and Inverse Modeling of V-Beam Thermal Sensors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09752)
*Tudor Bartha,Radu Chiorean,Adrian Groza*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出了一种用于V型梁热传感器逆向设计的机器学习框架，通过两阶段方法（前向神经网络+梯度下降逆优化）在满足目标位移的同时最小化结构体积和机械应力，MAPE达4.76%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 热传感器的逆向设计问题是不适定的——给定目标位移存在多种可能的几何配置，直接回归方法无法解决。需要一种能够处理多解性并同时优化体积和应力的设计方法。

Method: 两阶段方法：第一阶段训练一个前向神经网络模型，将几何参数和材料常数映射到传感器响应（位移）；第二阶段冻结前向模型，在满足目标位移的约束下，通过梯度下降逆向优化几何参数，同时最小化结构体积和机械应力。

Result: 使用3000样本数据集，位移预测MAPE为4.76%，超过70%的预测MAPE低于5%。

Conclusion: 所提出的两阶段机器学习框架能够有效解决V型梁热传感器逆向设计的不适定问题，在保证预测精度的同时实现了结构体积和应力的联合优化。

Original Abstract: This paper presents a machine learning framework for data-driven inverse design of V-beam thermal sensors. The goal is to determine the optimal sensor geometry: beam inclination angle, beam length and beam width that achieves a target displacement under a given temperature. The design should also provide the geometry with minimum structure volume and minimum mechanical stress the sensor must support. This problem is ill-posed as for a given displacement there are multiple possible geometric configurations, causing direct regression methods to fail. We document a series of five exploratory trials that progressively revealed the nature of the problem culminating in a two-phase solution: a neural network forward model trained to map geometry and material constants to sensor responses, a gradient-descent inverse optimization over the frozen forward model, minimizing stress and volume simultaneously. The proposed pipeline utilizes a 3000-sample dataset and achieves a MAPE of 4.76% for predicting the displacement, more than 70% of predictions having MAPE of under 5%.

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出了一种用于V型梁热传感器数据驱动逆向设计的机器学习框架。目标是确定最优传感器几何参数——梁倾角、梁长度和梁宽度——使得在给定温度下达到目标位移。该设计还需提供最小结构体积和最小机械应力的几何构型。该问题是不适定的，因为对于给定的位移存在多种可能的几何配置，导致直接回归方法失效。我们记录了五个探索性试验，逐步揭示了问题本质，最终形成一个两阶段解决方案：训练一个前向神经网络模型将几何参数和材料常数映射到传感器响应，然后冻结前向模型，通过梯度下降逆向优化，同时最小化应力和体积。所提出的方法使用3000样本数据集，位移预测的平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)达到4.76%，超过70%的预测MAPE低于5%。

</details>


### [197] [Physics-Informed Structure Anchoring With Capture-Aware Prototype Calibration for Cross-Environment RF Fingerprinting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09760)
*Fengchong Yao,Jianbing Li,Qing Liu,Qikun Liu,Kefeng Song,Haitao Li,Song Wang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出PISA-CAPC框架，通过拓扑结构锚定、CFO驱动的上下文残差抑制和无标签捕获感知原型校准，解决多天线RFFI在跨环境部署中的性能退化问题，在实测十发射器WiFi数据集上达到0.9257 Macro-F1。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 深度RFFI模型在采集环境变化时性能严重退化，而多天线接收场景中这种退化不仅来自通用分布偏移，还受到接收阵列拓扑、频偏动态和目标结构的影响，现有方法无法有效解耦这些因素。

Method: 提出PISA-CAPC框架：1) 利用拓扑图组织天线令牌并用CFO衍生描述符调制；2) 在身份表示周围施加带上下文的残差抑制；3) 部署时采用无标签捕获感知原型校准(U-CAPC)，在固定骨架下通过捕获局部原型证据校准决策分数。

Result: 在实测十发射器多天线WiFi基准上，平衡直推设置下目标域平均Macro-F1达到0.9257，消融实验证实各模块贡献互补增益。

Conclusion: PISA-CAPC建立了跨环境RFFI的固定骨架路径，将物理驱动的表示学习与无标签、捕获感知的决策校准有效结合，无需目标域骨架更新或标签即可缓解边界偏移。

Original Abstract: Radio frequency fingerprint identification (RFFI) uses transmitter-specific hardware imperfections as a physicallayer identity cue for Internet of Things (IoT) devices, but deep RFFI models often degrade when the acquisition environment changes. In multi-antenna reception, this degradation is not merely a generic distribution shift. It is also shaped by receiver-array topology, frequency-offset dynamics, and capturedependent target structure, which can distort embeddings and move source-trained decision boundaries. This article proposes physics-informed structure anchoring with capture-aware prototype calibration (PISA-CAPC), a framework that separates source representation anchoring from fixed-backbone target calibration. The representation stage organizes antenna tokens with a topology graph and modulates the graph using CFO-derived acquisition-dynamics descriptors. Bounded contextual residual suppression is then applied around the identity representation. At deployment, unlabeled capture-aware prototype calibration (U-CAPC) calibrates target decision scores through capturelocal prototype evidence under a fixed representation, mitigating boundary shift without requiring target-domain backbone updates or target labels. On a measured ten-transmitter multiantenna WiFi benchmark, PISA-CAPC achieves 0.9257 targetdomain mean Macro-F1 under a balanced transductive setting. Ablations confirm that topology-guided structure anchoring, contextual residual suppression, and capture-aware calibration contribute complementary gains. These results establish PISACAPC as a fixed-backbone route to cross-environment RFFI, coupling physically motivated representation learning with labelfree, capture-aware decision calibration.

中文摘要翻译: 射频指纹识别（RFFI）利用发射器特有的硬件缺陷作为物联网（IoT）设备的物理层身份标识，但深度RFFI模型在采集环境变化时性能往往下降。在多天线接收场景中，这种退化不仅仅是普通的分布偏移，还受到接收阵列拓扑结构、频偏动态以及捕获相关的目标结构的影响，这些因素会扭曲嵌入表示并移动源域训练得到的决策边界。本文提出了一种物理信息引导的结构锚定与捕获感知原型校准（PISA-CAPC）框架，将源域表示锚定与固定骨架的目标域校准分离。表示阶段利用拓扑图组织天线令牌，并使用基于CFO的采集动态描述符对图进行调制，随后在身份表示周围施加带上下文的残差抑制。部署时，无标签的捕获感知原型校准（U-CAPC）在固定表示下通过捕获局部的原型证据校准目标域决策分数，无需目标域骨架更新或目标标签即可缓解边界偏移。在一个实测的十发射器多天线WiFi基准测试中，PISA-CAPC在平衡直推设置下达到了0.9257的目标域平均Macro-F1。消融实验证实，拓扑引导的结构锚定、上下文残差抑制和捕获感知校准贡献了互补的性能提升。这些结果表明，PISA-CAPC建立了一条跨环境RFFI的固定骨架路径，将物理驱动的表示学习与无标签、捕获感知的决策校准相结合。

</details>


### [198] [Listen to the Features: Voice Anonymization Driven by Content Embedding Matching over Signal Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09767)
*Adrien Schneider,Kacper Zabkowski,Anderson Augusma,Frédérique Letué,Maria Camila Pinzon,Dominique Vaufreydaz*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于内容嵌入的语音匿名化模型，通过冻结的wav2vec2编码器提取内容嵌入，结合向量量化与HiFi-GAN声码器实现匿名化，无需波形重建损失或说话人嵌入映射，在保持低词错误率（WER 2.53）的同时实现高匿名化性能（EER 13.39），并部分保留情感信息（UAR 43.91）。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统语音匿名化方法往往以生成逼真语音为目标，可能牺牲内容保留。本文旨在实现一种专注于保留语音内容而非生成真实感语音的匿名化模型，同时有效去除说话人身份信息。

Method: 使用冻结的预训练wav2vec2编码器提取内容嵌入，通过向量量化（VQ）和HiFi-GAN声码器将嵌入解码为匿名化信号，训练目标迫使匿名化信号的嵌入与原始信号匹配，并引入带梯度反转层（GRL）的辅助说话人分类分支以丢弃说话人特定信息。

Result: 该方法实现了极低的词错误率（WER 2.53），匿名化性能（等错误率EER 13.39）排名在VPC第一梯队，情感部分保留（UAR 43.91），即使没有支持性训练目标，匿名化语音在没有重建损失的情况下仍可听。

Conclusion: 这种直接的基于嵌入的方法在语音内容保留和说话人身份匿名化之间取得了良好的平衡，同时展现了情感保留的附加能力，表明无需复杂重建损失或说话人嵌入映射即可实现有效的语音匿名化。

Original Abstract: The paper presents a voice anonymization model focusing on preserving content rather than producing realistic speech. It relies on content embeddings extracted from a frozen pretrained wav2vec2 encoder. These embeddings are decoded into an anonymized signal using vector quantization and a HiFi-GAN vocoder, both trained on LibriTTS without any waveform reconstruction loss or speaker embedding mapping. The training objective enforces that embeddings of the anonymized signal match those of the original one. While training, an auxiliary speaker classification branch with a gradient reversal layer is used to discard speakerspecific information. Results show that this straightforward embedding-based approach achieves very low WER (2.53) with an anonymization performance (EER 13.39) ranking within first level for VPC. Notably, emotions are partially preserved (UAR 43.91), even without a supporting training objective, while the anonymized voice is audible without reconstruction loss.

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出了一种专注于保留内容而非生成逼真语音的语音匿名化模型。该模型依赖于从冻结的预训练wav2vec2编码器中提取的内容嵌入。这些嵌入通过向量量化和HiFi-GAN声码器解码为匿名化信号，两者均在LibriTTS上训练，无需任何波形重建损失或说话人嵌入映射。训练目标强制匿名化信号的嵌入与原始信号的嵌入相匹配。训练过程中，使用带有梯度反转层的辅助说话人分类分支来丢弃说话人特定信息。结果表明，这种直接的基于嵌入的方法实现了极低的词错误率（WER 2.53），匿名化性能（等错误率EER 13.39）排名在语音隐私挑战赛（VPC）第一梯队。值得注意的是，即使没有支持性训练目标，情感也被部分保留（UAR 43.91），同时匿名化语音在没有重建损失的情况下仍然可听。

</details>


### [199] [BDFlow-3DRM: Height-Coherent 3D Radio Map Construction via Bi-Dynamical Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09778)
*Jun Yu,Meixia Tao,Shu Sun*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出BDFlow-3DRM，一种基于双向动态流匹配的框架用于三维无线电地图构建，通过语义潜空间中的确定性概率流建模高度感知表示和层间双向依赖，在多个数据集上实现更低的NMSE和大幅降低的推理复杂度，并能在宽高度范围内泛化。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有三维无线电地图构建方法缺乏对高度维度的有效建模，限制了其对未见高度配置的泛化能力，并降低了跨高度层的构建一致性。

Method: 将三维RM构建问题形式化为语义潜空间中的确定性概率流；BDFlow-3DRM从灵活的收发端高度输入中学习连续的高度感知表示，增强几何感知能力；其双向动态设计显式建模相邻高度层间的双向依赖关系，实现不同高度层RM的联合构建。

Result: 在多个简化与真实城市场景数据集上，相比扩散基线方法，NMSE降低28.6%，推理复杂度降低180倍；仅用20个训练接收高度层，即可在1-120m宽连续接收高度范围内保持准确预测。

Conclusion: BDFlow-3DRM通过双向动态流匹配框架有效解决了三维RM构建中高度维度建模不足的问题，在精度、效率和泛化能力上均表现出显著优势，具有大规模三维RM构建的实际应用潜力。

Original Abstract: Three-dimensional (3D) radio map (RM) is a key enabler for environment-aware communications in low-altitude wireless scenarios by providing site-specific channel priors indexed by spatial locations. However, existing 3D RM construction methods lack effective modeling of the height dimension, which limits their generalization to unseen height configurations and degrades construction coherence across height layers. In this paper, we propose BDFlow-3DRM, a bi-dynamical flow matching framework for 3D RM construction. Specifically, the 3D RM construction problem is formulated as a deterministic probability flow in a semantic latent space. BDFlow-3DRM learns continuous height-aware representations from flexible transceiver height inputs, enhancing geometric awareness. Meanwhile, its bi-dynamical design explicitly models bidirectional dependencies across neighboring height layers, so that RMs at different height layers can be constructed jointly. Extensive experiments on multiple datasets, covering diverse simplified and realistic urban scenarios, validate the effectiveness of BDFlow-3DRM. Compared with diffusion-based baselines, it reduces the normalized mean square error (NMSE) by 28.6% and attains a 180-fold reduction in inference complexity. More importantly, with only 20 training receiver-height layers, BDFlow-3DRM maintains accurate prediction over a wide continuous receiver-height range from 1 to 120 m under variable transmitter heights, highlighting its practical potential for large-scale 3D RM construction.

中文摘要翻译: 三维(3D)无线电地图(RM)通过提供由空间位置索引的站点特定信道先验信息，是低空无线场景中环境感知通信的关键使能技术。然而，现有的3D RM构建方法缺乏对高度维度的有效建模，这限制了其对未见高度配置的泛化能力，并降低了跨高度层的构建一致性。本文提出BDFlow-3DRM，一种用于三维RM构建的双向动态流匹配框架。具体地，将3D RM构建问题形式化为语义潜空间中的确定性概率流。BDFlow-3DRM从灵活的收发端高度输入中学习连续的高度感知表示，增强几何感知能力。同时，其双向动态设计显式建模相邻高度层间的双向依赖关系，从而可以联合构建不同高度层的RM。在涵盖多种简化与真实城市场景的多个数据集上进行的大量实验，验证了BDFlow-3DRM的有效性。与基于扩散的基线方法相比，它将归一化均方误差(NMSE)降低了28.6%，并实现了180倍的推理复杂度降低。更重要的是，仅用20个训练接收高度层，BDFlow-3DRM即可在1至120米的宽连续接收高度范围（可变发射机高度下）保持准确预测，突显了其在大规模3D RM构建中的实际应用潜力。

</details>


### [200] [Data-Aided Target Localization in Multistatic ISAC Systems With Communication Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10115)
*Na Zhao,Xiao Shen,Chao Ge,Ziping Lu,Yuan Shen*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种面向多基地ISAC系统的数据辅助目标定位框架，包含统计数据辅助感知与联合数据辅助感知与解码两种接收策略，通过利用数据符号提升感知性能，并联合优化时间分配与发射数据协方差以刻画通感性能边界。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在多基地ISAC系统中，感知接收器无法获取发射数据符号的实时取值，导致通信信号难以直接用于感知。现有方法未能充分利用数据符号中的信息，因此需要设计一种数据辅助框架来弥合这一差距。

Method: 1) 提出两种接收策略：统计数据辅助感知（边缘化未知数据符号）和联合数据辅助感知与解码（将可靠解码的数据符号作为虚拟导频）；2) 在OFDM信令下推导两种策略的目标定位性能极限；3) 构建联合时间分配与发射数据协方差优化问题；4) 设计两种数据辅助目标定位算法，并扩展到有限字母表信令。

Result: 理论分析和仿真验证表明，所提数据辅助方案相较于传统方法能获得显著的感知增益，且联合优化框架有效刻画了通信与感知之间的性能折中边界。

Conclusion: 所提出的数据辅助框架显著提升了多基地ISAC系统的目标定位性能，通过合理利用数据符号实现了通感性能的联合优化。

Original Abstract: Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) enables future wireless networks to perform sensing and communication (S&C) over a shared waveform. In multistatic ISAC systems, however, the sensing receivers do not know the realizations of transmitted data symbols, making it challenging to exploit communication signals for sensing. In this paper, we propose a data-aided framework for target localization with two receiver strategies, namely statistical data-aided sensing and joint data-aided sensing and decoding, where the former marginalizes the random unknown data symbols and the latter reuses the reliably decoded data symbols as known virtual pilots. Under orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signaling, we derive the performance limits for target localization in both strategies and adopt the achievable ergodic data rate as the communication metric. Then, we formulate a joint time-allocation and transmit data-covariance design problem for target localization under communication constraints, which characterizes the joint S&C bound and quantifies the sensing gain provided by data symbols. In addition, we develop two target localization algorithms that implement the proposed data-aided receiver processing, and extend the framework to finite-alphabet signaling. Simulation results validate theoretical analysis and the effectiveness of the proposed data-aided schemes.

中文摘要翻译: 集成感知与通信（ISAC）使得未来无线网络能够通过共享波形同时完成感知与通信（S&C）功能。然而，在多基地ISAC系统中，感知接收器无法获取发射数据符号的实时实现，这使得利用通信信号进行感知面临挑战。本文提出了一种面向目标定位的数据辅助框架，包含两种接收策略：统计数据辅助感知与联合数据辅助感知与解码。前者对随机未知数据符号进行边缘化处理，后者将可靠解码的数据符号复用为已知虚拟导频。在正交频分复用（OFDM）信令下，我们推导了两种策略中目标定位的性能极限，并采用可达遍历数据速率作为通信性能指标。随后，我们构建了面向通信约束下目标定位的联合时间分配与发射数据协方差设计问题，该问题刻画了联合通感性能边界，并量化了数据符号带来的感知增益。此外，我们开发了两种实现所提数据辅助接收处理的目标定位算法，并将框架扩展至有限字母表信令。仿真结果验证了理论分析以及所提数据辅助方案的有效性。

</details>


### [201] [A Closed-Form Noise-Sensitivity Asymmetry for Causal Branch Selection in Minimal-Array TDoA Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10129)
*Abeer Nasir Chaudhry,Salman Liaquat,Hasan Saeed Mir*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种仅利用测量数据解决最小阵列TDoA定位中双根分支选择模糊性的方法，无需增加传感器或角度传感器。通过隐函数微分和闭式分析发现两个根具有相同灵敏度分母，不对称性完全由分子决定，并推导出精确符号条件。物理根（外部根）灵敏度更高，基于此设计了常数内存的选择器，在噪声主导区域实现近0.99的分支选择准确率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 最小阵列（三个平面接收器）是实现TDoA定位最经济、最易部署的无源配置方案，但其固有缺陷是会产生两个可行的目标位置候选根，存在分支选择模糊性。传统解决方案需要增加第四个接收器或角度传感器，这牺牲了最小阵列的经济性和简洁性。本文的动机是仅从测量数据本身解决这一模糊性，保持最小阵列的固有优势。

Method: (1) 隐函数微分分析：证明两个根共享相同的灵敏度分母，因此经典根条件化方法无法区分它们，不对称性完全由分子决定。(2) 闭式分析：推导出不对称性的精确符号条件。(3) 因果常数内存选择器：计算每个根的变异性统计量，其期望值在噪声主导区域与每根灵敏度成正比，选择灵敏度更大的根。(4) 简单外部根规则：基于物理根（外部根）灵敏度更高的发现，直接选择外部根。

Result: (1) 在无维接收器图谱上，物理根在85%的双可行根工作点中灵敏度更高（中位数灵敏度比为16）。(2) 简单外部根规则在内部区域达到近0.99的分支选择准确率。(3) 常数内存实现可在在线环境中匹配该性能。(4) 基于平滑性和连续性的自然消歧方法在时序噪声下会反转并低于随机水平。

Conclusion: 最小阵列TDoA定位固有的分支选择模糊性可以通过分析根的灵敏度特性来解决，无需增加硬件。物理根（外部根）总是灵敏度更高的那个，这一发现使得简单的外部根规则和常数内存选择器能够实现高精度的分支选择。基于平滑性和连续性的方法不可靠，而所提出的基于灵敏度的方法在噪声环境下表现稳健。

Original Abstract: Minimal-array time-difference-of-arrival (TDoA) localization with three planar receivers reduces to a scalar quadratic whose two roots can both be feasible target positions, leaving a branch-selection ambiguity intrinsic to the minimal geometry. Because a minimal array is the cheapest, most deployable passive configuration, this ambiguity is conventionally broken only by adding a fourth receiver or an angle sensor, sacrificing the very minimality that motivates the array. This article resolves it from the measurements alone. Implicit differentiation shows that the two roots share an identical sensitivity denominator, so classical root conditioning cannot separate them and the entire asymmetry resides in the numerator. A closed-form analysis then yields an exact sign condition for the asymmetry, and over the feasible interior the more sensitive root is the outer, physical one, away from two algebraic degeneracy loci. A causal, constant-memory selector smooths a per-root variability statistic, whose expectation is shown to be proportional to the per-root sensitivity in the noise-dominated regime, and selects the larger one. Across a dimensionless receiver atlas the physical root is the more sensitive at a median of 85\% of two-feasible-root operating points (median sensitivity ratio 16), and, because the more sensitive root is the outer one, a simple outer-root rule attains near-0.99 branch-selection accuracy on this interior, matched online by a causal, constant-memory realization. The decisive empirical finding is that smoothness- and continuity-based disambiguation, the natural alternatives, invert under timing noise and fall below chance.

中文摘要翻译: 具有三个平面接收器的最小阵列到达时间差（TDoA）定位可简化为一个标量二次方程，其两个根都可能是可行的目标位置，这导致了最小几何结构固有的分支选择模糊性。由于最小阵列是最经济、最易部署的无源配置方案，传统上仅通过添加第四个接收器或角度传感器来打破这种模糊性，但这牺牲了促使使用最小阵列的"最小性"本身。本文仅从测量数据本身解决了这一问题。隐函数微分表明，两个根共享相同的灵敏度分母，因此经典的根条件化方法无法区分它们，整个不对称性完全存在于分子中。闭式分析随后给出了不对称性的精确符号条件，且在可行内部区域，灵敏度更高的根是外部的、物理的根，远离两个代数退化轨迹。一个因果的、常数内存的选择器平滑每个根的变异性统计量，在噪声主导区域其期望值与每根灵敏度成正比，并选择较大的那个。在无维接收器图谱上，物理根在85%的双可行根工作点中灵敏度更高（中位数灵敏度比为16），并且由于灵敏度更高的根是外部根，一个简单的外部根规则在此内部区域达到近0.99的分支选择准确率，由因果的、常数内存实现在线匹配。决定性的实验发现是，基于平滑性和连续性的消歧（自然的替代方案）会在时序噪声下反转并低于随机水平。

</details>


### [202] [Low-Altitude ISAC With Spherical Directly-Connected Antenna Array: Performance Analysis and Beamforming Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10215)
*Zhiqiang Xiao,Tao Zhang,Zhenjun Dong,Hao Wu,Xiaoqiang Qiao,Jianhua Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文针对低空经济中传统天线阵列3D感知覆盖受限和高仰角角分辨率退化的问题，提出基于球面直连天线阵列（DCAA）的通感一体化（ISAC）系统，并设计了贪心联合阵列选择与波束赋形优化框架，显著提升了感知覆盖、角度估计精度和通信-感知信噪比折中性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 低空经济的安全发展需要鲁棒的低空空域监测，而传统天线阵列存在三维感知覆盖受限、高仰角角度分辨率退化等问题，无法满足低空通感一体化（ISAC）系统的需求。

Method: 采用球面直连天线阵列（DCAA），通过在球面上精心部署多个简单均匀平面阵列（sUPA），无需移相器实现全三维覆盖和均匀角分辨率；并建立最大化最差感知信噪比的优化问题，提出基于贪心的联合阵列选择与波束赋形优化算法进行求解。

Result: 仿真结果表明，球面DCAA在感知覆盖、角度估计精度以及通信-感知信噪比折中方面均显著优于传统均匀平面阵列（UPA）。

Conclusion: 球面DCAA在低空通感一体化（ISAC）系统中具有巨大潜力，可为未来低空经济提供更优的感知与通信性能。

Original Abstract: The safety development requirements of low-altitude economy (LAE) renders the robust low-altitude airspace monitoring critical important than ever before. Integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) as one of the key development trends of 6G provides potential solutions for the LAE. However, conventional antenna arrays suffer from limited three-dimensional (3D) sensing coverage and degraded angular resolution at high elevation angles. To address these challenges, this paper investigates low-altitude ISAC systems enabled by the recently proposed spherical directly-connected antenna array (DCAA). By carefully deploying multiple simple uniform planar arrays (sUPAs) over a spherical surface, without relying on any phase shifter, spherical DCAA enjoys advantages of full 3D coverage, superior and uniform angular resolution, enhanced energy-focusing and low hardware cost. In this paper, we first characterizes the sensing performance of the spherical DCAA, in terms of the sensing signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), area average probability of detection, and Cramér-Rao lower bounds (CRLBs) for both elevation and azimuth angle estimation. Then, a low-altitude ISAC optimization problem is formulated to maximize the worst-case sensing SNR over a prescribed aerial region while satisfying the communication quality-of-service requirements of ground users. To effective solve this mixed-integer non-convex problem, we develop a novel greed-based joint array selection and beamforming optimization framework. Simulation results demonstrate that spherical DCAA significantly outperforms conventional UPA in terms of sensing coverage, angle estimation accuracy, and communication-sensing SNR tradeoff, highlighting its potential for future low-altitude ISAC systems.

中文摘要翻译: 低空经济的安全发展要求使得鲁棒的低空空域监测比以往任何时候都更加重要。作为6G关键发展趋势之一，通感一体化（ISAC）为低空经济提供了潜在解决方案。然而，传统天线阵列存在三维（3D）感知覆盖受限以及高仰角角分辨率退化的问题。针对这些挑战，本文研究了由最新提出的球面直连天线阵列（DCAA）支撑的低空通感一体化系统。通过在球面上精心部署多个简单均匀平面阵列（sUPA），无需依赖任何移相器，球面DCAA具备全三维覆盖、优越且均匀的角分辨率、增强的能量聚焦能力以及较低的硬件成本等优势。本文首先从感知信噪比（SNR）、区域平均检测概率以及仰角和方位角估计的克拉美-罗下界（CRLB）等方面刻画了球面DCAA的感知性能。然后，建立了一个低空通感一体化优化问题，旨在满足地面用户通信服务质量要求的同时，最大化指定空中区域的最差情况感知信噪比。为有效求解该混合整数非凸问题，本文提出了一种新颖的基于贪心的联合阵列选择与波束赋形优化框架。仿真结果表明，球面DCAA在感知覆盖、角度估计精度以及通信-感知信噪比折中方面显著优于传统均匀平面阵列（UPA），突显了其在未来低空通感一体化系统中的巨大潜力。

</details>


### [203] [Dual-Satellite Doppler Accuracy Prediction and Geometry Selection for Sparse LEO Signals of Opportunity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10241)
*Qi Liu,Marc Fernández-Temprado,Antoni Reus-Bergas,Shuguo Pan,Wang Gao,Gonzalo Seco-Granados,José A. López-Salcedo*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 研究稀疏LEO卫星双星多普勒定位中的精度预测与几何构型选择问题，提出基于DDOP和信息域融合的分析模型，揭示误差椭圆交角与定位精度的关系，并通过实测数据验证。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在仅有一两颗LEO卫星过境的稀疏信号机会场景下，多普勒定位精度严重依赖过境几何构型，缺乏有效的精度预测与卫星选择指导方法。

Method: 首先基于DDOP框架建立单星多普勒精度模型并用Iridium实测数据验证；然后构建信息域融合模型，结合两颗卫星过境的有效位置信息并处理各自的时钟参数；由此推导两个预测误差椭圆交角与融合定位精度之间的解析关系，并通过仿真验证；最后利用长期ORBCOMM观测数据评估有利卫星对的实际可用性。

Result: 误差椭圆交角约20°即可实现约50米的理论定位精度；此类互补卫星对通常在约30分钟内可获得。

Conclusion: 研究结果为稀疏LEO多普勒定位中几何感知的卫星选择和观测调度提供了实用指导。

Original Abstract: Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellites have emerged as a promising complement to GNSS for positioning in signal challenged environments. In sparse LEO signals of opportunity scenarios, Doppler positioning often relies on only one or two satellite passes, making positioning accuracy highly dependent on pass geometry. This paper investigates dual satellite LEO Doppler accuracy prediction and geometry selection. A single pass Doppler accuracy model based on the Doppler Dilution of Precision (DDOP) framework is first validated using real Iridium measurements. An information domain fusion model is then developed to combine the effective position information from two satellite passes while accounting for pass specific clock parameters. Based on this model, an analytical relationship between the intersection angle of the two predicted error ellipses and the fused positioning accuracy is derived and verified through simulations. Long term ORBCOMM observations are further used to evaluate the practical availability of favorable satellite pairs. Results show that an intersection angle of about 20° is sufficient to achieve approximately 50 m theoretical positioning accuracy, and that such complementary satellite pairs are typically available within about 30 min. These results provide practical guidance for geometry aware satellite selection and observation scheduling in sparse LEO Doppler positioning.

中文摘要翻译: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星已成为在信号受限环境下对GNSS进行定位的有前景的补充。在稀疏LEO机会信号的场景中，多普勒定位通常仅依赖一颗或两颗卫星过境，这使得定位精度高度依赖于过境几何构型。本文研究了双星LEO多普勒精度预测与几何构型选择问题。首先基于多普勒精度衰减因子（DDOP）框架建立了单星过境多普勒精度模型，并使用真实Iridium测量数据进行了验证。随后开发了一种信息域融合模型，用于结合两颗卫星过境的有效位置信息，同时处理各自特定的时钟参数。基于该模型，推导了两个预测误差椭圆交角与融合定位精度之间的解析关系，并通过仿真验证。进一步利用长期ORBCOMM观测数据评估了有利卫星对的实际可用性。结果表明，交角约20°即可实现约50米的理论定位精度，且此类互补卫星对通常在约30分钟内可获得。这些结果为稀疏LEO多普勒定位中几何感知的卫星选择和观测调度提供了实用指导。

</details>


### [204] [Tremerity-Fi: Non-Contact Daily-Life Tremor Severity Assessment by Commercial mmWave Radar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10258)
*Xiao Li,Jingyang Hu,Shang Gao,Yichao Gao,Yiyu Xin,Hongbo Jiang,Xiang-Yang Li*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出Tremerity-Fi，一种基于毫米波雷达的非接触式、保护隐私的震颤严重程度评估系统，通过自适应波束赋形、利用多径反射信号和无需监督的域自适应算法，实现了94.51%的震颤检测准确率和89.13%的严重程度评估准确率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有家庭震颤监测方案在用户配合度、隐私保护、环境干扰和系统泛化方面存在困难，难以在日常活动中实际应用。

Method: 1) 设计自适应波束赋形算法以从环境杂波中识别微弱有用信号；2) 利用通常被视为有害的多径反射来重建手部信号；3) 提出无监督域自适应算法以提升对未见环境和用户的泛化能力。

Result: 在5名患者和25名健康受试者、3种场景（办公室、家庭、医院）的实验中，震颤检测准确率94.51%（比SOTA毫米波雷达方法高约5%），震颤严重程度评估准确率89.13%。

Conclusion: 该系统在作为神经系统疾病患者的震颤监测辅助工具方面展现出充分的潜力。

Original Abstract: Tremor is a common symptom of neurological diseases. The regular assessment of daily tremors facilitates the evaluation of disease progression and assists clinicians in optimizing treatment strategies. However, current home monitoring solutions have difficulty in dealing with user cooperation, privacy concerns, environmental interference, and system generalization, leading to feasibility concerns in activities of daily living (ADL). To this end, we propose Tremerity-Fi, a non-contact and privacy-friendly tremor severity assessment system based on mmWave radar. To realize Tremerity-Fi, we first design an adaptive beamforming algorithm to accurately identify useful but weak signals from numerous reflections captured in the environment. Second, unlike primary reflections commonly used in mmWave sensing, we leverage multipath reflections that carry useful information about the target's motion, even though they are generally considered harmful, to help reconstruct hand signals and improve sensing performance. Furthermore, we propose an unsupervised domain adaptation algorithm to improve the ability to adapt to unseen environments and users. We collect a diverse dataset of 5 patients and 25 healthy subjects in 3 scenarios, such as offices, homes, and hospitals. Extensive experiments show that our system achieves 94.51% accuracy in tremor detection, about 5 higher than the SOTA mmWave radar method, and 89.13% in tremor severity assessment, demonstrating its sufficient potential as a tremor monitoring assistant for patients with neurological diseases.

中文摘要翻译: 震颤是神经系统疾病的常见症状。日常震颤的规律评估有助于评价疾病进展并辅助临床医生优化治疗策略。然而，当前的家庭监测解决方案在处理用户配合、隐私担忧、环境干扰和系统泛化方面存在困难，导致其在日常生活活动中的可行性存疑。为此，我们提出Tremerity-Fi，一种基于毫米波雷达的非接触式且隐私友好的震颤严重程度评估系统。为实现Tremerity-Fi，我们首先设计了一种自适应波束赋形算法，以准确识别从环境中捕获的大量反射信号中微弱但有用的信号。其次，与毫米波感知中常用的主反射不同，我们利用了携带有用目标运动信息的多径反射——尽管它们通常被认为是有害的——来帮助重建手部信号并提升感知性能。此外，我们提出了一种无监督域自适应算法，以提高对未见环境和用户的适应能力。我们在办公室、家庭和医院3种场景下采集了包含5名患者和25名健康受试者的多样化数据集。大量实验表明，我们的系统在震颤检测上达到94.51%的准确率，比最先进的毫米波雷达方法高出约5%，在震颤严重程度评估上达到89.13%的准确率，展示了其作为神经系统疾病患者震颤监测辅助工具的充分潜力。

</details>


### [205] [Rotating ULA-Enabled Computed Tomography for Efficient 3D Spatial Power Spectrum Synthesis: Architecture and Principled Orientation Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10270)
*Haocheng Hua,Weidong Mei,Jie Xu,Rui Zhang*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种通过旋转均匀线性阵列（ULA）合成三维空间功率谱的高效方法，利用单条射频链路和类似CT的旋转采样策略，以远少于传统方案的采样和移动开销实现全空间三维覆盖与均匀高角度分辨率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统三维空间谱感知方法（如固定均匀平面阵列或密集移动天线采样）存在硬件成本高、采样开销大或覆盖不完整的问题，亟需一种低复杂度、低开销且能实现全空间三维覆盖的高效方案。

Method: 受计算断层扫描（CT）启发，将均匀线性阵列绕其中心在三维空间旋转，每个旋转角度下进行模拟接收合并产生部分相干和，通过单射频链收集多次旋转的相干和来在线合成完整三维谱。根据是否可获取全局相干和，采用局部谱图像取最小值或累积相干和联合合成两种方式。旋转方向设计通过最大化多径分量对的最坏情况投影分离度，并最小化方向轴间的最坏投影相关性，采用多起点平滑极小极大算法优化。

Result: 数值结果表明，优化后的旋转方向均匀覆盖三维空间，仅用少量空间样本即可重构出接近密集三维立方体参考的全空间三维谱。

Conclusion: 所提方案在显著降低采样和移动开销的同时保持了均匀的高角度分辨率，其采样几何和顺序方向设计还支持流水线模拟波束形成，降低了实际硬件成本。

Original Abstract: This paper proposes an efficient three-dimensional (3D) spatial power spectrum synthesis method by rotating a uniform linear array (ULA) about its center in 3D space. Inspired by classical computed tomography (CT), the ULA performs analog receive combining at each rotation angle to produce a partial coherent sum. By collecting such sums over multiple rotations, the full 3D spectrum can be synthesized online via a single radio-frequency (RF) chain, without explicitly acquiring per-antenna signals. Depending on whether the overall coherent sum is accessible, the synthesis is obtained through either a minimum operation over partial spectrum images or joint synthesis after accumulating all coherent sums. Compared with fixed uniform planar array (UPA)-based combining and dense single movable-antenna (MA) sampling for 3D cubic virtual arrays, the proposed scheme achieves full-space 3D coverage with substantially reduced sampling and movement overhead while maintaining uniformly high angular resolution. Its sampling geometry and sequential orientation design also support pipelined analog beamforming, reducing practical hardware cost. To design rotation orientations in a principled manner without prior environmental information, we aim to maximize the expected worst-case projected separation between multi-path component (MPC) pairs. A secondary criterion then minimizes the worst-case projective correlation among orientation axes to reduce orientation redundancy. Accordingly, we optimize orientation sets for different numbers of orientations under isotropic-matrix and unit-norm constraints, using a multistart smooth minimax algorithm. Numerical results show that the optimized orientations uniformly span 3D space and reconstruct full-space 3D spectra close to the dense 3D cubic reference using only a fraction of spatial samples.

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出了一种通过绕其中心在三维空间旋转均匀线性阵列（ULA）的高效三维空间功率谱合成方法。受经典计算断层扫描（CT）启发，ULA在每个旋转角度下进行模拟接收合并以产生部分相干和。通过多次旋转收集这些相干和，即可经由单条射频（RF）链在线合成完整的三维谱，而无需显式获取每根天线的信号。根据能否获取全局相干和，合成可通过局部谱图像的最小值运算或累积所有相干和后的联合合成来实现。与固定的均匀平面阵列（UPA）合并以及用于三维立方虚拟阵列的密集单可移动天线（MA）采样相比，所提方案实现了全空间三维覆盖，显著降低了采样和移动开销，同时保持了均匀的高角度分辨率。其采样几何结构和顺序方向设计还支持流水线模拟波束形成，降低了实际硬件成本。为了在没有先验环境信息的情况下以原则性方式设计旋转方向，我们旨在最大化多径分量（MPC）对之间最坏情况的投影分离度。次要准则随后最小化方向轴之间最坏情况的投影相关性，以减少方向冗余。据此，我们在各向同性矩阵和单位范数约束下，针对不同数量的方向优化方向集，使用多起点平滑极小极大算法。数值结果表明，优化后的方向均匀地覆盖三维空间，且仅使用少量空间样本就能重构出接近密集三维立方体参考的全空间三维谱。

</details>


### [206] [Networked ISAC Enabled Target Recognition Towards Low-Altitude Economy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10319)
*Hongliang Luo,Chuanbin Zhao,Boxuan Sun,Zhonghua Chu,Shengjie Quan,Guangyi Liu,Feifei Gao*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于多基站协作与多尺度特征融合的低空目标识别方案，利用Swin Transformer融合三种时频谱特征，在ISAC网络中实现了高识别准确率与鲁棒的新子类泛化能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 针对ISAC网络中低空目标（无人机、鸟、车辆、行人）识别难题，现有方法难以充分利用多基站协作提供的多视角信息以及目标在不同尺度下的时频特征，需要设计更有效的融合识别方案。

Method: 1) 构建多基站协作场景下UAV、鸟、车辆、行人的运动方程、回波信道与回波信号模型；2) 从回波信号中提取速度分辨率优先、时间分辨率优先和速度转移三种时频谱作为多尺度特征；3) 设计基于Swin Transformer的多基站多尺度特征融合识别网络，包括深度特征提取、站内特征交互、站间特征交互和目标识别输出模块；4) 生成包含144万样本的大规模数据集用于训练与评估。

Result: 仿真结果显示，所提方案实现了高识别准确率和鲁棒的新子类泛化能力，验证了多尺度特征融合的有效性以及多基站协作带来的额外增益。

Conclusion: 多基站协作与多尺度特征融合显著提升了ISAC网络中低空目标识别的性能，所构建的大规模数据集可作为公共基准支持未来研究。

Original Abstract: In this paper, we propose a low-altitude target (LAT) recognition scheme based on multi-base station (BS) collaboration and multi-scale feature fusion for integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) network. Firstly, we formulate the motion equations, echo channels, and echo signals for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV), bird, vehicle, and pedestrian under multi-BS collaborative monitoring scenario. Then we extract the velocityresolution-preferred time-frequency spectrum, time-resolutionpreferred time-frequency spectrum, and the velocity-transfer time-frequency spectrum observed by each BS from echo signals. We collectively refer to these three types of time-frequency spectrum as the multi-scale feature of the LAT. Next, we design a multi-BS and multi-scale feature fusion enabled LAT recognition network with Swin Transformer, which employs the visualized images of multi-scale feature to jointly recognize the target through deep feature extraction, intra-BS feature interaction, inter-BS feature interaction, and target recognition output. We generate a massive echo signal dataset comprising 1,440,000 samples for LAT recognition within ISAC network. This dataset can serve as a public benchmark to evaluate our proposed scheme and facilitate future research. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed scheme realizes high recognition accuracy and robust unseen-subtype generalization, confirming the effectiveness of multi-scale feature fusion and the additional gains brought by multi-BS collaboration. The project page is available at: https://alivn999.github.io/COSMOS-Networked-ISAC-Enabl ed-Target-Recognition-Towards-Low-Altitude-Economy/.

中文摘要翻译: 本文针对集成感知与通信（ISAC）网络，提出了一种基于多基站协作与多尺度特征融合的低空目标识别方案。首先，我们建立了多基站协作监控场景下无人机、鸟、车辆和行人的运动方程、回波信道与回波信号模型。然后，从每个基站观测到的回波信号中提取速度分辨率优先的时频谱、时间分辨率优先的时频谱以及速度转移时频谱，将这三类时频谱统称为低空目标的多尺度特征。接着，我们设计了一种基于Swin Transformer的多基站多尺度特征融合低空目标识别网络，该网络利用多尺度特征的可视化图像，通过深度特征提取、站内特征交互、站间特征交互和目标识别输出四个阶段实现联合识别。我们生成了一个包含1,440,000个样本的大规模回波信号数据集，用于ISAC网络中的低空目标识别。该数据集可作为公共基准来评估我们提出的方案并促进未来研究。仿真结果表明，所提方案实现了高识别准确率和鲁棒的新子类泛化能力，证实了多尺度特征融合的有效性以及多基站协作带来的额外增益。项目页面访问地址：https://alivn999.github.io/COSMOS-Networked-ISAC-Enabled-Target-Recognition-Towards-Low-Altitude-Economy/。

</details>


### [207] [Non-Reciprocal Dynamic Metasurface Antenna: Practical Multiport-Network Modeling and Optimization for Multi-User Interference Resilience](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10363)
*Shuai S. A. Yuan,Jean Tapie,Bahman Amrahi,Viktar Asadchy,Philipp del Hougne*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出在基站部署非互易动态超表面天线（NR-DMA），通过联合优化超表面状态、模拟馈电权重、环形器端口分配和循环方向，实现前向与反向通道的不同响应，在全双工高信噪比场景下相较互易DMA将总速率提升约60%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 信道互易性从根本上限制了全双工基站应对多用户同频干扰的能力，本文旨在探索部署非互易动态超表面天线来突破这一限制。

Method: 采用多端口网络理论建模，利用制作的19GHz DMA的实验代理参数和实测环形器响应；通过对角可调散射矩阵捕获NR-DMA的可重构性；联合优化DMA状态、模拟馈电权重、环形器端口分配和循环方向。

Result: 在干扰受限的高信噪比场景下，NR-DMA相较互易DMA基准将全双工总速率提升约60%；对比代理目标和未考虑互耦的优化表明，端到端全双工优化和考虑互耦的建模均至关重要。

Conclusion: 非互易DMA和RIS不一定需要"超对角"可调散射矩阵；端到端全双工优化与互耦感知建模是实现性能提升的关键因素。

Original Abstract: Channel reciprocity fundamentally limits full-duplex (FD) base stations due to multi-user co-channel interference. We examine the potential of deploying a non-reciprocal dynamic metasurface antenna (NR-DMA) at the base station to overcome this limitation. Our NR-DMA architecture connects a single circulator to three feed ports of a multi-feed DMA with strong mutual coupling (MC) between its seven feeds and 96 1-bit-programmable meta-elements. We model our system with multiport network theory, using experimentally estimated proxy parameters of a fabricated 19-GHz DMA and the measured circulator response. Our NR-DMA's reconfigurability is captured by a diagonal tunable scattering matrix, showing that non-reciprocal DMAs and RISs need not require a "beyond-diagonal" tunable scattering matrix. We jointly optimize the DMA state, analog feed weights, circulator-port assignment, and circulation direction. Our optimized NR-DMA realizes distinct forward and reverse channel responses. In our interference-limited high-SNR case study, the NR-DMA improves the FD sum rate by about 60% over a reciprocal DMA benchmark. Comparisons with proxy objectives and MC-unaware optimization show that end-to-end FD optimization and MC-aware modeling are both essential.

中文摘要翻译: 信道互易性从根本上限制了全双工基站应对多用户同频干扰的能力。我们研究了在基站部署非互易动态超表面天线以克服这一限制的可行性。我们的NR-DMA架构将一个环形器连接到一个多馈电DMA的三个馈电端口上，该DMA的七个馈电和96个1比特可编程超元之间具有强互耦。我们采用多端口网络理论对系统进行建模，使用了制作的19GHz DMA的实验估计代理参数和实测的环形器响应。NR-DMA的可重构性由一个对角可调散射矩阵描述，表明非互易DMA和RIS不一定需要"超对角"可调散射矩阵。我们联合优化了DMA状态、模拟馈电权重、环形器端口分配和循环方向。优化后的NR-DMA实现了不同的前向和反向信道响应。在我们干扰受限的高信噪比案例研究中，NR-DMA相较互易DMA基准将全双工总速率提升了约60%。与代理目标和未考虑互耦的优化对比表明，端到端全双工优化和互耦感知建模均至关重要。

</details>


### [208] [SCOPE: Sidelobe-Controlled Off-grid Profile Estimation for Multiband Multistatic Target Localization in Upper Mid-Band ISAC Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10549)
*Wenyu Huang,Nuria González-Prelcic*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE算法，通过多视角一致性和迭代预编码器抑制栅瓣伪影，在碎片化FR3频段实现亚米级高精度定位。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 碎片化FR3频段（7-24 GHz）中，频率各向异性导致目标散射去相关，且大频段间隔产生严重栅瓣，形成持久的鬼影峰值，亟需鲁棒的定位算法来抑制这些模糊性。

Method: 发射端采用迭代最小化最大预编码器抑制区域外旁瓣；接收端采用基于Top-K抑制的剖面似然峰值选择避免陷入鬼影盆地，再通过无导数离网精化实现高精度定位。

Result: 在-5 dB SNR下以90%概率实现亚米级定位，在25 dB SNR下均方根误差（RMSE）达到3 mm。

Conclusion: SCOPE算法有效解决了多频段多基地ISAC中的栅瓣模糊问题，实现了高精度、鲁棒的定位性能。

Original Abstract: Multiband multistatic integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) in fragmented FR3 bands (7-24 GHz) enables high resolution localization via virtual wideband and spatial diversity. However, frequency anisotropy decorrelates target scattering across non-contiguous bands, while large inter-band frequency gaps generate severe grating lobes that create persistent ghost peaks. We propose sidelobe-controlled off-grid profile estimation (SCOPE), a robust localization algorithm that exploits multi-view consistency across distributed receivers and frequency bands to suppress grating-lobe ambiguities. At the transmitter, an iterative minimax precoder suppresses out-of-region sidelobes to reduce false peaks in the coarse likelihood map. At the receiver, SCOPE employs profile likelihood with Top-K inhibition-based peak selection to avoid trapping in ghost basins, followed by derivative-free off-grid refinement. Simulations demonstrate that SCOPE achieves sub-meter localization with 90% probability at -5 dB SNR and 3 mm root mean square error (RMSE) at 25 dB SNR.

中文摘要翻译: 碎片化FR3频段（7-24 GHz）中的多频段多基地集成感知与通信（ISAC）通过虚拟宽带和空间分集实现了高分辨率定位。然而，频率各向异性导致目标散射在非连续频段间去相关，同时大的频段间隔会产生严重栅瓣，形成持久的鬼影峰值。我们提出旁瓣控制离网剖面估计（SCOPE），一种鲁棒的定位算法，利用分布式接收机和频段间的多视角一致性来抑制栅瓣模糊性。在发射端，迭代最小化最大预编码器抑制区域外旁瓣以减少粗似然图中的虚假峰值。在接收端，SCOPE采用基于Top-K抑制的剖面似然峰值选择以避免陷入鬼影盆地，随后进行无导数离网精化。仿真结果表明，SCOPE在-5 dB信噪比下以90%的概率实现亚米级定位，在25 dB信噪比下均方根误差（RMSE）达到3毫米。

</details>


### [209] [Design and Experimental Validation of a Multiband Cross-Polarization Conversion (CPC) Metasurface for Radar Cross Section (RCS) Reduction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10687)
*Sohaib Yaqoob Chaudhry,Malik Muhammad Abdullah,Salman Liaquat,Jamal Haider,Umar Khan,Azhar Hasan*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于FR4基板的单层交叉极化转换超表面，在C、X、Ku波段实现多频段RCS缩减，PCR超过95%，RCS缩减超过10 dBsm，且在60°斜入射下性能稳定，实验与仿真吻合良好。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现代隐身技术对雷达散射截面（RCS）缩减有基本需求，现有被动RCS缩减策略中，超表面交叉极化转换因结构简单、低剖面而具有吸引力，但需要实现多频段、低成本、宽入射角的高性能方案。

Method: 设计了一种基于低成本FR4介质基板（相对介电常数4.4，损耗角正切0.02）的单层交叉极化转换（CPC）超表面，通过精心设计单元结构实现多频段谐振，将入射电磁波的极化状态进行转换，从而降低单站RCS。

Result: 在7.8 GHz、11.7 GHz和18 GHz三个频点实现PCR超过95%，对应C、X、Ku波段的单站RCS缩减超过10 dBsm；在60°斜入射下仍保持稳定的极化转换性能；暗室实验与全波电磁仿真结果高度一致。

Conclusion: 该设计提供了一种轻量、低成本、高性能的多频段隐身与低可观测平台应用候选方案，具有良好的实际部署潜力。

Original Abstract: Radar cross-section (RCS) reduction is a fundamental requirement in modern stealth technology, playing a critical role in the low-observable performance of aerial and naval platforms. Among the various passive RCS reduction strategies, including radar-absorbing materials, absorptive coatings, and artificially engineered surfaces, metasurface-based cross-polarization conversion has emerged as a compelling approach owing to its structural simplicity and low profile. In this work, a single-layer cross-polarization conversion (CPC) metasurface developed on a cost-effective FR4 dielectric substrate (relative permittivity 4.4, loss tangent 0.02) is proposed for multiband RCS reduction. The designed structure achieves a polarization conversion ratio (PCR) exceeding 95% at three distinct operating frequencies of 7.8 GHz, 11.7 GHz, and 18 GHz, spanning the C-, X-, and Ku-bands, which directly translates into a monostatic RCS reduction exceeding 10 dBsm at the corresponding bands. The metasurface further demonstrates stable polarization conversion performance under oblique incidence up to 60 degrees, confirming its suitability for wide-angle illumination conditions encountered in practical deployment scenarios. Experimental validation conducted in an anechoic chamber confirms close agreement with full-wave electromagnetic simulations, substantiating the reliability of the fabricated prototype. The proposed design offers a lightweight, low-cost, and high-performance candidate for multiband stealth and low-observable platform applications.

中文摘要翻译: 雷达散射截面（RCS）缩减是现代隐身技术的基本要求，在空中和海上平台的低可观测性能中起着关键作用。在包括雷达吸波材料、吸波涂层和人工工程表面在内的各种被动RCS缩减策略中，基于超表面的交叉极化转换因其结构简单和低剖面而成为一种引人注目的方法。本文提出了一种基于低成本FR4介质基板（相对介电常数4.4，损耗角正切0.02）的单层交叉极化转换（CPC）超表面，用于多频段RCS缩减。所设计结构在7.8 GHz、11.7 GHz和18 GHz三个不同工作频率（覆盖C、X和Ku波段）实现了超过95%的极化转换率（PCR），这直接转化为对应波段超过10 dBsm的单站RCS缩减。该超表面在高达60°的斜入射下进一步表现出稳定的极化转换性能，证实了其适用于实际部署场景中遇到的宽角度照射条件。在暗室中进行的实验验证与全波电磁仿真结果高度吻合，证实了所制作原型的可靠性。该设计为多频段隐身和低可观测平台应用提供了一种轻量、低成本、高性能的候选方案。

</details>


### [210] [An X-Band Monopulse Direction-Finding Receiver Based on a Rat-Race Comparator and a $2\times2$ Antipodal Vivaldi Array](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10692)
*M. Ahmad Nabil,Sohaib Yaqoob Chaudhry,Salman Liaquat*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 本文设计并实验验证了一款X波段紧凑型单脉冲测向接收机，采用2×2对跖Vivaldi天线阵列与环形电桥比较器网络，实现了和、方位差、俯仰差通道合成，在11 GHz下方位角测向RMSE为7度，适用于雷达、电子战与 surveillance 应用。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统单脉冲测向系统通常依赖机械扫描或复杂的射频前端，体积大、成本高。本文旨在设计一种无机械扫描、低成本、全集成化的紧凑型单脉冲接收机，以满足雷达、电子战和监视等领域对小型化被动测向系统的需求。

Method: 采用2×2对跖Vivaldi天线阵列（工作于8-12 GHz，增益约6.44 dBi）配合环形电桥（180度混合）比较器网络，同时合成和通道(Σ)、方位差通道(Δ_az)和俯仰差通道(Δ_el)。三个LTC5564包络检波器将通道输出转换为直流电压，由板载微控制器数字化处理，形成单脉冲比并估计到达角，结果在MATLAB图形界面实时显示。

Result: 在11 GHz下对-20°至19°范围内的14个方位角进行实验测向，均方根误差(RMSE)为7度。Vivaldi单元在8-12 GHz内阻抗匹配良好，比较器在差端口实现了所需的180度相位平衡，原型测试保持了一致性。

Conclusion: 该接收机是一种被动、低成本、全集成化的方案，成功实现了X波段的单脉冲测向功能，且架构可直接扩展至俯仰维度，在雷达传感、电子战和监视领域具有应用潜力。

Original Abstract: This paper presents the design, fabrication, and experimental validation of a compact monopulse direction-finding (DF) receiver operating in the X-band. The receiver combines a $2 \times 2$ antipodal Vivaldi antenna array with a rat-race (180-degree hybrid) comparator network that simultaneously synthesizes the sum ($Σ$), azimuth-difference ($Δ_{az}$), and elevation-difference ($Δ_{el}$) channels required for monopulse processing, removing the need for mechanical scanning. The Vivaldi element provides good impedance matching across 8-12 GHz with a simulated realized gain of approximately 6.44 dBi, and the comparator exhibits the 180-degree phase balance at its difference ports required for angle encoding, with the fabricated prototype preserving the matched, balanced response measured across the band. Three LTC5564 envelope detectors convert the channel outputs to DC voltages that are digitized by an on-board microcontroller and processed in software to form the monopulse ratios and estimate the direction of arrival (DoA), with the result displayed in real time on a MATLAB graphical user interface. Azimuth direction finding is experimentally demonstrated over fourteen angles spanning -20 to 19 degrees at 11 GHz, yielding a root-mean-square error (RMSE) of 7 degrees; the architecture is directly extensible to elevation. The result is a passive, low-cost, and fully integrated receiver suitable for radar sensing, electronic warfare, and surveillance.

中文摘要翻译: 本文介绍了一种工作在X波段的紧凑型单脉冲测向接收机的设计、制造与实验验证。该接收机将2×2对跖Vivaldi天线阵列与环形电桥（180度混合）比较器网络相结合，可同时合成单脉冲处理所需的和通道(Σ)、方位差通道(Δ_az)和俯仰差通道(Δ_el)，无需机械扫描。Vivaldi单元在8-12 GHz范围内具有良好的阻抗匹配，仿真实现增益约为6.44 dBi，比较器在其差端口实现了角度编码所需的180度相位平衡，所制造的原型在整个频段内保持了匹配且均衡的响应。三个LTC5564包络检波器将通道输出转换为直流电压，由板载微控制器数字化处理并在软件中计算单脉冲比以估计到达角，结果在MATLAB图形用户界面上实时显示。在11 GHz下对-20°至19°范围内的十四个方位角进行了实验测向，均方根误差为7度；该架构可直接扩展至俯仰维度。实验结果证明这是一种适用于雷达传感、电子战和监视的被动式、低成本、全集成化接收机方案。

</details>


### [211] [Site-Specific Learning for Low-Overhead Multi-User MIMO Beamforming](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10746)
*Cheng-Jie Zhao,Zhaolin Wang,Zongyao Zhao,Yuanwei Liu*

Main category: eess.SP

TL;DR: 提出一种低开销的站点特定MU-MIMO波束成形框架，利用站点特定信息（SSI）通过学习从低开销波束域观测到用户有效发射子空间的映射，在获取高分辨率CSI之前推断用户间可分离性，构建紧凑的组级CSI获取子空间，显著降低开销和用户端处理负担。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统有限反馈MU-MIMO依赖CSI-RS传输和用户反馈，当天线维度和候选用户池很大时，在线开销巨大。为降低这一负担，需要一种能利用站点特定无线电传播特征、减少高分辨率CSI获取前开销的方法。

Method: 利用站点特定信息（SSI）学习从低开销波束域观测（基于SSB的RSRP指纹）到用户有效发射空间子空间的映射，在CSI-RS获取前推断用户间可分离性，为选定用户构建紧凑的组级CSI获取子空间，再通过低维CSI-RS反馈进行CSI精化。

Result: 数值结果表明，所提框架能在CSI-RS获取前识别兼容用户组，在紧凑组子空间中保留大部分调度用户信道能量，以显著更低的开销和用户端处理负担实现比传统系统更高的有效速率。

Conclusion: 基于站点特定信息的低开销波束成形框架能够在不牺牲性能的前提下大幅降低MU-MIMO系统的在线开销和用户处理复杂度，可在标准有限反馈流程中实现。

Original Abstract: A low-overhead site-specific multi-user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) beamforming framework is proposed. Conventional limited-feedback MU-MIMO relies on channel state information reference signal (CSI-RS) transmission and user feedback before grouping and beamforming, which requires substantial online overhead when the antenna dimension and candidate-user pool are large. To reduce this burden, the proposed framework exploits site-specific information (SSI), which captures local radio propagation features. By learning the mapping from low-overhead beam-domain observations to effective transmit spatial subspaces of users, the BS can infer inter-user separability before high-resolution CSI acquisition and construct a compact group-level CSI acquisition subspace for the selected users. This site-specific design can be implemented within the standard limited-feedback procedure using synchronization signal block (SSB)-based reference signal received power (RSRP) fingerprints for subspace inference and CSI-RS feedback for low-dimensional CSI refinement. Extensive numerical results demonstrate that the proposed framework can identify compatible user groups before CSI-RS acquisition, preserve most scheduled-user channel energy in a compact group subspace, and achieve higher effective rates than conventional systems with significantly lower overhead and user-side processing burden.

中文摘要翻译: 本文提出了一种低开销的站点特定多用户多输入多输出（MU-MIMO）波束成形框架。传统的有限反馈MU-MIMO依赖信道状态信息参考信号（CSI-RS）传输和用户反馈进行分组和波束成形，当天线维度和候选用户池很大时，这需要大量的在线开销。为减轻这一负担，所提框架利用了捕获本地无线电传播特征的站点特定信息（SSI）。通过学习从低开销波束域观测到用户有效发射空间子空间的映射，基站可以在获取高分辨率CSI之前推断用户间的可分离性，并为选定的用户构建紧凑的组级CSI获取子空间。这种站点特定设计可以在标准有限反馈流程中实现，利用基于同步信号块（SSB）的参考信号接收功率（RSRP）指纹进行子空间推断，并利用CSI-RS反馈进行低维CSI精化。大量数值结果表明，所提框架能够在CSI-RS获取之前识别兼容的用户组，在紧凑的组子空间中保留大部分调度用户信道能量，并以显著更低的开销和用户端处理负担实现比传统系统更高的有效速率。

</details>

Original Abstract: We study the problem of joint compression and detection in distributed sensing systems, motivated by applications such as device-to-device connectivity in IoT networks and distributed radar. In such systems, spatially separated sensors must collaboratively decide whether their observations stem from a common underlying signal, while communicating over highly bandwidth-limited links. We consider a fundamental, insightful model in which one sensor (the encoder) observes a continuous-time realization of a stationary bandlimited Gaussian process, while the other sensor (the decoder) observes a delayed and noisy version of that signal, with an unknown delay. The encoder is allowed to transmit only a $k$-bit message to the decoder to assist in making a binary decision: either the observations are statistically independent, or they are time-shifted noisy versions of the same signal. We propose a low-complexity extremum-based scheme that exploits the structure of the signal to enable reliable decision-making under tight communication constraints. We derive nonasymptotic upper bounds on the false alarm and mis-detection probabilities of our method, as well as a simplified asymptotic bound for the latter. Representative simulations demonstrate that the proposed scheme outperforms the prevalent 1-bit-per-sample quantization baseline and a Fisher-information-based compression benchmark, while closely approaching an information-theoretic (nonrealizable) rate-distortion benchmark.

Original Abstract: We introduce a graph bispectrum formulation for characterizing higher-order interactions in graph signals. While conventional graph spectral methods capture only second-order structure, many graph signals exhibit nonlinear interactions that are not reflected in covariance or graph power spectra. Motivated by classical higher-order spectral analysis, we define a graph bispectrum tensor based on third-order moments of graph Fourier coefficients and derive a compact graph bicoherence measure that summarizes nonlinear mode interactions in a low-dimensional and scale-invariant form. We establish key properties of the proposed quantities, including vanishing third-order moments for Gaussian graph signals and a dynamical interpretation in terms of nonlinear mode coupling. Experiments on synthetic random graph signals demonstrate that the proposed measures detect complementary nonlinear dependencies even when second-order statistics are similar. We further apply the method to EEG recordings from the CHB-MIT Scalp EEG Database and show that ictal activity exhibits substantially increased nonlinear graph spectral coupling compared to interictal periods. The proposed approach provides an interpretable and computationally efficient tool for higher-order interaction analysis for graph signals.

Original Abstract: Reconfigurable distributed antennas and reflecting surface (RDARS) has recently emerged as a promising architecture for integrated sensing and communication (ISAC), owing to its flexible element-wise mode switching between connection and reflection modes. In this paper, to fully reap the benefits of mode configuration, muting elements that can absorb the incident energy are introduced into RDARS-aided ISAC systems to mitigate multi-user interference (MUI) and enhance sensing performance. Specifically, the maximum communication and sensing signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), and the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio (SINR) expressions are respectively derived for the three cases, together with the optimal number of muting elements for explicitly characterizing the tradeoff between reflection gain loss and MUI suppression. Furthermore, a model-driven APDD-Net is developed by deeply unfolding the APDD iterations into a layer-wise architecture, where key parameters are learned to reduce the computational complexity and accelerate convergence. Simulation results verify the theoretical findings on the muting gain and demonstrate that the proposed APDD-Net achieves a better tradeoff between communication and sensing performance compared with benchmark schemes.

Original Abstract: Distributed wireless spiking neural networks (DWSNNs) are a promising paradigm for energy-efficient edge inference in resource-constrained environments such as wireless sensor networks (WSNs). Yet, two limitations persist: their internal decision process is opaque, and their residual energy footprint remains a limiting factor for ultra-low-power deployments. This paper proposes a systematic methodology to convert a trained DWSNN into an equivalent Spiking Neural P (SN P) system, a biologically-inspired, rule-based computational model drawn from membrane computing, by extracting symbolic firing rules from the hidden-layer spike activity. The resulting SN P system provides direct, human-readable decision explanations while consuming three orders of magnitude less energy than its parent SNN. Experiments on the Neuromorphic MNIST (N-MNIST) dataset with a two-layer fully connected SNN using phase encoding and Leaky Integrate-and-Fire (LIF) neurons show that the SN P system retains approximately 84% of the original classification accuracy (73.77% vs. 87.68%) while the output layer connectivity decreases from 1000 to 120 class-specific connections. This complexity reduction is governed by a parameter related to the number of relevant hidden neurons per class that can be chosen according to a trade-off between computational complexity reduction and output accuracy. These results position SN P systems as lightweight, interpretable surrogates for trained distributed wireless SNNs in neuromorphic edge deployments.

Original Abstract: Interference is a limiting factor in the emerging dense low Earth orbit (LEO) networks. In the LEO network, the interference is spatially and temporally correlated. At narrow-beam LEO base stations (BSs), spatial interference can vary significantly, and multipath fading introduces temporal variation. While developing novel stochastic geometry analysis in a multibeam scenario, we explore spatio-temporal interference correlation in the LEO uplink. We derive a closed-form expression for the spatio-temporal interference correlation coefficient. As an application of the analysis, we show that the signal-to-interference ratio (SIR) entails significant spatial clustering, which is especially prevalent if the beams are near-Gaussian, i.e., have weak side lobes and/or the side lobe interference/inter-cell interference is small, and large cell sizes. In this regard, we demonstrate that an appropriately designed grant-free random access scheme, particularly slotted ALOHA, can mitigate spatial SIR clustering over the beams while preserving average throughput. Furthermore, we propose a novel gamma distribution model for the interference power distribution and a Lomax distribution model for the SIR.

Original Abstract: Graph neural network (GNN)-based precoding has demonstrated strong potential for scalable multi-user beamforming in multi-user multiple-input single-output (MU-MISO) systems under space division multiple access (SDMA). RS-GNN constructs precoder-dependent graph features at every refinement layer, enabling closed-loop interference-aware message passing, and recovers the common and private precoders through an analytically grounded structure-based reconstruction via a differentiable linear solver. This design decouples the learnable parameters from fixed system dimensions, enabling generalization to unseen system sizes without retraining. We formally prove that RS-GNN satisfies mixed permutation equivariance with respect to both user and antenna orderings, and show that RS-GNN reduces to conventional SDMA precoding as a special case by deactivating the common-stream branch. Simulation results demonstrate that RS-GNN achieves near-WMMSE sum-rate performance with significantly lower online inference time, while generalizing robustly to unseen system sizes; its SDMA special case consistently outperforms existing GNN-based precoders across unseen antenna and user configurations, SNR regimes, and channel distributions.

However, conventional RT suffers from high complexity under serial path-searching workflows. This letter proposes DeepRT Engine (DeepRT-E), a parallel RT acceleration architecture with a three-stage physically-inspired pipeline for real-time DTC construction. Firstly, DeepRT-E constructs a bounding volume hierarchy (BVH) to partition the scene and reduce redundant ray-surface intersections. Secondly, the shooting and bouncing rays (SBR) algorithm is executed through a ray-level parallel tracing framework to identify candidate surface sequences and prune the search space of the image method (IM). Finally, a parallel batched IM solver refines the retained candidates for accurate propagation-path recovery. Simulation results show that DeepRT-E reduces runtime by 96.3% and achieves a converged error of only 0.001 dB, outperforming Wireless InSite and Sionna in efficiency and accuracy.
