### [227] [A Unified Model for Highly Accurate ECG-Free Dynamic Coronary Roadmapping Using Spatio-Temporal Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09805)
*Saahil Islam,Sebastian Piat,Venkatesh N. Murthy,Serkan Cimen,Puneet Sharma,Andreas Maier,Florin C. Ghesu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出了一种统一的心脏相位匹配与导管尖端跟踪框架，基于大规模时空预训练模型，用于动态冠脉路图（DRM）中的运动补偿，减少术中造影剂注射和辐射暴露。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在PCI手术中，频繁的造影剂注射会增加辐射暴露和造影剂肾病风险。动态冠脉路图（DRM）虽可降低这些风险，但其准确性高度依赖心脏相位匹配和导管尖端跟踪。现有方法在无ECG信号和仅有少量人工标注时难以同时完成这两项任务。

Method: 提出统一框架，采用在1600万X光帧上预训练的大规模时空编码器学习心脏运动动力学，并引入基于ECG R峰检测和导管尖端跟踪的辅助任务优化模型，最后使用多数投票后处理策略聚合时序预测以提升鲁棒性。

Result: 在临床X射线数据集上达到SOTA性能，实现了低时间错位和鲁棒的相位匹配精度，满足实时DRM要求。

Conclusion: 首次将大规模时空预训练应用于DRM运动补偿任务，统一了心脏相位匹配与导管尖端跟踪，有效降低了对ECG信号和密集标注的依赖，为实时PCI引导提供了可行方案。

Original Abstract: Percutaneous Coronary Intervention (PCI) is a minimally invasive procedure used to restore coronary blood flow obstructed by atherosclerotic plaque. During PCI, repeated injections of iodine-based contrast agents are required to visualize the coronary arteries and guide interventional devices. However, frequent contrast injections increase radiation exposure and the risk of contrast-induced nephropathy, with acute kidney injury reported in up to 30% of patients with renal impairment. Dynamic Coronary Roadmapping (DRM) reduces these risks by overlaying a precomputed angiographic vessel map onto live fluoroscopy and continuously updating it throughout the procedure. Accurate DRM relies on precise cardiac phase matching between angiography and fluoroscopy, together with reliable catheter tip tracking for motion compensation. These tasks remain challenging in ECG-free settings and when only limited manual annotations are available. We present a unified DRM framework that simultaneously performs cardiac phase matching and catheter tip tracking for accurate real-time guidance. Our method employs a large-scale spatio-temporal encoder pretrained on 16 million X-ray frames to learn cardiac motion dynamics. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first application of large-scale spatio-temporal pretraining for motion compensation in DRM. We further introduce auxiliary tasks based on ECG R-peak detection and catheter tip tracking, improving optimization while eliminating the need for extensive catheter mask annotations. Finally, a majority-voting postprocessing strategy aggregates temporal predictions, improving robustness and providing a confidence score that correlates with phase-matching error. Comprehensive evaluation on clinical X-ray datasets demonstrates state-of-the-art performance, achieving low temporal misalignment and robust phase-matching accuracy suitable for real-time DRM.

中文摘要翻译: 经皮冠状动脉介入治疗（PCI）是一种微创手术，用于恢复被动脉粥样硬化斑块阻塞的冠状动脉血流。在PCI过程中，需要反复注射碘基造影剂以显影冠状动脉并引导介入器械。然而，频繁的造影注射增加了辐射暴露和造影剂肾病的风险，在肾功能不全的患者中，急性肾损伤的发生率高达30%。动态冠脉路图（DRM）通过将预先计算的血管造影图叠加到实时透视图像上，并在手术过程中持续更新，从而降低这些风险。准确的DRM依赖于血管造影与透视之间的精确心脏相位匹配，以及可靠的导管尖端跟踪以实现运动补偿。这些任务在无ECG信号的环境下以及仅具备有限人工标注时仍然具有挑战性。我们提出一个统一的DRM框架，可同时执行心脏相位匹配和导管尖端跟踪，以实现准确的实时引导。该方法采用在1600万X光帧上预训练的大规模时空编码器来学习心脏运动动力学。据我们所知，这是首次将大规模时空预训练应用于DRM中的运动补偿。我们进一步引入了基于ECG R峰检测和导管尖端跟踪的辅助任务，改善了模型优化，同时消除了对大量导管掩膜标注的需求。最后，采用多数投票后处理策略聚合时序预测，提升了鲁棒性，并提供了与相位匹配误差相关的置信度分数。在临床X射线数据集上的综合评估表明，该方法达到了最先进的性能，实现了低时间错位和鲁棒的相位匹配精度，适用于实时DRM。

</details>


### [228] [Calibrated Hybrid CNN-Transformer for Retinal OCT Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09809)
*Animesh Kumar*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种结合混合卷积-Transformer编码器与XGBoost分类头的视网膜OCT分类模型，并集成置信度校准、分布外拒绝和不确定性标记三项临床安全机制，在84,495张OCT扫描上达到95.4%准确率，校准误差降低12倍（ECE=0.0024）。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有视网膜OCT分类模型虽报告高准确率，但很少验证其置信度是否可信——模型高置信度但预测错误时，会延误患者接受挽救视力的治疗，存在临床安全隐患。

Method: 采用混合卷积-Transformer编码器提取特征，结合梯度提升（XGBoost）分类头，并引入三部分临床安全层：置信度校准、分布外（OOD）样本拒绝、以及逐预测的不确定性标记。

Result: 在四类OCT数据集（84,495张扫描）上达到95.4%准确率，校准误差降低十二倍（预期校准误差ECE=0.0024），且首次联合验证了全部三种安全机制。

Conclusion: 该模型是首个同时验证置信度校准、分布外检测和不确定性标记三种临床安全机制的OCT分类器，并公开了权重和可复现的多随机种子评估结果。

Original Abstract: Deep models for retinal optical coherence tomography (OCT) classification report high accuracy but rarely report whether their confidence can be trusted -- a gap that matters when a wrong-but-confident reading delays sight-saving treatment. We pair a hybrid convolutional-Transformer encoder with a gradient-boosting (XGBoost) classification head and a three-part clinical safety layer: confidence calibration, out-of-distribution (OOD) rejection, and per-prediction uncertainty flagging. On four-class OCT (84,495 scans) the model reaches 95.4% accuracy while cutting calibration error twelve-fold (expected calibration error, ECE = 0.0024), so the confidence it reports tracks its true accuracy. To our knowledge this is the first OCT classifier to validate all three safety mechanisms jointly, with public weights and reproducible multi-seed evaluation.

中文摘要翻译: 用于视网膜光学相干断层扫描（OCT）分类的深度模型报告了较高的准确率，但很少报告其置信度是否可信——当模型高置信度但判读错误时，会延误患者接受挽救视力的治疗，这一差距至关重要。我们将混合卷积-Transformer编码器与梯度提升（XGBoost）分类头以及三部分临床安全层相结合：置信度校准、分布外（OOD）拒绝以及逐预测的不确定性标记。在四类OCT数据集（84,495张扫描）上，该模型达到95.4%的准确率，同时将校准误差降低十二倍（预期校准误差ECE=0.0024），因此其报告的置信度能够反映真实准确率。据我们所知，这是首个联合验证全部三种安全机制的OCT分类器，并公开了模型权重及可复现的多随机种子评估结果。

</details>


### [229] [CHM-Net: Center Heatmap-driven Macro-Micro Modeling Network for MRI-based Microbial Density Stratification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09812)
*Jiaming Liang,Haolin Chen,Tingting Li,Bowen Yu,Qianyan Long,Tinghe Zhang,Xi Zhong,Xiaowei Hu,Xiaoqi Sheng,Hongmin Cai*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出了CHM-Net，一种基于中心热力图驱动的宏观-微观建模网络，用于从多模态MRI中非侵入性地推断微生物密度，在新型GBNPC 2026数据集上取得了显著优于基线方法的效果，ACC绝对提升12.06%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 微生物密度对于肿瘤评估和治疗决策具有重要临床意义，而深度学习的最新进展表明其可以从多模态MRI中非侵入性地推断出来，因此需要一种有效的患者级表示学习方法来实现MRI-based Microbial Density Stratification (MRI-MDS)。

Method: 提出CHM-Net（Center Heatmap-driven Macro-micro modeling Network），首先通过中心热力图引导的小病灶响应定位建立影像表型与微生物状态之间的关联，然后从局部热力图响应中构建患者级的宏观-微观证据用于微生物密度预测。

Result: 在GBNPC 2026数据集上，CHM-Net相较于最强基线方法取得了12.06%的绝对ACC提升；在两个3D医学图像数据集上的辅助验证进一步证明了其在体素医学图像分类场景中的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CHM-Net能够有效地从多模态MRI中非侵入性地进行微生物密度分层，在多个数据集上表现出优越性能与鲁棒性。

Original Abstract: Microbial density is clinically important for tumor assessment and treatment decision-making, and recent advances in deep learning suggest that it can be non-invasively inferred from multimodal MRI. In this work, MRI-based Microbial Density Stratification (MRI-MDS) is first investigated as a patient-level representation learning task, and Center Heatmap-driven Macro-micro modeling Network (CHM-Net) is introduced for this task. CHM-Net first establishes the link between imaging phenotypes and microbial states through center heatmap-guided small-lesion response localization. Building upon this, it constructs patient-level macro-micro evidence from localized heatmap responses for microbial density prediction. Experiments on the novel GBNPC 2026 dataset constructed for MRI-MDS demonstrate the effectiveness of CHM-Net, achieving superior performance over representative baselines with a 12.06% absolute ACC gain over the strongest competing result. Additionally, auxiliary validation on two 3D medical image datasets further verifies its robustness across volumetric medical image classification scenarios. The project is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CHM-Net-942E/.

中文摘要翻译: 微生物密度对于肿瘤评估和治疗决策具有重要的临床意义，而深度学习的最新进展表明，可以从多模态MRI中非侵入性地推断微生物密度。本文将基于MRI的微生物密度分层（MRI-MDS）作为一项患者级表示学习任务进行探索，并为此任务提出了中心热力图驱动的宏观-微观建模网络（CHM-Net）。CHM-Net首先通过中心热力图引导的小病灶响应定位，建立影像表型与微生物状态之间的关联。在此基础上，从局部热力图响应中构建患者级的宏观-微观证据，用于微生物密度预测。在专为MRI-MDS构建的新型GBNPC 2026数据集上的实验表明，CHM-Net取得了显著效果，相较于最强基线方法实现了12.06%的绝对ACC提升。此外，在两个3D医学图像数据集上的辅助验证进一步证明了其在不同体素医学图像分类场景中的鲁棒性。项目代码可在https://anonymous.4open.science/r/CHM-Net-942E/获取。

### [230] [Performance Benchmarking and Optimisation of Clustering Algorithms for Local and Non-Local Similarity Measure in Medical Image Analysis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09821)
*Sisipho Hamlomo,Marcellin Atemkeng*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文系统比较了五种聚类技术（k-means、mini-batch k-means、凝聚层次聚类、BIRCH、二分k-means）在MRI、超声和胸部X光三种医学影像模态中利用非局部自相似性进行聚类以辅助自适应压缩的效果。结果表明，凝聚聚类在MRI和超声上实现了最佳簇内同质性，mini-batch k-means在胸部X光上表现最佳，而BIRCH在所有模态下均表现不佳。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 医学影像生成的高分辨率图像在存储、传输和计算上存在巨大挑战。虽然低秩矩阵近似（LoRMA）技术通过利用结构冗余实现了高效压缩，但全局方法往往无法保留对诊断至关重要的局部细节。因此，需要探索能够识别结构相似区域（非局部自相似性）的聚类技术，以服务于自适应图像压缩等后处理任务。

Method: 评估了五种聚类技术：k-means、mini-batch k-means、凝聚层次聚类、BIRCH和二分k-means，应用于MRI、超声和胸部X光三种模态。所有聚类方法均使用随机搜索进行超参数优化，并使用轮廓系数（Silhouette score）、Davies-Bouldin指数和Calinski-Harabasz指数评估聚类质量。

Result: 标准k-means和二分k-means通常能实现较强的簇间分离和簇内紧致性，但倾向于形成少量具有高簇内变异性的簇，限制了后处理效果。凝聚聚类在MRI和超声上簇内同质性最优，更适合保留精细诊断细节。胸部X光中，mini-batch k-means在聚类质量和簇内紧致性之间取得了最佳平衡。BIRCH在所有模态下始终表现不佳。

Conclusion: 不同医学影像模态下最优聚类方法不同：凝聚聚类适用于MRI和超声（保留精细诊断细节），mini-batch k-means适用于胸部X光（平衡质量和紧致性），而BIRCH不适用于此类任务。标准k-means和二分k-means虽整体分离性好，但簇内变异度高，限制了自适应压缩中的有效性。

Original Abstract: Medical imaging generates high-resolution images posing significant storage, transmission, and computational challenges. While low-rank matrix approximation (LoRMA) techniques offer efficient compression by exploiting structural redundancy, global approaches often fail to preserve local details critical for diagnosis. This paper focuses on clustering techniques that exploit non-local self-similarity to identify structurally similar regions in medical images. These clusters can be used for post-processing tasks such as adaptive image compression. We evaluate five clustering techniques: k-means, mini-batch k-means, agglomerative hierarchical clustering, balanced iterative reducing and clustering using hierarchies (BIRCH), and bisecting k-means across MRI, ultrasound, and chest X-ray modalities. All clustering techniques were optimised using random search, and cluster quality was assessed using the Silhouette score, the Davies-Bouldin (DB) index, and the Calinski-Harabasz (CH) index. Results demonstrate that standard k-means and bisecting k-means generally achieve strong cluster cohesion and separation across modalities. However, they tend to form a small number of clusters with high intra-cluster variability, limiting their effectiveness for post-processing tasks such as adaptive compression. Agglomerative clustering outperformed other techniques for MRI and ultrasound in terms of intra-cluster homogeneity, making it more suitable for preserving fine diagnostic details. For chest X-rays, mini-batch k-means achieved the best balance between clustering quality and intra-cluster compactness. BIRCH consistently underperformed across all modalities.

中文摘要翻译: 医学影像生成的高分辨率图像带来了存储、传输和计算方面的巨大挑战。虽然低秩矩阵近似（LoRMA）技术通过利用结构冗余提供高效压缩，但全局方法往往无法保留对诊断至关重要的局部细节。本文聚焦于利用非局部自相似性来识别医学影像中结构相似区域的聚类技术，这些聚类可用于自适应图像压缩等后处理任务。我们评估了五种聚类技术：k-means、mini-batch k-means、凝聚层次聚类、基于层次结构的平衡迭代归约与聚类（BIRCH）以及二分k-means，应用于MRI、超声和胸部X光三种模态。所有聚类技术均使用随机搜索进行优化，并使用轮廓系数、Davies-Bouldin指数和Calinski-Harabasz指数评估聚类质量。结果表明，标准k-means和二分k-means通常能在不同模态下实现较强的簇内紧致性和簇间分离性。然而，它们倾向于形成少量具有高簇内变异性的簇，限制了其在自适应压缩等后处理任务中的有效性。凝聚聚类在MRI和超声的簇内同质性方面优于其他技术，因此更适合保留精细的诊断细节。对于胸部X光，mini-batch k-means在聚类质量和簇内紧致性之间取得了最佳平衡。BIRCH在所有模态下始终表现不佳。

</details>


### [231] [Robustness and Stability Analysis of Differentiable Shift-Variant FBP for Cone-Beam CT under Challenging Acquisition Settings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09828)
*Chengze Ye,Linda-Sophie Schneider,Yipeng Sun,Mareike Thies,Siyuan Mei,Paula Andrea Pérez-Toro,Siming Bayer,Andreas Maier*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了可微分移位变体滤波反投影（SV-FBP）框架在非标准锥束CT采集场景下的鲁棒性与适应性，发现在不规则轨迹下重建性能对轨迹顺序不敏感，而主要受采样点空间分布影响；在稀疏视角下计算效率显著优于迭代方法，但在极端欠采样下性能会下降；该框架无需架构修改即可适用于非平面多等中心几何轨迹。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 探究可微分SV-FBP框架在挑战性采集场景（如高度不规则/不连续轨迹、稀疏视角、非平面多等中心几何）下的鲁棒性和适应性，明确其性能边界与局限性，为非标准和机器人CBCT采集提供灵活高效的解决方案。

Method: 采用可微分移位变体滤波反投影（SV-FBP）框架，通过数据驱动方式估计锥束CT重建中的冗余权重，无需解析推导权重方案。系统性地在高度不规则/不连续轨迹、稀疏视角以及Lissajous-saddle等非平面多等中心几何下评估其性能。

Result: (1) 在高度不规则和不连续轨迹下框架保持稳定，重建性能对轨迹顺序/连续性不敏感，主要受采样点空间分布影响；(2) 稀疏视角下，在中等采样密度时重建质量有竞争力，计算速度比迭代方法快一个数量级；(3) 在极端欠采样下因缺乏迭代数据一致性导致性能退化；(4) 无需架构修改即可适用于Lissajous-saddle等非平面多等中心轨迹。

Conclusion: 可微分SV-FBP模型在非标准和机器人CBCT采集场景中是一种灵活高效的解决方案，但对极端欠采样敏感，其行为与局限性为后续研究提供了重要见解。

Original Abstract: The differentiable shift-variant filtered backprojection (SV-FBP) framework enables data-driven estimation of redundancy weights for cone-beam CT reconstruction under general source trajectories, removing the need for analytically derived weighting schemes. In this work, we present a systematic study of the robustness and adaptability of differentiable SV-FBP under challenging acquisition settings. We show that the framework remains stable across highly irregular and discontinuous trajectories, indicating that reconstruction performance is largely insensitive to trajectory ordering or continuity. Instead, the spatial distribution of sampling points plays a more dominant role. Under sparse-view conditions, differentiable SV-FBP achieves competitive reconstruction quality while providing an order-of-magnitude reduction in computation time compared to iterative reconstruction methods at moderate sampling densities. However, we identify a clear transition regime under severe undersampling, where the absence of iterative data consistency leads to performance degradation. Furthermore, we demonstrate that the framework remains applicable to non-planar multi-isocenter geometries, such as Lissajous-saddle trajectories, without requiring architectural modifications. These findings provide new insights into the behavior and limitations of the differentiable SV-FBP model and highlight it as a flexible and efficient solution for non-standard and robotic CBCT acquisition scenarios.

中文摘要翻译: 可微分移位变体滤波反投影（SV-FBP）框架能够通过数据驱动的方式估计锥束CT重建中的冗余权重，适用于一般源轨迹，无需解析推导权重方案。本文系统地研究了可微分SV-FBP在挑战性采集设置下的鲁棒性和适应性。我们表明，该框架在高度不规则和不连续轨迹下保持稳定，表明重建性能在很大程度上对轨迹顺序或连续性不敏感，而采样点的空间分布起着更主导的作用。在稀疏视角条件下，可微分SV-FBP在中等采样密度下实现了有竞争力的重建质量，同时计算时间比迭代重建方法快一个数量级。然而，我们识别出在严重欠采样下的一个明显过渡区域，其中缺乏迭代数据一致性导致性能退化。此外，我们证明该框架无需架构修改即可适用于非平面多等中心几何（如Lissajous-saddle轨迹）。这些发现为可微分SV-FBP模型的行为和局限性提供了新见解，并突显其作为非标准和机器人锥束CT采集场景中一种灵活高效解决方案的潜力。

</details>


### [232] [Tracking Intermittent Particles with Self-Learned Visual Features](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09829)
*Raphael Reme,Victor Piriou,Alison Hanson,Rafael Yuste,Alasdair Newson,Elsa Angelini,Jean-Christophe Olivo-Marin,Thibault Lagache*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种自监督学习视觉特征的方法，结合视觉与位置距离，用于拼接因遮挡或间歇性检测而断裂的粒子轨迹，在 Hydra vulgaris 神经元荧光时间序列数据上实现了高精度拼接，并将误差降低至此前算法的一半。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在时间序列荧光成像中，粒子可能因遮挡或间歇性检测导致跟踪算法将同一粒子的轨迹分裂成多个短轨迹段（tracklets），现有方法无法有效拼接这些断裂轨迹。

Method: 采用自监督学习提取粒子的视觉特征，结合视觉相似度距离与空间位置距离，构建综合距离度量，用于鲁棒地拼接属于同一粒子的不同 tracklets。

Result: 在 Hydra vulgaris 神经元荧光时间序列数据上验证，拼接精度高，且相比此前算法在相同数据上的错误率降低了一半。

Conclusion: 自监督学习的视觉特征能有效辅助粒子轨迹拼接，视觉与位置信息的融合显著提升了拼接鲁棒性，优于此前方法。

Original Abstract: In time-lapse fluorescence imaging, single-particle-tracking is a powerful tool to monitor the dynamics of objects of interest, and extract information about biological processes. However, tracked particles can be subject to occlusion and intermittent detectability. When these phenomena persist over a few frames, tracking algorithms tend to produce multiple tracklets for the same particle. In this work, we introduce self-supervised learning of visual features to compare tracked particles, and we exploit both visual and positional distances to robustly stitch tracklets representing the same particle. We demonstrate the performance of our stitching framework on time-lapse fluorescence sequences of Hydra vulgaris neurons. Results show high stitching precision, and reduction of errors made by previous algorithms on the same data by a factor of two.

中文摘要翻译: 在时间序列荧光成像中，单粒子跟踪是监测目标粒子动态并提取生物过程信息的有力工具。然而，被跟踪的粒子可能受到遮挡和间歇性可检测性的影响。当这些现象持续数帧时，跟踪算法往往会为同一粒子生成多个短轨迹段。在本工作中，我们引入自监督学习来提取视觉特征以比较被跟踪的粒子，并利用视觉距离与位置距离，鲁棒地拼接代表同一粒子的轨迹段。我们在 Hydra vulgaris 神经元的荧光时间序列序列上展示了拼接框架的性能。结果表明，拼接精度高，且相比此前算法在相同数据上的错误率降低了一半。

</details>


### [233] [Slide-Level Active Learning Reduces Annotation Burden in H&E images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09831)
*Mahsa Vali,Zhilong Weng,Noémie Moreaua,Yuri Tolkach,Katarzyna Bozek*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出SHAL，一种面向多类组织病理学分割的切片级混合主动学习框架，通过前景感知、阶段自适应和类别感知三种策略协同，在TCGA结直肠癌数据集上以26%标注预算达到Dice≥0.80，并展现出最佳跨域泛化性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有主动学习方法在组织病理学全切片图像分割中存在三个关键局限：部分标注WSI上的不确定性估计不可靠、补丁级获取与切片级标注流程不一致、多类设置中类别不平衡未被显式处理。因此需要一种更高效的主动学习框架来减少像素级标注成本。

Method: SHAL是一个患者级主动学习框架，包含三个互补组件：(1) 前景感知策略，抑制未标注背景区域的偏差；(2) 阶段自适应机制，在不同学习阶段混合预测熵和认知不确定性；(3) 类别感知策略，优先选择诊断相关的组织类别。

Result: 在TCGA结直肠癌数据集上，SHAL在完整标注预算下达到最高Macro Dice（0.846）；仅用26%预算（50/190张切片）即达到Dice≥0.80，而竞争方法需37%（70张切片）。在五个独立外部队列中，SHAL取得最高平均外部Macro Dice（0.815）和最小的内外泛化差距。

Conclusion: 患者级的混合不确定性获取策略能够有效降低注释成本，同时保持计算病理学中的跨域泛化能力。

Original Abstract: Deep learning-based segmentation of histopathology whole-slide images (WSIs) requires large amounts of pixel-level annotations, which are costly and time-consuming to obtain. Active learning (AL) has been proposed to reduce this effort, but existing methods exhibit three key limitations. Uncertainty estimation is unreliable on partially annotated WSIs, patch-level acquisition is inconsistent with slide-level annotation workflows, and class imbalance in multi-class settings is not explicitly addressed. To address these challenges, we propose SHAL (Slide-level Hybrid Active Learning), a patient-level AL framework for annotation-efficient multi-class histopathology segmentation. SHAL integrates three complementary components: a foreground-aware strategy that suppresses bias from unlabeled background regions, a stage-adaptive mechanism that hybridizes predictive entropy and epistemic uncertainty across learning stages, and a class-aware strategy that prioritizes diagnostically relevant tissue classes. SHAL is evaluated on the TCGA colorectal cancer dataset. It achieves the highest Macro Dice at the full annotation budget (0.846) and reaches Dice greater than or equal to 0.80 using only 26 percent of the budget (50 of 190 slides), whereas competing methods reach this threshold only at 37 percent (70 slides). Across five independent external cohorts, SHAL attains the highest mean external Macro Dice (0.815) and the smallest internal-to-external generalization gap among all methods (0.025 at Round 3 and 0.026 at the full budget). The results indicate that patient-level hybrid uncertainty acquisition reduces annotation cost without sacrificing cross-domain generalization in computational pathology.

中文摘要翻译: 基于深度学习的组织病理学全切片图像（WSI）分割需要大量像素级标注，而这些标注的获取成本高昂且耗时。主动学习（AL）被提出用于减少这一工作量，但现有方法存在三个关键局限：对部分标注的WSI进行不确定性估计不可靠；补丁级获取与切片级标注流程不一致；多类设置中的类别不平衡未被显式处理。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了SHAL（切片级混合主动学习），一个面向注释高效的多类组织病理学分割的患者级主动学习框架。SHAL集成了三个互补组件：前景感知策略，抑制未标注背景区域带来的偏差；阶段自适应机制，在不同学习阶段混合预测熵和认知不确定性；以及类别感知策略，优先选择诊断相关的组织类别。SHAL在TCGA结直肠癌数据集上进行了评估。它在完整标注预算下达到了最高的Macro Dice（0.846），并且仅用26%的预算（190张切片中的50张）即达到了Dice≥0.80，而竞争方法达到该阈值需要37%的预算（70张切片）。在五个独立的外部队列中，SHAL取得了最高的平均外部Macro Dice（0.815）以及所有方法中最小的内部到外部泛化差距（第3轮为0.025，完整预算下为0.026）。结果表明，患者级的混合不确定性获取策略能够降低注释成本，同时不牺牲计算病理学中的跨域泛化能力。

</details>


### [234] [Next-Dense-Stride Prediction for Multimodal Autoregressive Visual Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09892)
*Chicago Y. Park,Jialin Mao,Xiaojian Xu,Taha Kass-Hout,Ulugbek S. Kamilov,Cao Xiao*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: DenseAR提出了一种新的自回归图像生成范式，通过紧凑的单尺度tokenizer实现从粗到细的密集步长预测，避免了逐光栅扫描的低效和多尺度方法的昂贵开销，并在医学和自然图像上取得优异性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有自回归图像生成模型存在两个局限：一是逐光栅扫描顺序导致推理速度慢，二是多尺度方法需要长序列的多分辨率token来实现从粗到细预测，计算成本高昂。DenseAR旨在同时解决这两个问题。

Method: DenseAR将自回归图像生成重新表述为从粗到细的密集步长预测（next-dense-stride prediction）。核心思想是在单尺度潜空间网格上以渐进密集的步长遍历，自然地捕捉从全局结构到局部细节的过渡，从而并行预测多个token，加速推理。

Result: 在多对比度脑MRI上，单个DenseAR模型统一了跨模态翻译、条件生成和肿瘤分割任务，且性能与任务专用方法相当。在ImageNet上，DenseAR在类别条件生成质量（FID和IS指标）上优于不加步长排序的单网格基线和基于多尺度tokenizer的基线。

Conclusion: DenseAR通过紧凑单尺度tokenizer和渐进密集步长预测，在保持自回归建模灵活性的同时，实现了高效、统一的多模态多任务图像生成，验证了其在医学和自然图像领域的有效性。

Original Abstract: We introduce DenseAR, a new generative paradigm that reformulates autoregressive image generation as coarse-to-fine next-dense-stride prediction using a compact single-scale tokenizer. Our key insight is that traversing a single-scale latent grid with progressively denser strides naturally captures the transition from global structure to fine detail. This addresses two limitations of existing autoregressive models at once: the slow inference of raster-order autoregression, which DenseAR avoids by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, and the heavy cost of multi-scale approaches, which need long, multi-resolution token sequences to achieve coarse-to-fine prediction. Building on our efficient framework and the flexibility of autoregressive modeling, we further extend DenseAR to a unified model that handles multiple modalities and imaging tasks within a single backbone. We validate DenseAR on both medical and natural images. On multi-contrast brain MRI, a single DenseAR model unifies cross-modal translation, modality-conditioned generation, and tumor segmentation, while remaining competitive with task-specific methods. On ImageNet, DenseAR improves class-conditional generation quality (FID and IS) over both a single-grid baseline without stride ordering and a multi-scale tokenizer-based baseline.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了DenseAR，一种新的生成范式，它将自回归图像生成重新表述为使用紧凑的单尺度tokenizer进行从粗到细的下一个密集步长预测。我们的关键洞察是，以渐进密集的步长遍历单尺度潜空间网格能够自然地捕捉从全局结构到局部细节的过渡。这同时解决了现有自回归模型的两个局限：逐光栅顺序自回归的推理速度慢（DenseAR通过并行预测多个token避免了这一问题），以及多尺度方法为实现从粗到细预测所需的长序列多分辨率token带来的高昂成本。基于我们高效的框架和自回归建模的灵活性，我们进一步将DenseAR扩展为一个统一模型，能够在单一骨干网络内处理多种模态和成像任务。我们在医学图像和自然图像上验证了DenseAR。在多对比度脑MRI上，单个DenseAR模型统一了跨模态翻译、条件生成和肿瘤分割任务，同时与任务专用方法保持竞争力。在ImageNet上，DenseAR在类别条件生成质量（FID和IS指标）上优于不加步长排序的单网格基线和基于多尺度tokenizer的基线。

</details>


### [235] [Tomo-center: an AI-based rotation-axis center finder for synchrotron micro- and nano-tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09916)
*Songyuan Tang,Xiaoyang Liu,Viktor Nikitin,Alberto Mittone,Samuel J. Clark,Francesco De Carlo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种基于DINOv2视觉Transformer和注意力多实例学习的旋转轴定位方法（tomo-center），在低对比度样品和稀疏/噪声采集条件下均实现亚像素级精度，并已集成到多个断层层析软件包中。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统旋转轴定位方法（如Vo方法）依赖正弦图特征，在低对比度或弱吸收样品上容易失效，因此需要一种对低对比度、稀疏投影和噪声采集更鲁棒的方法。

Method: 将中心选择建模为二分类问题，使用DINOv2预训练的视觉Transformer作为特征提取器，结合基于注意力的多实例学习（Attention-based MIL）进行端到端微调。推理时，在一系列候选中心重建的断层图像堆栈上应用训练好的模型，选择最优中心。

Result: 在两个独立数据源上，平均绝对误差始终低于1像素；投影数减少至原来的1/10或泊松噪声空白扫描因子增加到10时，性能保持稳定；方法具有可解释性，可映射连续空间特征对分类的相对贡献。

Conclusion: 该学习型方法在低对比度、稀疏和噪声条件下显著优于传统方法，已作为开源命令行工具tomo-center发布并集成到多个断层层析软件包，支持常规光束线实验。

Original Abstract: Accurate determination of the rotation-axis position is a prerequisite for artifact-free reconstruction in parallel-beam synchrotron micro-tomography. Traditional approaches such as Vo's method rely on sinogram features that can fail for low-contrast or weakly absorbing specimens. We present a learning-based method that treats center selection as a binary classification problem, using a DINOv2-pretrained vision transformer aggregated with attention-based multiple-instance learning, fine-tuned end-to-end on tomographic images. At inference time, the proposed algorithm was applied to a stack of tomograms reconstructed at a sweep of candidate centers to select the optimal center for reconstruction. We tested the estimation accuracy of the proposed method on two independent data sources and consistently achieved a mean absolute error of below 1 pixel. We also tested the method robustness to sparse or noisy acquisitions with the same datasets and demonstrated consistent performance when the number of projections was reduced by a factor of up to 10 or the blank scan factor of the underlying Poisson's noise was increased to 10. We also illustrated the interpretability of the proposed method by mapping out the relative contributions of continuous spatial features to the overall classification task. This method, delivered as tomo-center, an open-source command-line tool, has been integrated into several tomography software packages to assist experiments during the routine beamline operations.

中文摘要翻译: 精确确定旋转轴位置是平行光束同步辐射显微断层成像中实现无伪影重建的前提。传统方法（如Vo方法）依赖正弦图特征，但对于低对比度或弱吸收样品可能失效。我们提出了一种基于学习的方法，将中心选择视为二分类问题，采用DINOv2预训练的视觉Transformer结合基于注意力的多实例学习，在断层图像上进行端到端微调。在推理阶段，该算法应用于在一系列候选中心下重建的断层图像堆栈，以选择最优重建中心。我们在两个独立数据源上测试了所提方法的估计精度，始终实现低于1像素的平均绝对误差。我们还使用相同数据集测试了该方法对稀疏或噪声采集的鲁棒性，结果表明，当投影数减少至原来的十分之一，或底层的泊松噪声的空白扫描因子增加到10时，模型性能保持一致。我们还通过映射连续空间特征对整体分类任务的相对贡献，展示了所提方法的可解释性。该方法已作为开源命令行工具tomo-center发布，并已集成到多个断层层析软件包中，以辅助常规光束线操作中的实验。

</details>


### [236] [A neuromorphic vision system for open-world visual intelligence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10066)
*Jiankai Yin,Zheng Miao,Lianghao Guo,Cong Li,Shengbo Wang,Hongfu Xu,Weihao Ma,Yuyang Zeng,Yubiao Luo,Yongxiang Li,Saitao Zhang,Arokia Nathan,Luigi Occhipinti,Shuo Gao,Zhong Sun,Xiaoyu Guo*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种受生物视觉和信息瓶颈理论启发的神经形态视觉系统，通过硬件实现的信息蒸馏策略（任务牵引机制），在193μs内完成目标跟踪、分割和轨迹预测等视觉任务，相比现有方法精度提升高达37.73%，延迟降低30.6倍。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前视觉智能方法在非结构化开放环境中面临计算密集、传感器通用性差等挑战，缺乏兼具时间高效性和鲁棒性的解决方案。

Method: 构建了偏振敏感成像器与RRAM阵列集成的神经形态视觉系统，通过光场选择、感兴趣区域提取和目标预测三个渐进阶段实现任务相关信息蒸馏（任务牵引机制）。

Result: 在8个开放场景中，目标跟踪精度提升25.54%，目标分割提升37.73%，轨迹预测提升36.10%，执行时间仅193μs，延迟相比最优方法平均降低30.6倍。

Conclusion: 该神经形态视觉系统通过硬件实现的任务牵引机制，实现了极低延迟与高精度的视觉智能，为开放环境下的实时视觉应用提供了有效方案。

Original Abstract: Time-efficient and robust visual intelligence remains a critical challenge in unstructured open-world environments, yet current approaches often rely on computationally intensive neural architectures or task-specific sensors with limited versatility. Inspired by biological vision and information bottleneck theory, we report a neuromorphic vision system that performs task-oriented visual intelligence through an information distillation strategy (named as task traction mechanism) implemented on hardware. The system integrates a polarization-sensitive imager with a resistive random-access memory (RRAM) array to progressively distill task-relevant information via light field selection, region of interest extraction, and target anticipation. The neuromorphic vision system conducts visual tasks within an execution time of 193 μs. Evaluation across eight challenging open-world scenarios shows accuracy improvements of 25.54%, 37.73%, and 36.10% for object tracking, object segmentation, and trajectory prediction, respectively, together with an average 30.6-fold reduction in latency relative to state-of-the-art solutions.

中文摘要翻译: 在非结构化的开放环境中，实现时间高效且鲁棒的视觉智能仍然是一个关键挑战，而当前方法往往依赖计算密集的神经架构或通用性有限的任务专用传感器。受生物视觉与信息瓶颈理论的启发，本文报道了一种神经形态视觉系统，该系统通过硬件实现的信息蒸馏策略（称为任务牵引机制）来执行面向任务的视觉智能。该系统集成了偏振敏感成像器与电阻式随机存取存储器阵列，通过光场选择、感兴趣区域提取和目标预测逐步蒸馏任务相关信息。该神经形态视觉系统在193 μs的执行时间内完成视觉任务。在8个具有挑战性的开放世界场景中的评估表明，该系统在目标跟踪、目标分割和轨迹预测上的精度分别提升了25.54%、37.73%和36.10%，同时相对于现有最优方案，延迟平均降低了30.6倍。

</details>


### [237] [Differentiable Proxy Learning for Adaptive Quantization Control in H.264 Video Coding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10478)
*Qihan Xu,Ivan V. Bajić*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出一种针对H.264帧内编码器的可微分代理学习方法，通过软索引机制实现QP梯度优化，并基于此构建自适应量化框架，在感知优化和机器视觉任务上均取得显著BD-rate降低。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: H.264等标准视频编码器不可微，难以直接通过梯度方法优化码率控制参数（如QP）以适配感知质量或机器视觉等特定目标；现有可微分代理方法对目标编码器的保真度缺乏显式刻画。

Method: 基于变速率学习压缩模型构建可微分代理，通过软索引机制使其对QP可微；分别针对全局QP（每图一个QP）和空间QP（宏块级QP）两种量化设置，训练代理逼近H.264的率失真行为；利用冻结的代理构建自适应量化（AQ）框架，用于感知优化和机器视觉任务。

Result: 所提代理紧密逼近H.264帧内编码器的率失真行为；相比于固定QP基线，代理AQ框架在语义分割任务上实现最高17.12%的BD-rate降低，在MS-SSIM上实现15.30%的BD-rate降低。

Conclusion: 提出的可微分代理学习方法能有效逼近H.264帧内编码器，并基于此构建的自适应量化框架在率-任务权衡上显著优于固定QP基线。

Original Abstract: H.264 has been the most widely used video coding format for the past two decades due to its relative simplicity, efficiency, and wide availability of software and hardware implementations. However, optimizing codec parameters such as the quantization parameter (QP) for specific objectives (e.g., perceptual quality or machine vision tasks) is challenging due to the non-differentiable nature of standard video codecs. While differentiable proxies have recently been used to enable gradient-based optimization around standard codecs, their fidelity to the target codec is rarely explicitly characterized. In this paper, we propose a differentiable proxy learning method for H.264 intra codec to enable adaptive quantization control. Built upon a variable-rate learned compression model, the proposed proxy is made differentiable with respect to codec QP through a soft-indexing mechanism. It is then trained to approximate the rate-distortion behavior of H.264 under two quantization settings: global-QP, which uses one QP per image, and spatial-QP, which assigns QPs at the macroblock level. Using the frozen trained proxy, we develop a proxy-based adaptive quantization (AQ) framework for both perceptual optimization and machine vision tasks. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed proxies closely approximate the rate-distortion behavior of H.264 intra codec. The resulting proxy-based AQ framework consistently improves rate-task trade-offs over fixed-QP H.264 baselines, achieving BD-rate reduction of up to 17.12% for semantic segmentation and 15.30% for MS-SSIM.

中文摘要翻译: H.264因其相对简单、高效以及软硬件实现的广泛可用性，在过去二十年中一直是最广泛使用的视频编码格式。然而，由于标准视频编码器的不可微性质，针对特定目标（如感知质量或机器视觉任务）优化编码器参数（如量化参数QP）具有挑战性。虽然最近已有工作利用可微分代理实现对标准编码器周围基于梯度的优化，但这些代理对目标编码器的保真度鲜有显式刻画。本文针对H.264帧内编码器提出一种可微分代理学习方法，以实现自适应量化控制。该代理基于变速率学习压缩模型构建，通过软索引机制使其对编码器QP可微，然后训练代理逼近H.264在两种量化设置下的率失真行为：全局QP（每张图像使用一个QP）和空间QP（在宏块级别分配QP）。利用冻结训练好的代理，我们开发了基于代理的自适应量化（AQ）框架，用于感知优化和机器视觉任务。实验结果表明，所提出的代理紧密逼近H.264帧内编码器的率失真行为。基于该代理的AQ框架在率-任务权衡上持续优于固定QP的H.264基线，在语义分割任务上实现了最高17.12%的BD-rate降低，在MS-SSIM上实现了15.30%的BD-rate降低。

</details>


### [238] [Projection-Domain Sensitivity Analysis of Vertebral DRRs Under Intrinsic Calibration Perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10551)
*Lin Li,Chaochao Zhou,Benjamin Aubert,Junlin Guo,Junchao Zhu*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本文研究了在荧光透视引导的脊柱成像中，内参标定扰动如何影响投影域一致性（如椎骨投影几何、轮廓形态和2D-3D配准精度），发现侧位投影比正位投影更敏感，且投影域一致性可作为传统重建指标的重要补充。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 尽管内参标定质量通常用重投影误差等重建指标评估，但其对投影域一致性的影响尚不清楚。本文旨在系统评估内参标定扰动对椎骨透视投影和下游配准性能的影响。

Method: 使用CT导出的椎骨模型和受控锥束成像几何，在保持相同解剖结构和采集姿态的条件下，生成具有真实内参和扰动内参的数字重建放射影像（DRR）。通过解剖标志位移、轮廓距离、轮廓重叠、图像相似度和基于标志点的2D-3D配准精度来量化投影域变化。

Result: 即使是小的内参标定扰动也会导致椎骨投影几何、轮廓形态、标志点定位和DRR外观的显著变化。敏感性具有强烈的视图依赖性：侧位（LAT）投影比正位（AP）投影表现出更大的形变和位移。这些投影不一致性会降低下游2D-3D配准性能，尤其是旋转对齐精度。

Conclusion: 投影域一致性是对传统重建标定指标的重要补充，为评估标定鲁棒性提供了实用框架。该方法可提高图像引导脊柱应用中DRR生成和荧光透视引导椎骨配准的可靠性。

Original Abstract: Accurate geometric calibration is essential for fluoroscopy-guided spinal imaging, digitally reconstructed radiograph (DRR) generation, and 2D--3D vertebral registration. Although calibration quality is typically evaluated using reconstruction-based metrics such as reprojection error, its influence on projection-domain consistency remains poorly understood. This study presents a synthetic framework for evaluating how intrinsic calibration perturbations affect vertebral fluoroscopic projections and downstream registration performance.
  CT-derived vertebral models and controlled cone-beam imaging geometry were used to generate DRRs with both ground-truth and perturbed intrinsic calibration parameters while maintaining identical anatomy and acquisition pose. Projection-domain changes were quantified using anatomical landmark displacement, contour distance, silhouette overlap, image similarity, and landmark-based 2D--3D registration accuracy in anterior--posterior (AP) and lateral (LAT) views.
  Results show that even small intrinsic calibration perturbations produce measurable changes in vertebral projection geometry, contour morphology, landmark localization, and DRR appearance. Sensitivity is strongly view dependent, with LAT projections exhibiting substantially greater deformation and anatomical displacement than AP projections. These projection inconsistencies also degrade downstream 2D--3D registration, particularly rotational alignment accuracy.
  The findings demonstrate that projection-domain consistency complements conventional reconstruction-based calibration metrics and provides a practical framework for assessing calibration robustness. This approach may improve the reliability of DRR generation and fluoroscopy-guided vertebral registration in image-guided spinal applications.

中文摘要翻译: 精确的几何标定对于荧光透视引导的脊柱成像、数字重建放射影像（DRR）生成以及2D-3D椎骨配准至关重要。尽管标定质量通常使用重投影误差等基于重建的指标进行评估，但其对投影域一致性的影响尚不清楚。本研究提出了一种合成框架，用于评估内参标定扰动如何影响椎骨透视投影及下游配准性能。我们使用CT导出的椎骨模型和受控锥束成像几何，在保持相同解剖结构和采集姿态的条件下，生成了具有真实内参和扰动内参的DRR。通过正位（AP）和侧位（LAT）视图中的解剖标志位移、轮廓距离、轮廓重叠、图像相似度以及基于标志点的2D-3D配准精度来量化投影域变化。结果表明，即使是小的内参标定扰动也会导致椎骨投影几何、轮廓形态、标志点定位和DRR外观的显著变化。敏感性具有强烈的视图依赖性，侧位投影比正位投影表现出更大的形变和解剖位移。这些投影不一致性还会降低下游2D-3D配准性能，尤其是旋转对齐精度。研究结果证明，投影域一致性是对传统重建标定指标的重要补充，并为评估标定鲁棒性提供了实用框架。该方法有望提高图像引导脊柱应用中DRR生成和荧光透视引导椎骨配准的可靠性。

</details>


### [239] [MUX-USCT: A Noise-Robust Neural Network for Ultrasound Computed Tomography](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10648)
*Yuchen Yuan,Hanhan Wu,Jinyang Li,Hanchen Wang,Yixuan Wu,Youzuo Lin,Lei Yang*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 提出MUX-USCT，一种具有自适应多路复用器的编码器-解码器架构，用于在临床噪声环境下实现鲁棒的超声计算机断层扫描重建，在OpenPros基准上达到6.88 m/s MAE且参数减少17%。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有DNN在无噪声环境中表现良好，但在临床实践中对轻度、中度和重度噪声缺乏鲁棒性，且噪声分布随环境变化，使噪声感知训练效果不佳。作者希望通过识别并过滤噪声源来提升模型鲁棒性。

Method: 提出MUX-USCT编码器-解码器架构，将已知声学采集几何编码为"自适应MUX"，能够自动识别和过滤噪声；在重建声速图时引入注意力机制。

Result: 在OpenPros基准上，MUX-USCT达到6.88 m/s MAE，比领先基线（7.65 m/s MAE）参数减少17%；在模拟临床噪声下，模型在多种退化类型中保持稳定，而几何无关基线则失败；注意力分布可提供传感器对之间信号质量的可解释指标。

Conclusion: MUX-USCT通过自适应MUX机制有效提升了DNN在临床噪声环境下的鲁棒性，参数效率更高，且注意力机制提供了可解释性的信号质量指标。

Original Abstract: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have shown strong potential for ultrasound computed tomography (USCT) reconstruction in ideal noise-free environments, yet existing DNNs are vulnerable to the noisy conditions in clinical practice, as they equally treat inputs that suffer mild, moderate, or severe noise. More challenging, the distributions of noise shift along with the environment, indicating the less effectiveness of noise-aware training, which injects a specific noise distribution into the training data. We rethink these challenges and observe that the DNN models can become more robust to noise if we know the noise sources and filter them out. This filtering operation is very alike the Multiplexers (or MUX), a fundamental combinational circuit in digital logic design. However, the challenge here is that noise can happen randomly during inference; as a result, the manually predefined MUX cannot work. To address these challenges, we propose MUX-USCT, a novel encoder-decoder DNN architecture that encodes the known acoustic acquisition geometry with an "adaptive MUX" that can automatically identify and filter noise, where the attention mechanism is applied in reconstructing the speed-of-sound map. On the OpenPros benchmark, MUX-USCT reaches 6.88 m/s MAE with 17% fewer parameters than the leading baseline with 7.65 m/s of MAE. Under simulated clinical noise, it remains stable across diverse degradation types that cause geometry-agnostic baselines to fail. Results show that the attention distributions in MUX-USCT provide interpretable indicators of the signal quality between pairs of transducers.

中文摘要翻译: 深度神经网络（DNN）在理想无噪声环境中展现出超声计算机断层扫描（USCT）重建的强大潜力，然而现有DNN在临床实践的噪声条件下表现脆弱，因为它们对遭受轻度、中度或重度噪声的输入一视同仁。更具挑战性的是，噪声分布随环境变化，这表明将特定噪声分布注入训练数据的噪声感知训练方法效果有限。我们重新思考这些挑战，观察到如果能够识别噪声源并将其滤除，DNN模型对噪声的鲁棒性可以显著提升。这种滤波操作非常类似于数字逻辑设计中的基本组合电路——多路复用器（MUX）。然而，挑战在于噪声在推理过程中可能随机发生，因此手动预定义的MUX无法工作。为应对这些挑战，我们提出MUX-USCT，一种新颖的编码器-解码器DNN架构，它将已知声学采集几何编码为"自适应MUX"，可以自动识别并过滤噪声，其中注意力机制被用于重建声速图。在OpenPros基准上，MUX-USCT达到6.88 m/s的平均绝对误差（MAE），参数比领先基线（7.65 m/s MAE）减少17%。在模拟临床噪声下，它在导致几何无关基线失效的多种退化类型中保持稳定。结果表明，MUX-USCT中的注意力分布提供了传感器对之间信号质量的可解释性指标。

</details>


### [240] [Diffusion MRI preprocessing affects ADC estimation and automatic PI-RADS v2.1 classification in bi-parametric prostate MRI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11385)
*Christos Kanakis,Mathias Perslev,Tim Schakel,Silvia Ingala,Akshay Pai,Dennis Klomp,Chantal M. W. Tax*

Main category: eess.IV

TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了不同的弥散加权成像（DWI）预处理策略（去噪、吉布斯振铃校正、配准畸变校正）对前列腺MRI中表观弥散系数（ADC）估计和自动PI-RADS分类的影响，发现预处理尤其是畸变校正能显著提升ADC图质量和深度学习模型的分类性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: DWI预处理在脑成像中已是标准流程，但在前列腺成像中应用有限且缺乏标准化流程。本研究旨在探究不同DWI预处理策略对ADC估计和自动PI-RADS分类的影响，以推动前列腺MRI优化预处理管道的建立。

Method: 从fastMRI前列腺队列中选取268例病例，依次应用去噪、吉布斯振铃校正和微分同胚配准进行畸变校正。使用线性最小二乘（LLS）和迭代加权LLS（IWLLS）比较ADC图。采用3分类DenseNet分类器，从多通道MRI输入中预测PI-RADS评分。

Result: 不同预处理管道间的ADC分析存在统计显著差异，LLS与IWLLS生成数值等价的ADC图；多数数据集间ADC值呈线性关系（PCC~0.99），畸变校正使DWI与T2w解剖对齐并改变了ADC值（PCC~0.90）；完全预处理的数据集在高风险PI-RADS类别上取得了最佳AUROC和灵敏度，且假阴性分析显示其对高风险类别产生最少的过度自信错误预测。

Conclusion: DWI预处理（尤其是畸变校正）能增强ADC图质量和深度学习模型对PI-RADS分类的预测能力，支持在前列腺MRI中建立优化预处理管道的必要性。

Original Abstract: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) is acquired as part of bi-parametric prostate MRI, but suffers from artifacts that degrade downstream quantitative and diagnostic performance. While DWI preprocessing is standard in brain imaging, its adoption in prostate imaging remains limited and lacks standardized pipelines. This study investigated the effect of different DWI preprocessing strategies on apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) estimation and automatic Prostate Imaging Reporting and Data System (PI-RADS) classification. 268 cases were derived from the fastMRI prostate cohort by sequentially applying denoising, Gibbs-ringing correction, and diffeomorphic registration for susceptibility distortion correction. ADC maps were compared using linear least squares (LLS) and iteratively-weighted LLS (IWLLS). A 3-class DenseNet classifier was trained to predict PI-RADS scores from multi-channel MRI inputs. ADC analysis revealed statistically significant differences across preprocessing pipelines, with LLS and IWLLS producing numerically equivalent maps. Linear relationships between ADC values were preserved across most datasets (PCC ~0.99), while distortion correction realigned DWI to T2w anatomy and altered ADC values accordingly (PCC ~0.90). Classification showed the best AUROC and sensitivity for high-risk PI-RADS classes in the fully processed dataset. False-negative analysis revealed this dataset produced the least overconfident incorrect predictions on high-risk classes, which is a desirable property for clinical triage. DWI preprocessing, particularly distortion correction, enhances both ADC map quality and the predictive power of deep learning models for PI-RADS classification, supporting the need for optimized preprocessing pipelines in prostate MRI.

中文摘要翻译: 弥散加权成像（DWI）作为双参数前列腺MRI的一部分被采集，但容易受到伪影的影响，从而降低下游定量分析和诊断性能。虽然DWI预处理在脑成像中已是标准流程，但其在前列腺成像中的应用仍然有限，且缺乏标准化流程。本研究探究了不同DWI预处理策略对表观弥散系数（ADC）估计和自动前列腺影像报告与数据系统（PI-RADS）分类的影响。从fastMRI前列腺队列中选取268例病例，依次应用去噪、吉布斯振铃校正和微分同胚配准进行磁敏感畸变校正。使用线性最小二乘（LLS）和迭代加权LLS（IWLLS）对ADC图进行比较。训练了一个3分类DenseNet分类器，用于从多通道MRI输入中预测PI-RADS评分。ADC分析显示，不同预处理管道之间存在统计显著差异，而LLS和IWLLS生成了数值等价的ADC图。大多数数据集之间ADC值保持线性关系（皮尔逊相关系数~0.99），而畸变校正使DWI与T2w解剖结构对齐，并相应地改变了ADC值（皮尔逊相关系数~0.90）。分类结果显示，完全预处理的数据集在高风险PI-RADS类别上取得了最佳的曲线下面积（AUROC）和灵敏度。假阴性分析表明，该数据集对高风险类别产生了最少的过度自信错误预测，这是临床分诊中所期望的特性。DWI预处理（尤其是畸变校正）既能增强ADC图质量，也能提升深度学习模型对PI-RADS分类的预测能力，这支持了在前列腺MRI中建立优化预处理管道的需求。

</details>

### [241] [Emergent Generalization by Representation Learning in Artificial Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10430)
*Hardik Rajpal,Dan Goodman*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文通过信息瓶颈约束循环神经网络学习低维表征，发现该表征对于时间序列预测中的旋转泛化和分布外泛化至关重要，并揭示了从记忆到泛化转变过程中因果涌现动力学的非单调轨迹。在老鼠海马CA1区实验中也观察到类似模式，表明学习紧凑、分布式且涌现的表征对泛化具有功能优势。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 低维神经流形在降维分析中被广泛使用，但这类低维表征是否具有生物学相关性并在学习系统中赋予功能优势，还是仅仅反映神经元层面的活动，这一争议在神经科学中尚未解决。

Method: 在循环神经网络中引入显式信息瓶颈（Information Bottleneck），强制学习低维表征；使用因果涌现（Causal Emergence）的信息论度量表征动态；通过时间序列预测任务测试旋转泛化和分布外泛化；并在老鼠海马CA1区的迷宫任务数据中验证。

Result: 低维表征对旋转泛化和分布外泛化是必要的；因果涌现动力学呈现非单调轨迹（先降后升再达最大值），且与任务复杂度相关；涌现结构的幅度可可靠预测泛化性能；小鼠CA1海马活动中观察到类似的非单调涌现动力学，且与行为表现相关。

Conclusion: 神经网络学习紧凑、分布式和涌现的表征能力赋予泛化功能优势，支持学习表征在认知中具有因果作用。

Original Abstract: Dimensionality reduction has proven powerful for identifying neural manifolds, which are low-dimensional structures underlying high-dimensional neural activity. These low-dimensional representations have improved the interpretability of population-level coding. Yet whether such low-dimensional representations are biologically relevant and confer functional advantages in learning systems, or merely reflect neuron-level activity, remains contested in neuroscience. We show that an explicit information bottleneck forcing a recurrent neural network to learn a low-dimensional representation is necessary for rotational and out-of-distribution generalisation in a time-series prediction task. Using information-theoretic measures of causal emergence, we characterise the dynamics of this representation across the memorisation-to-generalisation transition, finding a non-monotonic trajectory which shows an initial decrease, a minimum, and a subsequent rise to a maximum, even as prediction loss falls monotonically. This trajectory scales with task complexity, and the magnitude of emergent structure reliably predicts generalisation performance. Analysis of CA1 hippocampal activity in mice learning an alternating maze task reveals analogous non-monotonic emergence dynamics that track behavioural performance. Together, these findings indicate that the ability of neural networks to learn compact, distributed and emergent representations confers a functional advantage for generalisation, supporting a causal role for learned representations in cognition.

中文摘要翻译: 降维已被证明是识别神经流形的强有力工具，神经流形是隐藏在高维神经活动背后的低维结构。这些低维表征提高了群体水平编码的可解释性。然而，这类低维表征是否具有生物学相关性并在学习系统中赋予功能优势，抑或仅仅是神经元层面活动的反映，这在神经科学中仍存在争议。我们证明，在时间序列预测任务中，迫使循环神经网络通过显式信息瓶颈学习低维表征对于旋转泛化和分布外泛化是必要的。利用因果涌现的信息论度量，我们刻画了该表征从记忆到泛化转变过程中的动力学特征，发现了一个非单调的轨迹：即使预测损失单调下降，该轨迹仍先下降、经过最小值，再上升至最大值。这一轨迹随任务复杂度缩放，且涌现结构的幅度可靠地预测了泛化性能。对学习交替迷宫任务的小鼠CA1海马活动分析揭示了类似的非单调涌现动力学，且该动力学与行为表现相关。这些发现共同表明，神经网络学习紧凑、分布式和涌现表征的能力赋予了泛化功能优势，支持了学习表征在认知中的因果作用。

</details>


### [242] [Learning the Brain's Dynamics as a Port-Hamiltonian System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10439)
*Dibakar Sigdel*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 将脑皮层活动建模为port-Hamiltonian系统，结合保守互联与耗散端口，使用度量积分数值积分器和涨落-耗散噪声通道，在真实EEG数据上达到低测试MSE，通过三类标度无关临界性检验，并能在闭环神经调控中恢复失同步输入的相位锁定。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有BCI解码器缺乏对神经动力学生理约束（如能量守恒、耗散与临界性）的显式建模，导致解码鲁棒性和生物合理性不足。作者希望构建一个结构保持的神经动力学模型，能够同时捕捉脑皮层系统的保守与耗散行为，并生成符合生理特性的闭环调控信号。

Method: 将运动皮层在BCI任务中的动力学建模为port-Hamiltonian系统：保守部分采用神经相量之间的陀螺耦合，耗散端口由GNN代理驱动的幂律能量衰减实现。使用度量积分数值积分器演化相量状态，引入涨落-耗散一致性噪声通道生成体温下的随机轨迹。在PhysioNet EEGMMIDB数据集上训练，使用3名留出被试进行测试。

Result: 在真实EEG周期上训练后测试MSE达到指定值（\FitTestMSE），通过了三项标度无关临界性检验：近临界分支比（σ≈1）、1/f幂律谱、长程DFA相关性。生成的闭环神经调控信号能够在硅基实验中恢复失同步输入信号的相位锁定。

Conclusion: 该pHS模型兼具生物合理性与预测精度，为设计结构保持的BCI解码器提供了新路径，有望提升闭环神经调控的稳定性和有效性。

Original Abstract: We model human motor cortex during a wrist-extension BCI task as a port-Hamiltonian system (pHS): a conservative interconnection (gyroscopic coupling between neural phasors) plus a dissipative port (power-law energy decay driven by a GNN surrogate). A metriplectic integrator evolves the phasor state; a Fluctuation--Dissipation-consistent noise channel produces stochastic trajectories at body temperature. Training on \FitTrainN\ real EEG cycles (PhysioNet EEGMMIDB, 3 held-out subjects) reaches a test MSE of \FitTestMSE\ and passes three scale-free criticality rungs: near-critical branching ratio ($σ\approx1$), $1/f$ power-law spectrum, and long-range DFA correlations. The model generates closed-loop neuromodulation signals that restore phase-locking in silico when applied to de-synchronised inputs, suggesting a path toward structure-preserving BCI decoders.

中文摘要翻译: 我们将人类在腕伸展BCI任务中的运动皮层活动建模为port-Hamiltonian系统（pHS）：一个保守互联（神经相量之间的陀螺耦合）加上一个耗散端口（由GNN代理驱动的幂律能量衰减）。采用度量积分数值积分器演化相量状态；涨落-耗散一致性噪声通道产生体温下的随机轨迹。在\FitTrainN\个真实EEG周期（PhysioNet EEGMMIDB，3名留出被试）上训练后，测试MSE达到\FitTestMSE\，并通过了三个标度无关临界性阶梯：近临界分支比（σ≈1）、1/f幂律谱以及长程DFA相关性。该模型生成的闭环神经调控信号在应用于失同步输入时能够在硅基实验中恢复相位锁定，这为结构保持的BCI解码器指明了一条可行路径。

</details>


### [243] [Fast Whole-Brain, Geometry-Aware Functional Alignment for Cross-Subject Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10931)
*Pierre-Louis Barbarant,Florent Meyniel,Bertrand Thirion*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 提出一种名为SpectralOT的新型fMRI功能对齐方法，通过将皮层几何嵌入Laplace-Beltrami特征模态来正则化对齐，平衡功能特征对齐与解剖结构保留，并保持计算效率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 大脑反应模式的个体间差异限制了跨个体泛化的解码器开发，现有功能对齐方法需要在功能特征对齐、解剖结构保留和计算效率之间取得平衡。

Method: 提出SpectralOT方法，将皮层几何嵌入到Laplace-Beltrami特征模态中，并结合功能数据来正则化功能对齐过程。

Result: （文中未提供具体实验结果细节）该方法在功能特征对齐与解剖结构保留之间取得了更好的平衡，同时保持了计算效率。

Conclusion: SpectralOT通过引入Laplace-Beltrami特征模态作为正则化约束，能够有效平衡功能对齐、解剖保留和计算效率，为跨个体fMRI解码提供了可行的功能对齐方案。

Original Abstract: Decoding brain activity is useful for characterizing brain processes and understanding the functional architecture underlying cognition. However, the inter-individual variability in brain response patterns limits the development of decoders that generalize across individuals. A solution to this challenge is functional alignment: aligning functional data across individuals before training population-level decoders. The core issue is to strike the balance between aligning functional features and preserving the anatomical structure, while maintaining computational efficiency. We introduce a new functional alignment method for fMRI, SpectralOT, that embeds cortical geometry into Laplace-Beltrami eigenmodes along functional data to regularize the alignment.

中文摘要翻译: 解码大脑活动对于表征脑过程和理解认知背后的功能架构非常有用。然而，大脑反应模式的个体间差异限制了能够跨个体泛化解码器的开发。解决这一挑战的方案是功能对齐：在训练群体水平解码器之前，对齐个体间的功能数据。核心问题在于平衡功能特征对齐与解剖结构保留，同时保持计算效率。我们提出了一种新的fMRI功能对齐方法SpectralOT，该方法将皮层几何嵌入到Laplace-Beltrami特征模态中，并结合功能数据来正则化对齐过程。

</details>


### [244] [Imputation-free transformer learning enables robust Alzheimer's disease prediction and calibrated uncertainty quantification across heterogeneous clinical cohorts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11656)
*Christelle Schneuwly Diaz,Narmina Baghirova,Duy-Thanh Vu,Duy-Cat Can,Gilles Allali,Philippe Ryvlin,Oliver Y. Chén*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 提出NITROGEN，一种免插值Transformer模型，通过掩码自注意力和跨样本注意力联合建模患者内部特征依赖与患者间关系结构，直接在部分观测数据上进行鲁棒多模态学习，实现阿尔茨海默病的准确诊断分类和严重程度预测，并在校准性、可解释性和跨队列可靠性方面优于传统方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 真实世界临床数据的不完整性和异质性阻碍了阿尔茨海默病的准确诊断分类和疾病严重程度预测。传统插补策略会引入系统性偏差、扭曲特征间关系并产生过度自信的预测，这些问题在诊断场景中尤为严重。

Method: 提出NITROGEN，一种免插值Transformer，通过掩码注意力（masked attention）建模患者内部特征依赖，通过跨样本注意力（intersample attention）建模患者间关系结构，从而直接从不完整观测数据中进行鲁棒的多模态学习。

Result: 在ADNI上训练，在OASIS-3和AIBL两个独立队列上评估。NITROGEN在诊断和认知评分预测任务中，在校准性和不确定性量化方面优于树集成方法，同时保持具有竞争力的判别性能。跨队列和跨方法分析识别出颞极皮层厚度、年龄和APOE基因型是重要但非充分的特征。

Conclusion: 免插值注意力学习能在队列偏移下保持有意义的判别能力，揭示了在分布差异更大的队列上预期性能退化。评估模型时不仅要考虑准确率，还需关注校准性、可解释性和跨队列可靠性，这对临床部署至关重要。

Original Abstract: Accurate diagnostic classification and disease-severity prediction for Alzheimer's disease are hampered by the incompleteness and heterogeneity of real-world clinical data. Left unaddressed, these barriers prevent reliable disease modelling and hinder effective clinical evaluation. Conventional imputation strategies introduce systematic bias, distort inter-feature relationships, and yield overconfident predictions, limitations especially consequential in diagnostic settings. Here, we propose NITROGEN, an imputation-free transformer that jointly models within-patient feature dependencies and between-patient relational structure through masked and intersample attention, enabling robust multimodal learning directly from partially observed records. We trained NITROGEN on ADNI (N=7858 scans), and evaluated it on two independent cohorts: OASIS-3 (N=2675 scans) and AIBL (N=1286 scans). Across cohorts and diagnostic and cognitive score prediction tasks, NITROGEN showed robust calibration and uncertainty quantification advantages over tree-based ensemble methods, while maintaining competitive discriminative performance. Cross-cohort and cross-method analyses identified cortical thickness in the temporal pole, age, and APOE genotype as important, though not individually sufficient, features for AD classification. We further introduced a modality-aware uncertainty adjustment that augments predictive uncertainty proportionally to the importance of absent modalities, enabling calibrated confidence when diagnostic information is unavailable. Together, our results show that imputation-free attention learning preserved meaningful discrimination under cohort shift, revealing expected degradation on more distributionally different cohorts, and demonstrate that evaluating models along calibration, interpretability, and cross-cohort reliability, not accuracy alone, is essential for clinical deployment.

中文摘要翻译: 阿尔茨海默病的准确诊断分类和疾病严重程度预测受到真实世界临床数据不完整性和异质性的阻碍。若不加以解决，这些障碍将阻碍可靠的疾病建模并影响有效的临床评估。传统插补策略引入系统性偏差、扭曲特征间关系并产生过度自信的预测，这些局限在诊断场景中尤为严重。本文提出NITROGEN，一种免插值Transformer，通过掩码注意力和跨样本注意力联合建模患者内部特征依赖和患者间关系结构，实现直接从部分观测记录中进行鲁棒的多模态学习。我们在ADNI（N=7858次扫描）上训练NITROGEN，并在两个独立队列OASIS-3（N=2675次扫描）和AIBL（N=1286次扫描）上进行评估。在跨队列的诊断和认知评分预测任务中，NITROGEN在校准性和不确定性量化方面优于树集成方法，同时保持具有竞争力的判别性能。跨队列和跨方法分析识别出颞极皮层厚度、年龄和APOE基因型是阿尔茨海默病分类中重要但非单独充分的特征。我们进一步引入了一种模态感知的不确定性调整方法，该方法根据缺失模态的重要性成比例地增强预测不确定性，从而在诊断信息不可用时实现校准后的置信度。综合而言，我们的结果表明，免插值注意力学习能在队列偏移下保持有意义的判别能力，揭示了在分布差异更大的队列上预期的性能退化，并证明评估模型时不仅要考虑准确率，还需关注校准性、可解释性和跨队列可靠性，这对临床部署至关重要。

</details>

### [245] [The Singularity Space: A Generative Diffusion Framework for Signal Representation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10930)
*Eli Bar-Yosef,Amir Averbuch,Eli Turkel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Summary generation failed

<details>

Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Original Abstract: Generative models often represent signals as dense grids of amplitudes, blurring sharp transients that are crucial for the correctness of physical signals. We introduce Singularity Space, a generative framework that represents signals through complex-plane singularities, rooted in the classical pole-residue representation of meromorphic functions. We learn a latent space of physically constrained, per-signal singularity configurations to solve an inverse problem from degraded or partial observations. The framework has three key properties: interpretability, in which each generated singularity configuration corresponds to a set of physical parameters; structural stability, which mitigates Gibbs artifacts at discontinuities; and resolution-free output reconstruction on arbitrary grids without retraining or interpolation. Our framework employs a transformer-based diffusion model that directly predicts samples at complex-plane singularity coordinates, subject to geometric constraints during sampling. As a controlled test case for sharp-feature recovery, we evaluate our framework on 1D Burgers shocks, where each shock is represented by 32 predicted singularities (an $8\times$ reduction versus a 1024-point grid signal). Our framework preserves signal structure ($\text{TV ratio} \approx 1$) under unseen test-time observation noise, achieves a $4.2\times$ lower reconstruction error in zero-shot sub-resolution generalization than a grid-based baseline, and recovers physical parameters to $10^{-4}$ absolute error in-distribution. These results suggest that singularity-based representations may provide a practical foundation for other transient-dominated signals such as speech and biomedical signals, with potential extension to higher-dimensional domains.

Original Abstract: Deep learning for EEG-based seizure detection faces critical challenges: severe annotation scarcity and extreme class imbalance, where ictal events comprise less than 10\% of clinical recordings. We present DiffEEG, a 9.6M-parameter self-supervised foundation model that addresses both limitations through denoising diffusion pre-training and reinforcement learning (RL)-based fine-tuning. We ask what happens when this assumption is violated. This paper proposes a hybrid search framework that combines Thompson sampling with parallel self-avoiding walks to adaptively allocate computational effort across restriction classes of the LABS search space. The surrounding context hardly matters either: across every multi-file instance in Verified, under a protocol frozen before any data, rendering a file's remainder as UML skeletons and signatures resolves no more issues than deleting that remainder outright ($N{=}70$, exact McNemar $p{=}0.75$). That was our registered hypothesis, and it failed. Compressed context, meanwhile, matches whole files at a third of the tokens: a resolved issue costs $19$K context tokens, not $94$K. The instrument also yielded a finding the field should keep: temperature-0 API inference flips ${\sim}9\%$ of per-instance outcomes between byte-identical runs. That is a noise floor under every small effect reported on this benchmark, including ours. We release the instrument -- gold-validated environments, per-instance proof that every reference edit is expressible from every arm's context, deterministic patch construction, and pre-registered hypotheses whose nulls we publish.

Original Abstract: Model distillation -- training on outputs from stronger third-party models -- is widely used to boost performance, but raises concerns about unfair advantages and policy violations. This motivates a fundamental question: can we detect whether a model was distilled from another? We show that, while identifying a teacher model from a student in isolation is highly challenging, it becomes tractable in a reference-based setting: given a model and an earlier-generation checkpoint from the same lineage, we can identify the teacher model used to train the later checkpoint. We introduce a distillation detection method based on reference-based membership inference. By comparing how strongly a student model preferentially aligns with outputs from different candidate teachers relative to a reference checkpoint, our method identifies the most likely teacher and detects evidence of distillation. To handle unknown distillation pipelines such as hidden prompts, we infer proxy prompt templates directly from model outputs. We additionally identify a distinctive glyph-level signal specific to o1/o3 models. Evaluating distillation detection is challenging because modern model lineages are already heavily entangled. To address this, we develop a hybrid evaluation spanning both controlled distillation experiments and real-world models. Across both settings, our approach recovers the true teacher with near-perfect accuracy in single-teacher distillation scenarios, even when the underlying distillation pipeline is largely unknown. We further introduce statistical tests for both teacher attribution and distillation detection, and extend our framework to open-world settings where no teacher is guaranteed to be present among the candidates. Applying our method to contemporary models yields new evidence regarding potential distillation relationships involving QwQ, DeepSeek-R1, and GPT-OSS.

Original Abstract: Existing safety mechanisms for multimodal large language models (MLLMs) face a fundamental trade-off between safety and utility. Model fine-tuning achieves robust safety but compromises general utility. Input-side safety guardrails offer a lightweight alternative, yet they suffer from severe over-refusal, indiscriminately blocking benign queries or those the model could have safely answered through refusal or advisory responses. We identify that the root cause of over-refusal lies in the input-aware paradigm: safety guardrails make safety decisions without considering whether the model itself is capable of generating safe responses. Usually, MLLMs already possess intrinsic safety mechanisms that can transform harmful inputs into harmless outputs, but input-side safety guardrails override this capability, degrading user experience. Motivated by this insight, we propose a paradigm shift toward output-aware safety guardrails. Our method operates within the model's hidden state space to predict whether the forthcoming generation will be unsafe before it is fully produced. By training a lightweight classifier via multi-instance contrastive learning on hidden state representations, our approach distinguishes between inputs that will lead to unsafe outputs and those that will not, even when the inputs themselves contain risky elements. This enables precise intervention only when the model's actual response would be harmful. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our output-aware safety guardrail matches the safety performance of existing methods while drastically reducing over-refusal, preserving the model's utility and built-in safety capabilities. But the softmax is unchanged by adding a constant to every logit, so a model's logit zero-point is arbitrary, and the sign-branch reads that arbitrary point. The sign-branch is itself the accepted fix for an earlier bug, so the accepted fix branches on a quantity the training objective leaves unconstrained. Two measurable consequences follow. (1) The penalty is not well-defined: re-centring a model's logits by a constant is a provable no-op at theta=1, yet at a routine theta=1.3 it changes 58-96% of greedy tokens, where subtractive and normalized penalties change none; real checkpoints sit at widely different zero-points, so a fixed repetition_penalty is a different operation on every model. (2) It corrupts structured output: on 200 real-world JSON schemas, theta=1.3 drops the rate of valid, schema-conformant output from 97% to 23%. In our measurements, applying the penalty to normalized log-probabilities instead of raw logits removes both effects. HuggingFace already ships that operator (LogitNormalization); today it is off by default and applied after the penalty. This note gives the mechanism, the measurements (five models up to 7B, base and RLHF, on WikiText-103 prefixes; two code models on HumanEval and JSONSchemaBench; both effects replicated inside vLLM and llama.cpp through their own samplers on the same inputs), and the normalized variant.

Original Abstract: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) has become an important method for aligning large language models (LLMs) with human preferences because it removes the need for explicit reward modeling and reinforcement learning optimization. However, its performance depends heavily on the quality of preference data, and noisy preference data in real-world settings can weaken alignment performance. To address this issue, we propose a bilevel optimization framework and prove, under certain assumptions, that this framework can recover the DPO optimum under clean data. We further derive a prior form for the learnable weighting function under asymmetric label-flipping noise. Considering that high-quality metadata may be difficult to obtain, we propose a task-agnostic meta-knowledge-driven method that enables meta-learning even when metadata is completely unavailable. To reduce the high cost of higher-order gradients in LLM meta-learning, we combine central-difference approximation with LoRA fine-tuning and develop a scalable training scheme. Experiments on TL;DR summarization and Anthropic HH single-turn dialogue show that the proposed method improves training performance over multiple DPO baselines under different noise rates.

*Sheikh Salman Hassan,Irshad A. Meer,Almoatssimbillah Saifaldawla,Yan Kyaw Tun,Mustafa Ozger,Madyan Alsenwi,Nguyen Van Huynh,Woong-Hee Lee,Cedomir Stefanovic,Mathini Sellathurai,Henk Wymeersch,Tharmalingam Ratnarajah*

Original Abstract: Sixth-generation (6G) networks are moving toward AI-native operation, where learning modules are embedded across the radio access network (RAN), edge, and core. This transition requires learning from limited labels, heterogeneous wireless and network data, partial observations, non-stationary propagation, and latency-constrained control loops. Joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) is a promising self-supervised paradigm for this setting because it predicts missing or future representations in latent space instead of reconstructing raw measurements or using contrastive negative samples. This article presents a wireless-oriented tutorial on JEPA for 6G intelligence. We define the JEPA training mechanism, describe how CSI, beam measurements, KPIs, topology graphs, and sensing observations can be tokenized and masked, and position the learned encoder as a predictive representation layer for RAN, O-RAN, edge, and core functions, with task-specific heads or controllers producing final decisions. Then we present an illustrative, beam-management case study suggesting that a wireless-aware target, specifically an auxiliary future beam-energy target during self-supervised pretraining, can improve label efficiency and robustness across shifted deployment conditions relative to a supervised source domain. Finally, we outline open challenges in multi-timescale prediction, action-conditioned modeling, distributed training, trustworthiness, efficient deployment, benchmarking, and standardization.

### [268] [The Silent Freeze: Predicting When Low-Precision Training Stops Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09800)
*Zekai Shang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文发现低精度浮点训练会导致权重更新因低于半ULP而永久冻结（梯度非零但权重不再更新），并提出了可基于高精度轨迹和目标尾数长度先验预测该冻结的确定性条件。实验证明在bf16 GPT和8位浮点GPT-2中该冻结确实发生，并导致验证损失停滞，而随机舍入可消除该问题。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 低精度浮点训练中权重更新可能因精度不足而被舍入为零，导致训练静默停止（梯度非零但权重冻结），需要理解该现象的机制并实现可预测性。

Method: 提出基于每坐标半ULP条件的确定性冻结判定准则，仅需高精度轨迹和目标尾数长度即可预测低精度训练中的冻结位置，无需实际低精度数据。

Result: 1) bf16等效存储的GPT在训练中途按先验预测的步数永久冻结；2) 1.24亿参数GPT-2在两种fp8格式下稠密权重在初始化时即冻结，验证损失停滞；3) 随机舍入可消除持续冻结，且同样可被先验预测；4) 该条件在不同精度范围、不同网络结构上均成立。

Conclusion: 低精度训练中的权重冻结是确定性的、可预测的，而非随机噪声问题，随机舍入是有效的缓解方法。

Original Abstract: Training in reduced floating-point precision can silently halt learning: when a gradient-descent weight update falls below half the unit in the last place (ULP) of the weight, it rounds away and that coordinate freezes while its gradient is still nonzero. The freeze is deterministic, governed by a per-coordinate half-ULP condition, and predictable from a high-precision trajectory and the target mantissa length alone, without low-precision data. In a small GPT trained under the standard AdamW-plus-cosine recipe with bf16-equivalent stored weights, training proceeds normally and then permanently freezes just past mid-run, within four steps of the a-priori prediction. In a $124$-million-parameter GPT-2 transformer whose weights are constrained to the $8$-bit floating-point grid after every optimizer step, with no master weights, the dense weights freeze at initialization in both fp8 formats -- predicted \emph{a priori} from an fp32 reference -- and validation loss plateaus while full precision keeps improving. Stochastic rounding removes the persistent freeze, and the same reference predicts that too. The condition transfers across frozen-feature regression, a mantissa-truncation emulator spanning $128\times$ in precision, small networks, and a CNN on MNIST: a computable axis of low-precision training, not diffuse noise.

中文摘要翻译: 使用降低精度的浮点数进行训练可能会使学习过程悄然停止：当梯度下降的权重更新幅度低于该权重最后一位单位（ULP）的一半时，该更新会被舍入掉，该坐标被冻结而梯度仍非零。这种冻结是确定性的，受每坐标半ULP条件支配，且仅需高精度轨迹和目标尾数长度即可先验预测，无需低精度数据。在一个采用标准AdamW+余弦学习率调度、使用bf16等效存储权重的较小GPT模型中，训练正常进行，然后在运行中期过后永久冻结，与先验预测相差不超过四步。在一个1.24亿参数的GPT-2变压器中，其权重在每个优化器步骤后约束为8位浮点网格，且无主权重，两种fp8格式下的稠密权重均在初始化时冻结——根据fp32参考先验预测——验证损失陷入平台期，而全精度训练持续提升。随机舍入消除了这种持续冻结，同一参考同样预测到了这一点。该条件可迁移至冻结特征回归、跨越128倍精度范围的尾数截断仿真器、小型网络以及MNIST上的CNN：这是低精度训练中一个可计算的轴，而非弥漫的噪声。

</details>


### [269] [Discovering Latent Response Laws in Forced Physical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09801)
*Yi Zhu,Su Chen,Xiaojun Li,Xiuli Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FLARE是一种受迫潜在自编码器，能够从高维测量数据中学习受迫动力系统的紧凑响应坐标、稀疏输入依赖的潜在动力学，并解码出完整响应，从而实现对未见输入下的长时程高维响应预测。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 受迫动力系统的有效状态变量往往隐藏在高维测量数据中，传统方法难以同时处理内在动力学与时间依赖的外部输入，现有方程发现方法在受迫系统场景下能力有限。

Method: 提出FLARE（Forced Latent Autoencoder for Response Equations），包含三个核心：学习紧凑响应坐标、识别稀疏输入依赖的潜在动力学、解码方程 rollout 到完整响应；通过从数据中估计潜在维度、将状态估计与外部强制分离，支持从过去响应初始化预测并由未来输入驱动。

Result: 在多个已知动力系统、应用尺度的受迫响应以及视觉观测数据上，FLARE恢复了紧凑受迫动力学，并在未参与训练的新输入下成功预测了长时程高维响应。

Conclusion: FLARE将学习到的坐标转化为动力学接口，将方程发现扩展至有效状态隐藏于复杂观测中的系统，为受迫动力系统中高维响应的可解释建模与预测提供了新路径。

Original Abstract: Governing equations provide compact descriptions of physical systems, yet the variables in which they are simple are often hidden in high-dimensional measurements. This challenge is sharper for forced systems, whose responses depend on both intrinsic dynamics and time-dependent inputs. Here we introduce FLARE, a forced latent autoencoder for response equations that learns compact response coordinates, identifies sparse input-dependent latent dynamics and decodes equation rollouts to full responses. By estimating latent dimension from data and separating state estimation from external forcing, FLARE enables forecasts to be initialized from past responses and driven by prescribed future inputs. Across known dynamical systems, application-scale forced responses and visual observations, FLARE recovers compact forced dynamics and predicts long-horizon high-dimensional responses under inputs not used for training. By turning learned coordinates into a dynamical interface, FLARE extends equation discovery to systems whose effective states are hidden within complex observations, providing a route for interpretable modelling and prediction of high-dimensional responses in forced dynamical systems.

中文摘要翻译: 控制方程提供了物理系统的紧凑描述，然而这些方程所依赖的简单变量往往隐藏在高维测量数据中。对于受迫系统而言，这一挑战尤为突出，因为其响应既取决于内在动力学，也依赖于时变输入。本文提出FLARE（受迫响应方程潜在自编码器），该方法学习紧凑的响应坐标、识别稀疏的输入依赖潜在动力学，并将方程展开解码为完整响应。通过从数据中估计潜在维度、将状态估计与外部强制分离，FLARE使得预测可以从过去的响应初始化，并由预设的未来输入驱动。在多个已知动力系统、应用尺度的受迫响应以及视觉观测数据上，FLARE恢复了紧凑的受迫动力学，并在未用于训练的新输入下成功预测了长时程高维响应。通过将学习到的坐标转化为动力学接口，FLARE将方程发现扩展至有效状态隐藏于复杂观测中的系统，为受迫动力系统中高维响应的可解释建模与预测提供了一条新路径。

</details>


### [270] [Quota Marketplace: Dynamic Pricing for Efficient Allocation of ML Training Resources](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09802)
*Balasubramanian Sivan,Renato Paes Leme,Mihai Tiuca,Ian McFarlane,Vasilis Gkatzelis,Nehal Mehta,Soheil Hassas Yeganeh,Vahab Mirrokni,Amin Vahdat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出并实现了Quota Marketplace，一个面向异构价值需求的机器学习训练资源（如GPU）的市场化分配机制，在Google内部部署，理论上保证了帕累托效率与最大最小公平性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有资源分配机制（如Karma）在用户需求动态变化时能保证帕累托效率和最大最小公平性，但无法在需求具有异构价值（heterogeneous values）时维持这些关键性质。现实中不同工作负载对组织的价值天然存在差异，因此需要一种能容纳这种异构性的分配策略。

Method: 设计并实现了Quota Marketplace，一种基于市场的资源分配机制。允许用户表达其工作负载的价值，并根据供需波动进行动态资源定价，通过市场交易实现资源分配，从而在理论上达到帕累托效率和最大最小公平性。

Result: 在Google内部完成部署实施，展示了相关指标以证明其影响；有效处理了多项业务关键需求；理论上证明了该市场方法能够实现帕累托效率和最大最小公平性。

Conclusion: 市场化的资源分配机制能够使ML训练芯片的配置与组织优先级对齐，在异构价值需求场景下同时实现帕累托效率和最大最小公平性，并在实际部署中展现出显著的收益与机遇。

Original Abstract: The escalating demand for Machine Learning (ML) training resources in recent years has resulted in a substantial gap between the high demand and the available supply. Efficient allocation of these scarce and expensive resources is crucial for organizations to maximize their return on investment. Existing resource allocation mechanisms, like Karma [OSDI'23], are designed to guarantee Pareto efficiency and max-min fairness in settings with dynamic (time-varying) user demands, but fail to preserve these key properties in the presence of demands with heterogeneous values. Given the ubiquity and inevitability of heterogeneity in organizational values of different workloads, effective resource allocation policies must accommodate these variations.
  In this paper, we describe the design, implementation, deployment, and theoretical analysis of Quota Marketplace, a market-based mechanism to efficiently allocate ML training chips (like GPUs), explicitly addressing scenarios with demands of heterogeneous value. We detail the implementation of this mechanism within Google and present metrics that demonstrate its impact. We also discuss many business-critical requirements that the Quota Marketplace handles quite effectively, and document the gains and opportunities it has unlocked. We establish theoretically how this market-based approach achieves the essential properties of Pareto efficiency and max-min fairness by allowing the users to express the value of their workloads and enabling dynamic resource pricing based on supply and demand fluctuations. Ultimately, the market facilitates resource allocation that aligns with organizational priorities.

中文摘要翻译: 近年来，机器学习（ML）训练资源的需求激增，导致高需求与可用供给之间出现了巨大缺口。对这些稀缺且昂贵的资源进行高效分配，对于组织最大化其投资回报至关重要。现有的资源分配机制，如Karma [OSDI'23]，设计用于在动态（时变）用户需求场景下保证帕累托效率和最大最小公平性，但在面对具有异构价值的需求时无法保持这些关键性质。鉴于不同工作负载对组织价值的异构性和普遍性，有效的资源分配策略必须容纳这些差异。
本文描述了Quota Marketplace的设计、实现、部署和理论分析，这是一种基于市场的机制，用于高效分配ML训练芯片（如GPU），明确应对异构价值需求的场景。我们详述了该机制在Google内部的实现，并展示了证明其影响力的指标。我们还讨论了Quota Marketplace有效处理的许多业务关键需求，并记录了它已解锁的收益和机遇。我们从理论上证明，这种基于市场的方法通过允许用户表达其工作负载的价值，并基于供需波动实现动态资源定价，从而达成了帕累托效率和最大最小公平性这两项核心性质。最终，该市场促进了与组织优先级相一致的资源分配。

</details>


### [271] [Spectral Origins of the Self-Correction Blind Spot in Autoregressive Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09803)
*Ingrid Petrova,Luan Vejsiu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SPARC，一个基于谱代数理论的自校正理论框架，严格证明了自回归语言模型中自校正盲点的存在条件（误差传播算子的谱半径≥1），推导了校正标记的激活阈值，并给出了强化学习校正器训练的收敛性保证。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有工作仅从实验层面记录了自校正盲点现象，缺乏对以下问题的形式化建模：(1) 为何生成token会抑制其错误检测能力；(2) 校正标记的定量激活条件；(3) 强化学习自校正的收敛性保证。本文旨在填补这些理论空白。

Method: SPARC框架定义了误差传播算子（残差流上每步注意力Jacobian的乘积），通过谱半径条件（≥1）刻画盲点出现的充要条件；推导了基于谱半径的校正标记锐利激活阈值；证明了RL校正器训练的收敛率与耦合矩阵谱范数的关系。

Result: 谱理论预测与实测盲点率之间的RMSE仅为3.2%；理论预测与简单"Wait"标记实现89.3%盲点减少的实验结果吻合；RL训练的收敛准则在文本LLM和自回归图像/视频生成模态下具有不变性。

Conclusion: SPARC为自校正盲点提供了首个严格形式化理论，统一了不同自回归模态下的校正机制，并给出了可定量验证的预测条件和收敛保证。

Original Abstract: Large autoregressive language models exhibit a self-correction blind spot: they reliably fix identical errors when attributed to an external source yet fail to fix the same errors in their own outputs. Prior work has documented this phenomenon empirically, through controlled error injection, error-depth decompositions, RL-based verifier-corrector training, and intrinsic self-verification, but offers no formal model of why generating a token suppresses the ability to detect its error, no quantitative activation condition for correction markers, and no convergence guarantee for reinforcement-learning-based self-correction. We close these gaps with SPARC, a spectral-algebraic theory of self-correction in autoregressive generation. We define the error-propagation operator as the product of per-step attention Jacobians on the residual stream and prove that the blind spot arises if and only if the spectral radius of this operator is at least one. We derive a sharp activation threshold, given as a function of the spectral radius, that a correction marker must exceed, recovering the 89.3\% blind-spot reduction observed with a simple ``Wait'' marker. We further prove that RL-based verifier-corrector training converges at a rate proportional to the squared coupling strength over the square root of the number of samples if and only if the verifier-corrector coupling matrix has spectral norm below one, and that this criterion is invariant across residual-stream autoregressive modalities, unifying text LLMs and autoregressive image and video generation. Experiments across four backbones and a visual autoregressive probe validate every theorem, with spectral predictions matching measured blind-spot rates within 3.2\% RMSE.

中文摘要翻译: 大型自回归语言模型表现出一种自校正盲点：当相同错误归因于外部来源时，模型能可靠地修正，但无法修正自身输出中的相同错误。先前工作通过受控错误注入、错误深度分解、基于强化学习的验证器-校正器训练以及内在自我验证等手段，从实验上记录了这一现象，但缺乏对"为何生成token会抑制其错误检测能力"的形式化模型，没有校正标记的定量激活条件，也没有基于强化学习的自校正的收敛性保证。本文提出SPARC——一个用于自回归生成中自校正的谱代数理论。我们将误差传播算子定义为残差流上每步注意力Jacobian的乘积，并证明盲点出现的充要条件是该算子的谱半径≥1。我们推导出一个锐利的激活阈值（以谱半径的函数形式给出），校正标记必须超过该阈值，这复现了使用简单"Wait"标记所观察到的89.3%盲点减少。我们进一步证明，基于强化学习的验证器-校正器训练以正比于耦合强度平方除以样本数平方根的速率收敛，当且仅当验证器-校正器耦合矩阵的谱范数小于1，且该准则在残差流自回归模态下具有不变性，统一了文本LLM与自回归图像和视频生成。在四个主干网络和一个视觉自回归探针上的实验验证了每个定理，谱预测与实测盲点率之间的均方根误差仅为3.2%。

</details>


### [272] [RUBRIC: Realism--Utility Balanced Ranking for Imbalanced Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09816)
*Yanxuan Yu,Dong liu,Renata Borovica-Gajic,Ying Nian Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出RUBRIC框架，将合成样本选择转化为质量优先于数量的优化问题，通过真实性-效用权衡过滤低质量合成样本，提升类别不平衡学习中的分类性能与泛化能力。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有过采样方法生成大量低质量合成样本，扭曲决策边界或引入伪影，导致过拟合和泛化能力下降，亟需一种能够筛选高质量合成样本的过滤机制。

Method: 提出RUBRIC，一种生成器无关的过滤框架。将合成样本选择建模为质量-数量优化问题，通过真实性（判别器区分真实与合成样本）与效用（基于凹边界的评分函数衡量靠近决策边界的程度）的权衡对候选样本排序，并在温和正则条件下证明该策略能单调收紧基于边界的分类器的泛化界。

Result: 在信用卡欺诈检测等多个不平衡基准数据集上，RUBRIC在不同生成器下均提升了F1-macro和召回率，同时保持相当的ROC-AUC；还提供了显式的λ敏感度分析，说明用户如何在排序质量优先时恢复AUPRC。

Conclusion: RUBRIC通过质量优先的合成样本筛选策略，有效缓解了过采样方法中的低质量样本问题，提升了模型在不平衡数据上的泛化性能和关键指标，且不依赖于特定生成器，具有良好的通用性。

Original Abstract: Class imbalance poses a fundamental challenge in risk-sensitive applications such as fraud detection and medical diagnosis, where minority-class samples are scarce yet critical for accurate classification. Existing oversampling methods generate synthetic samples to rebalance class distributions; however, they often produce large numbers of low-quality candidates that distort decision boundaries or introduce artifacts, leading to overfitting and degraded generalization.
  In this work, we introduce RUBRIC, a generator-agnostic filtering framework that formulates synthetic sample selection as a quality-over-quantity optimization problem. RUBRIC ranks candidates using a realism-utility trade-off: realism is quantified by a learned discriminator that distinguishes real samples from synthetic samples, while utility captures proximity to the decision boundary through a concave margin-based scoring function. We show that, under mild regularity conditions, the proposed filtering strategy monotonically tightens the generalization bound for margin-based classifiers by jointly reducing distribution shift and suppressing near-negative tail contributions.
  Through extensive experiments on credit-card fraud detection and other imbalanced benchmarks, we demonstrate that RUBRIC improves F1-macro and recall while maintaining comparable ROC-AUC across several generators. We also provide explicit lambda-sensitivity analysis to show how users can recover AUPRC when ranking quality is prioritized.

中文摘要翻译: 类别不平衡在欺诈检测和医疗诊断等风险敏感应用中构成了根本性挑战，在这些场景中，少数类样本稀少但对准确分类至关重要。现有的过采样方法通过生成合成样本来重新平衡类别分布；然而，这些方法通常会产生大量低质量的候选样本，扭曲决策边界或引入伪影，导致过拟合和泛化能力下降。在这项工作中，我们提出了RUBRIC，一个与生成器无关的过滤框架，将合成样本的选择建模为一个质量优先于数量的优化问题。RUBRIC通过真实性-效用权衡对候选样本进行排序：真实性由学习得到的判别器量化，该判别器区分真实样本与合成样本；而效用则通过一个基于凹边缘的评分函数来捕捉样本靠近决策边界的程度。我们证明，在温和的正则条件下，所提出的过滤策略通过联合减少分布偏移和抑制近负类尾部贡献，单调地收紧基于边缘的分类器的泛化界。通过在信用卡欺诈检测及其他不平衡基准数据集上的大量实验，我们证明RUBRIC在多个生成器下提升了F1-macro和召回率，同时保持了相当的ROC-AUC。我们还提供了显式的λ敏感度分析，以展示用户在优先考虑排序质量时如何恢复AUPRC。

</details>


### [273] [Estimation, Prediction, and Assortment Optimization for Markov Chain Choice Models with Panel Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09817)
*Yalcin Akcay,Gerardo Berbeglia,Young-San Lin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对面板数据下的马尔可夫链选择模型，提出了包含参数估计、个性化选择预测和个性化品类优化的框架，利用部分序偏好信息捕捉同一顾客多次交易间的依赖关系，并设计了新的EM算法，在合成数据和真实寿司数据集上优于传统方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统马尔可夫链选择模型假设每次交易独立同分布于随机效用模型，忽略了同一顾客历史交易间的依赖关系。本文旨在利用面板数据中的部分序偏好信息来捕捉这种依赖，填补MC模型在面板数据选择建模方面的研究空白。

Method: 提出了融合部分序偏好信息的期望最大化（EM）算法，用于马尔可夫链模型的参数估计。算法通过将每名顾客的历史交易中隐含的偏好顺序（部分序）作为额外信息引入EM框架，从而更准确地估计转移概率参数。

Result: 在合成数据集和寿司数据集上，所提EM算法在参数估计性能上优于Simsek和Topaloglu (2018) 的传统EM算法以及基于多项逻辑模型的部分序基准方法（Jagabathula & Vulcano, 2018）。此外，对条件选择预测和品类优化问题给出了复杂度分析和计算结论。

Conclusion: 本文建立的框架为面板数据下基于马尔可夫链的选择建模提供了完整的解决方案，包括参数估计、预测与优化。理论和实验结果表明，利用部分序偏好信息能有效提升模型性能，所给出的计算复杂度结果对后续研究具有独立参考价值。

Original Abstract: We propose a framework for the Markov chain (MC) choice model with panel data, including parameter estimation, personalized choice prediction, and personalized assortment optimization. In contrast to the traditional setting, which assumes that each transaction is independently drawn from a random utility model, our framework accounts for dependencies among transactions for the same customer in historical data, captured by partial-ordering preference information. To the best of our knowledge, our framework initiates the study of choice modeling with panel data under MC. As our primary result, we propose novel expectation-maximization (EM) algorithms for MC parameter estimation by incorporating partial-ordering-based customer preference information. On synthetic datasets and the sushi dataset, our EM algorithms outperform the traditional EM algorithm of Simsek and Topaloglu (Operations Research, 66, 2018) and multinomial-logit-based partial-order benchmarks adapted from Jagabathula and Vulcano (Management Science, 64, 2018). As our secondary contribution, we present hardness and computational results for conditional choice prediction and assortment optimization problems. These results complement our estimation framework and clarify the computational landscape of conditional choice and assortment optimization, which may be of independent interest.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一个针对面板数据的马尔可夫链（MC）选择模型框架，涵盖参数估计、个性化选择预测和个性化品类优化。与传统设定（假设每次交易独立同分布于随机效用模型）不同，我们的框架通过部分序偏好信息来捕捉历史数据中同一顾客多次交易间的依赖关系。据我们所知，本框架首次开启了MC框架下面板数据选择建模的研究。作为主要结果，我们提出了融合基于部分序的顾客偏好信息的新型期望最大化（EM）算法用于MC参数估计。在合成数据集和寿司数据集上，我们的EM算法优于Simsek和Topaloglu（Operations Research, 66, 2018）的传统EM算法以及改编自Jagabathula和Vulcano（Management Science, 64, 2018）的基于多项逻辑模型的部分序基准方法。作为次要贡献，我们给出了条件选择预测和品类优化问题的困难性与计算结论。这些结果补充了我们的估计框架，阐明了条件选择和品类优化的计算景观，可能具有独立的学术价值。

</details>


### [274] [Learning Predictive Ambiguity Sets for Decision-Focused Distributionally Robust Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.09820)
*Junjie Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种学习式预测模糊集（LPAS），通过深度上下文模型输出状态依赖的Wasserstein半径和名义情景分布，使分布鲁棒优化的模糊集自适应于当前上下文，在投资组合优化中显著优于传统方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统"先预测后优化"系统将不确定性压缩为点预测后求解优化问题，忽略了预测误差；分布鲁棒优化虽能提供保护，但模糊集通常以历史样本为中心且使用固定半径，缺乏状态自适应性。

Method: 提出LPAS框架：深度上下文模型输出有限名义情景分布、状态依赖的Wasserstein半径及各向异性地面度量，构建上下文模糊集；半径通过条件分位数校准、规模正则化和下游决策损失联合训练，使鲁棒性自适应于当前状态。

Result: 在2018-2026年标普500的20只成分股投资组合优化中，LPAS实现了26.28%年化收益率、1.30夏普比率、1.61最终财富，尾部损失低于固定半径深度DRO基线，且使用更小的平均半径。

Conclusion: 学习式模糊半径能够恢复强固定半径DRO的大部分性能，同时减少不必要的保守性并提高对市场状态的适应性。

Original Abstract: Predict-then-optimize systems usually compress uncertainty into a point forecast and then solve a downstream optimization problem as if the forecast were reliable. Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) offers protection against misspecification, but the ambiguity set is often centered at historical samples and uses a fixed radius. We propose \emph{learned predictive ambiguity sets} (LPAS): a deep contextual model outputs a finite nominal scenario distribution, a state-dependent Wasserstein radius, and optionally an anisotropic ground metric. These outputs define a contextual ambiguity set that feeds a DRO decision layer. The radius is trained by a combination of conditional quantile calibration, size regularization, and downstream decision loss, so that robustness is adaptive rather than globally fixed. We derive the finite dual form used by the decision layer, present a staged training algorithm, and evaluate the method on distributionally robust portfolio optimization with 20 S&P 500 constituents from 2018--2026. The proposed method substantially improves over equal-weight, predict-then-optimize, and historical Wasserstein DRO baselines, achieving 26.28% annualized return, Sharpe ratio 1.30, final wealth 1.61, and lower tail loss than a deep fixed-radius DRO baseline while using a smaller average radius. The results show that learned ambiguity radii can recover most of the performance of strong fixed-radius DRO while reducing unnecessary conservatism and improving regime adaptivity.

中文摘要翻译: "先预测后优化"系统通常将不确定性压缩为点预测，然后求解一个将预测视为可信的下游优化问题。分布鲁棒优化（DRO）提供了对模型误设的保护，但其模糊集通常以历史样本为中心并采用固定半径。我们提出了学习式预测模糊集（LPAS）：一个深度上下文模型输出有限的名义情景分布、状态依赖的Wasserstein半径，以及可选的各向异性地面度量。这些输出定义了一个上下文模糊集，用于驱动DRO决策层。该半径通过条件分位数校准、规模正则化和下游决策损失的组合进行训练，使得鲁棒性具有自适应性而非全局固定。我们推导了决策层所使用的有限对偶形式，提出了分阶段训练算法，并在2018-2026年标普500的20只成分股上对分布鲁棒投资组合优化方法进行了评估。所提出的方法显著优于等权重、"先预测后优化"和历史Wasserstein DRO基线，实现了26.28%的年化收益率、1.30的夏普比率、1.61的最终财富，且尾部损失低于深度固定半径DRO基线，同时使用了更小的平均半径。结果表明，学习式模糊半径能够恢复强固定半径DRO的大部分性能，同时减少不必要的保守性并提高对市场状态的适应性。

</details>
