Original Abstract: Bayesian optimization is increasingly used to guide data-efficient experimentation in chemistry, materials science, and related laboratory settings, but its practical performance depends strongly on how well surrogate-model assumptions match the geometry and noise structure of the underlying objective. We introduce tidyHEBO, a robust Bayesian optimization model inspired by heteroskedastic evolutionary Bayesian optimization (HEBO) for single-objective, sequential optimization. tidyHEBO reconstructs the HEBO design philosophy in BoTorch and revises surrogate training, output-warping selection, acquisition function evaluation, and Pareto-front search. We benchmarked tidyHEBO on synthetic functions, Olympus emulators, fully experimental reaction-optimization datasets, needle-in-a-haystack (NIAH) materials problems, and Bayesmark hyperparameter optimization tasks. On these tasks tidyHEBO achieved competitive to superior performance and improvement in robustness across repeated optimization runs. We therefore propose tidyHEBO as a practical tool for sequential experimentations and a strong general-purpose benchmark for future Bayesian optimization research.

中文摘要翻译: 贝叶斯优化越来越多地被用于指导化学、材料科学及相关实验室环境中数据高效的实验，但其实际性能强烈依赖于代理模型假设是否匹配底层目标的几何结构和噪声结构。我们提出了 tidyHEBO，一种受异方差演化贝叶斯优化（HEBO）启发的稳健贝叶斯优化模型，用于单目标序列优化。tidyHEBO 在 BoTorch 中重构了 HEBO 的设计理念，并对代理模型训练、输出扭曲选择、采集函数评估和帕累托前沿搜索进行了改进。我们在合成函数、Olympus 仿真器、全实验反应优化数据集、针尖堆（NIAH）材料问题以及 Bayesmark 超参数优化任务上对 tidyHEBO 进行了基准测试。在这些任务中，tidyHEBO 取得了竞争性甚至更优的性能，并在重复优化运行中提升了鲁棒性。因此，我们提出 tidyHEBO 作为序列实验的实用工具以及未来贝叶斯优化研究的强通用基准。

</details>


### [332] [From Self-Attention to Connection Laplacian: A Unified Operator View of Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10677)
*Binbin Lin,Wei Chen,Yalun Li,Wenxiao Wang,Jieping Ye,Xiaofei He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出连接游走（connection walk）形式体系，将自注意力机制建模为令牌位置图上的连接游走过程，证明单头注意力是恒定传输的连接传播、多头注意力是门控混合传输的边缘依赖连接游走，并揭示了其与经典几何算子（如随机游走连接拉普拉斯算子）的联系。实验表明，训练后的Transformer深层有效注意力图收敛为稳定几何算子，学习到的传输呈现近似缩放等距结构。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 自注意力机制在现代序列模型中广泛应用，但其算子层面的几何结构尚未被充分理解，缺乏将自注意力与经典几何算子联系起来的统一形式体系。

Method: 将令牌序列视为令牌位置图上的向量场，将注意力识别为连接游走过程：消息通过非负游走矩阵聚合，同时沿每条边由学习到的线性映射传输。在此框架下严格证明单头注意力与多头注意力的几何本质，并推导其退化为随机游走连接拉普拉斯算子的条件。

Result: 理论结果表明单头注意力是恒定传输的连接传播步骤，多头注意力是边缘依赖的连接游走且有效传输为注意力门控混合。实验结果显示，从124M到8B参数的Transformer（编码器/解码器）中，有效注意力图在深层收敛为稳定几何算子，学习到的传输自组织为近似缩放等距，且随规模扩大而增强。

Conclusion: 本文提供了将自注意力与经典几何算子联系起来的连接游走形式体系，并给出了一套从几何角度分析Transformer模型的算子级工具。

Original Abstract: Self-attention is a ubiquitous primitive in modern sequence models, yet its operator-level geometry is only partially understood. We view a token sequence as a vector field over the token-position graph and identify attention as a connection walk: messages are aggregated by a nonnegative walk matrix while being transported along each edge by a learned linear map. Within this framework, we prove that single-head attention (SHA) is exactly a connection propagation step with constant transport, and that multi-head attention (MHA) is exactly a single edge-dependent connection walk whose effective transport is an attention-gated mixture of headwise transports. We further clarify the conditions under which the corresponding generator reduces to a random-walk connection Laplacian, highlighting the roles of stochasticity, reversibility, and metric-compatible transports. Empirically, we find that trained Transformers across scales (from 124M to 8B) and structures (encoder/decoder) exhibit geometric structure consistent with our theory: effective attention graphs converge to stable geometric operators in deeper layers, learned transports self-organize into approximate scaled isometries, and both phenomena strengthen consistently with scale. Overall, the paper provides a precise connection-walk formalism that links self-attention to classical geometric operators, along with a set of operator-level tools for analyzing transformer models from a geometric perspective.

中文摘要翻译: 自注意力机制是现代序列模型中无处不在的基本操作，但其算子层面的几何结构尚未被完全理解。本文将令牌序列视为令牌位置图上的向量场，并将注意力识别为一种连接游走：消息通过非负游走矩阵聚合，同时沿每条边由学习到的线性映射进行传输。在此框架内，我们证明了单头注意力恰好是一个具有恒定传输的连接传播步骤，而多头注意力恰好是一个单边依赖的连接游走，其有效传输是由注意力门控的头间传输混合。我们进一步阐明了相应生成元退化为随机游走连接拉普拉斯算子的条件，强调了随机性、可逆性和度量相容传输的作用。实验上，我们发现在不同规模（从124M到8B）和结构（编码器/解码器）上训练的Transformer表现出与我们的理论一致的几何结构：有效注意力图在深层收敛为稳定的几何算子，学习到的传输自组织为近似缩放等距，且这两种现象随着规模扩大而持续增强。总体而言，本文提供了一种精确的连接游走形式体系，将自注意力与经典几何算子联系起来，并提供了一套从几何角度分析Transformer模型的算子级工具。

</details>


### [333] [LayerNorm as Implicit Gain Control in Looped Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10681)
*Matthias M. M. Buehlmaier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了预LayerNorm循环Transformer中LayerNorm作为隐式增益控制器的作用，揭示了循环Jacobian的非正态收缩特性，并证明线性carry的作用是稳定化而非记忆，梯度下降会将记忆路由到更具表达力的非线性循环中。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有研究对循环Transformer中LayerNorm的作用理解不足，特别是其对循环稳定性的影响机制尚不明确。作者希望揭示LayerNorm在预LayerNorm循环Transformer中如何影响循环的收敛性和记忆机制。

Method: 通过理论分析推导预LayerNorm循环Transformer中循环Jacobian的谱特性，证明LayerNorm使循环Jacobian非正态且渐近收缩；通过六个任务的训练实验（含控制消融实验）验证理论发现。

Result: 1) LayerNorm使循环Jacobian非正态，在算子范数超过1时仍能在每个验证不动点处渐近收缩，真正稳定性预算为谱边界而非算子范数边界；2) 当carry ρ→1时谱边界耗尽，少数初始化永不到达不动点；3) 线性carry不是深度记忆机制，梯度下降将记忆路由到非线性循环，carry仅起稳定化作用；4) 在具有轴向对齐逐通道结构的任务上，梯度下降会征用carry。

Conclusion: 预LayerNorm循环Transformer中线性carry的核心作用是稳定化而非记忆，循环的记忆能力来自更具表达力的非线性循环。对角线carry约束ρ(Ā)<1是必要但不充分的收敛条件。

Original Abstract: In pre-LayerNorm looped transformers, LayerNorm inside the recurrent block acts as an implicit gain controller: by coupling the block's local Lipschitz constant inversely to the activation scale, it renders the recurrence Jacobian non-normal -- asymptotically contractive at every verified fixed point even where its operator norm exceeds 1 -- so the true stability budget is the spectral margin, not an operator-norm bound. That margin depletes as the carry $ρ\to 1$, and a minority of initializations never converge to a fixed point at all, so the diagonal carry constraint $ρ(\bar{A}) < 1$ is necessary but not sufficient for convergence of the full recurrence. Training experiments across six tasks, including a controlled ablation, reveal that the linear carry is not the depth-memory mechanism: gradient descent routes memory through the block's more expressive nonlinear recurrence and leaves the stability-constrained carry at rest -- the carry's role is stabilization, not memory. We characterize the boundary of this claim: on tasks with axis-aligned per-channel structure, gradient descent does recruit the carry. All results are derived analytically and verified in a from-scratch, CPU-scale implementation; verification at larger scale is needed.

中文摘要翻译: 在预LayerNorm循环Transformer中，循环块内部的LayerNorm充当隐式增益控制器：通过将块的局部Lipschitz常数与激活尺度成反比耦合，它使得循环Jacobian变得非正态——即使在算子范数超过1的情况下，也能在每个已验证的不动点处渐近收缩——因此真正的稳定性预算是谱边界，而非算子范数边界。该边界随着carry ρ→1而耗尽，少数初始化永远无法到达不动点，因此对角线carry约束ρ(Ā)<1是完整循环收敛的必要但不充分条件。跨越六个任务的训练实验（包括控制消融实验）揭示，线性carry并非深度记忆机制：梯度下降将记忆路由到块中更具表达力的非线性循环，而让受稳定性约束的carry处于静止状态——carry的作用是稳定化，而非记忆。我们刻画了这一结论的边界：在具有轴向对齐逐通道结构的任务上，梯度下降确实会征用carry。所有结果均通过理论分析推导并在从头实现的CPU级实验中验证；更大规模的验证尚需进行。

</details>


### [334] [Learning to Fine-tune Foundation Models under Resource Limitations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10694)
*Thomas Tsouparopoulos,Iordanis Koutsopoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对资源受限设备上的预训练基础模型，提出了一种基于强化学习（演员-评论家算法）的最优持续微调策略，在有限计算预算下决定何时微调模型，实验表明该方法在相同计算预算下准确率提升超过4%，仅需25%的微调步骤即可达到全参数微调97%的准确率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 资源受限设备上部署的预训练基础模型面临持续微调决策问题：每时刻新到达的训练数据需要决定是否进行微调（消耗计算资源）还是丢弃数据。现有方法缺乏在有限计算预算下系统性地优化“何时微调”的策略。

Method: 将问题建模为约束马尔可夫决策过程（CMDP），系统状态包含模型性能、计算预算和数据分布相关性三个维度。提出基于演员-评论家（Actor-Critic）的强化学习方法求解最优策略；对于微调性能可预测的特殊情况，简化为动态规划问题。

Result: 在文本分类数据集上，该方法在相同计算预算下准确率超过基线微调方法4%以上；仅需25%的微调步骤即可达到全参数微调97%的准确率。

Conclusion: 所提出的强化学习驱动的持续微调策略能有效在资源受限场景下平衡模型性能与计算成本，实现接近全参数微调的性能同时大幅减少计算开销。

Original Abstract: We study the problem of optimal continual fine-tuning for a pre-trained Foundation Model deployed at a resource-limited device. At each time slot, a new batch of training data arrives, and the controller is faced with two options: either use the data to fine-tune the model and incur a compute cost, or do not fine-tune the model and discard the data. After the decision, the performance of the current model is measured in terms of an application-specific performance metric such as classification accuracy. Our objective is to learn an optimal policy that determines \emph{when to fine-tune the model} on a single task (e.g., sentiment analysis), under a finite compute budget. We formulate this online decision-making problem as a constrained Markov Decision Process, where the system state captures three essential aspects: (\textit{i}) model's performance, (\textit{ii}) computational budget, and (\textit{iii}) data distribution relevance to historic data encountered up to that point. The transition to the next state is stochastic and therefore, we propose a reinforcement learning-based method to solve this problem, namely the \emph{actor-critic} algorithm. We also consider the special case where the performance of fine-tuning for a given model can be predicted or estimated prior to decision; in this case the problem becomes a Dynamic Programming one. Experiments with a large pre-trained model on a widely-used text classification dataset demonstrate that our method consistently outperforms fine-tuning approaches with the same compute budget by more than $4\%$ in terms of accuracy and achieves $97\%$ of full-parameter fine-tuning accuracy while requiring only $25\%$ of the fine-tuning steps.

中文摘要翻译: 我们研究了在资源受限设备上部署的预训练基础模型的最优持续微调问题。在每个时间槽，一批新的训练数据到达，控制器面临两个选项：要么使用数据微调模型并产生计算成本，要么不微调模型并丢弃数据。决策后，当前模型的性能以应用特定的性能指标（如分类准确率）来衡量。我们的目标是在有限计算预算下，学习一个确定何时在单个任务（如情感分析）上微调模型的最优策略。我们将这个在线决策问题建模为一个约束马尔可夫决策过程，其中系统状态捕捉三个关键方面：（i）模型性能，（ii）计算预算，以及（iii）数据分布与截止到该时刻的历史数据的相关性。转移到下一状态是随机的，因此我们提出了一种基于强化学习的方法来解决这个问题，即演员-评论家算法。我们还考虑了特殊情况，即给定模型的微调性能可以在决策前预测或估计；在这种情况下，问题转化为动态规划问题。在广泛使用的文本分类数据集上使用大型预训练模型进行的实验表明，我们的方法在相同计算预算下，准确率一致地优于微调方法超过4%，并且仅需25%的微调步骤即可达到全参数微调准确率的97%。

</details>


### [335] [On the modality gap and the contrastive loss in multi-modal representation learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10698)
*Fabian Mager,Hiba Nassar,Lars Kai Hansen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了CLIP式双编码器对比学习中的模态差距问题，指出InfoNCE在低温下会主动产生模态差距，并提出xNCE方法（引入模态内负样本）来缩小差距，同时不损害迁移性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有CLIP-style双编码器对比学习中，图像和文本嵌入在共享空间中仍然存在模态差距，这一问题限制了跨模态对齐的质量。作者试图解释该差距的成因并寻求解决方案。

Method: 提出xNCE方法，在InfoNCE基础上同时使用跨模态（inter-modal）负样本对和模态内（intra-modal）负样本对进行对比学习，以缓解低温下InfoNCE产生的模态差距。

Result: 1. 单模态实验表明InfoNCE在低温下会主动产生模态差距。2. 理论分析证实模态差距是InfoNCE在低温下的模式失败。3. xNCE在MS-COCO上保持检索性能的同时持续缩小模态差距。4. xNCE在所有基准测试上均提升了零样本分类性能，而高温InfoNCE和正则化InfoNCE均未做到。

Conclusion: 模态差距是InfoNCE在低温下的模式失败，xNCE通过引入模态内负样本有效缩小差距，且不影响判别性几何结构，从而提升跨模态迁移能力。

Original Abstract: We study the modality gap in CLIP-style dual-encoder contrastive learning, where image and text embeddings remain misaligned despite being trained in a shared space. We argue that the gap is induced by a failure of the InfoNCE formulation with independent encoders. We conduct a uni-modal experiment with two independent encoders and identical initialization conditions and find that InfoNCE actively generates a gap at low temperatures. We provide a theoretical analysis of this phenomenon and show that the modality gap is indeed a mode-failure of InfoNCE, but only at low temperatures. We propose a simple modification called xNCE, which uses intermodal as well as intra-modality negative contrastive pairs. xNCE matches retrieval performance on MS-COCO while consistently reducing the gap even at low temperatures. Notably, xNCE improves zero-shot classification over the InfoNCE baseline across all benchmarks, whereas high-temperature InfoNCE and regularized InfoNCE both fail to do so, demonstrating that xNCE reduces the modality gap without sacrificing the discriminative geometry needed for transfer.

中文摘要翻译: 我们研究了CLIP式双编码器对比学习中的模态差距问题，即尽管图像和文本嵌入在同一共享空间中进行训练，它们之间仍然存在未对齐的现象。我们认为这种差距是由独立编码器的InfoNCE公式的失败所导致的。我们设计了一项单模态实验，使用两个独立的编码器并在完全相同的初始化条件下进行训练，发现InfoNCE在低温条件下会主动产生模态差距。我们从理论上分析了这一现象，表明模态差距确实是InfoNCE的一种模式失败，但仅在低温条件下出现。我们提出了一种称为xNCE的简单改进，它同时使用跨模态负样本对和模态内负样本对进行对比。xNCE在MS-COCO上保持了与InfoNCE相当的检索性能，同时在低温条件下持续缩小了模态差距。值得注意的是，xNCE在所有基准测试上都优于InfoNCE基线的零样本分类性能，而高温InfoNCE和正则化InfoNCE均未能做到这一点，这表明xNCE在不牺牲迁移所需的判别性几何结构的前提下有效减小了模态差距。

</details>


### [336] [Scaffold splits hide structural-frontier failures in ADMET models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10729)
*Jiacheng Zheng,Chang Guo,Zixuan Wang,Xinyu Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种标签无关的“结构前沿”（Structural-Frontier）数据划分方法，该划分基于物理化学距离保留最稀疏、最偏远的支架组，并在六个ADMET任务上评估了该划分对模型误差的影响。结果发现这种划分导致模型误差显著上升（中位数87.0%，均值130.3%），且现有的稳健惩罚方法（包括提出的多视图前沿风险外推方法MVFRE）无法有效缓解。论文还指出，数据划分构建和标签来源本身是重要的评估约束条件。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的分子性质模型常用Bemis-Murcko支架划分来评估泛化能力，但支架标识符只是化学陌生性的一种概念。作者希望引入一种更严格的、基于物理化学距离的结构前沿划分方法，以暴露模型在真正陌生化学空间中的失败情况，并检验现有稳健训练方法是否能应对这类挑战。

Method: 1) 提出标签无关的结构前沿划分（Structural-Frontier split），保留物理化学上最稀疏、最偏远的支架组作为测试集；2) 引入多视图前沿风险外推方法（MVFRE），一种基于四个分子视图的计数调整的尾部风险惩罚损失；3) 在六个ADMET任务上与70/10/20支架划分、Lo-Hi和DataSAIL划分进行比较；4) 在31,561个海洋天然产物数据集上进行外部审计。

Result: 1) 与70/10/20支架划分相比，结构前沿划分使同等加权的首要误差中位数增加87.0%，均值增加130.3%（去除BBB任务后均值降至75.9%）；2) 消息传递图网络仍存在较大差距（四个任务均值82.8%），且不会发生评分排序反转；3) MVFRE方法对感知机头的前沿误差改变仅0.16%，对图网络改变-1.9%，效果不显著；4) 与Lo-Hi和DataSAIL划分相比，结构前沿划分平均误差更大；5) 海洋天然产物审计显示OOD状态与遗留ADMET预测的一致性依赖于分子视图、终点和教师覆盖范围。

Conclusion: 数据划分的构建方式和标签来源本身就是重要的评估约束条件，现有的训练惩罚方法（包括MVFRE）无法解决结构前沿划分带来的模型失效问题，需要更有效的策略来应对真正化学陌生的分布外场景。

Original Abstract: Molecular property models are commonly evaluated by holding out Bemis--Murcko scaffolds, yet a scaffold identifier is only one notion of chemical unfamiliarity. We introduce a label-free structural-frontier split that reserves the sparsest and most physicochemically remote scaffold groups, and evaluate it on six public experimental or curated ADMET tasks. Against a 70/10/20 scaffold control with identical acyclic grouping, the frontier inflates equally weighted primary error with a taskwise median of 87.0\% and a skew-sensitive mean of 130.3\% (descriptive task/seed bootstrap interval, 52.1--246.0\%). The mean falls to 75.9\% once BBB is removed; that endpoint is the one whose score ranking inverts at the frontier. A message-passing graph-network control still shows a large gap (mean 82.8\% over four tasks) and does not invert, so a low-capacity head does not explain the effect. We also test Multi-View Frontier Risk Extrapolation (\method), a count-adjusted tail-risk penalty over four molecular views, and treat it as a falsifiable probe. It changes normalized frontier error by only 0.16\% relative to empirical risk minimization for the perceptron head (interval, $-0.43$--0.84\%) and by $-1.9$\% for the graph network; three fixed robust-penalty controls are likewise inconclusive. Against the published Lo-Hi and DataSAIL splitters the frontier inflates error more on average, though no split is uniformly hardest. An audit of 31,561 marine natural products further shows that OOD status and agreement with legacy ADMET predictions depend on the molecular view, endpoint and teacher coverage. Split construction and label provenance are important evaluation constraints in their own right, and the tested training penalties do not resolve the frontier failures we observe.

中文摘要翻译: 分子性质模型通常通过留出Bemis-Murcko支架来评估，但支架标识符只是化学陌生性的一种概念。我们引入了一种无标签的结构前沿划分方法，该方法保留了最稀疏、物理化学上最偏远的支架组，并在六个公开实验或整理的ADMET任务上进行了评估。与具有相同无环分组的70/10/20支架对照相比，前沿划分使同等加权的首要误差增加了任务中位数87.0%和偏态敏感均值130.3%（描述性任务/随机种子自助法区间为52.1–246.0%）。去除BBB任务后均值降至75.9%；该终点是评分排序在前沿划分下发生反转的那个任务。消息传递图网络对照仍然显示出较大差距（四个任务均值82.8%）且排序未反转，因此低容量分类头不能解释该效应。我们还测试了多视图前沿风险外推方法（MVFRE），这是一种基于四个分子视图的计数调整尾部风险惩罚，并将其作为可证伪的探针。对于感知机分类头，它仅使归一化前沿误差相对于经验风险最小化改变了0.16%（区间为-0.43–0.84%），对于图网络改变了-1.9%；三个固定的稳健惩罚对照同样无定论。与已发表的Lo-Hi和DataSAIL划分相比，前沿划分平均误差更大，尽管没有一种划分是绝对最难的。对31,561个海洋天然产物的审计进一步表明，OOD状态与遗留ADMET预测的一致性取决于分子视图、终点和教师覆盖范围。划分构建和标签来源本身就是重要的评估约束条件，而所测试的训练惩罚方法无法解决我们观察到的前沿划分失效问题。

</details>


### [337] [To Answer or to Abstain: Mitigating Search-Agent Hallucinations via Abstention-Aware Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10738)
*Fengji Zhang,Tianyu Fan,Yuxiang Zheng,Xinyao Niu,Chengen Huang,Jacky Keung,Bei Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种基于弃权感知强化学习（AWA-RL）的方法，通过在检索失败时动态调整弃权奖励，减少大语言模型在开放域问答中的幻觉问题，在保持高精度同时显著提升可靠性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前训练范式主要奖励正确答案，但在检索失败时未能惩罚虚构答案，从而隐式加剧了幻觉问题。现有方法缺乏对模型何时应该弃权（即不回答）的显式机制。

Method: 提出AWA-RL（Abstention-Aware Reinforcement Learning），利用模型查询特定的先验能力和持续的在策略训练观测，动态塑造弃权奖励，使模型学会在检索失败时主动弃权而非生成虚构答案。同时引入新指标RA-F1来度量能力-可靠性之间的权衡。

Result: 相比不弃权的基线方法，AWA-RL的绝对精确率提升高达10.3%，整体RA-F1提升2.9%，仅牺牲少量原始准确率。

Conclusion: AWA-RL成功构建了既高能力又高可靠性的搜索代理，验证了通过弃权机制可以有效缓解大语言模型在开放域问答中的幻觉问题。

Original Abstract: Recent advances in equipping Large Language Models (LLMs) with search tools and outcome-reward reinforcement learning (RL) have achieved new state-of-the-art results on open-domain QA tasks. However, we argue that current training paradigms harbor a critical vulnerability: they predominantly reward correct answers but fail to penalize fabricated ones when retrieval fails, thereby implicitly exacerbating hallucinations. To address this, we propose Abstention-Aware Reinforcement Learning (AWA-RL), which dynamically shapes the abstention reward utilizing the model's query-specific prior capabilities and continuous on-policy training observations. We also introduce a novel metric, RA-F1, to measure the capability-reliability trade-off. Compared to non-abstaining baselines, AWA-RL boosts absolute precision by up to 10.3% and overall RA-F1 by 2.9%, with only marginal sacrifice in raw accuracy. These results confirm that AWA-RL successfully yields highly capable and reliable search agents. The code, data, and model weights are publicly available at https://github.com/zfj1998/AWA-RL.

中文摘要翻译: 近期，为大语言模型（LLMs）配备搜索工具和结果奖励强化学习（RL）的进展在开放域问答任务上取得了新的最优结果。然而，我们认为当前训练范式存在一个关键漏洞：它们主要奖励正确答案，但在检索失败时未能惩罚虚构答案，从而隐式加剧了幻觉问题。为解决这一问题，我们提出了弃权感知强化学习（AWA-RL），该方法利用模型查询特定的先验能力和持续的在策略训练观测，动态塑造弃权奖励。我们还引入了一个新指标RA-F1，用于度量能力-可靠性之间的权衡。与不弃权的基线方法相比，AWA-RL的绝对精确率提升高达10.3%，整体RA-F1提升2.9%，仅牺牲少量原始准确率。这些结果证实了AWA-RL成功构建了既高能力又高可靠性的搜索代理。代码、数据和模型权重已在https://github.com/zfj1998/AWA-RL公开。

</details>


### [338] [Multi-Scale Convolution with Optimal Transport Attention Effect on Multivariate Time Series](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10740)
*HaoChong Fu,Jian Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出MSC-OT模型，融合多尺度卷积与Sinkhorn最优传输注意力，用于多变量时间序列预测，在多个数据集上取得良好效果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 多变量时间序列分析中存在两大挑战：一是难以捕获多粒度的结构模式，二是难以有效抑制噪声。现有注意力机制在这两方面表现不足。

Method: MSC-OT包含两部分：(1) 多尺度卷积增强：基于反转嵌入对注意力分数矩阵进行多尺度卷积，捕获变量交互空间中的局部结构模式；(2) Sinkhorn最优传输正则化：将注意力计算建模为最优传输问题，通过迭代矩阵缩放实现变量间信息流的均衡。最后采用自适应融合策略动态组合基础注意力、卷积增强和OT正则化分数。

Result: 在ETT、Electricity、Traffic、Solar-Energy、Exchange-Rate等数据集上，MSC-OT在短期和长期预测任务中均表现优异。消融实验验证了各组件及其协同作用的有效性。

Conclusion: MSC-OT通过多尺度卷积和最优传输注意力机制，有效提升了多变量时间序列预测的准确性，各组件协同贡献显著。

Original Abstract: The analysis of Multivariate Time Series (MTS) plays an important role in a lot of real-world practical applications, but it still remains some challenging problem about capturing multi-granularity structural patterns and suppressing noise appropriately. Multi-Scale Convolution with Optimal Transport Attention (MSC-OT) is proposed in this paper. MSC-OT is a useful architecture to optimize the attention mechanism. It combines multi-scale convolution with Sinkhorn optimal transport method based on inverted embedding. The inverted embedding approach embeds each variable as a token and allows the model to capture cross-variate relationships better. MSC-OT consists of two part: (1) Multi-Scale Convolution Enhancement, that applies multi-scale convolutions to attention score matrices based on inverted embedding, capturing local structural patterns in the variate-interaction space induced by compressed temporal representations; (2) Sinkhorn Optimal Transport Regularization, that formulates attention computation as an optimal transport problem and employs iterative matrix scaling to ensure balanced information flow across variates. Adaptive Fusion Strategy utilizes softmax-normalized learnable weights to dynamically combine base attention, convolution-enhanced, and OT-regularized scores. Experiments on widely-used datasets, including ETT, Electricity, Traffic, Solar-Energy, and Exchange-Rate, show that MSC-OT achieves well performance in both short-term and long-term forecasting tasks. Ablation experiments further validate the effectiveness of each proposed component and their synergistic contributions to improving prediction accuracy for multivariate time series forecasting.

中文摘要翻译: 多变量时间序列（MTS）分析在许多实际应用中扮演着重要角色，但在捕获多粒度结构模式和适当抑制噪声方面仍存在挑战性问题。本文提出了一种基于最优传输注意力的多尺度卷积模型（MSC-OT）。MSC-OT是一种优化注意力机制的有效架构，它将多尺度卷积与基于反转嵌入的Sinkhorn最优传输方法相结合。反转嵌入方法将每个变量嵌入为一个令牌，使模型能够更好地捕获变量间关系。MSC-OT包含两个部分：(1) 多尺度卷积增强，基于反转嵌入对注意力分数矩阵应用多尺度卷积，在由压缩时间表示诱导出的变量交互空间中捕获局部结构模式；(2) Sinkhorn最优传输正则化，将注意力计算建模为最优传输问题，并通过迭代矩阵缩放确保变量间的信息流均衡。自适应融合策略利用softmax归一化的可学习权重，动态组合基础注意力、卷积增强和最优传输正则化分数。在广泛使用的数据集（包括ETT、Electricity、Traffic、Solar-Energy和Exchange-Rate）上的实验表明，MSC-OT在短期和长期预测任务中均取得了良好性能。消融实验进一步验证了每个提出组件的有效性及其在提高多变量时间序列预测精度方面的协同贡献。

</details>


### [339] [Policy-Driven CT-Agent: Modeling Phase-Aware Diagnostic Control for Clinically Consistent CT Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10748)
*Yanmeng Dong,Han Li,Yujia Li,Jingsong Liu,Xun Ma,Yanzhu Hu,Zhengyang Xu,Zhicheng Li,Nassir Navab,Shaohua Kevin Zhou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PD-CTAgent，一种基于策略驱动的CT智能体，用于临床一致的CT分期选择和诊断推理。它通过临床结构抽象模块（CSAM）统一异构多期相表示，并利用知识引导的诊断控制模型（KDCM）评估期相充分性、迭代请求额外期相，从而桥接静态CT分析与真实临床工作流。在三个数据集上验证了有效性和临床一致性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有CT-based AI方法假设所有期相均可获得，专注于固定期相下的静态任务，无法建模是否需要额外期相。这一局限源于异构的多期相表示、需要超越视觉线索的知识引导期相控制，以及现有数据集缺乏对期相充分性决策的监督。

Method: 提出Policy-Driven CT-Agent (PD-CTAgent)，包含：1) 临床结构抽象模块（CSAM），将异构CT期相统一为一致的期相感知证据表示；2) 知识引导的诊断控制模型（KDCM），评估期相充分性并迭代请求额外期相；3) 策略驱动智能体设计，灵活遵循不同机构、区域或指南的诊断协议。

Result: 在LIDC、MCT-LTDiag两个公开数据集和一个私有数据集上的实验表明，该方法有效且具有临床一致性。

Conclusion: PD-CTAgent桥接了静态CT分析与真实临床工作流，实现了灵活遵循不同指南的期相选择与诊断推理。

Original Abstract: Computed Tomography (CT) diagnosis often relies on dynamic selection of imaging phases, such as non-contrast, arterial, or venous phases, based on preliminary findings, clinical suspicion, and diagnostic guidelines. This phase-wise decision process is critical for reducing unnecessary radiation exposure while supporting timely staging and treatment planning. However, phase-selection protocols can vary across hospitals, regions, and guidelines, while most existing CT-based AI methods assume that all phases are available and focus on static tasks under a fixed imaging phase, failing to model whether additional phases are required. This limitation stems from heterogeneous multi-phase representations, the need for knowledge-guided phase control beyond visual cues, and the lack of supervision for phase-sufficiency decisions in existing datasets. To address these challenges, we propose Policy-Driven CT-Agent (PD-CTAgent) for clinically consistent CT phase selection and diagnostic reasoning. PD-CTAgent introduces a Clinical Structure Abstraction Module (CSAM) to harmonize heterogeneous CT phases into a unified, phase-aware evidence representation. Based on this representation, a Knowledge-Guided Diagnostic Control Model (KDCM) evaluates phase sufficiency and iteratively requests additional phases when necessary. The policy-driven agent design further allows PD-CTAgent to flexibly follow different institutional, regional, or guideline-specific diagnostic protocols. Together, PD-CTAgent bridges static CT analysis and real-world clinical workflows. Experiments on two public datasets, LIDC and MCT-LTDiag, and one private dataset demonstrate its effectiveness and clinical consistency. Code will be made public upon acceptance.

中文摘要翻译: 计算机断层扫描（CT）诊断通常依赖于根据初步发现、临床怀疑和诊断指南动态选择成像期相（如平扫期、动脉期或静脉期）。这种逐期相的决策过程对于减少不必要的辐射暴露同时支持及时的分期和治疗规划至关重要。然而，期相选择协议在不同医院、地区和指南之间存在差异，而大多数现有的基于CT的AI方法假设所有期相均可获得，并专注于固定成像期相下的静态任务，未能建模是否需要额外的期相。这一局限源于异构的多期相表示、需要超越视觉线索的知识引导期相控制，以及现有数据集中缺乏对期相充分性决策的监督。为应对这些挑战，我们提出Policy-Driven CT-Agent（PD-CTAgent），用于临床一致的CT期相选择和诊断推理。PD-CTAgent引入临床结构抽象模块（CSAM），将异构的CT期相统一为一致的、期相感知的证据表示。基于该表示，知识引导的诊断控制模型（KDCM）评估期相充分性，并在必要时迭代请求额外的期相。策略驱动的智能体设计进一步使PD-CTAgent能够灵活遵循不同机构、区域或指南特定的诊断协议。综上，PD-CTAgent桥接了静态CT分析与真实临床工作流。在两个公开数据集LIDC和MCT-LTDiag以及一个私有数据集上的实验证明了其有效性和临床一致性。代码将在接收后公开。

</details>


### [340] [The VC dimension of partial concept classes via Radon's theorem](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10751)
*Grigory Ivanov,Attila Jung,Márton Naszódi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究实Banach空间中两类带间隔的几何部分概念类的VC维，在L_p空间（包括ℓ_1）中给出了膨胀球部分概念类的无维数上界，与间隔参数δ匹配的下界，并推导了L_p空间中的稠密邻域引理。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 将膨胀球部分概念类的VC维研究从欧氏空间（ℓ_2^d）推广到更一般的L_p空间（包括非欧的ℓ_1），后者在算法上尤为重要。

Method: 通过将距离线性化映射到具有非平凡Rademacher类型的空间，然后使用平衡有符号和估计或无维数Radon定理，并借助泛函分析思想。

Result: 给出了L_p空间（1≤p<∞）中膨胀球部分概念类VC维的无维数上界（依赖于间隔和半径，不依赖维度和测度空间），给出了与δ匹配的下界，并将稠密邻域引理推广到L_p空间。

Conclusion: 成功将膨胀球部分概念类的VC维界从欧氏空间扩展到更一般的L_p空间，理论结果具有维数无关性，具有重要的算法意义。

Original Abstract: Following Alon, Hanneke, Holzman, and Moran (FOCS 2021), we define a partial concept class (PCC) as a family of partial functions \(f: V\to\{0,1,\ast\}\); equivalently, its concepts partition the ground set into black ($f^{-1}(1)$), grey ($f^{-1}(\ast)$), and white parts ($f^{-1}(0)$). Its VC dimension is defined by shattering sets on which the value $\ast$ is not taken. We study two geometric PCCs in real Banach spaces, both with a margin \(δ>0\): expanded half-spaces, where the grey part is a strip of width at least \(δ\) adjacent to a half-space, and expanded balls, where the grey part is an annulus of width \(δ\) around a unit radius ball.
  Our main results are dimension-free upper bounds on the VC dimension of the PCC of expanded balls in \(L_p\parenthμ\), \(1\le p<\infty\), including the non-Euclidean and algorithmically particularly relevant case \(\ell^d_1\). These bounds depend on the margin and on the radii, but not on the ambient dimension or the underlying measure space. These are extensions of the work of Bourneuf, Charbit, and Thomassé (FOCS 2025) who studied the PCC of expanded balls in Euclidean space, that is, $\ell_2^d$. We also prove lower bounds on the VC dimension that match the upper bounds in terms of the margin parameter $δ$. Finally, we derive a Dense Neighborhood Lemma in \(L_p\)-spaces, again extending the known Euclidean results.
  Our method relies on the linearization of the distance through a map into a space of non-trivial Rademacher type, and then the use of a balanced signed-sum estimate, or a no-dimensional Radon theorem. The arguments rely on ideas from functional analysis that are clearly explained for the non-expert in that field.

中文摘要翻译: 遵循Alon、Hanneke、Holzman和Moran（FOCS 2021）的工作，我们将部分概念类定义为部分函数族 \(f: V\to\{0,1,\ast\}\)；等价地，其概念将基础集划分为黑色（\(f^{-1}(1)\)）、灰色（\(f^{-1}(\ast)\)）和白色（\(f^{-1}(0)\)）三部分。其VC维定义为在不取\(\ast\)值的集合上的打碎性质。我们研究实Banach空间中两类带间隔\(\delta>0\)的几何部分概念类：扩展半空间（灰色部分为宽度至少\(\delta\)的邻接半空间的带状区域）和膨胀球（灰色部分为围绕单位半径球的宽度为\(\delta\)的环状区域）。我们的主要结果是L_p空间（\(1\le p<\infty\)，包括非欧且算法上尤为相关的\(\ell^d_1\)情况）中膨胀球部分概念类VC维的无维数上界。这些界依赖于间隔和半径，但不依赖于环境维数或底层的测度空间。这是对Bourneuf、Charbit和Thomassé（FOCS 2025）在欧氏空间（即\(\ell_2^d\)）中研究的膨胀球部分概念类的推广。我们还证明了VC维的下界，这些下界在间隔参数\(\delta\)的意义上与上界匹配。最后，我们在L_p空间中推导了稠密邻域引理，同样推广了已知的欧氏结果。我们的方法依赖于通过将距离线性化映射到具有非平凡Rademacher类型的空间，然后使用平衡有符号和估计或无维数Radon定理。论证中使用的泛函分析思想已为非该领域专家清晰地阐释。

</details>


### [341] [LSTrans: Efficient Knowledge Transfer for Lightweight and Automated ECG Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10784)
*Yi Zhao,Jiajun Gao,Chenyang Xu,Yuxi Zhou,Hao Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LSTrans，一种轻量级混合模型，结合1D卷积骨干与Transformer编码器，并采用低秩适配和知识蒸馏技术，在资源受限的可穿戴设备上实现高效、敏感的心电图自动分类，兼顾诊断敏感性与资源效率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在资源受限的可穿戴设备上部署深度学习模型进行自动化心电图分类面临计算成本高的挑战，现有模型难以同时保证诊断敏感性和资源效率。

Method: 提出LSTrans轻量级混合模型：设计带有交错层架构的1D卷积骨干以捕获宏观节律趋势和微观形态变化；级联Transformer编码器建模长程时间依赖；在关键层引入低秩适配（LoRA）压缩模型并减少可训练参数；采用同质和异质知识蒸馏将高容量教师模型的诊断知识迁移至学生模型。

Result: 在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，LSTrans在诊断敏感性与资源效率之间达到了有竞争力的平衡，显著降低了峰值内存占用和下游适配中的训练延迟。

Conclusion: LSTrans为资源受限的可穿戴设备上的心电图自动分类提供了一种轻量级且高效的解决方案，在保持高诊断敏感性的同时大幅提升计算资源效率。

Original Abstract: Deploying deep learning models for automated electrocardiogram classification on resource-constrained wearable devices remains challenging due to high computational costs. To address this, we propose LSTrans, a lightweight hybrid model designed for efficient and sensitive ECG analysis. LSTrans introduces a specialized 1D convolutional backbone with an interleaved layer architecture to capture both macroscopic rhythmic trends and microscopic morphological variations. This backbone is cascaded with a Transformer encoder to model long-range temporal dependencies, incorporating Low-Rank Adaptation across critical layers to compress the model and reduce the trainable parameter space. We further employ homogeneous and heterogeneous knowledge distillation to transfer diagnostic expertise from high-capacity teacher models to the student. Experimental results on multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that LSTrans achieves a competitive balance between diagnostic sensitivity and resource efficiency, substantially reducing peak memory footprints and training latency during downstream adaptation. The source code is available for review at https://github.com/zyee00128/LSTrans4BIBM.

中文摘要翻译: 在资源受限的可穿戴设备上部署用于自动化心电图分类的深度学习模型仍然面临计算成本高的挑战。为此，我们提出LSTrans，一种轻量级混合模型，专为高效且敏感的心电图分析而设计。LSTrans引入了一个具有交错层架构的特制1D卷积骨干，以同时捕获宏观节律趋势和微观形态变化。该骨干与Transformer编码器级联，用于建模长程时间依赖关系，同时在关键层引入低秩适配（Low-Rank Adaptation）以压缩模型并减少可训练参数空间。我们进一步采用同质和异质知识蒸馏（Knowledge Distillation），将高容量教师模型的诊断专业知识迁移至学生模型。在多个基准数据集上的实验结果表明，LSTrans在诊断敏感性与资源效率之间实现了有竞争力的平衡，显著降低了下游适配过程中的峰值内存占用和训练延迟。源代码可在https://github.com/zyee00128/LSTrans4BIBM公开获取。

</details>


### [342] [Hierarchical Bayesian Quadrature](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10793)
*Tim Weiland,Toni Karvonen,Philipp Hennig*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出层次化贝叶斯求积（Hierarchical Bayesian Quadrature），通过自适应增长的树状分区将非平稳被积函数分解为局部平稳模型，再通过高斯过程条件化重组跨子域相关性，无需MCMC即可处理非平稳积分问题，在基准测试和流行病学模型证据计算中显著优于标准贝叶斯求积。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 标准贝叶斯求积主要使用平稳协方差函数，这导致对被积函数非平稳行为的模型误设，需要一种能够自适应处理非平稳性的贝叶斯求积方法。

Method: 通过自适应增长的基于树的划分将积分域分解为局部平稳模型，利用高斯过程条件化的层级结构重新组合局部积分估计以恢复跨子域相关性，采用模型选择准则控制树的生长以避免不必要的划分。

Result: 在基准积分问题和流行病学模型证据计算中，层次化贝叶斯求积在非平稳被积函数上显著优于标准贝叶斯求积，同时在平稳被积函数上匹配其性能。

Conclusion: 层次化贝叶斯求积是一种简单、无需MCMC、能自适应调整评估预算到局部被积函数复杂度的有效方法，为非平稳积分问题提供了实用解决方案。

Original Abstract: Numerical integration is a cornerstone of various scientific computing applications, such as engineering simulations and model evidence computations in probabilistic machine learning. Bayesian Quadrature uses Gaussian process surrogates that explicitly encode structural assumptions about the integrand to obtain integral estimates with quantified uncertainty. These surrogates are predominantly based on stationary covariance functions, which results in model misspecification for integrands exhibiting nonstationary behavior. We tackle this issue through an adaptively growing, tree-based partition of the integration domain into local stationary models. Our method recombines the local integral estimates through a hierarchy of GP conditioning that reintroduces cross-subdomain correlations, while model selection criteria control the tree growth to avoid unnecessary partitioning. The resulting algorithm is simple, requires no MCMC, and adapts its evaluation budget to local integrand complexity. On benchmark integration problems and a model evidence computation for an epidemiological model, Hierarchical Bayesian Quadrature achieves substantial gains over standard Bayesian Quadrature on nonstationary integrands while matching its performance on stationary ones.

中文摘要翻译: 数值积分是各类科学计算应用的基石，例如工程仿真和概率机器学习中的模型证据计算。贝叶斯求积利用高斯过程代理模型显式编码关于被积函数的结构性假设，从而获得带有量化不确定性的积分估计。这些代理模型主要基于平稳协方差函数，这导致对被积函数非平稳行为的模型误设。我们通过自适应增长的基于树的划分将积分域分解为局部平稳模型来解决这一问题。我们的方法通过高斯过程条件化的层级结构重新组合局部积分估计，从而恢复跨子域相关性，同时模型选择准则控制树的生长以避免不必要的划分。最终算法简单、无需马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛（MCMC），并能根据局部被积函数复杂度自适应调整评估预算。在基准积分问题和流行病学模型的模型证据计算中，层次化贝叶斯求积在非平稳被积函数上显著优于标准贝叶斯求积，同时在平稳被积函数上匹配其性能。

</details>


### [343] [Weight-Adjusted Gradients Reveal Parameter Importance and Failure Modes in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10803)
*Shrestha Datta,Hongfu Liu,Anshuman Chhabra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出权重调整梯度(WAG)方法，通过结合模型权重与一阶梯度信息来估计参数重要性，揭示LLM中存在少量关键参数，其修改会导致性能急剧下降，现有指标无法捕捉此类失效模式。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 理解大型语言模型中的哪些参数具有关键影响力，对于提升模型效率、可靠性和可解释性至关重要。现有重要性评估指标未能捕捉到参数修改导致性能急剧下降的失效模式，需要一种能够显式捕捉权重与梯度交互作用的方法。

Method: 提出Weight-Adjusted Gradients (WAG)方法，通过结合模型权重与一阶梯度信息来估计参数重要性，显式捕捉两者之间的交互作用，从而识别出对模型行为产生不成比例影响的参数子集。

Result: WAG能够识别出一小部分关键参数，修改这些参数会导致模型性能急剧下降；在多个应用场景（混合专家架构、参数级遗忘、混合精度量化、知识编辑中的层选择）中展示了实用性；揭示了权重与梯度之间此前未被充分探索的相互作用。

Conclusion: 参数重要性无法单独通过权重或梯度信号完全理解；WAG揭示了训练网络的基本结构特性，可作为分析、调试和控制LLM的统一方法，为原理性模型级解释开辟了新方向。

Original Abstract: Understanding which parameters are influential in Large Language Models (LLMs) is central to improving their efficiency, reliability, and interpretability. We introduce Weight-Adjusted Gradients (WAG), a simple yet effective approach for estimating parameter importance that explicitly captures the interaction between model weights and first-order gradient information and identifies parameters that disproportionately influence model behavior, such as those responsible for collapse phenomena in LLMs. Across a range of models and settings, we show that WAG surfaces a tiny but critical subset of parameters whose modification leads to dramatic degradation in performance, a failure mode that existing importance metrics overlook. These findings reveal a previously underexplored interplay between weights and gradients, suggesting that parameter importance cannot be fully understood through either signal alone. The surprising effectiveness of WAG points to fundamental structural properties of trained networks and motivates new open questions about the role of zeroth-order and first-order information in deep learning. We demonstrate the practical utility of WAG across multiple applications, including expert allocation in mixture-of-expert architectures, parameter-specific unlearning, mixed-precision quantization, and layer selection for knowledge editing. Our results position WAG as a unified approach for analyzing, debugging, and controlling LLMs, and opens new directions for principled model-level interpretation.

中文摘要翻译: 理解大型语言模型（LLM）中哪些参数具有影响力，对于提升其效率、可靠性和可解释性至关重要。本文提出权重调整梯度（WAG），一种简单而有效的参数重要性估计方法，它显式捕捉模型权重与一阶梯度信息之间的交互作用，并识别出对模型行为产生不成比例影响的参数，例如导致LLM崩溃现象的参数。在一系列模型和设置中，我们表明WAG能够揭示一个微小但关键的参数子集，修改这些参数会导致性能急剧下降，这是现有重要性指标所忽视的一种失效模式。这些发现揭示了权重与梯度之间此前未被充分探索的相互作用，表明参数重要性无法通过单独任何一个信号得到完全理解。WAG的惊人有效性指向了训练网络的基本结构特性，并引发了关于零阶与一阶信息在深度学习中作用的新开放性问题。我们展示了WAG在多个应用中的实用价值，包括混合专家架构中的专家分配、参数级遗忘、混合精度量化以及知识编辑中的层选择。我们的结果将WAG定位为分析、调试和控制LLM的统一方法，并为原理性模型级解释开辟了新方向。

</details>


### [344] [When does distribution shift break graph neural networks calibration?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10804)
*Abderaouf Bahi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次给出了图神经网络在分布偏移下校准的闭式理论刻画，发现校准由单一标量决定，并提出了无需目标标签的校准方法STAC。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 分布偏移下GNN的校准行为（预测置信度与实际精度的对齐程度）尚不明确，且现有图校准方法依赖部署分布中的标注验证数据，缺乏理论基础。

Method: 通过闭式理论推导刻画GNN在分布偏移下的校准行为，证明校准由依赖图结构变化和特征质量的单一标量决定；进而提出STAC（无源、无标签的校准方法）。

Result: 理论精确识别了模型何时过自信、欠自信或保持校准，并直接给出最优温度缩放策略；在均匀分布偏移下单一全局温度理论上最优；合成基准实验显著改善校准，但真实图数据集上无目标标签的可靠校准仍具挑战。

Conclusion: 理论为分布偏移下GNN校准提供了首个闭式刻画，解释了为何复杂节点级重校准方法无额外收益，并推动了无标签校准方法的发展。

Original Abstract: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications where distribution shift is un-avoidable. However, how such shifts affect model calibration, defined as the agreement between predictive confidence and actual accuracy, remains poorly understood, and existing graph calibration methods typically rely on labeled validation data from the deployment distribution. In this work, I present the first closed-form theoretical characterization of GNN calibration under distribution shift. I show that calibration is governed by a single scalar quantity that explicitly depends on structural changes between the source and target graphs, as well as feature quality. This characterization precisely identifies when a model becomes over-confident, under-confident, or remains calibrated, and directly yields the optimal temperature scaling strategy. I further extend the analysis to graph convolutional networks with symmetric normalization, multi-class classification, and covariate shift, and derive a theoretical upper bound on the expected calibration error. My analysis also reveals that, under homogeneous distribution shift, a single global temperature is theoretically optimal, providing a principled explanation for why more complex node-wise recalibration methods offer no additional benefit. Building on these theoretical insights, I propose STAC, a source-free, label-free calibration method. Experiments on synthetic benchmarks demonstrate substantial calibration improvements, while evaluations on five real-world graph datasets show that reliable calibration without target labels remains challenging despite the strong predictive power of the theory.

中文摘要翻译: 图神经网络（GNN）越来越多地部署在分布偏移不可避免的实际应用中。然而，这种偏移如何影响模型校准——即预测置信度与实际精度之间的对齐程度——仍知之甚少，且现有的图校准方法通常依赖于来自部署分布的有标注验证数据。本文首次给出了分布偏移下GNN校准的闭式理论刻画。研究表明，校准由单一标量决定，该标量显式依赖于源图与目标图之间的结构变化以及特征质量。该刻画精确识别了模型何时变得过自信、欠自信或保持校准，并直接导出了最优温度缩放策略。本文进一步将分析扩展到对称归一化的图卷积网络、多分类和协变量偏移，并推导了期望校准误差的理论上界。分析还揭示，在均匀分布偏移下，单一全局温度在理论上是最优的，这为为何更复杂的节点级重校准方法无法带来额外收益提供了原理性解释。基于这些理论洞见，本文提出了STAC，一种无源、无标签的校准方法。合成基准实验展示了显著的校准改进，而对五个真实世界图数据集的评估表明，尽管该理论具有强大的预测能力，但在没有目标标签的情况下实现可靠的校准仍然具有挑战性。

</details>


### [345] [Lower Bound on the Cumulative Constrained Violation for the OGD+Projection algorithm for Constrained Online Convex Optimization (COCO)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10808)
*Haricharan Balasundaram,Karthick Krishna Mahendran,Rahul Vaze*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了在约束在线凸优化问题中，OGD+Projection算法的累积约束违反（CCV）下界为Ω(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})，这是首个此类下界结果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 目前已知OGD+Projection算法在d=2时达到O(√T)遗憾和O(T^{1/3})的CCV，在任意d时达到O(√T)遗憾和O(√T)的CCV，但缺乏对CCV下界的研究。本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 通过理论分析推导OGD+Projection算法在约束在线凸优化问题中累积约束违反的下界，给出下界Ω(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})。

Result: 证明了OGD+Projection算法的CCV下界为Ω(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})，这是该方向首个下界结果。

Conclusion: 该下界结果表明OGD+Projection算法的CCV性能在维度d增加时退化，揭示了现有方法在高维约束在线凸优化问题中的局限性。

Original Abstract: The problem of constrained online convex optimization is considered, where at each round, once a learner commits to an action $x_t \in \mathcal{X} \subset \mathbb{R}^d$, a convex loss function $f_t$ and a convex constraint function $g_t$ that drives the constraint $g_t(x)\le 0$ are revealed. The objective is to simultaneously minimize the static regret and cumulative constraint violation (CCV) compared to the benchmark that knows the loss functions and constraint functions $f_t$ and $g_t$ for all $t$ ahead of time, and chooses a static optimal action that is feasible with respect to all $g_t(x)\le 0$. Currently, the best known algorithm is OGD+Projection algorithm of [Vaze and Sinha, 2025] that has simultaneous regret of $O(\sqrt{T})$ and CCV of $O(T^{1/3})$ for $d=2$ [Balasundaram et al., 2026], and simultaneous regret of $O(\sqrt{T})$ and CCV of $O(\sqrt{T})$ for any $d$ [Sarkar and Sinha, 2026]. In this paper, we show that the CCV of the OGD+Projection algorithm is $Ω(T^{\frac{d-1}{2d}})$. This is the first such lower bound result.

中文摘要翻译: 本文研究了约束在线凸优化问题。在该问题中，每一轮学习者选择一个动作x_t ∈ X ⊂ R^d后，凸损失函数f_t和驱动约束g_t(x) ≤ 0的凸约束函数g_t才会被揭示。目标是相对于提前知晓所有时刻损失函数和约束函数f_t、g_t，并选择对所有g_t(x) ≤ 0都可行的静态最优动作的基准，同时最小化静态遗憾和累积约束违反（CCV）。目前，已知最好的算法是[Vaze and Sinha, 2025]的OGD+Projection算法，当d=2时[Balasundaram et al., 2026]实现了O(√T)的遗憾和O(T^{1/3})的CCV，当d为任意维度时[Sarkar and Sinha, 2026]实现了O(√T)的遗憾和O(√T)的CCV。本文证明了OGD+Projection算法的CCV下界为Ω(T^{(d-1)/(2d)})。这是首个此类下界结果。

</details>


### [346] [Diachronic Sample Integration: Robust Tail-Risk Estimation with Generative Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10810)
*Shuning Zhao,Patrick Wong,Leran Zhang,Xiaolin Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Diachronic Sample Integration (DSI)，一种测试时推理框架，通过集成随机训练轨迹中多个检查点生成的样本来稳定尾部估计，在不修改生成目标的情况下显著降低尾部估计误差。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在数据稀缺的风险敏感应用中，深度生成模型对罕见不良场景（尾部事件）的建模质量至关重要，但标准生成目标侧重整体分布保真度，导致低概率尾部易受局部优化噪声影响，在有限模拟预算下尾部依赖的泛函不稳定。

Method: DSI是一种测试时推理框架，通过集成来自随机训练轨迹中多个检查点的生成样本来构建一个检查点混合分布，该分布平均了各检查点特定的尾部波动，而非依赖单个脆弱的终点检查点。

Result: 在多变量合成过程和高频交易数据上，DSI在固定模拟预算下显著降低了尾部估计误差，优于单检查点基线以及标准扩散方法和最先进的尾部感知基线。

Conclusion: DSI通过集成多检查点样本有效稳定了尾部估计，为风险敏感场景下的生成模型应用提供了一种无需修改生成目标的实用解决方案。

Original Abstract: Deep generative models are increasingly used as simulators for downstream decision-making under data scarcity, but in risk-sensitive applications their usefulness depends on rare adverse scenarios rather than typical samples. Standard generative objectives prioritize bulk distributional fidelity, leaving low-probability tails vulnerable to localized optimization noise and making tail-dependent functionals unstable under finite simulation budgets. We introduce Diachronic Sample Integration (DSI), a test-time inference framework that ensembles generated samples across checkpoints from a stochastic training trajectory. DSI targets a checkpoint-mixture distribution that averages checkpoint-specific tail fluctuations rather than relying on a single brittle endpoint. We formalize this mechanism through a finite-budget bias-variance theory. Empirically, across multivariate synthetic processes and high-frequency trading data, DSI substantially reduces tail-estimation error compared to single-checkpoint baselines under fixed simulation budgets, outperforming standard diffusion and state-of-the-art tail-aware baselines without modifying the generative objective.

中文摘要翻译: 深度生成模型越来越多地被用作数据稀缺情境下下游决策制定的模拟器，但在风险敏感应用中，其价值取决于罕见不良场景而非典型样本。标准生成目标优先保证整体分布保真度，使得低概率尾部容易受到局部优化噪声的影响，并导致在有限模拟预算下尾部依赖的泛函不稳定。我们提出了历时样本集成（Diachronic Sample Integration, DSI），一种测试时推理框架，该框架集成来自随机训练轨迹中多个检查点生成的样本。DSI针对一个检查点混合分布，该分布平均了各检查点特定的尾部波动，而非依赖单个脆弱的终点。我们通过有限预算的偏差-方差理论形式化了这一机制。在经验上，在多变量合成过程和高频交易数据上，DSI在固定模拟预算下相比单检查点基线显著降低了尾部估计误差，且在不修改生成目标的情况下优于标准扩散方法和最先进的尾部感知基线。

</details>


### [347] [Graph Neural Networks for RFID-Based Spatial Geometry Inference in Spatial AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10822)
*Curtis Shull,Merrick Green,Roy Rucker*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个基于图神经网络的框架，利用RFID观测数据推断室内空间几何结构，通过建模RFID读数、天线和物理结构之间的关系来预测物体的运动轨迹和空间区域。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统RFID定位技术只能估计标签位置，无法捕获物体与基础设施之间的高阶空间关系；现有方法多关注孤立样本定位，缺乏关系建模能力。

Method: 构建图表示：节点对应RFID观测值，边编码邻近和上下文关系；将信号强度数据、楼层平面语义和空间约束融入图中，使用图神经网络训练以预测几何模式（如线性轨迹、矩形边界区域、物体运动路径）。

Result: 本文未报告具体实验结果，核心是一种新提出的方法框架。

Conclusion: 将拓扑结构作为一级信息来源，通过图神经网络对RFID观测进行关系建模，能够有效推断室内空间几何结构。

Original Abstract: Indoor spatial understanding remains a fundamental challenge for intelligent systems operating in physical environments. Traditional RFID localization techniques typically estimate positions of tags using signal strength measurements but fail to capture higher-order spatial relationships between objects and infrastructure. Recent work on RFID and wireless indoor localization has increasingly emphasized robust learning under noisy propagation, while recent graph-based localization methods demonstrate the value of relational modeling over isolated samples. This paper introduces a graph-based learning framework that leverages Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) to infer spatial geometry from RFID observations. Rather than predicting isolated coordinates, the proposed system models relationships between RFID readings, antennas, and physical structures within an indoor floorplan. This framing is aligned with recent graph-based indoor positioning and graph construction literature, where topology is a first-class source of information for downstream inference. The approach integrates signal strength data, floorplan semantics, and spatial constraints into a graph representation where nodes correspond to RFID observations and edges encode proximity and contextual relationships. A GNN is then trained to predict geometric patterns such as linear trajectories, rectangular bounding regions, and movement paths of objects in space.

中文摘要翻译: 室内空间理解仍然是智能系统在物理环境中运行的基本挑战。传统的RFID定位技术通常利用信号强度测量来估计标签的位置，但无法捕获物体与基础设施之间的高阶空间关系。近年来，RFID和无线室内定位的研究日益强调在噪声传播下的鲁棒学习，而基于图的定位方法则展示了关系建模相较于孤立样本的优势。本文提出了一种基于图学习的框架，利用图神经网络从RFID观测中推断空间几何结构。该系统的核心并非预测孤立的坐标，而是建模RFID读数、天线和物理结构在室内楼层平面中的关系。这一框架与近期基于图的室内定位和图构建文献相一致，其中拓扑结构作为下游推理的一级信息来源。该方法将信号强度数据、楼层平面语义和空间约束融入图表示，其中节点对应RFID观测，边编码邻近和上下文关系。然后训练图神经网络来预测几何模式，例如物体的线性轨迹、矩形边界区域和运动路径。

</details>


### [348] [Predictive Divergence Masks for LLM RL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10848)
*Xiangxin Zhou,Jiarui Yao,Penghui Qi,Bowen Ping,Jiaqi Tang,Haonan Wang,Tianyu Pang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出预测性散度掩码（Predictive Divergence Mask），用于改进LLM强化学习中PPO/DPPO的方向判据，通过预测策略梯度步骤对散度的变化方向来决定是否掩码，替代了传统的基于采样token重要性比率的单样本代理方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有PPO/DPPO方法中，接近性判据使用概率散度（DPPO），但方向判据仍沿用PPO基于采样token重要性比率的单样本代理方法，该比率符号可能与散度变化符号不一致，导致判据不一致。

Method: 提出预测性散度掩码，直接预测下一步策略梯度更新将增加还是减少与信任域相同的散度。针对离散softmax策略导出闭式解，并为生产环境中的截断（top-K）词表设计两种轻量级top-K估计器。

Result: 基于散度的方向判据比基于采样比率的判据与散度实际变化对齐更好；该掩码在多种模型规模和精度设置下提升了RL训练效果。

Conclusion: 预测性散度掩码通过统一接近性和方向判据的散度基础，解决了PPO/DPPO中判据不一致问题，有效提升了LLM强化学习的训练性能。

Original Abstract: Reinforcement learning for large language models (LLMs) typically relies on trust-region masks to stabilize off-policy updates. The dominant PPO-style approach uses the sampled-token importance ratio for two criteria: a proximity criterion, which asks whether the policy has moved too far from the behavior policy, and a direction criterion, which asks whether the update pushes it farther away. Recent work DPPO improves the proximity criterion by replacing PPO's ratio-based test with a probability divergence between the behavior and training policies. However, its direction criterion is still inherited from PPO. A token can be masked only when the sampled-token importance ratio moves away from one. We observe that this ratio-based direction criterion is a single-sample proxy that can disagree in sign with the change of the divergence that defines the proximity criterion. We therefore propose the predictive divergence mask, which asks whether the next policy-gradient step will increase or decrease the same divergence used by the trust region. For the discrete softmax policies used in LLM RL, we derive this prediction in closed form. Because production rollout engines expose only a truncated (top-K) view of the vocabulary, we develop two lightweight top-$K$ estimators for this prediction. Detailed analysis shows the divergence-based direction is better aligned with the realized change of the divergence than the sampled ratio, and the resulting masks improve RL training across model scales and precision settings.

中文摘要翻译: 大语言模型的强化学习通常依赖信任域掩码来稳定离策略更新。主流的PPO风格方法使用采样token的重要性比率进行两项判据：接近性判据（检查策略是否偏离行为策略过远）和方向判据（检查更新是否使其进一步偏离）。近期工作DPPO通过将PPO基于比率的检验替换为行为策略与训练策略之间的概率散度，改进了接近性判据。然而其方向判据仍继承自PPO：仅当采样token的重要性比率偏离1时才掩码该token。我们观察到这种基于比率的方向判据是一种单样本代理，其符号可能与定义接近性判据的散度变化符号不一致。因此我们提出预测性散度掩码，直接预测下一步策略梯度更新将增加还是减少信任域所使用的同一散度。针对LLM强化学习中使用的离散softmax策略，我们推导出该预测的闭式解。由于生产环境的rollout引擎仅暴露词表的截断（top-K）视图，我们为此预测设计了两种轻量级top-K估计器。详细分析表明，基于散度的方向判据比基于采样比率的方向判据与散度实际变化更对齐，且由此产生的掩码在多种模型规模和精度设置下均能改善RL训练。

</details>


### [349] [Reliability Scaling Laws for Quantized Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10855)
*Sirine Ayadi,Sándor Daróczi,Stephan Günnemann,Bertrand Charpentier*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 对量化大语言模型在扰动输入下的可靠性（不确定性、校准、鲁棒性）进行全面评估，发现4位量化模型在可靠性-效率权衡上达到最优，且量化增强了对自然输入扰动的鲁棒性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 尽管量化LLM在标准预测指标上表现优异，但其在扰动输入下的可靠性（如不确定性评估、校准和鲁棒性）尚未得到充分研究，而这对于模型可靠部署至关重要。

Method: 构建三部分可靠性评估框架：(1) 使用不确定性指标评估2/3/4/8位量化模型；(2) 评估不同规模与位宽下的校准质量；(3) 设计字符级和词级扰动测试鲁棒性。并分析可靠性与模型总位数之间的缩放规律。

Result: (1) 模型性能随总位数单调提升，但可靠性呈非线性缩放；(2) 4位量化模型达到可靠性峰值，即中等规模量化提供最佳可靠性-效率权衡；(3) 量化增强了LLM对自然输入扰动的鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 中等位宽（4位）的量化模型在可靠性-效率权衡上最优，量化不仅节省资源，还能提升模型对输入扰动的鲁棒性。

Original Abstract: Quantization is a powerful strategy to build capable and resource-efficient large language models (LLMs) by reducing the bitwidth of the parameters. While quantized LLMs achieve state-of-the-art performance on unperturbed inputs using standard predictive metrics, their performance on perturbed inputs, measured using reliability metrics, remains underexplored, despite its importance for reliable deployment. To address this gap, we first conduct a comprehensive reliability evaluation of quantized LLMs consisting of three key components: (1) Uncertainty: We assess the trustworthiness of LLMs quantized to 2, 3, 4, and 8 bits using six different quantization methods, employing established uncertainty metrics. (2) Calibration: We assess how well-calibrated the uncertainty estimates of quantized models are across model scales and bit precisions. (3) Robustness: We design character-level and word-level input perturbations to evaluate the reliability of quantized models under semantically-preserving variations in the inputs that arise in real-world applications. Second, we characterize how reliability scales with the total number of model bits. Our study reveals that while the performance scales monotonically with the total number of bits, the reliability scalings are nonlinear. A reliability peak occurs for 4-bit quantized models, indicating that quantizing moderately sized models offers the best reliability-efficiency trade-off. Additionally, our empirical findings reveal that quantization enhances the robustness of LLMs to natural input perturbations.

中文摘要翻译: 量化是一种通过降低参数位宽来构建高性能且资源高效的大语言模型（LLM）的有效策略。虽然量化后的LLM在标准预测指标下对未扰动输入取得了最先进的性能，但它们在扰动输入下的性能（使用可靠性指标衡量）仍未得到充分探索，而这对于模型的可靠部署至关重要。为填补这一空白，我们首先对量化LLM进行了全面的可靠性评估，包含三个关键部分：(1) 不确定性：使用已有的不确定性指标，评估采用六种不同量化方法量化至2、3、4和8位的LLM的可靠性；(2) 校准：评估量化模型在不同模型规模和位精度下的不确定性估计校准质量；(3) 鲁棒性：设计字符级和词级输入扰动，以评估量化模型在实际应用中出现的语义保持输入变化下的可靠性。其次，我们刻画了可靠性如何随模型总位数缩放。本研究表明，虽然性能随总位数单调提升，但可靠性的缩放是非线性的。4位量化模型出现了可靠性峰值，表明中等规模量化模型提供了最佳的可靠性-效率权衡。此外，我们的实证发现表明，量化增强了LLM对自然输入扰动的鲁棒性。

</details>


### [350] [Singular perturbations and hierarchical learning in two-layer neural networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10869)
*Cédric Gerbelot,Jean-Christophe Mourrat*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了高维下无限宽两层神经网络在错误设定单指标模型上的种群梯度流，证明了层级学习场景中常数和线性分量的恢复时间阈值，并分析了二次分量的学习起始行为及其与已学习分量的相互作用。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 验证Berthier等人提出的层级学习场景中关于时间尺度的猜想，证明各分量恢复的尖锐显式阈值。

Method: 基于奇异摄动流在积分约束定义的流形附近演化的定量近似方法。

Result: 1) 严格证明了隐藏链接函数的常数和线性分量在预测的时间尺度内被恢复；2) 分析了二次分量学习的起始过程，发现早期学习的分量会持续影响后续动力学；3) 展示了权重经验测度的奇异行为：少数神经元显著增长，其余神经元重新排列以保持已学分量。

Conclusion: 验证了层级学习场景的时间尺度猜想，揭示了不同分量学习之间的相互作用机制及权重分布的非平凡演化行为。

Original Abstract: We study the population gradient flow of an infinitely wide two-layer neural network learning a misspecified single-index model in high dimension. The two layers are optimized jointly, with a perturbative parameter tuning the relative training speed between the first and second layer. This setting was considered by Berthier, Montanari and Zhou in \cite{berthier2024learning}, who conjectured a hierarchical learning scenario with explicit timescales as the second layer is trained faster than the first. In this paper, we prove that the constant and linear components of the hidden link function are indeed recovered within the predicted timescales, at sharp explicit thresholds. We then analyze the onset of learning of the quadratic component and show that the components learned at earlier stages continue to influence the dynamics in an essential way. Our proof is based on quantitative approximation results for singularly perturbed flows evolving near a manifold defined by integral constraints. At a phenomenological level, we also show that the empirical measure of the weights displays singular behaviour when reaching the quadratic component of the hidden link, with a small fraction of neurons growing significantly while the remaining ones rearrange to preserve the components already learned.

中文摘要翻译: 我们研究了一个无限宽两层神经网络在高维下学习错误设定的单指标模型的种群梯度流。两层网络被联合优化，通过一个扰动参数调节第一层和第二层之间的相对训练速度。这一设定由Berthier, Montanari和Zhou在\cite{berthier2024learning}中提出，他们猜想在第二层训练速度快于第一层时存在具有显式时间尺度的层级学习场景。在本文中，我们证明了隐藏链接函数的常数和线性分量确实在预测的时间尺度内被恢复，且达到了尖锐的显式阈值。接着，我们分析了二次分量学习的起始过程，并展示了早期阶段学习到的分量会继续以关键方式影响动力学。我们的证明基于奇异摄动流在积分约束定义的流形附近演化的定量近似结果。在现象学层面，我们还展示了当到达隐藏链接的二次分量时，权重的经验测度表现出奇异行为：一小部分神经元显著增长，而其余神经元重新排列以保持已经学习到的分量。

</details>


### [351] [Infrared Organization and Critical Cognitive Field Formation in Transformer Dynamics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10923)
*Byung Gyu Chae*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过实验验证了认知场理论(Cognitive Field Theory)对Transformer动力学的预测，发现训练过程中慢弛豫模式的红外累积导致态密度谱( TDOS)趋于平坦、记忆自能出现瞬态极大值、认知遗忘间隙最小化，表明红外集体组织是Transformer动力学的普适原则。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 大型语言模型展现出显著的涌现行为，但其集体动力学的物理机制尚不清楚。认知场理论预测学习通过慢弛豫模式的红外累积来重组时间尺度态密度(TDOS)，从而增强记忆自能、缩小认知遗忘间隙并增强集体易感性，该理论需要定量实验验证。

Method: 使用公开可用的Pythia语言模型，直接从Transformer层的Jacobian矩阵中提取弛豫谱，并在训练过程、网络深度和模型规模等维度上定量测量TDOS、记忆自能、遗忘间隙、记忆核和红外临界指数。

Result: 测量发现：(1) 慢弛豫模式呈现渐进式红外累积，产生近似平坦的红外TDOS (ρ(λ)~λ^{-0.1})和无标度记忆核(K(t)~t^{-1})；(2) 记忆自能在早期优化中出现显著瞬态极大值，随后弛豫到亚稳态近临界区域，对应最小的认知遗忘间隙和最大的集体易感性。

Conclusion: 这些定量实验证据表明Transformer动力学受红外集体组织支配，且该动态行为在训练、网络深度和模型规模上具有可重复性，表明红外慢模组织是Transformer动力学的普适集体原则。

Original Abstract: Large language models exhibit remarkable emergent behaviors, yet the physical mechanism governing their collective dynamics remains poorly understood. Cognitive Field Theory predicts that learning reorganizes the time-scale density of states (TDOS) through the infrared accumulation of slow relaxation modes, thereby enhancing the memory self-energy, reducing the cognitive forgetting gap, and strengthening the collective susceptibility. Using publicly available Pythia language models, we extract relaxation spectra directly from Transformer layer Jacobians throughout training, network depth, and model scale, allowing the TDOS, memory self-energy, forgetting gap, memory kernel, and infrared critical exponent to be measured quantitatively. The measurements reveal progressive infrared accumulation of slow relaxation modes, producing an approximately flat infrared TDOS with \( ρ(λ)\simλ^{-0.1} \) and scale-free memory kernels \( K(t)\sim t^{-1}. \) The memory self-energy exhibits a pronounced transient maximum during early optimization before relaxing toward a metastable near-critical regime, corresponding to the smallest cognitive forgetting gap and the largest collective susceptibility predicted by Cognitive Field Theory. These observations provide quantitative experimental evidence that Transformer dynamics are governed by infrared collective organization. The reproducibility of the same dynamical behavior across training, network depth, and model scales suggests that infrared slow-mode organization represents a universal collective principle of Transformer dynamics.

中文摘要翻译: 大型语言模型展现出显著的涌现行为，然而支配其集体动力学的物理机制仍未被充分理解。认知场理论预测，学习通过慢弛豫模式的红外累积来重组时间尺度态密度(TDOS)，从而增强记忆自能，缩小认知遗忘间隙，并增强集体易感性。我们利用公开可用的Pythia语言模型，直接从Transformer层Jacobian矩阵中提取训练过程、网络深度和模型规模下的弛豫谱，从而定量测量TDOS、记忆自能、遗忘间隙、记忆核和红外临界指数。测量结果揭示了慢弛豫模式的渐进式红外累积，产生了近似平坦的红外TDOS（ρ(λ)~λ^{-0.1}）和无标度记忆核（K(t)~t^{-1}）。记忆自在早期优化过程中表现出显著的瞬态极大值，随后弛豫至亚稳态近临界区域，对应于认知场理论所预言的最小认知遗忘间隙和最大集体易感性。这些观察结果为Transformer动力学受红外集体组织支配提供了定量实验证据。该动态行为在训练、网络深度和模型规模上的可重复性表明，红外慢模组织代表了Transformer动力学的普适集体原则。

</details>


### [352] [The Spectral Structure of Latent Treatment Effects](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10926)
*Hamza Virk,Bijan Mazaheri,Yihren Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种称为压缩可观测算子的新方法，用于在存在未观测混杂因素的情况下识别异质性处理效应。该方法将先前的合成潜在结果（SPO）标量矩序列统一为算子谱分析的几何框架，通过有限维谱分析替代高阶标量反演，并支持过完备代理系统。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在观测因果推断中，存在未观测混杂因素时识别异质性处理效应是一个核心难题。先前基于离散潜在混杂变量的代理模型（如SPO方法）通过递归构造标量矩来恢复处理效应的混合分布，但这种方法在处理高维、过完备代理系统时存在局限性，缺乏统一的理论框架。

Method: 本文揭示SPO标量矩序列是一个更基本对象的投影。在相同的人口分解假设下，存在一个精确的压缩可观测算子：投影到共享代理信号子空间后，两个处理臂商算子的差相似于潜在处理效应的对角矩阵。其特征值为潜在效应；经锚归一化后，其左特征向量可恢复目标-代理特征矩阵及潜在混合比例。每个SPO标量矩都是该算子幂的双线性泛函。

Result: 该估计器能处理过完备代理系统，用有限维谱分析替代高阶标量反演，并给出了处理效应、特征行和单纯形投影混合权重的概率一阶扰动界。

Conclusion: 本文提出的压缩可观测算子框架统一并推广了SPO方法，将因果推断中的异质性处理效应识别问题转化为算子谱分析问题，提供了更强大的理论保证和实际估计能力。

Original Abstract: Identifying heterogeneous treatment effects under unobserved confounding is central in observational causal inference. In proxy models with a discrete latent confounder, prior Synthetic Potential Outcomes (SPO) [Mazaheri-Squires-Uhler '25] recover the mixture of treatment effects through recursively constructed scalar moments. We show that this sequence is one projection of a more fundamental object. Under the same population factorization assumptions, there is an exact compressed observable operator: after projecting onto the shared proxy signal subspace, the difference of two treatment-arm quotient operators is similar to the diagonal matrix of latent treatment effects. Its eigenvalues are the latent effects; its lifted left eigenvectors, after anchor normalization, recover the target-proxy feature matrix and then the latent mixture proportions. Every scalar SPO moment is a bilinear functional of a power of this operator. The resulting estimator handles overcomplete proxy systems, replaces high-order scalar inversion with finite-dimensional spectral analysis, and admits high-probability first-order perturbation bounds for treatment effects, feature rows, and simplex-projected mixture weights.

中文摘要翻译: 在观测因果推断中，识别未观测混杂因素下的异质性处理效应是一个核心问题。在具有离散潜在混杂变量的代理模型中，先前的合成潜在结果（SPO）方法[Mazaheri-Squires-Uhler '25]通过递归构造的标量矩来恢复处理效应的混合分布。我们证明该序列是一个更基本对象的投影。在相同的人口分解假设下，存在一个精确的压缩可观测算子：投影到共享代理信号子空间后，两个处理臂商算子的差相似于潜在处理效应的对角矩阵。其特征值为潜在效应；经锚归一化后，其左特征向量可恢复目标-代理特征矩阵，进而恢复潜在混合比例。每个SPO标量矩都是该算子幂的双线性泛函。所得到的估计器能处理过完备代理系统，用有限维谱分析替代高阶标量反演，并为处理效应、特征行和单纯形投影混合权重提供了高概率一阶扰动界。

</details>


### [353] [Bandit PCA with Minimax Optimal Regret](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10936)
*Moïse Blanchard,Dmitrii Ostrovskii,Aadirupa Saha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了在线主成分分析（PCA）的赌博机反馈版本（Bandit PCA），将遗憾的上下界从之前的 $O(d\sqrt{rT\log T})$ 和 $\Omega(r\sqrt{T/\log T})$ 改进为近乎最优的 $\tilde{\Theta}(r\sqrt{dT})$，并通过多尺度探索的在线镜像下降算法实现了上界，同时构建自适应对手证明了匹配的下界。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: Bandit PCA 问题由 Kotlowski 和 Neu (2019) 提出，但遗憾上下界之间存在明显差距（上界 $O(d\sqrt{rT\log T})$，下界 $\Omega(r\sqrt{T/\log T})$），本文旨在缩小这一差距，确定该问题的极小化最优遗憾率。

Method: 上界算法：将问题建模为在（实）密度矩阵的谱面体上进行在线镜像下降，并结合多尺度探索策略——不同谱量级的特征空间以不同速率更新。下界构造：设计自适应对手，根据学习者的动作隐藏大奖励子空间，将遗憾下界归约为子空间估计问题。

Result: 将遗憾上界从 $O(d\sqrt{rT\log T})$ 改进为 $O(r\sqrt{dT})$（至多对数因子），将下界从 $\Omega(r\sqrt{T/\log T})$ 改进为 $\Omega(r\sqrt{dT})$，确定了极小化最优遗憾率为 $\tilde{\Theta}(r\sqrt{dT})$。

Conclusion: 本文基本解决了 Bandit PCA 的遗憾界问题，填平了上下界之间的缺口，并讨论了该方法与自适应测量量子断层扫描之间的联系。

Original Abstract: We study the bandit-feedback version of online principal component analysis (Bandit PCA): in each round $t = 1,\dots,T$, the adversary selects a $d \times d$ symmetric gain matrix $G_t$ with spectrum in $[0,1]$ and rank at most $r$; the learner simultaneously selects a unit vector $w_t \in S^{d-1}$ and receives the reward $w_t^\top G_t w_t$. The learner receives no other feedback, and aims to minimize the regret against the best unit vector in hindsight. This problem was introduced by Kotlowski and Neu (2019), who gave an algorithm with regret $O(d\sqrt{rT \log T})$ and showed the lower bound of $Ω(r\sqrt{T/\log T})$. We improve upon both of these bounds and essentially bridge the gap between them, establishing the minimax regret of order $r\sqrt{dT}$ up to polylogarithmic factors in $d$ and $T$. The upper bound is attained by a novel algorithm, which combines online mirror descent on the spectrahedron of (real) density matrices with a multiscale exploration scheme in which the eigenspaces with different spectral magnitudes are updated at different rates. For the lower bound, we construct an adaptive adversary that refines a hidden large-reward subspace based on the learner's actions, in such a way that low regret is impossible without estimating the subspace; as a result, lower-bounding the regret reduces to studying the arising subspace estimation problem. Finally, we discuss connections of Bandit PCA with adaptive-measurement quantum tomography.

中文摘要翻译: 我们研究在线主成分分析（PCA）的赌博机反馈版本（Bandit PCA）：在每个轮次 $t = 1,\dots,T$ 中，对手选择一个 $d \times d$ 对称增益矩阵 $G_t$，其谱位于 $[0,1]$ 内且秩至多为 $r$；学习者同时选择一个单位向量 $w_t \in S^{d-1}$ 并获得奖励 $w_t^\top G_t w_t$。学习者没有其他反馈，目标是最小化相对于事后最优单位向量的遗憾。该问题由 Kotlowski 和 Neu (2019) 引入，他们给出了一个遗憾为 $O(d\sqrt{rT \log T})$ 的算法，并证明了 $\Omega(r\sqrt{T/\log T})$ 的下界。我们改进了这两个界，基本填补了它们之间的缺口，确定了在 $d$ 和 $T$ 的多对数因子意义下阶为 $r\sqrt{dT}$ 的极小化最优遗憾。上界由一种新颖的算法实现，该算法将（实）密度矩阵谱面体上的在线镜像下降与多尺度探索方案相结合——不同谱量级的特征空间以不同速率更新。对于下界，我们构造了一个自适应对手，它根据学习者的动作隐藏一个大的奖励子空间，使得不估计子空间就不可能实现低遗憾；因此，遗憾的下界归结为对所出现的子空间估计问题的研究。最后，我们讨论了 Bandit PCA 与自适应测量量子断层扫描之间的联系。

</details>


### [354] [Sticky Jump Diffusions: A Unifying View of Masked, Continuous, and Hybrid Diffusion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10951)
*Pascal Jutras-Dubé,Patrick Pynadath,Jeremy Lu,Yuan Gao,Ruqi Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了粘性跳跃扩散（SJDs），一种以token嵌入为离散锚点的连续时间马尔可夫过程，通过去噪危险匹配训练，统一了掩码扩散、连续扩散和混合扩散，并提出跨位置混合核作为新的设计空间。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有扩散模型家族（掩码扩散、连续扩散、混合扩散）各有不同的设计假设和局限性，缺乏统一的视角来解释这些设计选择背后的原理，例如掩码扩散的掩码为何不携带源token信息、连续扩散为何需要终端投影、混合扩散的更新规则为何如此设计。

Method: 提出粘性跳跃扩散（SJDs），前向过程中锚点以危险率释放质量并在连续空间中扩散；时间反向通过通量平衡得到由得分驱动的SDE和粘性跳跃核。通过去噪危险匹配（Denoising Hazard Matching）从单个去噪分类器中估计得分和每个锚点的反向危险率，使用免仿真的交叉熵训练。

Result: SJD统一了掩码扩散、连续扩散和混合扩散作为其极限情况，并解释了各家族的设计选择。提出的跨位置混合核（cross-position blending）通过混合邻域干净值或嵌入来引入空间局部性或约束图的归纳偏置，在CIFAR-10、Text8和Sudoku上优于恒等核混合扩散。

Conclusion: 粘性跳跃扩散为扩散模型提供了一个统一的理论框架，揭示了现有模型的设计根源，并通过设计非平凡的粘性跳跃核（如跨位置混合）为改进生成模型提供了新的方向。

Original Abstract: We introduce Sticky Jump Diffusions (SJDs), continuous-time Markov processes on $\mathbb R^d$ whose discrete anchors are token embeddings. In forward time, anchors release their mass at a hazard rate and the released mass diffuses in the continuous ambient space; time reversal couples a score-driven SDE with a sticky jump kernel whose rate and destination are fixed by flux balance with the forward law. We estimate the score and the per-anchor reverse hazards from a single denoising classifier via Denoising Hazard Matching, the hazard analogue of denoising score matching, with simulation-free cross-entropy training. SJD recovers masked diffusion, continuous diffusion, and hybrid diffusion as limits. Its reversal explains features that each family treats as given: the mask of masked diffusion carries no evidence about the source token because the unsticking kernel of every anchor collapses to the same absorbing point; the terminal projection of continuous diffusion is required due to the absence of atoms in its forward marginal, without which flux balance yields no reverse jumps; and the update rules of hybrid diffusion (commit rate, destination, and drift) all follow from flux balance rather than from separate design. Beyond these limits, the unsticking kernel becomes a design space: a cross-position blending corrupts each position toward a blend of its neighbors' clean values or embeddings, turning dependency structure such as spatial locality or a constraint graph into an inductive bias of the corruption itself, and improves over the identity-kernel hybrid on CIFAR-10, Text8, and Sudoku.

中文摘要翻译: 我们引入了粘性跳跃扩散（Sticky Jump Diffusions, SJDs），这是一种定义在$\mathbb R^d$上的连续时间马尔可夫过程，其离散锚点为词元嵌入。在前向时间中，锚点以危险率释放质量，释放的质量在连续环境空间中扩散；时间反向通过通量平衡将得分驱动的随机微分方程与粘性跳跃核耦合，该跳跃核的速率和目的地由通量平衡决定。我们通过去噪危险匹配（去噪得分匹配的危险类比方法），利用单个去噪分类器估计得分和每个锚点的反向危险率，并通过免仿真的交叉熵进行训练。SJD将掩码扩散、连续扩散和混合扩散作为其极限情况。其反向过程解释了各家族视为先验设定的特征：掩码扩散的掩码不携带源词元证据，因为每个锚点的脱离核都坍缩到同一个吸收点；连续扩散需要终端投影，因为其前向边际中缺乏原子，没有原子则通量平衡无法产生反向跳跃；混合扩散的更新规则（承诺率、目的地和漂移）均来自通量平衡，而非单独设计。超越这些极限情况后，脱离核成为一个设计空间：跨位置混合将每个位置向邻居的干净值或嵌入的混合方向扰动，将空间局部性或约束图等依赖结构转化为扰动本身的归纳偏置，并在CIFAR-10、Text8和Sudoku上优于恒等核混合扩散。

</details>


### [355] [WSqD: A Horizon-Free Learning Rate Schedule for Large Model Training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10959)
*Jianhao Ma,Yuxin Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出WSqD学习率调度策略，用与训练水平无关的逆平方根基替换WSD的恒定稳定阶段，实现训练水平可扩展且达到最优收敛率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 标准学习率调度（如余弦退火）依赖于固定训练步数，无法灵活扩展训练长度；WSD虽允许恢复训练，但其峰值学习率仍针对原始水平调优，扩展后变得次优。

Method: 提出WSqD（Warmup with Square-root base and linear Decay）调度器：在预热后采用平移的逆平方根基学习率（而非恒定学习率），最后仍保留线性冷却阶段。训练水平仅用于决定何时开始最终冷却。

Result: 在随机凸优化中证明达到极小极大最优的O(1/√T)最后迭代收敛率；在SlimPajama语料库的语言模型预训练中，WSqD在多种训练水平下匹配或优于精心调优的WSD等基线，且只需复用单一峰值学习率。

Conclusion: WSqD实现了训练水平无关的基学习率调度，允许在扩展训练时无需重新调优峰值学习率，同时在理论和实践上均表现优异。

Original Abstract: Standard learning rate schedules such as cosine annealing are tied to a fixed training horizon, limiting their ability to accommodate post hoc horizon extension. Warmup-stable-decay (WSD) partially addresses this issue by maintaining a long constant-rate phase before a short linear cooldown, allowing training to resume from a pre-decay checkpoint. However, its peak learning rate is still tuned based on the original training horizon and can become suboptimal when training is extended. Motivated by stochastic convex optimization, we propose WSqD (Warmup with Square-root base and linear Decay), a learning rate schedule that replaces WSD's constant stable phase with a shifted inverse-square-root base while retaining the final linear cooldown. In the stochastic convex setting, WSqD provably attains the minimax-optimal $O(1/\sqrt{T})$ last-iterate convergence rate. Importantly, its base learning rate schedule is horizon-independent, and the training horizon is needed only to determine when to begin the final cooldown. Empirically, on language-model pretraining using the SlimPajama corpus, WSqD matches or outperforms carefully tuned WSD and other baselines across multiple training horizons while reusing a single peak learning rate.

中文摘要翻译: 标准的学习率调度策略（如余弦退火）依赖于固定的训练水平，限制了其在事后扩展训练步数的能力。WSD（预热-稳定-衰减）调度通过在一个短的线性冷却阶段之前维持一个长的恒定学习率阶段，部分解决了这一问题，允许从冷却前的检查点恢复训练。然而，其峰值学习率仍然是基于原始训练水平调优的，当训练延长时可能变得次优。受随机凸优化的启发，我们提出了WSqD（带平方根基和线性衰减的预热），这是一种学习率调度策略，它用平移的逆平方根基替换了WSD的恒定稳定阶段，同时保留了最终的线性冷却阶段。在随机凸优化背景下，WSqD可证明达到极小极大最优的$O(1/\sqrt{T})$最后迭代收敛率。重要的是，其基学习率调度与训练水平无关，训练水平仅用于确定何时开始最终的冷却阶段。在基于SlimPajama语料库的语言模型预训练实验中，WSqD在使用单一峰值学习率的情况下，在多种训练水平上匹配或优于精心调优的WSD及其他基线方法。

</details>


### [356] [Reinforcement Learning for Execution under Dynamic Fees in a Closed-Loop DEX Simulator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10960)
*Wen-Ting Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个最小化闭环模拟器，用于研究自动做市商（AMM）中面向交易者的动态费用对订单流的影响。通过均衡启发的动态费用规则、费用敏感噪声流和闭式CEX-AMM套利模型，发现一个小型DQN策略在动态费用环境下可将执行缺口降低13.3个基点，而恒定费用下效果不显著。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有AMM的动态费用提案缺乏历史数据支撑，因为交易者面向的费用从未变化、交易者类型是隐性的、重放数据无法模拟顺序决策环境。因此需要构建一个包含缺失信号的闭环模拟器来研究动态费用对执行控制的影响。

Method: 构建最小化闭环模拟器，包含：两个恒定乘积池、均衡启发的动态费用规则、费用敏感噪声流、闭式CEX-AMM套利模型。使用均衡作为闭包原则而非可学习对象。以调度、规划、前瞻和表格策略的调优基准阶梯为对照，评估小型DQN策略的性能。

Result: 小DQN是唯一经过评估的有效策略，其配对改进在统计上排除零值。在保留的1000个种子测试块上，DQN在每种测试的步内排序下均降低了执行缺口，在预设的代理最后排序下降低订单名义价值的13.3个基点。优势集中在动态费用环境中学习得到：恒定费用下配对差异与零无显著区别。

Conclusion: 该结果为AMM中执行控制提供了模型条件下的反事实证据，而非关于历史交易者、均衡博弈或可部署利润的证据。动态费用环境中的执行优化是可行的，但需要基于模拟器的策略学习而非依赖历史数据。

Original Abstract: Trader-facing dynamic fees are increasingly proposed for automated market makers (AMMs), but historical data do not identify how order flow would respond: trader-facing fees do not vary, trader types are latent, and a replayed tape is not a sequential decision environment. We therefore construct a minimal closed-loop simulator in which the missing signal exists by construction: two constant-product pools repriced by an equilibrium-inspired dynamic-fee rule, fee-sensitive noise flow, and closed-form CEX--AMM arbitrage. Equilibrium is used as a closure principle, not as an object the trader learns. Against a tuned benchmark ladder of schedule, planning, lookahead, and tabular policies, a small DQN is the only evaluated valid policy whose paired improvement over tuned one-step routing excludes zero. On a reserved final block of 1{,}000 seeds with completion forced to 1.0 for every policy, it reduces implementation shortfall under every tested intra-step ordering, by $13.3\bps$ of order notional under the pre-specified agent-last ordering, and the edge is concentrated in, and learned from, dynamic-fee environments: under constant fees the paired difference is indistinguishable from zero. The result is model-conditioned counterfactual evidence about execution control in AMMs, not evidence about historical traders, equilibrium play, or deployable profit.

中文摘要翻译: 面向交易者的动态费用越来越多地被提出用于自动做市商（AMM），但历史数据无法识别订单流将如何响应：交易者面向的费用从未变化，交易者类型是隐性的，重放数据并非顺序决策环境。因此，我们构建了一个最小化的闭环模拟器，其中缺失的信号通过构造方式存在：两个恒定乘积池，采用均衡启发的动态费用规则重新定价，包含费用敏感的噪声流，以及闭式的中心化交易所（CEX）-AMM套利模型。均衡被用作闭包原则，而非交易者学习的目标。以调度、规划、前瞻和表格策略的调优基准阶梯为对照，小型深度Q网络（DQN）是唯一经过评估的有效策略，其相对于调优的单步路由的配对改进在统计上排除零值。在保留的1000个种子组成的最终测试块上（每个策略的完成率强制为1.0），DQN在每种测试的步内排序下均降低了执行缺口；在预设的代理最后排序下，降低幅度为订单名义价值的13.3个基点。这一优势集中在动态费用环境中，并从该环境中学习得到：在恒定费用下，配对差异与零无显著区别。该结果是关于AMM中执行控制的模型条件反事实证据，而非关于历史交易者、均衡博弈或可部署利润的证据。

</details>


### [357] [Efficient Online Proportional Sampling with Applications to Smoothed Online Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10963)
*Amirmahdi Mirfakhar,Maria-Florina Balcan,Hedyeh Beyhaghi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究高维空间中在线比例采样问题，针对σ-平滑对手和随机顺序对手，设计了一种高效数据结构，避免显式维护指数级增长的子区域，并证明了深度上界分别为O(√(σT))和O(log T)，应用于带分段结构奖励的在线学习，获得亚线性遗憾。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 在高维在线比例采样问题中，诱导划分的复杂度随时间呈指数增长（O(t^d)），传统方法无法高效支持采样和更新。本文旨在设计一种数据结构，在避免显式维护指数级子区域的前提下，实现高效更新和比例采样，以支撑主从博弈、算法配置等实际应用。

Method: 设计了一种针对轴平行超平面产生的分段结构的不连续区域的高效数据结构。该结构在σ-平滑自适应对手下深度达到O(√(σT))，在随机顺序对手下深度达到O(log T)，避免了显式维护O(t^d)个子区域的开销。

Result: 在σ-平滑自适应对手下，数据结构深度紧界为O(√(σT))；在随机顺序对手下，深度为O(log T)——这是该类问题首次获得的结果。将该框架应用于分段结构奖励的在线学习，在完全信息和赌博机反馈下均获得高效的无遗憾算法，具有可证明的亚线性遗憾界。

Conclusion: 本文提出的数据结构有效解决了高维在线比例采样面临的指数增长难题，在不同对手模型下取得了紧的深度界，并为分段结构奖励的在线学习提供了高效的无遗憾算法。

Original Abstract: We study the problem of efficient online proportional sampling from a high-dimensional domain under a $σ$-smoothed adversary, where the sampling distribution is induced by a dynamically evolving weight function defined over a sequence of piecewise-structured partitions. This setting captures a broad range of applications, including principal-agent games (e.g., pricing and contract design), and algorithm configuration and parameter tuning. The central challenge is maintaining an efficient data structure as the induced partition grows increasingly complex over time -- naively, the number of subregions can grow as $O(t^d)$ by round $t$ in $d$ dimensions. We design a data structure that supports efficient updates and proportional sampling while avoiding the cost of explicitly maintaining this exponential growth, where the discontinuities are structured from axis-parallel hyperplanes. Under a $σ$-smoothed adaptive adversary, we prove a tight $O(\sqrt{σT})$ bound on the depth of our data structure, and an $O(\log T)$ bound under a random-order adversary -- to our knowledge, the first such results for this class of problems. We apply this framework to online learning with piecewise-structured rewards, obtaining efficient no-regret algorithms under both full-information and bandit feedback, with provable sublinear regret guarantees.

中文摘要翻译: 我们研究在σ-平滑对手下从高维域中进行高效在线比例采样的问题，其中采样分布由定义在一系列分段结构划分上的动态演化权重函数诱导。该设定涵盖广泛的应用，包括主从博弈（例如定价和契约设计）以及算法配置和参数调优。核心挑战在于维护一个高效的数据结构，因为诱导的划分随时间变得越来越复杂——朴素地，到第t轮时子区域数量在d维空间中可达O(t^d)。我们设计了一种数据结构，支持高效更新和比例采样，同时避免显式维护这种指数级增长的开销，其中不连续性由轴平行超平面结构化产生。在σ-平滑自适应对手下，我们证明数据结构深度的紧界为O(√(σT))；在随机顺序对手下深度为O(log T)——据我们所知，这是该类问题的首个此类结果。我们将该框架应用于带分段结构奖励的在线学习，在完全信息和赌博机反馈下均获得高效的无遗憾算法，并具有可证明的亚线性遗憾保证。

</details>


### [358] [Enhanced Byzantine-Robust Federated Learning Via Truncated-Quadratic Loss for Heterogeneous Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10970)
*Zhi-Yong Wang,Hao Nan Sheng,Werner Stefan,Hing Cheung So,Linqi Song,Weitao Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于截断二次损失（TQ）的鲁棒聚合规则，解决了联邦学习中中心裁剪和Huber聚合器在存在异常值时产生有偏解的问题，实现了非凸损失和异构数据下的渐近最优拜占庭鲁棒学习。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有中心裁剪和Huber聚合器在存在异常值时会产生有偏解，导致在高数据异构和大量异常值场景下失效，亟需一种能有效缓解偏差的鲁棒聚合方法。

Method: 利用凸共轭理论证明中心裁剪与Huber聚合器的等价性，并揭示其偏差来源；提出基于截断二次损失（TQ）的新型鲁棒聚合规则，以缓解现有方法的偏差问题；提供鲁棒偏差估计策略以增强TQ的有效性。

Result: TQ聚合器在非凸损失函数和异构数据下实现阶最优的拜占庭鲁棒学习；在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上的实验表明鲁棒性优于现有竞争方法。

Conclusion: TQ聚合器有效缓解了现有方法的偏差，提升了联邦学习系统的可靠性，且仅需拜占庭客户端数量的估计即可保持鲁棒性。

Original Abstract: Federated learning distributes data among $n$ clients, making it vulnerable to malicious attacks and data heterogeneity, which together pose challenges for robust learning. To tackle this issue, centered clipping and Huber aggregators have been exploited for Byzantine robustness. In this paper, we first demonstrate their equivalence via convex conjugate theory, and show that they can yield biased solutions in the presence of outliers, leading to failure under high data heterogeneity and a substantial fraction of outliers. Next, we propose a new robust aggregation rule that utilizes the truncated-quadratic (TQ) loss, effectively mitigating the biases of existing methods, such as centered clipping and Huber aggregators. We show that our aggregator achieves order-optimal Byzantine-robust learning under nonconvex loss functions and heterogeneous data, ultimately enhancing the reliability of federated learning systems. Additionally, we provide a robust deviation estimation strategy for TQ, demonstrating its effectiveness. Furthermore, we show that TQ maintains robustness even when only an estimate of the number of Byzantine clients is available. Finally, experimental results on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and CIFAR-10, indicate that our aggregator provides better robustness performance than the competing techniques.

中文摘要翻译: 联邦学习将数据分布在n个客户端中，使其易受恶意攻击和数据异构性的影响，这对鲁棒学习构成了挑战。为了解决这一问题，中心裁剪和Huber聚合器已被用于拜占庭鲁棒性。本文首先通过凸共轭理论证明了它们的等价性，并表明它们在存在异常值时会产生有偏解，导致在高数据异构和大量异常值场景下失效。接着，我们提出了一种利用截断二次损失的新型鲁棒聚合规则，有效缓解了中心裁剪和Huber聚合器等现有方法的偏差。我们证明，在非凸损失函数和异构数据下，该聚合器实现了阶最优的拜占庭鲁棒学习，最终提升了联邦学习系统的可靠性。此外，我们为TQ提供了一种鲁棒偏差估计策略，证明了其有效性。进一步地，我们表明TQ即使在仅知拜占庭客户端数量估计的情况下也能保持鲁棒性。最后，在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和CIFAR-10上的实验结果表明，我们的聚合器比竞争技术提供了更好的鲁棒性性能。

</details>


### [359] [A Multi-Agent Framework for Zero-Dimensional Reduced-Order Model Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.10994)
*Bingteng Sun,Hao Yin,Yiling Chen,Renjie Xiao,Lei Xie,Shanyou Wang,Ruonan Wang,Shubao Chen,Qingzong Xu,Lin Lu,Qiang Du,Junqiang Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Z-COPA多智能体框架，将0D降阶模型规划转化为图结构优化问题，在航空发动机二次空气系统等基准测试中取得最优性能，颠覆了传统0D模型规划范式。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 当前0D ROM规划依赖人工经验，拓扑探索受限且迭代周期长；传统优化方法（如GA）局限于局部参数调优；单一LLM智能体难以处理0D ROM规划的长时域和高耦合特性。

Method: 提出Z-COPA多智能体架构，核心包括符号动作图引擎（SAGE）和MILP引导导航（MGN）优化器，通过专用的图表示方法将0D流网络拓扑编码为图结构优化问题。

Result: 在两个真实航空发动机二次空气系统、两个IEEE配电网重构基准和两个配水网络基准上验证，在正向和逆向设计中均取得最优任务完成质量。

Conclusion: Z-COPA颠覆了传统0D模型规划范式，为探索更广阔的拓扑空间和实现高度自动化、全局最优的气动系统架构提供了新技术途径。

Original Abstract: Zero-dimensional reduced-order models (0D ROMs) are central to multi-dimensional design workflows for high-end complex equipment. However, the planning process currently relies on manual expertise, limiting topological exploration and prolonging iterations. Even traditional optimization methods such as Genetic Algorithms (GA) are typically confined to local parameter tuning. Although Large Language Model (LLM) agents have shown promise in exploring large sample spaces, and frameworks such as Chain of Thought (CoT) and Reason and Act (ReAct) improve reasoning reliability, while Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) overcomes domain knowledge barriers, a single agent still falls short for the long-horizon and highly coupled nature of complex 0D ROM planning. This paper proposes the Zero-dimensional reduced-order model CO-Planning framework (Z-COPA), a multi-agent architecture featuring a Symbolic Action Graph Engine (SAGE) and a MILP-Guided Navigation (MGN) optimizer. Its core innovation is a dedicated graph representation method that accurately encodes the 0D flow network topology, converting the empirical planning process into a rigorous graph structure optimization problem. We validate the forward and inverse design capabilities and generalization performance of Z-COPA on two real aircraft engine secondary-air systems, two IEEE power-distribution reconfiguration benchmarks, and two water-distribution network benchmarks. The results show superior task completion quality, obtaining the best performance in both forward and reverse design of air systems. Z-COPA disrupts the traditional 0D model planning paradigm, providing a new technical approach for exploring broader topological space and achieving highly automated, globally optimal air system architectures.

中文摘要翻译: 零维降阶模型（0D ROM）是高端复杂设备多维度设计工作流程的核心。然而，当前的规划过程依赖人工经验，限制了拓扑探索并延长了迭代周期。即使是遗传算法（GA）等传统优化方法通常也局限于局部参数调优。尽管大语言模型（LLM）智能体在探索大样本空间方面展现出潜力，且思维链（CoT）和推理与行动（ReAct）等框架提高了推理可靠性，同时检索增强生成（RAG）克服了领域知识障碍，但单一智能体仍难以应对复杂0D ROM规划的长时域和高耦合特性。本文提出零维降阶模型协同规划框架（Z-COPA），一种采用符号动作图引擎（SAGE）和MILP引导导航（MGN）优化器的多智能体架构。其核心创新在于一种专用的图表示方法，能够精确编码0D流网络拓扑，将经验性规划过程转化为严格的图结构优化问题。我们在两个真实航空发动机二次空气系统、两个IEEE配电网重构基准和两个配水网络基准上验证了Z-COPA的正向和逆向设计能力及泛化性能。结果表明，Z-COPA在任务完成质量上表现出色，在气动系统的正向和逆向设计中均取得了最优性能。Z-COPA颠覆了传统0D模型规划范式，为探索更广阔的拓扑空间和实现高度自动化、全局最优的气动系统架构提供了新的技术途径。

</details>


### [360] [TabPFN beyond Tabular Data: Calibration and Accuracy on Multimodal Embeddings](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11007)
*Jingxiang Zhang,Lujia Zhong,Zijie Zhu,Shuo Huang,Yuang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出将TabPFN作为多模态分类中冻结编码器的即插即用、零梯度分类头，实验表明其在负对数似然和期望校准误差上优于8种基线方法，能显著改善模型校准性能，同时在中等以上样本量条件下保持有竞争力的准确率。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的少样本多模态分类头（如k近邻、逻辑回归、线性SVM）虽然计算高效，但产生的置信度分数校准不良，限制了它们在校准敏感应用中的可靠性。本文旨在寻找一种无需训练、即插即用的分类头，在保持计算效率的同时改善校准性能。

Method: 将TabPFN作为冻结的图像、文本和音频编码器的即插即用、零梯度分类头。TabPFN是一种基于Transformer的先验数据拟合网络，无需梯度训练即可直接对嵌入特征进行分类。实验跨越14个数据集、11个编码器、3种模态，共22,820个评估场景，与8种基线方法（kNN、逻辑回归、线性SVM等）进行全面比较。

Result: 在22,820个评估场景中，TabPFN在负对数似然和期望校准误差上取得最佳平均排名；相对于八种基线的平均值，NLL降低48-62%，ECE降低2.1-5.3倍，同时准确率匹配或超过基线平均水平。准确率优势是有条件的：集中在中等至高样本量（k≥50）和低至中等特征维度（d≤32）时，当标注数据稀缺、特征维度高或竞争方法接近上限时优势减弱。在骨干网络适配实验中，用TabPFN替换训练好的线性头可显著改善校准性能并保持有竞争力的准确率。

Conclusion: TabPFN可作为校准敏感的多模态分类中一种有效的免训练分类头，能够显著改善模型校准性能，同时在适当条件下保持有竞争力的准确率。研究为实际应用中如何选择TabPFN提供了经验指导。

Original Abstract: Few-shot multimodal classification commonly attaches a lightweight head, such as $k$-nearest neighbors, logistic regression, or a linear SVM, to a frozen pretrained encoder. Although computationally efficient, these heads can produce poorly calibrated confidence scores, limiting their reliability in calibration-sensitive applications. We evaluate TabPFN as a plug-and-play, zero-gradient classification head for frozen image, text, and audio encoders. Across 22{,}820 evaluation episodes spanning 14 datasets, 11 encoders, and three modalities, TabPFN achieves the best mean rank among nine classification heads on both negative log-likelihood (NLL) and expected calibration error (ECE). At a representative setting, it reduces NLL by 48--62\% and ECE by 2.1--5.3$\times$ relative to the average of the eight baselines while matching or exceeding their average accuracy. Its accuracy advantage is conditional, concentrating at moderate-to-high shot counts and low-to-moderate feature dimensions ($k \ge 50$, $d \le 32$), and diminishing when labeled data are scarce, feature dimensions are high, or competing methods approach ceiling accuracy. In targeted backbone-adaptation experiments, replacing the trained linear head with TabPFN substantially improves calibration while preserving competitive accuracy. These results provide empirical guidance for using TabPFN as a training-free head in calibration-sensitive multimodal classification. To support transparency and reproducibility, we publicly release the source code, experiment configurations, and evaluation scripts in our GitHub repository: https://github.com/Jingxiang-Zhang/tabpfn-multimodal-embeddings.
