Before success, prerequisite progress on hard problems receives no reward signal; after success, outcome rewards cannot distinguish well-organized correct trajectories from redundant or locally flawed ones. We introduce SCOPE-RL (Scaffolded Chain Optimization with Process Efficiency), a two-stage framework that densifies this anchor while retaining the GRPO update: Adaptive Scaffolded RL adds prefix-decomposed verifiable rewards on answer-hidden sub-question chains before success, and Quality-Aware Process RL applies correctness-gated process-shape rewards to refine correct trajectories after success. An expert-validated Step-Quality Evaluation Protocol evaluates useful-step density, error localization, and token efficiency beyond final-answer accuracy. On Qwen3-8B-Instruct trained on DAPO-Math and Big-Math, SCOPE-RL improves average accuracy by up to 11.2 pp and reduces reasoning tokens by up to 27.1% over outcome-only GRPO; the gains hold under GSPO and on Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct, indicating that reward-signal densification is complementary to policy-update-level RLVR advances. Code and data are available at https://github.com/tokencraft-lab/SCOPE-RL.

中文摘要翻译: 基于可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）使用稀疏的可验证最终答案奖励来优化大语言模型。这种稀疏锚点能够可靠地验证轨迹是否成功，但不能对产生该轨迹的推理路径提供直接反馈。在成功之前，困难问题上的前置进展得不到任何奖励信号；在成功之后，结果奖励无法区分组织良好的正确轨迹与冗余或局部有缺陷的正确轨迹。我们提出SCOPE-RL（带过程效率的脚手架链优化），一个两阶段框架，在保留GRPO更新方式的同时对奖励锚点进行密化：自适应脚手架RL在成功之前，对答案隐藏的子问题链施加前缀分解的可验证奖励；质量感知过程RL在成功之后，应用正确性门控的过程形状奖励来优化正确轨迹。专家验证的步骤质量评估协议从有用步骤密度、错误定位和token效率等多个维度进行评估，超越最终答案准确率。在DAPO-Math和Big-Math上训练的Qwen3-8B-Instruct上，SCOPE-RL相比纯结果奖励的GRPO平均准确率提升最高11.2个百分点，推理token减少最高27.1%；这些收益在GSPO和Qwen3-0.6B-Instruct上同样成立，表明奖励信号密化与策略更新层面的RLVR改进是互补的。代码和数据已开源：https://github.com/tokencraft-lab/SCOPE-RL。

</details>


### [390] [CDFM: Towards a General-Purpose Causal Discovery Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11508)
*Jie Qiao,Ruichu Cai,Zijian Li,Weilin Chen,Pengfei Hua,Boyan Xu,Zhengming Chen,Zhifeng Hao,Peng Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出因果发现基础模型（CDFM），一个面向零样本结构推断的统一通用框架。通过理论分析因果可识别性边界、设计变分分解框架、大规模合成预训练数据，CDFM在多种因果发现任务上一致超越传统算法，推动因果发现向通用基础模型范式转变。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 随着现实数据规模与异质性的持续增长，传统数据集特定的因果发现方法导致碎片化的试错驱动范式，难以扩展到现代科学发现的需求。因此，需要一种统一的、通用的因果发现基础模型，能够实现零样本的结构推断。

Method: 1) 理论分析因果可识别性边界，揭示因果先验机制的关键作用；2) 提出原则性变分框架，将未知因果机制视为潜变量，将不可解边际似然分解为可解的学习模块；3) 利用变分分解指导CDFM的架构设计，并通过综合因果知识大规模合成结构因果模型进行预训练。

Result: 实验结果表明CDFM在多种因果发现任务上一致优于传统算法，成功内化了复杂的统计不对称性，实现了可靠的零样本泛化。

Conclusion: CDFM推动了因果发现领域从数据集特定的碎片化范式向通用基础模型范式的转变，验证了大规模预训练与因果先验机制结合的有效性。

Original Abstract: Causal discovery, the process of recovering underlying causal structures from observational data, is a fundamental pursuit across scientific disciplines. Over the past decades, numerous algorithms have been developed to tackle this challenge through workflows tailored to the specific causal mechanisms underlying each type of dataset, demonstrating effectiveness across a wide range of applications. However, as the volume and heterogeneity of real-world data continue to grow, this dataset-specific approach inevitably leads to a fragmented, test-driven paradigm that struggles to scale to the demands of modern scientific discovery. To address this, we formulate the Causal Discovery Foundation Model (CDFM) as a unified, general-purpose framework for zero-shot structural inference. To ensure reliable generalization across unknown domains, we first investigate the theoretical boundaries of causal identifiability, revealing the indispensable role of causal prior mechanisms in this process. Building on these insights, we formulate a principled variational framework that treats unknown causal mechanisms as latent variables and mathematically decomposes the intractable marginal likelihood into distinct, tractable learning modules. The variational decomposition provides a conceptual design principle for the architecture design of CDFM, while comprehensive causal knowledge guides the large-scale synthesis of our pretraining data. By pretraining on a massive, highly diverse space of synthetic structural causal models, CDFM successfully internalizes complex statistical asymmetries. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CDFM consistently outperforms traditional algorithms, driving a paradigm shift toward a general-purpose causal discovery foundation model.

中文摘要翻译: 因果发现——从观测数据中恢复底层因果结构的过程——是科学领域中一项基本追求。过去数十年中，研究者开发了大量算法，通过针对每类数据集底层特定因果机制定制的工作流来应对这一挑战，并在广泛的应用中展现出有效性。然而，随着真实世界数据的规模和异质性持续增长，这种数据集特定的方法不可避免地导致了碎片化的试错驱动范式，难以扩展到现代科学发现的需求。为解决这一问题，我们将因果发现基础模型（CDFM）形式化为一个统一、通用的零样本结构推断框架。为确保在未知领域上的可靠泛化，我们首先探究了因果可识别性的理论边界，揭示了因果先验机制在此过程中不可或缺的作用。基于这些见解，我们构建了一个原则性变分框架，将未知因果机制视为潜变量，并从数学上将不可解的边际似然分解为若干个可解的学习模块。该变分分解为CDFM的架构设计提供了概念性设计原则，而全面的因果知识则指导了预训练数据的大规模合成。通过在庞大且高度多样化的合成结构因果模型空间上进行预训练，CDFM成功内化了复杂的统计不对称性。大量实验表明，CDFM一致优于传统算法，推动因果发现向通用基础模型范式转变。

</details>


### [391] [DAG-FM: A Foundation Model for Causal Discovery under Heterogeneous Causal Mechanisms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11510)
*Yikang Chen,Zhengkang Guan,Haoyuan Qian,Peng Cui,Yi Yang,Kun Kuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DAG-FM，一种将因果发现分解为两个自回归阶段（叶节点预测和父节点预测）的基础模型架构，通过混合叶子专家（MoLE）处理多样化的功能因果模型假设，在合成和真实数据集上均达到最先进性能。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有因果发现方法面临两大挑战：底层因果机制的异质性以及有向无环图（DAG）的高维组合搜索空间。传统算法和现有基础模型在准确性和可扩展性上仍存在不足。

Method: DAG-FM将因果发现分解为两个自回归阶段（叶节点预测器和父节点预测器），采用鲁棒的表格交互块建模行-列交互，并引入混合叶子专家（MoLE）动态路由和适应不同的功能因果模型（FCM）机制家族，通过迭代推理算法提取因果顺序并构建有效DAG。

Result: 在合成基准和复杂真实世界数据集上均达到最先进的性能，在准确性和可扩展性方面显著优于传统经典算法和近期基础模型。

Conclusion: DAG-FM作为一种新型基础模型架构，通过分解因果发现过程和引入MoLE机制，有效解决了因果机制异质性和高维搜索空间问题，为因果发现提供了高效且可扩展的解决方案。

Original Abstract: Causal discovery from observational tabular data remains fundamentally challenging, primarily due to the heterogeneity of underlying causal mechanisms and the high-dimensional combinatorial search space of Directed Acyclic Graphs (DAGs). In this paper, we propose \textbf{DAG-FM}, a novel foundation model architecture that amortizes causal discovery. Unlike direct matrix prediction, DAG-FM decomposes the causal discovery process into two auto-regressive stages using two specialized Transformer-based sub-modules: a leaf-node predictor and a parent-node predictor. To effectively model complex row-column interactions, we adopt a robust tabular interaction block to output feature-wise representations. Crucially, to handle diverse and unknown Functional Causal Model (FCM) assumptions in real-world scenarios, we introduce Mixture-of-Leaf-Experts (MoLE), allowing the model to dynamically route and adapt to identifiable mechanism families. Through an iterative inference algorithm, DAG-FM seamlessly extracts causal orderings and constructs valid DAGs. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DAG-FM achieves state-of-the-art performance on both synthetic benchmarks and complex real-world datasets, significantly outperforming traditional classical algorithms and recent foundation models in both accuracy and scalability.

中文摘要翻译: 从观测表格数据进行因果发现仍然面临根本性挑战，主要源于底层因果机制的异质性以及有向无环图（DAG）的高维组合搜索空间。本文提出DAG-FM，一种新颖的基础模型架构，实现了因果发现的摊销化。与直接的矩阵预测不同，DAG-FM将因果发现过程分解为两个自回归阶段，使用两个专门的基于Transformer的子模块：叶节点预测器和父节点预测器。为了有效建模复杂的行列交互，我们采用鲁棒的表格交互块来输出特征级表示。关键的是，为了处理现实场景中多样且未知的功能因果模型（FCM）假设，我们引入了混合叶子专家（MoLE），使模型能够动态路由并适应可识别的机制家族。通过迭代推理算法，DAG-FM无缝地提取因果顺序并构建有效的DAG。大量实验表明，DAG-FM在合成基准和复杂真实世界数据集上均达到了最先进的性能，在准确性和可扩展性方面显著优于传统经典算法和近期基础模型。

</details>


### [392] [AutoMatBench: An Automatic Optimization Toolkit for the Acceleration of Material Properties Prediction Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11526)
*Hongxiao Li,Wanling Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AutoMatBench，一个基于贝叶斯优化的自动基准测试工具包，用于全面评估材料属性预测（MPP）模型在分布外（OOD）数据上的表现，弥补了MatBench仅评估分布内（ID）任务的不足，能在更少的成本下获得更全面的基准测试结果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: MatBench在分布内（ID）任务上表现良好，但无法反映模型在分布外（OOD）材料数据上的表现，导致在新材料发现中失败。因此需要一种能全面评估模型在多种配置下性能的方法。

Method: 结合MatBench的流程和现有的OOD性能评估研究，构建了巨大的基准测试配置空间；为避免枚举所有配置的高成本，进一步提出AutoMatBench，采用贝叶斯优化自动搜索最优配置。

Result: 不同配置下的性能差异巨大且可通过先验知识解释；AutoMatBench在12步优化内即可达到与MatBench和先前OOD研究相似的结果，且节省超过一半的成本；同时发现了对MPP基准测试更有价值的结论。

Conclusion: 必须考虑配置对性能结果的因果影响；AutoMatBench能高效、低成本地全面评估MPP模型性能，对新材料发现的成本与效率有积极贡献。

Original Abstract: Material property prediction (MPP) infers key properties from chemical composition and structure, accelerating the discovery and optimization of novel materials. In the realm of MPP, MatBench is a widely accepted benchmarking tool that defines over ten significant problems and provides the paradigm of performance evaluation for AI prediction models. Even though MatBench works well in benchmarking the performances of prediction models on in-distribution (ID) tasks and datasets, it lacks the ability to reflect their performances on out-of-distribution (OOD) material data, resulting failure in new material discovery. By combining the pipelines of MatBench and the existing researches on OOD performance evaluation, this study enables a huge space of benchmarking configurations, comprehensively reflecting the performances, abilities, and disadvantages of various AI prediction models. This work reports that the discrepancy of performances at different configuration values is huge and can be illustrated with prior knowledge and novel insights, therefore consideration of causal effect of configurations on performance results is necessary. In case of the impossibility of enumerative benchmarking at every configuration, this work further proposes AutoMatBench, an automatic toolkit with Bayesian optimization. Experiments with AutoMatBench reports that, within twelve steps of optimization, the similar results with MatBench and former OOD research can be accessed while more than half of the cost are saved. Besides, this tool also yields more essential findings on MPP benchmarking, positively contributing to the cost and efficiency of new material discovery.

中文摘要翻译: 材料属性预测（MPP）通过从化学组成和结构中推断关键属性，加速了新材料的发现与优化。在MPP领域，MatBench是一个广泛接受的基准测试工具，它定义了十余个重要问题，并为人工智能预测模型提供了性能评估范式。尽管MatBench在评估预测模型在分布内（ID）任务和数据集上的性能方面表现良好，但它无法反映模型在分布外（OOD）材料数据上的表现，导致在新材料发现中失效。通过结合MatBench的流程与现有OOD性能评估研究，本研究实现了巨大的基准测试配置空间，全面反映了各种AI预测模型的性能、能力与不足。本文报告指出，不同配置值下的性能差异巨大，且可以通过先验知识与新颖见解加以阐释，因此必须考虑配置对性能结果的因果影响。针对无法枚举所有配置进行基准测试的困境，本文进一步提出了AutoMatBench——一个基于贝叶斯优化的自动工具包。使用AutoMatBench的实验表明，在十二步优化内，即可获得与MatBench及先前OOD研究相似的结果，同时节省超过一半的成本。此外，该工具还产出了对MPP基准测试更有价值的发现，对新材料发现的成本与效率做出了积极贡献。

</details>


### [393] [Random Label Prediction Heads for Studying Memorization in Deep Neural Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11541)
*Marlon Becker,Jonas Konrad,Luis Garcia Rodriguez,Benjamin Risse*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种通过向训练样本添加辅助随机标签并利用随机标签预测头（RLP-head）来实证研究深度神经网络记忆化现象的方法，该方法可衡量不同层的记忆化容量，并基于此提出一种新的正则化技术。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有研究缺乏一种直接、可操作的方法来实证测量深度神经网络中不同层级的记忆化程度，以及记忆化与泛化之间的复杂关系。

Method: （1）在每个训练样本上附加辅助随机标签；（2）在网络任意深度附加随机标签预测头（RLP-head），从中间表示预测随机标签；（3）将RLP-head的性能解释为Rademacher复杂度的经验估计，从而衡量样本级记忆化和模型容量；（4）基于RLP-head输出提出新的正则化技术以降低记忆化。

Result: （1）RLP-head可有效衡量网络各层的记忆化容量；（2）提出的正则化技术可显著降低记忆化；（3）降低记忆化在不同数据集和训练设置下可能改善或损害泛化性能，挑战了过拟合等同于记忆化的传统假设。

Conclusion: 记忆化与泛化并非简单的等价关系，过拟合不等同于记忆化；该工作为理解深度学习的记忆化机制提供了新工具，并启发了关于记忆化与泛化关系的新假说。

Original Abstract: We introduce a straightforward yet effective method to empirically study memorization in deep neural networks for classification tasks. Our approach augments each training sample with auxiliary random labels, which are then predicted by a random label prediction head (RLP-head). RLP-heads can be attached at arbitrary depths of a network, predicting random labels from the corresponding intermediate representation and thereby enabling analysis of how memorization capacity evolves across layers. By interpreting the RLP-head performance as an empirical estimate of Rademacher complexity, we obtain a direct measure of both sample-level memorization and model capacity. We leverage this random label accuracy metric to analyze generalization and overfitting in different models and datasets. Building on this approach, we further propose a novel regularization technique based on the output of the RLP-head, which demonstrably reduces memorization. Interestingly, our experiments reveal that reducing memorization can either improve or impair generalization, depending on the dataset and training setup. These findings challenge the traditional assumption that overfitting is equivalent to memorization and suggest new hypotheses to reconcile these seemingly contradictory results. The source code is available at https://github.com/MarlonBecker/RandomLabelHeads

中文摘要翻译: 我们引入了一种直接而有效的方法来实证研究深度神经网络在分类任务中的记忆化现象。该方法为每个训练样本附加辅助随机标签，并由随机标签预测头（RLP-head）进行预测。RLP-head可以附着在网络任意深度，从相应的中间表示中预测随机标签，从而分析记忆化容量在各层之间的演变。通过将RLP-head的性能解释为Rademacher复杂度的经验估计，我们获得了样本级记忆化和模型容量的直接度量。我们利用这一随机标签准确率指标来分析不同模型和数据集上的泛化与过拟合。基于该方法，我们进一步提出了一种基于RLP-head输出的新型正则化技术，该技术可显著降低记忆化。有趣的是，我们的实验表明，降低记忆化既可能改善也可能损害泛化性能，具体取决于数据集和训练设置。这些发现挑战了过拟合等同于记忆化的传统假设，并提出了新的假说来解释这些看似矛盾的结果。源代码见https://github.com/MarlonBecker/RandomLabelHeads

</details>


### [394] [Condition-Stratified Robustness Analysis of Post-Hoc Calibration Methods for Probabilistic Classifiers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11542)
*Gurdeep Singh Virdee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文对事后校准方法（温度缩放与保序回归）进行了条件分层的鲁棒性分析，发现校准性能在数据集内部的不同操作条件下存在显著差异，且依赖于具体评估指标。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有研究大多仅报告校准方法的总体平均性能，未检验其在同一数据集内不同操作条件下是否保持稳定，因此需要系统分析校准方法在条件分层下的鲁棒性。

Method: 采用预注册的条件分层鲁棒性分析框架，在四个受控条件（C1–C4）下比较温度缩放（TEMP）和保序回归（ISO），评估四个假设组：经Holm校正的判别差异（H1）、Brier分数差异（H2）、校准斜率（H3）和最佳设定下的AUROC差异（H4）。

Result: TEMP与ISO的判别差异在所有条件下均很小（-0.0155至0.0139），Holm校正p值均为0.9895；TEMP的Brier分数差异始终为负（C1: -0.0002至C4: -0.0074），ISO出现符号反转；TEMP校准斜率更接近1（0.7597–0.9493），ISO斜率偏离较大（0.1364–0.2726）；AUROC差异从C1的接近零（-0.0004）变为C4的正值（0.0264）。

Conclusion: 数据集内部的鲁棒性依赖于具体操作条件和评估指标，不同校准方法的优劣并非全局一致，且不声明外部可迁移性。

Original Abstract: Post-hoc calibration is widely adopted to correct probability estimates from trained classifiers, yet most evaluations report aggregate performance without testing whether that performance holds across distinct operating conditions within a single dataset. We present a pre-registered, condition-stratified robustness analysis comparing temperature scaling (TEMP) and isotonic regression (ISO) across four controlled conditions (C1--C4). Four hypothesis groups are evaluated: discrimination deltas with Holm-corrected multiplicity control (H1), Brier score differences (H2), calibration slope outcomes (H3), and AUROC differences under best-condition setups (H4). TEMP-minus-ISO discrimination deltas remain small across all conditions (-0.0155 to 0.0139), with Holm-adjusted p-values of 0.9895 everywhere. TEMP Brier differences are consistently negative (C1: -0.0002 through C4: -0.0074), while ISO shows sign reversals. TEMP calibration slopes stay closer to unity in every condition (range 0.7597--0.9493) than ISO slopes (0.1364--0.2726). AUROC differences shift from near zero in C1 (-0.0004) to positive in C4 (0.0264). These results establish that in-dataset robustness is condition-dependent and metric-specific. No claim of external transportability is made.

中文摘要翻译: 事后校准被广泛用于修正训练分类器的概率估计，但大多数评估仅报告总体性能，而未检验该性能在单一数据集内不同操作条件下是否仍然成立。本文提出一种预注册的、条件分层的鲁棒性分析，在四个受控条件（C1–C4）下比较温度缩放（TEMP）和保序回归（ISO）。评估了四个假设组：经Holm校正多重性控制的判别差异（H1）、Brier分数差异（H2）、校准斜率结果（H3）以及最佳设定下的AUROC差异（H4）。TEMP与ISO的判别差异在所有条件下均保持较小（-0.0155至0.0139），Holm校正p值均为0.9895。TEMP的Brier分数差异始终为负（C1: -0.0002至C4: -0.0074），而ISO出现符号反转。TEMP校准斜率在所有条件下更接近1（范围0.7597–0.9493），ISO斜率则偏离较大（0.1364–0.2726）。AUROC差异从C1接近零（-0.0004）变为C4的正值（0.0264）。这些结果证实，数据集内部的鲁棒性依赖于具体操作条件和评估指标。本文不声称任何外部可迁移性。

</details>


### [395] [Advancing Optimal Subset Oracle via Learning Relaxation of Neural Set Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11555)
*Yongquan Shi,Zijing Ou,Shiping Wang,Yatao Bian*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种替代蒙特卡洛采样的代理目标函数来优化神经集函数学习中的变分推理，减少了计算开销并加速了推理过程，同时在子模最大化下提供了近似保证。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的神经集函数学习框架在弱监督场景下依赖蒙特卡洛采样来估计变分推理中的证据下界梯度，重复采样导致计算开销大，且随机性会破坏优化轨迹的稳定性。

Method: 将证据下界重新解释为集函数的连续松弛，学习一个代理目标函数替代基于采样的ELBO梯度估计，在连续域中提供稳定且高效的梯度，从而减少计算开销并加速推理。

Result: 在多种真实世界任务上的实验表明，所提方法在所有基线上取得了一致的性能提升。

Conclusion: 所提出的框架通过连续松弛和代理目标函数有效解决了采样带来的计算和稳定性问题，并在子模最大化下建立了近似保证，同时揭示了与变分自由能的联系。

Original Abstract: Learning neural set functions is pivotal to a wide range of important applications, including compound selection in AI-driven drug discovery and product recommendation. Recent work has introduced optimal subset oracles to implicitly learn set functions under practical weakly supervised settings, where model parameters are optimized through mean-field variational inference. However, these frameworks rely on Monte Carlo sampling to estimate gradients of the evidence lower bound when updating the variational distribution. Repeated sampling across iterations incurs substantial computational overhead, while the resulting stochasticity can destabilize the optimization trajectory. In this work, we reinterpret the evidence lower bound as a continuous relaxation of the set function and learn a surrogate objective that replaces sampling-based ELBO gradient estimation during variational optimization. The learned surrogate provides stable and efficient gradients throughout the continuous domain, thereby reducing computational overhead and accelerating inference. Furthermore, we establish an approximation guarantee for the proposed framework under submodular maximization and characterize its connection to variational free energy. Experiments on a variety of real-world tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over existing baselines.

中文摘要翻译: 学习神经集函数对于一系列重要应用至关重要，包括人工智能驱动药物发现中的化合物选择和产品推荐。最近的研究引入了最优子集预言机，以在实际弱监督设置下隐式学习集函数，其中模型参数通过平均场变分推理进行优化。然而，这些框架在更新变分分布时依赖蒙特卡洛采样来估计证据下界的梯度。跨迭代的重复采样带来了大量的计算开销，同时产生的随机性可能破坏优化轨迹的稳定性。在这项工作中，我们将证据下界重新解释为集函数的连续松弛，并学习一个代理目标函数，在变分优化过程中替代基于采样的ELBO梯度估计。所学习的代理目标在整个连续域上提供稳定且高效的梯度，从而减少计算开销并加速推理。此外，我们在子模最大化下为所提出的框架建立了近似保证，并刻画了其与变分自由能的联系。在各种真实世界任务上的实验表明，该方法在现有基线上取得了一致的性能提升。

</details>


### [396] [Heuristic Learning for Active Flow Control Using Coding Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11565)
*Paul Garnier,Jonathan Viquerat,Elie Hachem*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出用编码智能体直接搜索显式可执行反馈律（启发式控制器）替代传统深度强化学习中的神经网络策略优化，在13个主动流动控制基准上，该方法在10个环境中匹配或超越最强DRL基线，且控制器更紧凑、可解释、可迁移。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 深度强化学习在主动流动控制中依赖大量仿真交互，且神经网络策略难以解释；因此探索一种可直接生成可解释、紧凑控制律的替代范式。

Method: 引入约束启发式学习协议，编码智能体反复提出、评估和修正控制器实现，通过公共基准接口交互，直接搜索显式可执行反馈律而非优化神经网络参数。

Result: 在13个主动流动控制基准（涵盖1D/2D/3D问题）上，启发式控制器在10个环境中匹配或超越最强DRL基线；控制器紧凑可解释，揭示物理有意义的反馈机制，能成功迁移到更困难配置，且在变雷诺数、瑞利数、执行器数和观测稀疏性下保持竞争力。

Conclusion: 通过编码智能体的启发式学习是传统强化学习可行且互补的替代方案，兼具竞争性能和物理可解释的控制器表示。

Original Abstract: Active flow control involves nonlinear dynamics, partial observations, and computationally expensive simulations, making controller design particularly challenging. Deep reinforcement learning (DRL) has emerged as a powerful framework for such problems, but its success typically relies on large numbers of simulator interactions and produces neural-network policies whose decision process often remains difficult to interpret. In this work, we investigate a different paradigm: instead of optimizing neural-network parameters, we use modern coding agents to search directly for explicit executable feedback laws. We introduce a constrained heuristic-learning protocol in which an agent iteratively proposes, evaluates, and revises controller implementations while interacting exclusively through the public benchmark interface. The proposed framework is evaluated on 13 active flow-control benchmarks spanning one, two, and three-dimensional problems and compared against the strongest available DRL baselines under identical simulation budgets. The discovered heuristic controllers match or outperform the best DRL policy in 10 of the 13 environments while remaining compact, interpretable, and directly inspectable. Beyond aggregate performance, the resulting controllers reveal physically meaningful feedback mechanisms, transfer successfully across more challenging configurations, and remain competitive under varying Reynolds and Rayleigh numbers, actuator counts, and observation sparsity. These results suggest that heuristic learning through coding agents constitutes a credible and complementary alternative to conventional reinforcement learning, combining competitive performance with physically interpretable controller representations. Prompts and source code are available at https://github.com/DonsetPG/fluid-heuristic-learning.

中文摘要翻译: 主动流动控制涉及非线性动力学、部分观测和计算昂贵的仿真，使得控制器设计极具挑战性。深度强化学习（DRL）已成为解决此类问题的强大框架，但其成功通常依赖于大量的仿真交互，并且产生的神经网络策略的决策过程往往难以解释。本文研究了一种不同的范式：我们不优化神经网络参数，而是使用现代编码智能体直接搜索显式的可执行反馈律。我们引入了一种约束启发式学习协议，在该协议中，智能体通过公共基准接口交互，迭代地提出、评估和修正控制器实现。该框架在13个涵盖一维、二维和三维问题的主动流动控制基准上进行了评估，并在相同的仿真预算下与最强的可用DRL基线进行了比较。所发现的启发式控制器在13个环境中的10个中匹配或超越了最优DRL策略，同时保持紧凑、可解释且可直接审视。在聚合性能之外，所得控制器揭示了物理上有意义的反馈机制，能够成功迁移到更具挑战性的配置中，并在变化的雷诺数和瑞利数、执行器数量以及观测稀疏性下保持竞争力。这些结果表明，通过编码智能体进行启发式学习是传统强化学习的一种可信且互补的替代方案，兼具竞争性能和物理可解释的控制器表示。提示词和源代码见 https://github.com/DonsetPG/fluid-heuristic-learning。

</details>


### [397] [Structure-Feature Aligned Graph Learning via Alternating Constrained Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11577)
*Chengcheng Yan,Qingsong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种约束双视图框架，通过通道分割自适应门控GNN（CSAG-GNN）和稳定循环交替优化策略，解耦GNN中特征变换与邻域聚合的依赖，提升对拓扑噪声和异嗜连接的鲁棒性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统GNN将特征变换与邻域聚合耦合，导致模型对拓扑噪声和异嗜连接脆弱。为解耦这种依赖，引入约束双视图框架。

Method: 1）利用独立锚定网络通过自监督重构目标学习内在属性特征；2）提出CSAG-GNN，通过节点级门控机制动态路由全局频谱平滑与局部空间判别表示；3）设计稳定循环交替优化策略求解耦合双层目标，防止训练中表示漂移。

Result: 在同质和异嗜基准数据集上均取得平衡的性能提升和结构鲁棒性，优于竞争基线方法。

Conclusion: 所提框架有效解耦了GNN中的特征变换与聚合依赖，在多种图结构条件下均表现出稳健的性能优势。

Original Abstract: We introduce a constrained two-view framework for node prediction that aligns structure-conditioned GNN embeddings with a structure-free feature prior learned by an anchor model. Conventional Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) couple feature transformation and neighborhood aggregation, which renders them vulnerable to topology noise and heterophilous connections. To decouple this dependency, our framework utilizes an independent anchor network to capture intrinsic attribute features via a self-supervised reconstruction objective. Furthermore, we propose a Channel-Split Adaptive Gated GNN (CSAG-GNN) that dynamically routes representations between global spectral smoothing and local spatial discrimination through a node-wise gating mechanism. We propose a stable cyclic alternating optimization strategy to solve the resulting coupled bi-level objective, preventing mutual representation drift during training. Empirical results on both homophilous and heterophilous benchmarks show balanced performance gains and structural robustness over competitive baselines.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一种面向节点预测任务的约束双视图框架，该框架将受结构约束的GNN嵌入与由锚定模型学习的无结构特征先验进行对齐。传统的图神经网络（GNN）将特征变换与邻域聚合耦合在一起，这使得它们容易受到拓扑噪声和异嗜连接的影响。为解耦这种依赖关系，我们的框架利用独立的锚定网络通过自监督重构目标来捕获内在的属性特征。此外，我们提出了一种通道分割自适应门控GNN（CSAG-GNN），该网络通过节点级门控机制在全局频谱平滑与局部空间判别之间动态路由表示。我们提出了一种稳定的循环交替优化策略来求解由此产生的耦合双层目标，从而防止训练过程中相互表示漂移。在同类和异嗜基准数据集上的实验结果均表明，与竞争力强的基线方法相比，我们的方法取得了均衡的性能提升和结构鲁棒性。

</details>


### [398] [Privacy-Aware Collaborative and Distributed Bayesian Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11600)
*Aditya Rane,Sathwik Yamana,Paritosh Ramanan,Srikanthan Ramesh,Akash Deep*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种用于分布式贝叶斯优化的协作元学习框架，在不交换原始数据的情况下实现与集中式方法相当的性能。研究发现梯度共享会泄露客户端观测信息，且随着搜索收敛、查询集中在最优值附近，泄露会加剧。评估了差分隐私防御机制并刻画了其隐私-效用权衡。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有分布式贝叶斯优化方法需要交换原始数据或面临隐私泄露风险，尤其是梯度共享机制下的信息泄露问题尚未被充分研究。

Method: 提出协作元学习框架用于分布式贝叶斯优化，分析梯度共享的隐私泄露特性，并引入差分隐私作为防御手段。

Result: 梯度共享会泄露客户端观测信息，泄露程度随搜索收敛和查询集中于最优值而加剧；差分隐私可在隐私与效用之间进行权衡。

Conclusion: 协作元学习框架能在无原始数据交换下匹配集中式性能，但需注意梯度共享带来的隐私风险，差分隐私可提供有效防护但需权衡效用损失。

Original Abstract: We propose a collaborative meta-learning framework for distributed Bayesian optimization matching centralized performance without raw-data exchange. We show gradient sharing leaks client observations, with leakage worsening as the search converges and queries concentrate near the optimum. We evaluate a differentially private defense and characterize its privacy-utility trade-off.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一种用于分布式贝叶斯优化的协作元学习框架，该框架无需交换原始数据即可达到与集中式方法相当的性能。我们发现梯度共享会泄露客户端观测信息，且随着搜索收敛、查询集中在最优值附近，泄露会加剧。我们评估了差分隐私防御机制，并刻画了其隐私-效用权衡。

</details>


### [399] [Fundamental Limitations of Fixed-Budget Best-Arm Identification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11635)
*Motti Goldberger*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文证明了在固定预算的最佳臂识别问题中，任何自适应算法都无法在所有问题实例上一致达到静态最优策略的误差衰减率，差距至少为(1 + log(K)/8)^{-1}倍。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 此前已有多种自适应算法被构造使其采样比例收敛到静态最优比例，但能否在所有问题实例上一致匹配静态最优策略的误差衰减率一直是一个悬而未决的开放问题。本文旨在回答这一理论问题。

Method: 针对K≥3且奖励来自单参数自然指数族分布的情形，通过构造反例，证明对任意算法都存在至少一个问题实例，其误差衰减率至多为静态最优策略的(1 + log(K)/8)^{-1}倍。

Result: 对于K≥3且奖励来自任何单参数自然指数族分布，任何算法都存在至少一个实例，其误差衰减率至多为静态最优策略的(1 + log(K)/8)^{-1}倍。这同时回答了Qin (2022)提出的开放问题，表明固定预算最佳臂识别不存在复杂性。

Conclusion: 固定预算最佳臂识别问题中，自适应算法无法在所有问题实例上一致匹配静态最优策略的误差衰减率，因此该问题不存在统一意义上的复杂度。

Original Abstract: In fixed-budget best-arm identification, also known as ranking and selection, an algorithm has a sampling budget to distribute across $K$ arms. Each sample provides noisy feedback about that arm's mean, and the goal is to identify the arm with the largest mean. A common performance benchmark is the static oracle: a non-adaptive strategy that knows the means in advance and chooses fixed sampling proportions to maximize the exponential decay rate of the probability of incorrect identification. Several adaptive algorithms have been constructed such that their sampling proportions converge to the static oracle proportions. However, it has remained open whether any algorithm could match the static oracle's error decay rate uniformly across all problem instances. We answer this in the negative. For any $K\ge 3$ and for rewards drawn from any one-parameter natural exponential family, we show that for any algorithm, there is at least one instance where the error decay rate is at most $\left(1 + \frac{\log(K)}{8}\right)^{-1}$ times that of the static oracle. This also answers the open question posed by Qin (2022), showing that fixed-budget best-arm identification does not admit a complexity.

中文摘要翻译: 在固定预算的最佳臂识别（也称为排序与选择）问题中，一个算法需要将采样预算分配给K个臂。每次采样提供关于该臂均值的带噪声反馈，目标是识别出具有最大均值的臂。一个常见的性能基准是静态最优策略：一种预先知道均值信息的非自适应策略，通过选择固定的采样比例来最大化错误识别概率的指数衰减率。已有多种自适应算法被构造，使其采样比例收敛到静态最优比例。然而，任何算法能否在所有问题实例上一致匹配静态最优策略的错误衰减率，这一问题一直悬而未决。我们对此给出了否定回答。对于任意K≥3且奖励来自任何单参数自然指数族分布的情形，我们证明：对任意算法，都存在至少一个实例，其错误衰减率至多为静态最优策略的(1 + log(K)/8)^{-1}倍。这也回答了Qin (2022)提出的开放问题，表明固定预算的最佳臂识别不存在复杂性。

</details>


### [400] [Bet on Features: Anytime-Valid and Feature-Aware Auditing of Conditional Quantile Forecasters](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11653)
*Ivane Antonov,Sohom Mukherjee,Richard Pibernik,Yo Joong Choe*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种无分布假设、基于博弈论的连续审计框架，用于检测黑箱条件分位数预测器在非独立同分布损失下的校准错误，并能按审计者可获取的信息粒度提供细粒度的“特征感知”证据。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有分位数预测的后验测试（backtests）受限于固定时间窗口，无法应对数据流漂移和制度变化；且未考虑校准概念的信息依赖性——同一预测器对信息粗粒度的审计者表现为校准，对信息更丰富的审计者则可能非校准。

Method: 建立分布自由、博弈论的连续审计框架，形式化不同特征集下的条件分位数校准概念，识别审计者能获得检测力的备择假设集，并针对特征线性上下文赌注（contextual bets）推导有限时间检测保证，无需独立同分布假设。

Result: 在模拟和真实数据上验证发现，流行的时间序列预测器Chronos-2在多个相关特征上存在严重校准错误。

Conclusion: 所提框架能在非独立同分布场景下持续、特征感知地审计黑箱条件分位数预测器，提供可解释的误校准证据，且对实际部署中的预测器监测具有重要应用价值。

Original Abstract: Black-box conditional quantile forecasts are widely used for sequential decisions under asymmetric costs, such as inventory planning in supply chain management. Once deployed, such forecasters must be monitored continuously as data streams drift and regimes change; this invalidates standard, fixed-horizon backtests for calibration. Further, existing backtests do not take into account that the notion of calibration is, in fact, information-dependent: forecasts can look calibrated to an auditor with coarse information while being miscalibrated to an auditor with richer information. We develop a distribution-free and game-theoretic testing framework for continuously auditing black-box conditional quantile forecasters with non-i.i.d. losses, such that the resulting evidence process is powerful against predictably chosen alternatives specified by the features available to the auditor. We first formalize notions of conditional quantile calibration when different sets of features are available to the auditor, establishing that the coarseness of the auditor's information set determines the hardness of the testing problem. We then identify the sets of alternatives for which the auditor can achieve power, and focusing on contextual bets linear in the features, we derive finite-time detection guarantees for such alternatives, all without an i.i.d. assumption. The resulting evidence processes are interpretable at the feature level, as they quantify fine-grained, "feature-aware" evidence for miscalibration. We empirically validate these methods on simulated and real data, finding that a popular time series forecaster (Chronos-2) is highly miscalibrated w.r.t. multiple relevant features.

中文摘要翻译: 黑箱条件分位数预测器广泛用于非对称成本下的序列决策，例如供应链管理中的库存规划。一旦部署，此类预测器必须随数据流漂移和制度变化而持续监测；这使标准的固定期限校准后验测试失效。此外，现有后验测试未考虑校准概念事实上是信息依赖的：对于信息粗粒度的审计者，预测器可能表现为校准，而对于信息更丰富的审计者则是非校准的。我们开发了一个无分布假设、基于博弈论的测试框架，用于在非独立同分布损失下连续审计黑箱条件分位数预测器，使得生成的证据过程对审计者可获取特征指定的可预测备择假设具有较强的检测能力。我们首先形式化了当审计者可获取不同特征集时的条件分位数校准概念，确立了审计者信息集的粗粒度决定了测试问题的难度。然后，我们识别了审计者能够获得检测力的备择假设集，并聚焦于特征线性上下文赌注，推导了针对这些备择假设的有限时间检测保证，全部无需独立同分布假设。生成的证据过程在特征层面具有可解释性，因为它们量化了细粒度的、“特征感知”的误校准证据。我们在模拟和真实数据上实证验证了这些方法，发现流行的时间序列预测器Chronos-2在多个相关特征上高度误校准。

</details>


### [401] [How to Tame Grokking: Representation Geometry as a Control Signal](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11666)
*Maksim A Kazanskii*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究了神经网络中“grokking”（顿悟）现象与表示几何之间的关系，发现维度坍塌总是先于泛化出现，并提出GeomDR正则化方法通过调整隐藏表示的维度来加速泛化，最高可达52倍。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 尽管已有大量研究，但影响grokking现象出现和时机的因素仍不完全清楚，本文旨在探究表示几何与延迟泛化之间的关系。

Method: 提出几何维度正则化（GeomDR），一种简单的谱正则化方法，通过在训练过程中修改隐藏表示的有效维度来干预grokking动态。

Result: 在模加法、模除法和置换组合任务中，GeomDR一致地改变了grokking动态，可显著加速泛化的出现（最高加速52倍）；在多层感知机和Transformer中观察到相似的定性效果。

Conclusion: 表示几何可以作为grokking的有效控制信号，几何干预为研究和影响神经网络中的延迟泛化提供了实用方法。

Original Abstract: Grokking is a phenomenon in which neural networks initially memorize training data and only later exhibit strong generalization after prolonged optimization. Despite extensive recent study, the factors influencing the emergence and timing of grokking remain incompletely understood. We investigate the relationship between representation geometry and delayed generalization. We find that dimensionality collapse consistently precedes the onset of grokking in all evaluated settings. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Geometric Dimensionality Regularization (GeomDR), a simple spectral regularizer that modifies the effective dimensionality of hidden representations during training. Across modular addition, modular division, and permutation composition tasks, GeomDR consistently alters grokking dynamics and can substantially accelerate the onset of generalization depending on the intervention schedule and target dimensionality. In several settings, grokking is accelerated by up to 52 times relative to standard AdamW training. Similar qualitative effects are observed in both multilayer perceptrons and transformers. Together, these results suggest that representation geometry can serve as an effective control signal for grokking and provide evidence that geometric interventions offer a practical approach for studying and influencing delayed generalization in neural networks.

中文摘要翻译: Grokking是一种现象，神经网络最初记忆训练数据，只有在长时间优化后才表现出强大的泛化能力。尽管近期已有大量研究，但影响grokking出现和时机的因素仍不完全清楚。我们探究了表示几何与延迟泛化之间的关系。我们发现，在所有评估设置中，维度坍塌始终先于grokking的出现。受这些观察启发，我们引入了几何维度正则化（GeomDR），这是一种简单的谱正则化方法，可在训练过程中修改隐藏表示的有效维度。在模加法、模除法和置换组合任务中，GeomDR一致地改变了grokking动态，并且根据干预计划和目标维度，可以显著加速泛化的出现。在若干设置中，grokking相较于标准AdamW训练最多加速了52倍。在多层感知机和Transformer中也观察到了相似的定性效果。这些结果表明，表示几何可以作为grokking的有效控制信号，并为几何干预为研究和影响神经网络中延迟泛化提供实用方法这一观点提供了证据。

</details>


### [402] [A multi-scale feature enhanced graph neural network for fluid dynamics prediction in complex geometries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11672)
*Li Xiao,Tianyu Li,Yiye Zou,Mingjie Zhang,Xiaogangd Deng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出多尺度特征增强图神经网络（ME-GNN），通过两步消息传递机制、注意力U-Net和K-hop采样，解决了GNN在复杂几何和大规模网格上的挑战，在三个基准数据集上取得了最优结果。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 工业设计中流体动力学的大规模数值模拟计算成本高昂，深度神经网络虽有潜力但图神经网络在处理复杂几何和大规模网格时面临挑战，因此需要更高效的模型。

Method: 提出ME-GNN，包含：(1) 两步消息传递机制的图神经网络，捕获详细局部特征；(2) 集成均匀网格离散化的注意力U-Net，提取粗细多尺度特征；(3) 利用K-hop采样构建子图，支持大规模数据集的高效训练并保留局部细节。

Result: 在ShapeNet-Car上速度场相对L2误差0.0196、表面压力0.0556；AirfRANS上流场归一化均方误差0.0033；DrivAerNet上表面压力相对L2误差0.1416，均达到最优结果。

Conclusion: ME-GNN能有效处理复杂几何和大规模网格上的流体动力学仿真任务，显著提升预测精度，为工业设计中的高效仿真提供了可行方案。

Original Abstract: Industrial design in fields such as vehicle and aerospace engineering often relies on large-scale numerical simulations to evaluate fluid dynamics performance, which can incur substantial computational costs. Deep neural networks have shown promise in improving simulation efficiency, especially graph neural networks (GNNs), which demonstrate great potential due to their flexibility with unstructured data. However, GNNs face challenges when dealing with tasks involving complex geometries and large-scale meshes. In this paper, we propose the Multi-scale Feature Enhanced Graph Neural Network (ME-GNN) to tackle these challenges. ME-GNN employs a graph neural network with a two-step message-passing mechanism to capture detailed local features effectively. Additionally, it integrates an Attention U-Net with uniform grid discretization, enabling the extraction of both fine and coarse features. The model also utilizes K-hop sampling to construct subgraphs, facilitating efficient training on large datasets while preserving detailed local features. We evaluated ME-GNN on three benchmark datasets and achieved state-of-the-art results: a relative L2 error of 0.0196 for the velocity field and 0.0556 for the surface pressure on ShapeNet-Car, a normalized mean squared error of 0.0033 for the flow field on AirfRANS, and a relative L2 error of 0.1416 for the surface pressure on DrivAerNet.

中文摘要翻译: 车辆和航空工程等领域的工业设计通常依赖大规模数值模拟来评估流体动力学性能，这会带来巨大的计算成本。深度神经网络在提升仿真效率方面展现出潜力，尤其是图神经网络（GNN），因其对非结构化数据的灵活性而显示出巨大潜力。然而，GNN在处理涉及复杂几何和大规模网格的任务时面临挑战。本文提出多尺度特征增强图神经网络（ME-GNN）以应对这些挑战。ME-GNN采用带有两步消息传递机制的图神经网络，有效捕获详细的局部特征。此外，它集成了具有均匀网格离散化的注意力U-Net，能够提取粗细多尺度特征。该模型还利用K-hop采样构建子图，在大规模数据集上实现高效训练同时保留详细的局部特征。我们在三个基准数据集上评估了ME-GNN，取得了最优结果：在ShapeNet-Car上速度场的相对L2误差为0.0196，表面压力为0.0556；在AirfRANS上流场的归一化均方误差为0.0033；在DrivAerNet上表面压力的相对L2误差为0.1416。

</details>


### [403] [CatRetriever: Contrastive Representation Learning for Slab-to-Bulk Retrieval in Generative Catalyst Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11712)
*Jungho Oh,Woosung Kim,Dong Hyeon Mok,Jonggeol Na,Seoin Back*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出CatRetriever，一个对比表示学习模型，通过将slab与bulk晶体表示对齐到共享潜空间，解决了催化逆设计中缺失的slab-to-bulk连接问题，实现从slab查询准确检索母体bulk结构（R@1>91%, R@3>98%），并进一步构建了面向吸附能目标的bulk发现流程。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有的催化剂表面生成模型只能在slab层面生成催化剂表面-吸附质结构，无法提供对应的母体bulk结构，导致难以评估依赖于bulk的性质（如形成能、表面能、晶体对称性和可合成性）。本文旨在填补这一slab到bulk的缺失连接。

Method: 将slab到bulk的映射建模为检索问题，提出CatRetriever，一个基于对比表示学习的模型，将slab和bulk晶体表示对齐到共享潜空间中。在此基础上，进一步构建了面向吸附能目标的bulk发现流程，融合了bulk检索、生成式搜索空间扩展和吸附能分布分析。

Result: 在分布内和留出评估集上，CatRetriever对slab查询的母体bulk候选检索R@1>91%，R@3>98%。

Conclusion: CatRetriever提供了一种可扩展的途径，将催化剂生成模型与物理上合理且吸附能兼容的bulk催化剂发现连接起来。

Original Abstract: Inverse design is an emerging data-driven paradigm for efficiently navigating vast chemical spaces to discover new materials with targeted properties, and in the context of heterogeneous catalysis, surface generative models have recently advanced this goal by directly generating catalyst surface-adsorbate structures. However, these models typically operate at the slab level and do not provide the corresponding parent bulk structure, making it difficult to assess bulk-dependent properties such as formation energy, surface energy, crystallographic symmetry, and synthesizability. Here, we address this missing slab-to-bulk connection as a retrieval problem and introduce CatRetriever, a contrastive representation learning model that aligns slab and bulk crystal representations in a shared latent space. From a slab query, CatRetriever accurately retrieves plausible parent bulk candidates with R@1 > 91% and R@3 > 98% on both the in-distribution and holdout evaluation sets. We further extend the CatRetriever framework into an adsorption energy targeted bulk discovery pipeline that combines bulk retrieval, generative search space expansion, and adsorption energy distribution analysis. This workflow evaluates candidates by both structural compatibility with the query slab and their ability to access the target adsorption energy range across diverse surface environments. CatRetriever therefore provides a scalable route for connecting catalyst generative models with physically plausible and adsorption energy compatible bulk catalyst discovery.

中文摘要翻译: 逆向设计是一种新兴的数据驱动范式，能够高效地驾驭广阔的化学空间，以发现具有目标性能的新材料。在异相催化领域，表面生成模型通过直接生成催化剂表面-吸附质结构，近期推进了这一目标。然而，这些模型通常仅在slab层面运行，并不提供对应的母体bulk结构，从而难以评估依赖于bulk的性质，如形成能、表面能、晶体对称性和可合成性。本文将该缺失的slab-to-bulk连接建模为一个检索问题，并引入CatRetriever——一种对比表示学习模型，将slab与bulk晶体表示在共享潜空间中对齐。通过slab查询，CatRetriever能够准确检索出合理的母体bulk候选结构，在分布内和留出评估集上R@1>91%，R@3>98%。我们进一步将CatRetriever框架扩展为面向吸附能目标的bulk发现流程，融合了bulk检索、生成式搜索空间扩展以及吸附能分布分析。该工作流通过查询slab的结构兼容性以及候选结构在不同表面环境下达到目标吸附能范围的能力，对候选结构进行评估。因此，CatRetriever提供了一种可扩展的途径，将催化剂生成模型与物理上合理且吸附能兼容的bulk催化剂发现连接起来。

</details>


### [404] [Active Offline-to-Online Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11720)
*Alper Kamil Bozkurt,Shangtong Zhang,Yuichi Motai*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次研究离线到在线强化学习（O2O-RL）中的有限交互预算下的主动策略选择问题，提出基于上置信界（UCB）的主动选择方法，在策略评估与微调之间实现最优权衡，实验表明该方法一致优于现有基线。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 标准O2O-RL流程中，微调性能对算法和超参数高度敏感，一旦选定单一策略进行微调，存在较大风险；同时在线交互预算有限，如何在策略评估（识别高性能策略）和策略微调（提升策略性能）之间合理分配交互资源是一个未解决的关键问题。

Method: 提出一种主动策略选择方法，基于策略未来性能的上置信界（UCB）来动态选择策略进行微调。该上置信界通过对在线评估获得的观测数据拟合局部线性性能预测模型而推导得出，从而在策略评估与微调之间实现自适应权衡。

Result: 在多种实验设置下，所提出方法一致优于现有的O2O-RL基线方法，表明主动选择和微调策略能比固定单一策略或平均分配预算更有效地利用有限的在线交互预算。

Conclusion: 主动选择并微调策略能更有效地利用有限的在线交互预算，推动了离线强化学习在真实系统中（在线交互成本高或风险大）的实际部署。

Original Abstract: Background: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) enables effective policies to be trained from large, previously collected datasets and subsequently improved through limited online interaction. This offline-to-online RL (O2O-RL) paradigm is particularly promising in nonstationary domains where interaction is costly or potentially hazardous. Standard O2O-RL pipelines train multiple candidate policies offline, evaluate them using off-policy or online evaluation, and then deploy and fine-tune the policy with the highest estimated value. However, as in offline pretraining, fine-tuning performance is highly sensitive to the choice of algorithm and hyperparameters, making it risky to commit to a single policy. Objectives: We study active policy selection for fine-tuning under a limited interaction budget in O2O-RL settings. To our knowledge, this is the first work to address this problem. Methods: We formulate the problem by identifying a fundamental trade-off between allocating online interactions to policy evaluation, which helps identify high-performing policies, and allocating them to fine-tuning, which improves policy performance. We then propose an approach that balances this trade-off by actively selecting policies for fine-tuning based on upper-confidence bounds on their future performance. These bounds are derived from locally linear performance forecasts fitted to observations obtained through online evaluation. Results: Across a diverse range of experiments, the proposed approach consistently outperforms existing O2O-RL baselines. Conclusions: Actively selecting and fine-tuning policies uses limited online interaction budgets more effectively than either committing to a single policy or dividing the budget equally among all policies. Our framework also advances offline RL toward practical deployment in real-world systems where online interaction is costly or risky.

中文摘要翻译: 背景：离线强化学习能够从大型历史数据集中训练出有效策略，并通过有限的在线交互进行后续改进。这种离线到在线的强化学习范式在交互成本高或存在潜在危险的非平稳领域中尤为有前景。标准的O2O-RL流程会离线训练多个候选策略，使用离策略评估或在线评估对其进行评估，然后部署并微调具有最高估计价值的策略。然而，与离线预训练一样，微调性能对算法和超参数的选择高度敏感，这使得承诺使用单一策略存在风险。目标：我们研究在O2O-RL环境下，在有限的交互预算下进行微调的主动策略选择问题。据我们所知，这是首次针对该问题开展的研究。方法：我们通过识别在线交互在策略评估（有助于识别高性能策略）与微调（提升策略性能）之间分配的根本性权衡来形式化该问题。然后，我们提出了一种平衡这一权衡的方法，该方法基于策略未来性能的上置信界来主动选择策略进行微调。这些置信界通过对在线评估获得的观测数据拟合局部线性性能预测而推导得出。结果：在多种实验设置下，所提出的方法一致优于现有的O2O-RL基线。结论：主动选择并微调策略比承诺使用单一策略或在所有策略之间平均分配预算更有效地利用了有限的在线交互预算。我们的框架还推动离线强化学习向在线交互成本高或风险大的真实世界系统实际部署迈进。

</details>


### [405] [Time-Lag-Aware Deep Reinforcement Learning for Flexible Job-Shop Scheduling in PPVC Module Factories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11725)
*Ziheng Zhang,Wei Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对预制装配式建筑（PPVC）模块化工厂中混凝土养护、水池试水、油漆干燥等工序导致的长时间滞后问题，提出了一种基于双注意力深度强化学习的调度求解器。通过三项最小侵入式扩展（滞后感知动态、预测性滞后特征通道、活锁掩码嵌入），该方法在基准实例上平均仅比约束规划参考解差约4%，优于所有调度规则和遗传算法元启发式，且可在数秒内重新规划。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 预制装配式建筑生产过程中存在混凝土固化、水密性测试和油漆干燥等长时间滞后环节，这些滞后环节会导致模块被阻塞而工位空闲，使得即使最优参考完工时间也平均膨胀约67%。忽视这些滞后因素再事后修复的效果甚至不如简单的调度规则。因此需要一种能有效处理此类长时间滞后约束的调度方法。

Method: 基于最先进的双注意力深度强化学习求解器，进行三项最小侵入式、可单独消融的扩展：(1) 具有可接受奖励边界的滞后感知动态；(2) 两个预测性滞后特征通道；(3) 活锁掩码的操作类型和工位类型嵌入。在无任何扩展时，实现与原始求解器完全一致。同时发布了基于官方指南的公开基准生成器。

Result: 在留出实例上，学习到的策略是最强的免求解器调度方法：它平均达到约束规划参考解的约4%以内，优于所有调度规则和遗传算法元启发式。在容量竞争加剧时优势更加明显，单个混合规模策略在训练过的工厂规模范围内保持领先优势。无需求解器、模型或许可证，可在数秒内重新规划。

Conclusion: 所提出的滞后感知深度强化学习方法有效解决了PPVC生产中的长时间滞后调度问题，达到了接近精确求解器的性能，且具有快速重规划、无需商业求解器等实用优势。精确求解器仍然是质量天花板，但该方法在部署场景中提供了强有力且实用的替代方案。

Original Abstract: Prefabricated prefinished volumetric construction moves most building work into module factories, whose production floor operates as a flexible job shop. A major complication is decisive: long post-operation time-lags caused by concrete curing, watertightness ponding tests, and paint drying, during which a module is blocked while its workstation stays free. On benchmark instances grounded in an official national prefabrication guidebook, these lags inflate even the optimal reference makespan by about 67% on average, and ignoring them at decision time, then repairing to feasibility, is worse than every dispatching rule. We adapt a state-of-the-art dual-attention deep reinforcement learning solver through three minimally invasive, individually ablatable extensions: lag-aware dynamics with an admissible reward bound, two anticipatory lag feature channels, and liveness-masked operation- and station-type embeddings. With every extension disabled the implementation reproduces the original solver exactly, so all gains are attributable to the adaptations. We release a public, guidebook-grounded benchmark generator. On held-out instances the learned policy is the strongest solver-free scheduler: it reaches within about 4% of a constraint-programming reference and beats every dispatching rule and a genetic-algorithm metaheuristic, with its advantage widening under capacity contention, and a single size-mixed policy carries this lead across the trained range of factory sizes. It needs no solver, model, or license in the loop and re-plans within seconds of a disruption; where an exact solver can be deployed, that solver remains the quality ceiling, a boundary we map explicitly.

中文摘要翻译: 预制装配式建筑将大部分建筑工作转移到模块工厂，其生产车间作为柔性作业车间运行。一个主要的复杂因素是决定性因素：由混凝土养护、防水性水池测试和油漆干燥导致的长时间操作后滞后，在此期间模块被阻塞而其工位保持空闲。在基于官方国家预制指南的基准实例上，这些滞后使即使是最优参考完工时间也平均膨胀约67%，而在决策时忽略它们然后修复至可行性的做法比任何调度规则都更差。我们通过三项最小侵入式、可单独消融的扩展，适配了一个最先进的双注意力深度强化学习求解器：具有可接受奖励边界的滞后感知动态、两个预测性滞后特征通道，以及活锁掩码的操作类型和工位类型嵌入。当所有扩展被禁用时，实现与原始求解器完全相同，因此所有增益都归功于这些适配。我们发布了一个基于官方指南的公开基准生成器。在留出实例上，学习到的策略是最强的免求解器调度方法：它达到约束规划参考解的约4%以内，优于所有调度规则和遗传算法元启发式，其优势在容量竞争加剧时扩大，并且单个混合规模策略在训练过的工厂规模范围内保持这一领先优势。它不需要任何求解器、模型或许可证参与，可在数秒内对中断进行重新规划；在可以部署精确求解器的地方，该求解器仍然是质量天花板——我们明确地绘制了这一边界。

</details>


### [406] [HiFi-LLP: High-Fidelity, Low-Cost Latency Predictors with Confidence for Robust HW-NAS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11746)
*Shambhavi Balamuthu Sampath,Behzad Shomali,Nael Fasfous,Moritz Thoma,Judeson Anthony Fernando,Lukas Frickenstein,Pierpaolo Mori,Manoj Rohit Vemparala,Alexander Frickenstein,Walter Stechele*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出高保真低成本的延迟预测器HiFi-LLP，基于图注意力网络和置信度度量，结合混合NAS框架，在保持竞争性Pareto前沿的同时实现高达8.6倍加速。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 硬件感知优化（如HW-NAS）依赖硬件在环（HIL）延迟测量，但HIL顺序测量成为瓶颈；现有延迟预测器需大量样本且预测不准确会误导NAS过程。

Method: 提出HiFi-LLP，基于图注意力网络（GAT）的高保真低成本延迟预测器，并引入置信度度量；进一步提出混合NAS框架，将低置信度预测路由至HIL测量。

Result: HiFi-LLP在10%精度界上比先前平台特定预测器高9个百分点，在LatBench数据集六种设备上Spearman秩相关系数达0.996；混合NAS相比典型NAS实现8.6倍加速，同时保持竞争性Pareto前沿。

Conclusion: HiFi-LLP有效解决了延迟预测中的保真度与成本权衡问题，混合NAS框架通过预测与HIL的智能路由实现了高效硬件感知神经架构搜索。

Original Abstract: With deep neural networks (DNNs) increasingly deployed on edge devices, hardware (HW)-aware optimization techniques--such as HW-aware compression and HW-aware neural architecture search (HW-NAS)--have become essential. These methods rely on real feedback from the target hardware to tailor DNN architectures for efficient deployment. While the search can be parallelized, latency measurements via hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) remain a bottleneck due to their sequential nature. Recent approaches use latency predictors to replace costly HIL feedback, but challenges persist: (1) platform-specific predictors often require tens of thousands of samples, and (2) inaccurate predictions can mislead the NAS process. To address this, we introduce HiFi-LLP, a high-fidelity, low-cost latency predictor based on graph attention networks, augmented with a confidence metric. HiFi-LLP outperforms prior platform-specific predictors by up to 9 percentage points (p.p.) in the 10% accuracy bound and achieves a Spearman's rank correlation of up to 0.996 across six devices in the LatBench dataset. We further propose a hybrid NAS framework that routes low-confidence predictions to HIL, achieving up to 8.6$\times$ speedup compared to typical NAS while maintaining a competitive Pareto front.

中文摘要翻译: 随着深度神经网络（DNN）越来越多地部署在边缘设备上，硬件感知优化技术——如硬件感知压缩和硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW-NAS）——变得至关重要。这些方法依赖来自目标硬件的真实反馈来定制DNN架构以实现高效部署。虽然搜索可以并行化，但通过硬件在环（HIL）进行的延迟测量因其顺序特性而仍然是一个瓶颈。近期方法使用延迟预测器来替代昂贵的HIL反馈，但挑战依然存在：（1）平台特定的预测器通常需要数万个样本，以及（2）不准确的预测可能误导NAS过程。为解决这一问题，我们引入了HiFi-LLP，一种基于图注意力网络的高保真低成本延迟预测器，并辅以置信度度量。HiFi-LLP在10%精度界上比先前的平台特定预测器高出最多9个百分点，并在LatBench数据集的六种设备上实现了高达0.996的Spearman秩相关系数。我们进一步提出了一种混合NAS框架，将低置信度预测路由至HIL，在保持竞争性Pareto前沿的同时，与典型NAS相比实现了高达8.6倍的加速。

</details>


### [407] [From Global to Factor-Wise Expert Composition in Discrete Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11758)
*Haozhe Huang,Yudong Xu,Abhijoy Mandal,Alán Aspuru-Guzik*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出FactorDiff框架，将扩散模型的组合生成从逐样本级别扩展到因子级别，通过动态路由各因子到最相关的专家模型，在ARC-AGI基准上优于全局标量加权方案。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有基于时间依赖混合权重的组合扩散方法在逐样本级别工作，将每个生成状态视为整体，忽略了不同专家可能具有的空间或功能特化能力。

Method: 提出FactorDiff因子级组合框架，将样本分解为更小的因子，设计动态路由采样过程，将每个因子分配给最相关的专家模型；以空间/像素级组合作为实例化。

Result: 在ARC-AGI基准上，简单的因子特定路由方法在需要逻辑一致性和空间解缠的任务中持续优于复杂的全局标量加权方案。

Conclusion: 因子级分解和动态专家路由是提升扩散模型组合生成能力的有效途径，尤其在需要细粒度空间推理的任务上具有显著优势。

Original Abstract: Discrete diffusion models offer a powerful framework for solving complex reasoning tasks, particularly through compositional generation, which combines multiple pre-trained experts to generalize beyond their individual training data. Recent theoretical corrections introduce time-dependent mixing weights to better align composed diffusion dynamics with the intended target. However, these methods are fundamentally limited by working on a per-sample basis, treating each generated state monolithically and ignoring the potential spatial or functional specializations of different experts. In this work, we address this limitation by proposing FactorDiff - a factor-wise composition framework for diffusion models. We posit that samples can be further decomposed into smaller factors, and propose a sampling process that dynamically routes each factor to the most relevant expert. We instantiate this framework with spatial/pixel-level compositions and validate it on the ARC-AGI benchmark, demonstrating that simple factor-specific routing consistently outperforms complex global scalar weighting schemes on tasks that require logical consistency and spatial disentanglement.

中文摘要翻译: 离散扩散模型为解决复杂推理任务提供了一种强大的框架，特别是通过组合生成——将多个预训练专家模型组合起来，以泛化到超出各自训练数据范围的新任务。近期的理论修正引入了时间依赖的混合权重，以更好地将组合后的扩散动力学与目标分布对齐。然而，这些方法从根本上受到逐样本级别工作的限制，将每个生成状态视为整体处理，忽略了不同专家模型可能具有的空间或功能特化能力。在这项工作中，我们通过提出FactorDiff——一种面向扩散模型的因子级组合框架——来克服这一局限。我们认为样本可以进一步分解为更小的因子，并提出了一种采样过程，能够动态地将每个因子路由到最相关的专家模型。我们以空间/像素级组合实例化该框架，并在ARC-AGI基准上进行了验证，结果表明，在需要逻辑一致性和空间解缠的任务中，简单的因子特定路由方法持续优于复杂的全局标量加权方案。

</details>


### [408] [From Expressivity to Sample Complexity: Narrow Teachers for Transformers via C-RASP](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11760)
*Michael Rizvi-Martel,Satwik Bhattamishra,Guillaume Rabusseau,Michael Hahn*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对Transformer模型的理论理解问题，指出现有研究多关注表达能力而忽视了可学习性，作者通过借鉴损失景观分析工作，提出了使用Transformer学习C-RASP构造的样本复杂度初步界限。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有对Transformer的理论研究主要集中在表达性（通过手工构建权重或计算复杂性论证哪些任务在假设类中），但很少有工作研究这些解的可学习性，本文旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 借鉴最近损失景观分析（loss landscape analysis）的研究成果，提出学习C-RASP构造的样本复杂度（sample complexity）界限。

Result: 提出了使用Transformer学习C-RASP构造的初步样本复杂度界限。

Conclusion: 本文在理解Transformer的可学习性方面取得了进展，为后续更深入的理论分析提供了基础。

Original Abstract: A theoretical understanding of Transformers is crucial to better understand the capacities and limitations of large language models (LLMs). There is much work analyzing the expressivity of attention-based models. By proposing handcrafted weights or using computational complexity arguments, a large amount of past theoretical works have sought to characterize which tasks are and which are not in the hypothesis class of Transformer models. However, little work investigates the learnability of such solutions. In this work, we make progress towards this goal. Inspired by recent loss landscape analysis work, we propose preliminary sample complexity bounds for learning C-RASP constructions with Transformers.

中文摘要翻译: 对Transformer的理论理解对于更好地把握大型语言模型（LLMs）的能力与局限性至关重要。已有大量工作分析基于注意力模型的表达性。通过提出手工构建的权重或使用计算复杂性论证，大量过去的理论工作试图刻画哪些任务在Transformer模型的假设类之内，哪些不在。然而，很少有工作研究这类解的可学习性。在本文中，我们朝着这一目标取得了进展。受近期损失景观分析工作的启发，我们提出了使用Transformer学习C-RASP构造的样本复杂度初步界限。

</details>


### [409] [An Exact Instrument for State Usage in Selective State-Space Models, and the Input-Driven Migration It Reveals](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11796)
*Raktim Bhattacharya*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种精确测量选择性状态空间模型（如Mamba）中每个模态贡献的工具，发现模型会根据输入动态重新分配状态空间，并基于此实现输入调度的模态剪枝，在保持性能的同时显著降低状态预算。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有研究缺乏精确工具来测量Mamba这类选择性状态空间模型中各模态的实际使用情况，无法理解模型如何根据输入动态选择模态，也难以实现有效的模态剪枝。

Method: 利用对角状态矩阵的特性，将每个通道的输出精确分解为各模态贡献；构建逐(层、通道、窗口)的Gram张量来精确计算任意模态子集丢弃后的输出误差；通过第一遍前向传播读取每个窗口的模态使用率，实现输入调度的模态剪枝。

Result: 该工具在Mamba-1系列上验证的相对误差为2.3×10⁻⁷，预测剪枝误差的中位相对偏差为5×10⁻⁷（4464个配置）；发现训练好的模型会根据输入重新分配状态空间，最受影响层的输入相关oracle可将输出误差减半；输入调度的模态剪枝在130M到7B规模上均优于静态、Hankel基和层自适应方法，在半状态预算下匹配未剪枝模型。

Conclusion: 模型的状态空间使用具有高度输入依赖性，主要由输入相关的写映射B_t驱动而非时间步选择机制；输入调度的模态剪枝能有效利用这一特性实现可实现的性能提升，但本文不声称实际的部署计算或内存节省。

Original Abstract: Selective state-space models such as Mamba route information through a bank of first-order modes whose input coupling is set by a learned selection mechanism. We give an exact instrument for measuring how a trained model uses these modes. Because the state matrix is diagonal, each channel's output decomposes exactly into per-mode contributions, and a per-(layer, channel, window) Gram tensor yields the exact output error of dropping any subset of modes, offline, at any budget. Validated against the reference implementation to a relative error of $2.3\times10^{-7}$ on the Mamba-1 family where it is exact, the instrument predicts a layer's deployed pruning error to a median relative deviation of $5\times10^{-7}$ over $4{,}464$ configurations, its floor set by the reconstruction. Applying the instrument across the Mamba-1 family (130M--2.8B), the deployed 7B Falcon-Mamba, and Mamba-2, we find that trained models re-allocate their state space with the input: which modes carry the signal migrates across contexts, and at the most affected layers a per-input oracle roughly halves the output error of a fixed mode set. Frozen-signal counterfactuals attribute the migration primarily to the input-dependent write map $B_t$; the timestep usually identified with selectivity carries almost none of it. Input-scheduled mode pruning on this measurement outperforms static, Hankel-based, and layer-adaptive rankings at every scale from 130M to the deployed 7B Falcon-Mamba, and at half the state budget it matches the unpruned model. Because the scheduler reads each window's mode usage from a first pass, this demonstrates realizable headroom; we claim no deployed compute or memory saving.

中文摘要翻译: Mamba等选择性状态空间模型通过一组一阶模态来路由信息，这些模态的输入耦合由学习到的选择机制设定。我们给出了一种精确测量训练模型如何使用这些模态的工具。由于状态矩阵是对角的，每个通道的输出可精确分解为各模态的贡献，而逐(层、通道、窗口)的Gram张量可以在任意预算下离线精确计算丢弃任何模态子集的输出误差。该工具在Mamba-1系列上经验证与参考实现的相对误差为2.3×10⁻⁷（在该系列上为精确值），在4464个配置上预测部署剪枝误差的中位相对偏差为5×10⁻⁷，其下限由重构误差决定。将该工具应用于Mamba-1系列（130M–2.8B）、已部署的7B Falcon-Mamba以及Mamba-2，我们发现训练好的模型会根据输入重新分配其状态空间：承载信号的模态会随上下文迁移，在最受影响的层上，每个输入的oracle大约能将固定模态集的输出误差减半。冻结信号的反事实分析表明，这种迁移主要由输入相关的写映射B_t驱动；通常与选择性相关联的时间步几乎不承担任何作用。基于此测量的输入调度模态剪枝在从130M到已部署7B Falcon-Mamba的各个规模上均优于静态、基于Hankel和层自适应的排序方法，在半状态预算下与未剪枝模型性能相当。由于调度器从第一遍前向传播中读取每个窗口的模态使用率，这展示了可实现的上行空间；我们不声称任何部署计算或内存节省。

</details>


### [410] [Relaxing Faithfulness with Intervention-Only Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11816)
*Bijan Mazaheri,Jiaqi Zhang,Caroline Uhler*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出干预-即时忠实性假设，替代传统忠实性假设，利用硬干预中的信息在允许路径抵消的情况下非参数地识别因果结构，将干预作为因果发现的首要信息源。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统因果发现算法依赖忠实性假设，即因果关联的变量必须表现出统计依赖性。但许多自然系统中存在缓冲和稳定路径的相互抵消，这违反忠实性假设，导致算法错误地移除因果依赖关系。作者认为硬干预中包含的因果连接信息在第一阶段被忽视了。

Method: 提出干预-即时忠实性（intervention-immediacy faithfulness）这一更温和的假设，允许路径抵消存在。基于此假设，利用硬干预中的信息，非参数地识别因果结构。同时定义了当干预范围有限、识别条件不满足时的等价类。

Result: 证明了在干预-即时忠实性假设下，即使存在路径抵消，也能非参数地识别因果结构。干预应作为因果结构信息的主要载体，优先级应高于条件独立性检验。

Conclusion: 干预应取代条件独立性检验，成为因果发现中信息的主要来源。这一范式转变有助于在传统忠实性假设被违反（如路径抵消）的场景下仍能正确识别因果结构。

Original Abstract: Causal discovery algorithms learn a network that describes the causal dependencies among random variables. A common workflow involves first utilizing conditional independence properties on observational data to determine partially directed causal relationships, then applying interventions to orient the unknown causal directions. A critical assumption for the first step is faithfulness: a requirement that causally linked variables exhibit statistical dependence. Many natural systems include buffering and stabilizing pathways that cancel out to achieve systemic robustness. This cancellation of pathways violates faithfulness, leading causal discovery algorithms to incorrectly remove causal dependencies. In this paper, we argue that hard interventions contain information about the presence/absence of causal linkage that is overlooked in the first stage of structure discovery. We show that a mild assumption -- called intervention-immediacy faithfulness -- that allows cancellations, is sufficient to nonparametrically identify causal structures with hard interventions. These results position interventions as the primary carriers of information about causal structure, which should take precedence over conditional independence testing. To flip the paradigm, we also specify equivalence classes when the identification criteria are not met due to limitations in the scope of interventions.

中文摘要翻译: 因果发现算法学习一个描述随机变量间因果依赖关系的网络。常见的工作流程是：首先利用观测数据上的条件独立性性质确定部分有向的因果关系，然后施加干预以确定未知的因果方向。第一步的一个关键假设是忠实性：要求因果关联的变量必须表现出统计依赖性。许多自然系统包含相互抵消以达到系统鲁棒性的缓冲和稳定路径。这种路径抵消违反了忠实性，导致因果发现算法错误地移除因果依赖关系。本文认为，硬干预中包含了在第一阶段结构发现中被忽略的关于因果连接存在与否的信息。我们证明了一个允许抵消存在的温和假设——称为干预-即时忠实性——足以在硬干预条件下非参数地识别因果结构。这些结果将干预定位为因果结构信息的主要载体，其优先级应高于条件独立性检验。为了翻转这一范式，我们还定义了当由于干预范围限制而导致识别条件不满足时的等价类。

</details>


### [411] [Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11826)
*Romain Amigon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种轻量级、节俭的神经架构搜索（NAS）框架，结合Transformer强化学习控制器的全局宏搜索与人工蜂群（ABC）算法的局部微搜索，能够在消费级GPU（RTX 3060）上高效搜索出参数紧凑的深度学习模型，解决了元启发式方法的冷启动问题，并在CIFAR-10和信用卡欺诈检测任务上验证了其有效性和部署可行性。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 传统神经架构搜索（NAS）需要巨大的计算资源（数千GPU天），难以在消费级硬件上普及。本文旨在设计一种能在普通GPU上运行、资源高效的NAS方法，使架构设计民主化。

Method: 提出了一种节俭的模因（memetic）NAS框架，结合了基于强化学习（RL）训练的自回归Transformer控制器（负责全局宏观搜索）与人工蜂群（ABC）算法（负责局部微观挖掘）；并在RL阶段引入动态熵机制以防止性能停滞时的过早收敛，同时通过算法惩罚网络深度来抑制模型臃肿。

Result: 在CIFAR-10上，仅用约174K参数、3小时搜索时间（RTX 3060）即达到84.85%准确率（显著小于ResNet-20）；在信用卡欺诈检测（高度不平衡表格数据）上，以约4.6K参数的紧凑网络达到0.71的F1分数。

Conclusion: 该方法能够生成定制化、可访问、参数高效且适合边缘部署的深度学习模型，有效解决了冷启动和模型臃肿问题。

Original Abstract: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has automated the design of deep learning models but traditionally requires massive computational resources, often measured in thousands of GPU-days. In this paper, we propose a frugal and memetic NAS framework designed to democratize architecture design on consumer-grade hardware. Our approach combines the global macro-search capabilities of an autoregressive Transformer controller, trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL), with the local micro-exploitation of an Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm. To prevent premature convergence during the RL phase, we introduce a dynamic entropy mechanism that forces topological exploration upon detection of performance stagnation. Evaluated on a standard GPU (NVIDIA RTX 3060), our hybrid method effectively resolves the "cold-start" problem inherent in metaheuristics. By algorithmically penalizing network depth, our framework actively mitigates model bloat: on the CIFAR-10 dataset, it discovers an efficient architecture reaching 84.85% accuracy with only $\sim$174,000 parameters (significantly smaller than standard baselines like ResNet-20) in 3 hours of search time. Furthermore, we demonstrate the framework's flexibility by applying it to credit card fraud detection, directly optimizing the F1-Score on highly imbalanced tabular data to reach a F1-Score of 0.71 with a compact network of $\sim$4,600 parameters. These results suggest that our approach can yield tailored, accessible, and highly parameter-efficient deep learning models suitable for edge deployment.

中文摘要翻译: 神经架构搜索（NAS）已实现了深度学习模型的自动化设计，但传统方法通常需要巨大的计算资源，往往以数千GPU天来衡量。本文提出了一种节俭的模因NAS框架，旨在在消费级硬件上实现架构设计的民主化。我们的方法结合了基于强化学习（RL）训练的自回归Transformer控制器的全局宏观搜索能力与人工蜂群（ABC）算法的局部微观挖掘能力。为防止RL阶段过早收敛，我们引入了一种动态熵机制，该机制在检测到性能停滞时会强制进行拓扑探索。在标准GPU（NVIDIA RTX 3060）上的评估表明，我们的混合方法有效解决了元启发式方法中固有的"冷启动"问题。通过算法惩罚网络深度，我们的框架主动缓解了模型臃肿：在CIFAR-10数据集上，它仅用约174,000个参数（远小于ResNet-20等标准基线）和3小时搜索时间就发现了一个高效架构，准确率达到84.85%。此外，我们通过将该框架应用于信用卡欺诈检测，直接优化高度不平衡表格数据的F1分数，以约4,600个参数的紧凑网络达到了0.71的F1分数，展示了其灵活性。这些结果表明，我们的方法可以生成定制化、可访问且参数高效的深度学习模型，适合边缘部署。

</details>


### [412] [Inside the Unfair Judge: A Mechanistic Interpretability Account of LLM-as-Judge Bias](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11871)
*Zixiang Xu,Sixian Li,Huaxing Liu,Xiang Wang,Shuai Li,Zirui Song,Xiuying Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出从表征层面（隐藏状态几何结构）理解LLM-as-judge的评分偏差，而非仅从输入输出层面分析。研究发现偏差在激活空间中沿低维、类型特定的子空间分布，通过因果控制可双向调节评分，且线性投影可预测模型在未见基准上的失败。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有LLM作为评判者的偏差研究主要停留在输入输出层面（扰动输入、测量分数差异、提出提示词层面的缓解方法），缺乏对偏差内部表征机制的理解。作者认为偏差在评判模型的隐藏状态中存在表征层面的解释，这能补充输入输出视角并提供其无法实现的操作性用途。

Method: 在7个评判模型、7种偏差类型、9个基准上，采用三种方法：1) 几何分析：研究基线输入与偏差输入在激活空间中的流形分布；2) 因果控制：沿偏差子空间操控隐藏状态以双向调节评分；3) 操作性预测：通过线性投影到偏差方向特征来预测评判模型在未见基准上的失败。

Result: 1) 基线评判输入占据紧凑的激活流形，偏差输入沿低维、类型特定的子空间位移，该子空间随层深而锐化；2) 沿该子空间操控隐藏状态可双向驱动评分，正向重现偏差评分，反向恢复基线评分，随机方向的效果小一个数量级；3) 线性投影到偏差方向特征可显著优于基于文本的方法，预测模型在三个完全未见基准上的失败。

Conclusion: 将偏差理解为激活几何结构而非输入输出噪声，能够在统一的框架下整合几何结构、因果控制和操作性预测，为理解和缓解LLM评判偏差提供了新的表征层面视角。

Original Abstract: Existing studies of LLM-as-judge scoring bias work predominantly at the input-output level: they perturb inputs, measure score deltas, and propose prompt-level mitigations. We argue that the same biases admit a representation-level account in the judge's hidden state, complementary to the input-output view and operationally useful in ways it does not afford. We report three findings, across seven judges, seven bias types, and nine benchmarks. Geometry: baseline judging inputs occupy a tight activation manifold while biased inputs are displaced along a low-dimensional, type-specific subspace that sharpens with depth and is recovered consistently by three families of estimators. Causal control: steering hidden states along this subspace drives scoring in both directions, forward shifts reproducing biased scoring on clean inputs and reverse shifts restoring baseline scoring on biased ones, while matched-norm random directions produce shifts an order of magnitude smaller. Operational: a simple linear projection onto the same bias-direction features anticipates judge failures on three entirely unseen benchmarks, substantially outperforming text-based alternatives. Reading bias as activation geometry, rather than as input-output noise, unifies geometric structure, causal control, and operational prediction within a single framework. The project page is available at https://xzx34.github.io/unfair-judge/

中文摘要翻译: 现有的关于大语言模型作为评判者（LLM-as-judge）评分偏差的研究主要集中在输入输出层面：它们扰动输入、测量分数差异，并提出提示词层面的缓解措施。我们认为，同样的偏差在评判模型的隐藏状态中存在表征层面的解释，这既能补充输入输出视角，又能提供其无法实现的操作性用途。我们在7个评判模型、7种偏差类型和9个基准上报告了三个发现。几何结构：基线评判输入占据紧凑的激活流形，而偏差输入沿低维、类型特定的子空间发生位移，该子空间随网络深度加深而锐化，且能被三类估计器一致地恢复。因果控制：沿该子空间操控隐藏状态可双向驱动评分，正向移动在干净输入上重现偏差评分，反向移动在偏差输入上恢复基线评分，而匹配范数的随机方向产生的偏移小一个数量级。操作性：将简单的线性投影作用于同一偏差方向特征，可预测评判模型在三个完全未见基准上的失败，显著优于基于文本的替代方法。将偏差理解为激活几何结构而非输入输出噪声，在统一的框架下整合了几何结构、因果控制和操作性预测。项目页面见 https://xzx34.github.io/unfair-judge/

</details>


### [413] [Invariant Learning Dynamics of Transformers in Inductive Reasoning Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11875)
*Tiberiu Musat,Tiago Pimentel,Nicholas Zucchet,Thomas Hofmann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一个理论框架来解释Transformer语言模型中归纳推理能力的涌现，将训练动力学约束在低维不变流形上，从而可解释地刻画了上下文学习与权重学习之间的竞争、随机初始化对获胜电路的影响，以及电路自动检测。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有关于Transformer学习动力学的研究大多局限于特定任务，缺乏统一的、可泛化的理论框架来理解归纳推理能力的涌现机制。

Method: 定义了一类统一的归纳任务（包括上下文n-gram和多跳推理），理论证明了注意力模型的训练动力学可以约束在一个低维不变流形上，在该流形上学习动力学仅由少量可解释坐标捕获，而非数百万参数。

Result: 1) 刻画了数据统计如何控制上下文学习与权重学习之间的竞争；2) 揭示了随机初始化如何决定存在多个解时的“获胜”电路；3) 证明了流形上的坐标框架可用于自动检测已训练的模型中学到了哪些电路。

Conclusion: 将电路形成视为低维动力学现象，朝着建立Transformer学习的预测性理论迈出了一步。

Original Abstract: We present a theoretical framework to explain the emergence of inductive reasoning abilities in Transformer language models. While previous works on Transformer learning dynamics have so far been mostly tied to specific tasks, we study a generalized class of inductive tasks that unifies several synthetic tasks known in the literature, including in-context n-grams and multi-hop reasoning. In this class, we theoretically prove that the training dynamics of attention models can be confined to a highly interpretable, low-dimensional invariant manifold. On this manifold, the learning dynamics are captured by a handful of interpretable coordinates rather than millions of parameters, making both theoretical and empirical analysis more tractable. Using this framework, we characterize how data statistics govern the competition between in-context and in-weights learning, we study how random initializations determine the `winning' circuit when multiple solutions are possible, and we demonstrate that the coordinate frame associated with the manifold can be used to automatically detect which circuits have been learned in trained models. By casting circuit formation as a low-dimensional dynamical phenomenon, we take a step toward a predictive theory of how Transformers learn.

中文摘要翻译: 我们提出了一个理论框架来解释Transformer语言模型中归纳推理能力的涌现。先前关于Transformer学习动力学的研究大多局限于特定任务，而我们研究了一类广义的归纳任务，它统一了文献中已知的若干合成任务，包括上下文n-gram和多跳推理。在该类任务中，我们从理论上证明了注意力模型的训练动力学可以约束在一个高度可解释的低维不变流形上。在该流形上，学习动力学仅由少量可解释坐标而非数百万参数所捕获，这使得理论和实证分析都更加易于处理。利用这一框架，我们刻画了数据统计如何控制上下文学习与权重学习之间的竞争，研究了随机初始化如何在存在多个可能解时决定“获胜”电路，并证明了与该流形相关联的坐标框架可用于自动检测训练模型中哪些电路已被学习。通过将电路形成视为低维动力学现象，我们向建立Transformer学习的预测性理论迈进了一步。

</details>


### [414] [Requential Coding: Pushing the Limits of Model Compression with Self-Generated Training Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2607.11883)
*Shikai Qiu,Marc Finzi,Yujia Zheng,Kun Zhang,Andrew Gordon Wilson*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为“requential coding”的新型压缩框架，通过教师模型从学生自身分布中选择训练样本来构建编码，实现了独立于参数数量和数据熵的代码长度，在压缩效率和泛化保证上显著优于现有方法。

<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>

Motivation: 现有压缩方法存在局限：基于参数的方法（如量化）的代码长度随模型规模缩放，无法反映参数实际存储的信息量；前置编码（prequential coding）虽压缩训练轨迹，但需编码完整数据序列，当数据熵高时代码长度很大。需要一种能真正反映模型学习到的规律性、且代码长度与参数规模和数据熵无关的压缩方法。

Method: 提出requential coding：教师模型从学生自身分布中选择训练样本，学生代码仅记录这些选择，只在教师与学生意见不一致处产生比特开销。由此得到的代码长度独立于参数数量和数据熵。

Result: 1）Requential代码长度通常比前置编码短数个数量级，且优势随规模增长而扩大；2）在损失固定的情况下，更大模型和集成模型尽管参数更多，但压缩后尺寸更小；3）应用于PAC-Bayes边界，在十亿参数级大语言模型上取得了最优泛化保证，即使零误差也优于基于量化后量化的边界；4）在计算最优区间，边界随规模增长而收紧；5）预测多轮训练会导致逐渐过拟合；6）能够将数据集中可学习信息与不可预测的随机内容分离，发现低熵文本比高熵图像数据包含更多可学习结构。

Conclusion: Requential coding是一种高效的压缩框架，能揭示先前压缩方法无法触及的现象，在模型规模不断增大的背景下具有显著优势，并为大模型的泛化理论提供了更紧的界。

Original Abstract: Compression is fundamental to intelligence. A model that can represent its training data as a short code has discovered regularities that enable generalization. Large neural networks may learn functions far simpler than their parameter counts suggest, but it is challenging to construct codes that realize this simplicity. Parameter-based methods such as quantization produce code lengths that scale with model size, insensitive to how much information the parameters store. Prequential coding bypasses this issue by compressing the training trajectory, but codes the exact data sequence regardless of how much the model learns, yielding large codes when the data has high entropy. We introduce requential coding, where a teacher model selects training samples drawn from the student's own distribution. The student's code records only these selections, which cost bits only where teacher and student disagree. The resulting code length is independent of parameter count and data entropy, and often orders of magnitude shorter than the prequential counterpart, with an advantage that grows with scale. This compression sheds light on phenomena inaccessible to prior compressors. Holding loss fixed, larger models and ensembles compress to much smaller sizes despite more parameters. Plugged into a PAC-Bayes bound, the requential code yields state-of-the-art generalization guarantees for billion-parameter LLMs, outperforming bounds built on aggressive post-training quantization even granted zero error. The bound tightens with scale in the compute-optimal regime, as models become increasingly compressible relative to dataset size. The same code predicts that models gradually overfit when trained for multiple epochs. It also isolates the learnable information in a dataset from its unpredictable, random content, revealing that lower-entropy text holds far more learnable structure than higher-entropy image data.

中文摘要翻译: 压缩是智能的基础。一个能够将其训练数据表示为短编码的模型，已经发现了能够实现泛化的规律性。大型神经网络可能学习到远比其参数数量所暗示的更简单的函数，但构建能实现这种简单性的编码具有挑战性。基于参数的方法（如量化）产生的代码长度随模型规模缩放，对参数存储的信息量不敏感。前置编码通过压缩训练轨迹绕过了这一问题，但它编码的是精确的数据序列，无论模型学到了多少，当数据具有高熵时都会产生较大的代码长度。我们引入了后置编码，其中教师模型从学生自身的分布中选择训练样本。学生的代码仅记录这些选择，其比特开销仅发生在教师和学生意见不一致之处。由此得到的代码长度独立于参数数量和数据熵，并且通常比前置编码短数个数量级，且这种优势随规模增长而扩大。这种压缩揭示了先前压缩方法无法触及的现象。在损失固定的情况下，更大模型和集成模型尽管参数更多，但压缩后的尺寸却小得多。将后置编码应用于PAC-Bayes边界，在十亿参数的大语言模型上取得了最优的泛化保证，即使允许零误差，也优于基于激进的后训练量化的边界。在计算最优区间，边界随规模增长而收紧，因为模型相对于数据集大小变得日益可压缩。同样的编码还预测，在多轮训练中模型会逐渐过拟合。它还能将数据集中的可学习信息与不可预测的随机内容分离开来，揭示出低熵文本比高熵图像数据包含远更多的可学习结构。

</details>
